items.quote: So, I think our growth may -- the insulin market growth may be a little bit declining in the..... because of the initiation phase, which was taken by the GLP-1, but as time progresses, you will see that a higher single-digit growth of insulin will continue, but when you talk about analogs, you see a double -digit growth and irrespective of GLP -1 that double -digit growth has been sustained.

items.statement: Partnership business faces aggressive competition in generic CV/CNS portfolio; structural catch-up may take until 2027
items.quote: But still, you know, the competition in the market is quite aggressive in this portfolio. So, maybe 2026, I don't I'm not expecting that we'll reach the industry growth. 2027, this is what we -- where we are evaluating right now.

items.statement: Real-world evidence studies (4 publications Q4-Q2) strengthening Toujeo and Soliqua positioning in Indian guidelines
items.quote: So, we have Soliqua and Toujeo real world experience publications, which were closer to four between quarter four to quarter two of this year. Landmark real world evidence study, which was a scientific evidence of dissemination and KOL advocacy.

items.statement: Evaluating parent pipeline for diabetes innovations; currently focused on innovative devices (Bluetooth, AI platforms) for insulin delivery
items.quote: Currently we are evaluating whatever comes in the pipeline for diabetes, surely India will be a place to really focus upon. For this moment, whatever is available is the innovative devices, Bluetooth devices, AI platforms.

items.statement: Partnership business grew 2% in Q2 FY26; Amaryl (OAD) with Emcure meeting market growth; CV/CNS with Cipla lagging but reorganizing
items.quote: And if you look at the last changes which we did in the partnership is the with Amaryl in with Emcure, and today when we look at -- we just divide it and look at OAD segment, for example the sales out from the partner in Emcure is meeting the market growth, which gives us a very promising kind of a direction that we are on a right track.

items.statement: Partners Emcure and Cipla have dedicated standalone teams for Sanofi products; no diversion to their own new products
items.quote: No, that can, we can tell you very clearly, as a partnership it's a win -win, and Emcure is really invested as we are invested, while the other products which they are bringing in have a separate team, but they have a team which is standalone team for Amaryl and also for the CV portfolio.

items.statement: CSR reaching 600,000+ direct beneficiaries by end 2026; expanded KiDS and Mobile Medical Units to Madhya Pradesh via NHM MoU
items.quote: By end of this year, around 600,000 plus direct beneficiaries will be reached with different programs, example, Ki DS & Diabetes in Schools, as well as Mobile Medical Units. And we recently added an MoU signature with NHM in MP

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance Rs 1,400-1,600 crore with EBITDA around 10%
items.quote: We expect revenue for Financial Year '27 to be in the range of Rs 1,400 to Rs 1,600 crores, based on the current pricing environment, with EBITDA in the region of 10%.

items.statement: Domestic volumes double-digit growth supported by GST 2.0 implementation
items.quote: Domestic volumes registered double -digit growth supported by improved demand from the implementation of GST 2.0.

items.statement: Export volumes single-digit growth from customer engagement conversion
items.quote: Export volumes also recorded single-digit growth driven by successful conversion of ongoi ng customer engagements into business gains and continued traction in international markets.

items.statement: Tyre industry healthy domestic demand from replacement and OEM offtake
items.quote: The tyre industry continued to witness healthy domestic demand during the quarter, supported by strong replacement demand and healthy OEM offtake across both the passenger and commercial vehicle segments.

items.statement: Non-tyre segment temporary demand contraction due to input cost spike and labor shortage
items.quote: We did see a temporary demand contraction in the non-tyre segment due to lower production on account of a sharp increase in input costs and shortage of labor due to the cooking gas shortages during the quarter.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs 45 crore, margin 11.2%, up 210 bps YoY and 480 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 stood at 11.2%, expanding by 210 basis points YoY compared to Q1 FY26, and by 480 basis points QoQ compared to Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Full year EBITDA expected to hover around 10% with volume growth and operating leverage
items.quote: So, like I mentioned in my speech, while there could be a bit of small adjustments in the EBITDA, overall, for the year with the combination of the volume growth also kind of kicking in as well as operating leverages, we expect to hover around 10% of EBITDA.

items.statement: Deferred volumes from supply constraints expected to recover in coming quarters
items.quote: We continue to work closely with our suppliers and logistics partners to normalize supplies and execute the pending orders, and we remain confident of recovering the deferred volumes in the coming quarters.

items.statement: New Rs 130 crore Dahej investment progressing well despite war disruptions
items.quote: Our new Rs 130 crore investment in Dahej is also progressing well, and our teams have done a great job of keeping it on track in spite of the challenges and disruptions we have been witnessing on account of the war in the last few months.

items.statement: TDQ plant trial production underway, customer samples initiated, commercial ramp-up over time
items.quote: Trial production at our new TDQ plant in Dahej is coming along well with initiation of samples to customers. As approvals progress and commercial supplies ramp up over time, we believe this investment will further reinforce our competitive position in the market.

items.statement: TDQ plant approvals take 6-8 months, volumes trickling in Q4 FY27, material in Q1 FY28
items.quote: So, the approvals are expected, so it takes typically about six to eight months, right, which we have been talking, sometimes even lesser. So, we should seeing it start trickling in Quarter 4, but more into going into Quarter 1 of next year is when I see the numbers coming in.

items.statement: Revenue growth driven by volume growth and selling price increases from raw material cost pass-through
items.quote: We started Financial Year '27 on a strong note with revenue from operations reaching Rs. 403 crores, reflecting an impressive 20% year -on-year growth driven by growing volumes and increase in selling prices on account of increase in raw material costs.

items.statement: Realization moderation expected from Q1 levels but supported by product mix and domestic accelerator pricing
items.quote: So, it is a combination of all, which is surely, like you mentioned, we will have to get also realistic, there is expected to be some moderation, it will not be at the same level that Quarter 1, but there will be some moderation.

items.statement: Utility costs inflated due to Middle East crisis gas price spike and availability issues
items.quote: We were all aware the gas prices went up significantly because of the Middle East crisis. Gas availability issue was there. Operational constraints were imposed by the regulatory bodies because we have to operate the plant at certain throughput rates.

items.statement: Freight rates increased due to Middle East war logistics challenges
items.quote: As we witnessed the Middle East war crisis, we had logistic challenges. Obviously, the freight rates went up. So, there was some increase on account of that.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty approved on Sulphonamides (CBS and NS) effective 20 June 2026
items.quote: The Central Government has approved the imposition of anti-dumping duty on Sulphonamides, covering both CBS and NS on 20th June 2026.

items.statement: DGTR positive final recommendation on Pilflex 13 in June 2026, awaiting Government approval
items.quote: On the other product front, the Pilflex 13 the Director General of Trade Remedies, DGTR, issued a positive final recommendation in June 2026. The implementation of the anti -dumping duty on Pilflex 13 is now subject to the approval of the Government of India.

items.statement: Pilflex 13 ADD decision expected by end of September 2026 within 90-day statutory window
items.quote: And typically, these powers are exercised within a window of 90 days as per the statute. So, today we cannot comment what is the view of Central Government because it's purely discretionary in their regime. We are hopeful we will make adequate representation wherever it is needed to substantiate our case. Now we will wait for the outcome maybe by the end of September.

items.statement: Export volume mix 33%, domestic 67% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: In the 1st Quarter, we see exports about roughly 33% and domestic 67%.

items.statement: Export share directionally targeting 40-45% over next few years
items.quote: Directionally, you are right Aditya, that's the way it will go on. So, yes, because also from our presence in the international markets, that will be the direction it will go. Yes.

items.statement: INR depreciation vs USD and CNY not yielding significant competitive benefit
items.quote: Not any significant change, Praveen. We have not, yes, you are absolutely right on the data points that you mentioned. But we have not seen a significant impact on account of that.

items.statement: Specialty segment currently ~15% of revenue, expected to add 5-10% from new expansion
items.quote: Yes, so that should add to that. So, I would expect at least another 5% to 10%, we should see an additional.

items.statement: ADD coverage on CBS-NS and Pilflex 13 covers 25-30% of top line excluding TDQ
items.quote: So, this would be totally about 25% to 30%.

items.statement: China Sunshine adding accelerator capacity, but anti-dumping duty now in place provides protection
items.quote: Yes, so that was also one of the reasons that we had approached for the anti -dumping on the accelerators. So, those capacities you are referring to was also one of the intermediates to the main accelerators. And so, we have a position both not only in domestic, but also with international customers on that front. And we are able to compete at this point with also the anti-dumping duty now that is

items.statement: Chinese players adjusting yuan prices downwards, rubber chemicals still enjoy export subsidies
items.quote: Yes, that is right. And still, I think Rubber Chemicals is still a product group that still enjoys the export subsidies.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty continues on raw material pricing and availability
items.quote: Yes, so there is continued uncertainty definitely on the front of raw materials. I think you have to take those calls because it does keep moving up and down, like it has happened in the last few weeks, depending on the geopolitical situation.

items.statement: Stock change of Rs 45 crore in Q1 FY27 impacted conversion cost
items.quote: We also had a manufacturing improvement in volume terms. If you see in the stock change, there is Rs. 45 crores related to the stock change. So, that also played a role.

items.statement: Expect commodity and feedstock inflation impact to become more visible in Q3
items.quote: We, therefore, expect the impact of commodity and feedstock inflation to become more visible in the third quarter.

items.statement: EBITDA margin approximately 26% for Q2 and 24% for H1 FY26
items.quote: This translates to an EBITDA margin of approximately 26% for the quarter and 24% for the first half.

items.statement: Guided EBITDA margin range of 21% to 24%
items.quote: We are guided by our pricing actions by 2 things. One is our outlook on raw material prices / cost, and the second is our direction on maintaining our EBITDA margin at 21% to 24%.

items.statement: Implemented two price increases in low double digits during January to June
items.quote: In the quarter, which is the April to June quarter, we have taken pricing action, which are in low double digit. And with that, there are 2 price increases that we have implemented this year, January to June.

items.statement: Prepared to take further pricing action if raw material costs or forex move adversely
items.quote: If the volatility increases or if facts change, then we stand prepared to take whatever other pricing action is required.

items.statement: Broad-based volume growth across consumer, industrial, and institutional businesses
items.quote: We delivered another strong quarter with broad-based growth across our consumer, industrial, and institutional business.

items.statement: Rural business continues to grow at double digits
items.quote: The rural business continues to grow at double digits.

items.statement: Power brand grew ahead of rest of business supporting healthier portfolio mix
items.quote: In personal mobility, our power brand grew ahead of the rest of the business, supporting a healthier portfolio mix and demonstrating consumers' preference for high-performance lubricants.

items.statement: Expanded fully synthetic range with new variants in Activ, GTX, and GTX 0W-20
items.quote: We expanded our fully synthetic range. We introduced premium variants in Castrol Activ. It's called Castrol Activ Synthetic 10W-30 and 5W-30 visco metrics. We upgraded GTX 5W-30 to a fully synthetic product positioning, and introduced a full synthetic under GTX 0W-20.

items.statement: Expanded auto care range to 40,000 outlets; 34,000 motorcycle workshops and 16,000 car workshops in service ecosystem
items.quote: We expanded availability of our auto care range to 40,000 outlets and strengthened our service ecosystem with 34,000 independent motorcycle workshops and 16,000 car workshops.

items.statement: Castrol-branded auto service (CAS) network now 850 strong; rural distribution at 45,000 outlets with 950 rural service express
items.quote: The Castrol-branded auto service, CAS, is now 850 strong. Our rural distribution continues to expand. We are now at about 45,000 outlets, and on that, we are now at 950 rural service express, which cater to bikes.

items.statement: Annual capex around INR 100 crores split roughly half between manufacturing and market visibility
items.quote: We do spend our capital, either in our manufacturing units to make sure that they have the latest standards of health and safety or for capacity expansion, et cetera, and we spend our capital in market to make sure that we have the right level of visibility for our dealers as well as the workshops. So that continues to be in the range as we always declare for the year that we spend about INR100 cr

items.statement: Lean inventory profile with fast churn; inventory for Q3 bought towards end of Q2 at higher prices
items.quote: I think we pride ourselves on a very lean inventory profile. So, we do churn our inventory fast, and that's why we are already planning for the inventory that we will use in 3Q to be that which has been bought towards the end of second quarter.

items.statement: Interim dividend of INR 6.25 per share declared, payable on or before 2nd September 2026
items.quote: The Board this quarter has declared an interim dividend of INR6.25 per share, which will be payable on or before 2nd September 2026.

items.statement: Dividend yield usually around 5% combining interim and final; special dividends paid occasionally
items.quote: past many years, we've followed windows to split our dividend into one interim and one final. And usually, we're a cash-generating business, and we like to reward our shareholders with a healthy dividend payout. While we don't have a call pay number, you would see that our dividend yields are usually in the range of around 5% when I accumulate the interim and final dividend

items.statement: Industrial business contributes ~15% of revenue, growing at high double digits for last couple of years
items.quote: Industrial business, as you would remember in the past, we've spoken about it, has contributed about 15% of our overall business. It is growing faster than the rest of the company, and hence that percentage slowly will increase, but it is still in that ballpark range.

items.statement: Data center cooling not material yet; products ready for both immersion and direct-to-chip; trials ongoing with some business won
items.quote: We have products that apply for both. From a competitor set, there are lubricant companies which operate in this space. There are also other chemical companies that operate with fluids in that space.

items.statement: Most passenger car brands already compliant with E20 fuel requirements
items.quote: I would also add a quick one, which is most of our brands in the passenger car business are already compliant with the requirements of operating with an E20 fuel into the engine.

items.statement: Cautious outlook due to higher inflationary pressures, uneven monsoon, and continued commodity volatility
items.quote: Looking ahead, we remain cautious given higher inflationary pressures, uneven monsoon conditions, and continued volatility in key commodities.

items.statement: BP divesting 65% of global Castrol to Stonepeak; deal progressing with licenses across countries; open offer timeline depends on deal closure
items.quote: BP announced as a part of its strategic review that they would divest 65% share of the global Castrol company, and Stonepeak emerged as the lead bidder. The transaction currently is progressing well, and Stonepeak is in the process of getting the right licenses and operating methods across the entire country, across the entire world, which is many countries.

items.statement: Paharpur plant completed 9 years and Silvassa 3 years without significant recordable incident; Silvassa received NAMC Gold Award
items.quote: Our Paharpur plant completed 9 years, and Silvassa 3 years, without any significant recordable incident. Silvassa plant also received the NAMC Gold Award, and Castrol India received a Special Jury Award for championing sustainable procurement practices.

items.statement: Silvassa plant temporarily ceased operations in July due to heavy rainfall; fully back up with no impact on operations
items.quote: Earlier in July, which is after the close of second quarter, there were a couple of days where there was very heavy rainfall in Silvassa. We had ceased operation of our plant at that point in time, in the interest of safety. But I'm pleased to say that the plant is fully back up.

items.statement: OCI loss of INR 66 crores due to revaluation of Ki Mobility investment based on external market comparables
items.quote: It is a revaluation of our investment into Ki Mobility. You would recall that the company had made this investment close to about 4 years ago. And our accounting policy guides us that we must revalue this asset every 6 months, and the method of revaluation is really based on external markets.

items.statement: Revenue target of INR 1,000 crores by FY29-30 through organic growth
items.quote: The company looks at growing to INR 1,000 crores by 2029-'30. And that growth is going to be very organic coming from its existing product basket.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target to reach sustainable double digits of 10-13%
items.quote: Target margins are to stabilize and take the EBITDA margins to a sustainable double digit, grow it from a 10% to 11% and going up to 13% and keep it sustainably consistent at those levels.

items.statement: Expect to reach 10% EBITDA margin in FY27
items.quote: So hopefully, yes, we can go up to -- we are trying to get into 10% this year.

items.statement: Capex of INR 30-40 crores over next 3-4 years for capacity expansion and Thane plant shift
items.quote: We are looking at around another INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores capex and going up to INR 1,000 crores over the next three to four years.

items.statement: FY27 capex estimated at INR 5-10 crores for new product lines and MIG wire expansion
items.quote: This year, I think we're looking at around INR 5 crores to INR 7 crores, because as I mentioned -- or going up to INR 10 crores, because as I mentioned, we've already set up two product vertical lines, and we're also looking at expanding the MIG wire product line.

items.statement: Current capacity 59,000 MT, expanding to 71,000 MT with wire capacity additions
items.quote: And then we are increasing it up by 20,000 metric ton to 70,000 metric tons. So, that 20,000 metric ton is majorly going to be the wire capacity addition that you just spoke about.

items.statement: Flux cored wire capacity of 300 MT set up, targeting 1,000 MT by FY29
items.quote: Right now we have already set up a production line of flux cored wire around 300 metric tons. Our plan, once it is properly set, our plan is to go up to 1000 tons.

items.statement: Received orders from 3-4 major players for nuclear sector after NPCIL approval
items.quote: Even we are also expecting an inquiry from MEIL Hyderabad. So, there are 7 or 8 good potential vendors. They are in process to inspect our plant and start the work. We have already received orders also from 3-4 major players.

items.statement: Nuclear power capacity expected to triple to 22 GW by 2031-32, with 14 lakh crore government outlay
items.quote: India today has a capacity of around 8.8 gigawatts of nuclear power capacity, which is expected to triple by 2031-'32, but eventually go up to 100 gigawatts by 2047. And to even achieve these numbers, the government of India has not only outlaid around 14 lakh crores for this CapEx.

items.statement: Infrastructure boom with 1.4 trillion national infra pipeline driving welding consumable demand
items.quote: The infrastructure growth, of course, with the government's imperative on infrastructure growth with 1.4 trillion national infra pipeline, metros, power, railways, that is going to, as I mentioned in the previous slide also on the key sectors the growth in the steel, the oil and gas defence and energy.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved 204 bps to 7.8% from 5.7% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA again went up by around 77% from INR 4 crores, INR 4.5 crores to INR 8 crores. And the EBITDA margin going up by 204 basis points from 5.7% to 7.8%.

items.statement: Niche products contribute 27-30% of revenue with higher margins than commodity products
items.quote: So currently around 27% to 30% would come from the niche product category. And of course, the larger chunk coming from the commodity products.

items.statement: Expanding into SAW wire, SAW flux, flux cored wire, stainless steel wires, and specialty alloys
items.quote: So, yes, this slide of the presentation shows that what are the verticals that we are looking forward to expand in the organic, via the organic methodology is the stainless steel wires, which the company already has production capacity, also expand that vertical. Saw wires and saw flux, we've already started with commercial production in this quarter. Flux core wire is another vertical which is th

items.statement: Empanelled with key B2B clients including BHEL, L&T, JCB, Adani, ONGC, NPCIL, Indian Railways, and defence sector
items.quote: We work very closely with all the leading B2B companies like BHEL, L&T, JCB, Adani, ONGC. So, all the sectors actually primarily, I will just give quickly that any and every sector that employs -- uses metal, be it steel, be it any other metal has to use welding consumable and that is exactly where we play our part.

items.statement: Only 3 NPCIL-certified players: D&H Sécheron, Ador, and GEE; early mover advantage in nuclear
items.quote: Currently, I would say with NPCIL, I think it is D&H Sécheron and Ador who are certified and GEE. It's only these players who are certified by NPCIL.

items.statement: Export orders received from Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, Russia, Bahrain, Muscat, Dubai; targeting Europe via German Rail TUV approval
items.quote: This year you will see we are actually targeting export market and we are getting good feedback. This year we have already received orders from various countries. From Vietnam, Saudi and Russia also. Russia already our distributor is trying to get the NAKS approval.

items.statement: Current working capital limits INR 100 crores with comfortable headroom; no incremental limits needed for next year
items.quote: So currently, the working capital limits are around INR 100 crores. The company, as I mentioned, has comfortable headroom space in that area. So, we are not looking at incremental working capital limits in the next one year.

items.statement: No term loans on books; only working capital limits; interest cost reduced from 2.4% to 1.8% YoY
items.quote: So, there is no existing term loan on the company's books. There's only a working capital limit that the company utilises, which also we have a fairly comfortable headroom space with the banks.

items.statement: Thane land monetization expected to generate INR 400 crores over 5 years via area-sharing revenue model
items.quote: By this action, the company intends to unlock the value of that parcel of land and monetize it. So, the cash flow is coming from it approximately INR 400 crores over the next five years is where the company looks at going ahead and doing some inorganic growth.

items.statement: Inorganic growth from INR 1,000 to 2,000 crores via acquisitions in welding equipment, specialty electrodes, and complementary consumables
items.quote: So, welding equipments and systems is going to be a key product category that we have already enlisted and we have already earmarked for acquisitions. We're also looking at speciality and hard facing electrodes that are high margin consumables and that will improve the overall product mix of the company.

items.statement: Industry size INR 12,000-13,000 crores with shift from unorganized to organized certified players
items.quote: The industry itself today is at around crores INR 12,000 crores to INR 13,000 crores and with a huge chunk of it in the unorganized sector, which more and more with time it is shifting towards the organized sectors with certified players supplying.

items.statement: Promoter share pledge of INR 40 crores for personal loan settlement; timeline 3-4 years to free pledged shares
items.quote: So, the pledge has been done for personal, regarding the settlement of personal loan that the promoters had to take. And the timeline for the same or another three to four years, we'll be slowly reaping and freeing the share pledge.

items.statement: Thane plant shifting to be completed by end of September 2026
items.quote: Oh, we are already in process. I think by end of September, it will be completed.

items.statement: Shipbuilding revenue expected 3-5% from flux cored wires; nuclear revenue target 10% by FY29-30
items.quote: At least I would say, we should be doing at least 10% of our business from nuclear. This is what we envisage. And from shipbuilding now, shipbuilding business will also be going to start take up for which the major consumption will come from flux cored wires. So once that should also will take care of around 3% to 5% of our revenue.

items.quote: Overall, the EBITDA stood at Rs. 702 million, which is at about 13.6%. In the last quarter, we reported 12.4% EBITDA. The same time last year, we had reported 9.7% EBITDA.

items.statement: Management targets PAT margin band of 7.5%-8.5% for near-term quarters, expects improvement by 2030 with scale benefits

This time our revenue stands at around Rs. 527 crores. But when you ask about on a percentage terms, that is the range, somewhere between 7.5%-8.5% is the margin range that we can at least as an overall band that you can take.

items.statement: Phase-1 and Phase-1(a) capex ~40% complete, production started; targeting 25%-30% capacity improvement over next 2-3 years
items.quote: Roughly, I would say that we are looking at anywhere between 25%-30% capacity improvement.

items.quote: Beginning of this year, we had a projection, which was 15%-20% lower than last year. Just for reference, last year, the industry volume was 480,000. If you do the math, we should be north of 450,000. Best case, same as last year.

items.statement: Q1 M&HCV volumes ~110k vehicles, among highest in several years; delayed monsoon supporting freight and replacement demand
items.quote: Even though we did see a dip, almost like 30%, but that quarter, Q1 ended up to be one of the highest in the past several years at almost 110,000 vehicles in the M&HCV segment.

items.statement: New 160 tandem axle in pilot production with a large customer; bus axle launch delayed to incorporate upcoming pass-by noise norms
items.quote: We are launching a new tandem axles, which is already in pilot batch, and it's getting into production mode as we speak. This is a 160 tandem, so we are launching this with one of the large customers.

items.statement: BS-VI OBD-I/II changes have minimal impact; upcoming AEBS, Type-II Endurance Braking, BS-VII, pass-by noise and HPFE Phase-1B monitored; products aligned for >300 hp trend
items.quote: Going forward in the next four years after 2030, we are anticipating AEBS norms and Type-II Endurance Braking and the BS-VII as well. These three may not have a significant impact on our product lines, but what we are anticipating in addition is the more stringent pass-by noise norms and HPFE Phase-1B.

items.quote: On the steel prices, see all the commodities are always settled back-to-back with the customer. We don't have any impact. Yes, there were some price increases that are there, which we have absorbed this quarter but

items.quote: So, Shikha, our exports are traditionally in the range of 8%-12%. I think that's been what we have seen in the last year. This time we were slightly better off in terms of exports. So, we were at about 13% for the quarter, on the overall pie.

items.statement: Share of business with Ashok Leyland steady; aim for single-source status on new products but OEMs follow dual-sourcing; market share varies monthly by product mix

items.quote: As you can see, Meritor gives us all the new product licensing, and they also help us test those products for India-specific applications. Meritor not only brings in this expertise, both in terms of developing or updating

items.quote: For the Q1 ended June 2026, our revenue from operations stood at Rs. 5,168 million, and we had our other income, which includes treasury and non-treasury income, which is about Rs. 103 million.
