items.quote: Also, like last time we told, just in time, our electrification of one of our furnaces was completed so that also kind of helped us to manage production in spite of we are running with a lower or less availability of LPG.

items.statement: Key risks: monsoon progression, geopolitical tensions affecting freight and cost escalations; defense segment has long gestation (3-10 years) and tender-based uncertainty
items.quote: The headwind is monsoon. We do not know how it is going to play out. Barring that, there is a potential opportunity for us to look at keeping that exports, the sales steady and stronger.

items.statement: Defense revenue 5%-10% of total, varies by tender awards; mining not actively pursued due to low volumes and different product requirements
items.quote: Currently, our presence out of the revenue that we are generating, maybe defense goes 5%-10% depending on how the tenders are awarded. Some years it is lower, some years when the tenders come back-to-back, it can be higher. Coming to mining, that's something we are not really pursuing because the deep mining or the big mining equipments, what we see in India, one, the volumes are very low.

items.statement: Capex for FY27 expected in similar range of 8% to 10% of sales
items.quote: Again, plant-wise breakup we generally do not give. I think directionally it will be very similar numbers what you have explained.

items.statement: Rail plant at Jamshedpur and plain bearings at Bharuch on track
items.quote: As the Chairman explained, the rail plant is on track. The plain bearings, which is going on in our Bharuch factory, that's on track.

items.statement: Bharuch plant SRB utilization at 40-45% in Q1, targeting 70% by Aug-Sep; CRB line lower, ramping by Q2/Q3 end
items.quote: That utilization level in the last quarter would have been anywhere close to 40%-45%, and we expect that to ramp it up to 70%, which Chairman told in the last meeting, in August, September timeframe.

items.statement: Bharuch plant revenue approximately INR50 crore in Q1, growing quarterly, nearing breakeven
items.quote: far as this quarter was concerned, the revenue was approximately in the range of 50 Crore [Inaudible 00:11:53], and we are growing every quarter there. We are almost very close to...breakeven

items.statement: High double-digit revenue growth Y-o-Y driven by resilient demand in core segments
items.quote: We have delivered high double-digit revenue growth this quarter Y-o-Y, driven by resilient demand, especially in the core segments, and our execution both for export and domestic.

items.statement: Process segment grew ~30% Y-o-Y led by metal projects and wind energy; exports to US up 21%
items.quote: On the process side, Y-o-Y it is, I think, almost 30% growth and largely coming from the metal customers as we see a little bit of projects coming into. And there are some companies which are making mills in India and exporting out of India.

items.statement: Railway demand sluggish due to government fund diversion to defence/infra; tenders delayed
items.quote: The government buying for railways is certainly slow. But that is a time issue. Year-on-year, there will be that slow, steady growth.

items.statement: Standalone PBT margin 16.2% in Q1 FY27 vs 16.1% in Q1 FY26; gross margin expanded 100 bps Y-o-Y to 39.9%
items.quote: Our PBT margin was at 16.2%, broadly in line with 16.1% in Q1 '26. It is worth noting that the same quarter last year did not carry depreciation of our new capacity investment, which has since been capitalized.

items.statement: Steel prices up ~INR5,000/ton (INR1,500-1,600 in Jan, INR3,500 in April); LPG to natural gas conversion completed; base oil volatile
items.quote: The steel industry is pushing hard to increase their prices. They have already put some January INR1,500 or INR1,600 per ton, then by April another INR3,500 per ton. So, in totality, so around INR5,000 per ton is already into this.

items.statement: Price hikes passed through in heavy truck and tractor markets; rail and PSU contracts fixed until renewal
items.quote: We are able to pass on certain level of cost escalation, especially in the heavy truck market. There are, like railways, a fixed contract. As we get into the new contracts, then that would start going in.

items.statement: Q1 revenue mix: Rail 22% (INR200 cr), Mobile 20% (INR184 cr), Distribution 17% (INR154 cr), Process 20% (INR186 cr), Exports 22% (INR200 cr)
items.quote: For this quarter, FY27 first quarter, rail stood at INR200 crore, that is 22% of the total INR929. Mobile others was at INR184 crore. Distribution was at INR153.9, which is INR154 almost. Process was INR186. Exports was at almost INR200 crore.

items.statement: Manufactured vs traded mix remains ~75/25
items.quote: It is almost in the similar range, I would say. Though we do not disclose, but I think whatever numbers we gave in the earlier quarters, it's almost in the similar range of 75/25.

items.statement: BIS certification secured for CRB and TRB rollers
items.quote: Also, I am happy to share that during the quarter, we have secured the BIS certification for CRB and CRB rollers and TRB rollers, and we are on the journey to complete that process.

items.statement: Amalgamation of Timken GGB Technology Private Limited with Timken India approved by Board, pending NCLT Bangalore
items.quote: The scheme of amalgamation of Timken GGB Technology Private Limited with Timken India Limited has been approved by the Board earlier and is now with the NCLT, that is the Law Tribunal, Bangalore Bench.

items.statement: India focused on off-highway, rail, heavy truck, tractors; not in passenger cars, 2/3-wheelers; parent's 80/20 strategy to enhance performance
items.quote: As far as India is concerned, we are focused on what we do here. Mobile is almost a 20% market for us, which is tractors, which is heavy truck. As you know, we do not play the commercial vehicle market, I mean to say passenger cars.

items.statement: US market resilient for taper exports; Europe down, ASEAN down, China down, South Africa okay, Australia flat
items.quote: On the intercompany, as you know, that America market is resilient. It is showing nice signs, though Europe and other places, South Africa is okay. Australia is flattish. ASEAN is down. China is down, but the American market is up, and we are supplying tapers to America.

items.statement: Geopolitical challenges and war create uncertainty for exports; steel capacity utilization not full; base oil volatility
items.quote: I believe the new normal, like the post-COVID, this is the new normal that geopolitical challenges and war will be there in bits and pieces. At the same time, life will go on.

items.statement: Management expects 10-15% top-line growth over the next three years, driven by strong export growth.
items.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years. This is what we can say currently right now. And this we have mentioned very clearly on this thing. So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth because certain things sometimes you plan and it's not in your hands.

items.statement: US automotive business expected to grow 60-70% over the next three years, potentially doubling.
items.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right? In terms of US automotive.

items.statement: Current quarter margin of 25%+ is sustainable; last quarter was abnormally high due to forex gains.
items.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%. But last quarter, it was abnormally high because of foreign exchange increase in -- abnormally high increase in fo reign exchange rates. So that was a onetime increase basically. But this present quarter's margin will be sustainable and expected to

items.statement: Management advises taking current 25%+ margin as base; any upside is a bonus.
items.quote: You people have been told that you people should analyst point of view company point of view margin take this margin we're getting now for granted. What's extra, consider that as a bonus.

items.statement: Potential additional capex of INR 250 crores over next two years if greenfield expansion (outside India) is finalized.
items.quote: 2027, 2028 can't tell you exact figure, depends -- if we have taken a final call on putting up a new facility somewhere. So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores. Yes, it will be additional. But we can tell you after taking the final call.

items.statement: New line of 5 lakh meters/month expected to start production by Feb-Mar 2027 at existing facility.
items.quote: So we have already ordered the line for our expansion in our current premises. So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

items.statement: Revenue growth driven by price/mix (export share increase), not raw material pass-through; raw material prices volatile.
items.quote: It's a mix change. Management: It's a mix because not only raw material prices, it is because our export business has grown, so it's a higher price item. So that's the reason for the growth

items.statement: No price hike pushed in US export OEM market yet; 10% natural hedge from USD appreciation; raw material costs remain elevated.
items.quote: So obviously, we have not taken a price increase in the export market but you also have to look at one more thing in this 10% more or less natural hedge has happened. Right? If today I was selling material for US$8 and I was having realization of 85 to 86, so at 94 I was getting a 10% natural hedge.

items.statement: Freight costs increased 4x due to West Asia conflict; raw material prices volatile (spiked in March, softened, then rose again).
items.quote: There are two parts in this. The first one, because of the Gulf War the problem arises that impacted the price in Q1. And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

items.statement: Gaining wallet share with existing US OEMs (Ford, Chrysler); also pursuing new OEMs in Europe and South Africa (BMW, Mercedes).
items.quote: Our share of business in Ford was very less. So we have got good orders from Ford and the business will increase with Ford also and in Chrysler also. So US automotive the business will increase. The Europe automotive sector we have business in South Africa both for BMW and Mercedes.

items.statement: Domestic footwear segment faces intense competition from China; PU plant underutilized due to cost competition.
items.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure. So, there are 2 options. Obviously, I've told in the past also that we are talking to top brands, but sampling is also been done, but no business has been confirmed so far.

items.statement: India FTA seen as positive for export sentiment, especially Europe; may help de-risking procurement from India.
items.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

items.statement: Geopolitical volatility (Trump tariffs, West Asia war, shipping disruptions) delaying greenfield location decision (Mexico, US, NAFTA).
items.quote: So it could be in Mexico, it could be in U.S., it could be in some other NAFTA areas. We are still considering various options, but there's so much of volatility in the market. So it's not easy to decide where exactly we should put the plant right now.

items.statement: Freight costs may normalize if war situation improves; other expenses (INR 9 cr increase) partly recurring, partly one-time.
items.quote: No, we cannot say that this will be continued. But since the situation -- war situation will be improved, then definitely the freight charges may come down.

items.statement: Peak revenue potential from current expansion: INR 250-400 crores incremental annually depending on product mix.
items.quote: So maybe an additional of INR300 crores to INR400 crores, but it depends also a lot on the product mix. So, like are we expanding more on the export front? Or are we expanding more on the domestic front? But anywhere between INR250 crores to INR400 crores could be a figure that you can see depending on the product mix.

items.statement: Chairman Suresh Poddar had slight infection, difficulty speaking on calls, but managing well.
items.quote: He had a slight infection. So obviously he's managing everything well. But he is having a little difficulty in talking on con-call.

items.statement: Other expenses increased INR 9 crores QoQ due to 4x freight costs, travel, legal/professional fees; partly recurring.
items.quote: No, it's mixed reasons. Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account. That expenses have increased in this quarter.

items.statement: CSR: 50,000 plantations done; adopted schools; healthcare, sanitation, family welfare initiatives recognized by state government.
items.quote: Under the corporate social responsibility programs, we have contributed towards regular plantations around 50,000 plants already done and have a plan to do it at larger scale in coming years. The company has also adopted many happy schools for education of children.

items.statement: Private Markets credit book guided to grow 15-20% Y-o-Y; half achieved in Q1
items.quote: what we had guided at the end of quarter 4 was this book should see at least a 15% to 20% growth Y-o-Y. So I think we've almost done half of that growth in the first quarter.

items.statement: Wealth Management net inflows target INR6,000 crores minimum for FY27
items.quote: we are targeting about INR6,000-odd crores at the minimum.

items.statement: Asset Management to invest INR150 crores over next 2 years
items.quote: We have ou tlined INR150 crores investment further into Asset Management over the next 2 years

items.statement: Corporate Advisory pipeline INR220,000 crores including NSE and Jio IPOs; INR150,000 crores excluding them
items.quote: pipeline of transactions is extremely strong with almost INR220,000 crores of pipeline of DRHP filed IPO transactions. The INR220,000 crores number includes filings of National Stock Exchange as well as Jio Platforms.

items.statement: ARC distressed credit portfolio INR3,114 crores after INR1,200 crores recovery and INR600 crores new deployment
items.quote: our distressed credit portfolio was INR3,665 crores at the end of quarter 4 '26, which is now INR3,114 crores. This includes almost INR1,200 crores of recovery and INR600 crores of new transactions done.

items.statement: Private Markets net revenue doubled to INR462 crores; pre-provision operating profit grew 2.3x to INR375 crores
items.quote: Net revenue for Q1 FY27 doubled to INR462 crores and pre-provision operating profit grew almost 2.3x to INR375 crores.

items.statement: ARC wholesale returns 18-22%, retail 15-18%, blended 16-18% IRR
items.quote: ARC wholesale returns are around 18% to 22%. And at the retail asset levels, the returns are around 15% to 18%. So all in all, on average, we're able to clock anywhere between 16% to 18%.

items.statement: July Corporate Advisory revenues already exceed June, signaling recovery
items.quote: The month of July, our revenues on the transaction side in Corporate Advisory and Capital Markets for the month of July already exceed what we have done in June, which is a very, very positive sign.

items.statement: Wealth Management transactional business weak due to low primary market activity
items.quote: performance was a little subdued because of weak transactional business, which is again related to the markets and also the primary market issuance

items.statement: Launched JM Multi Asset Allocation Fund, JM Pre-IPO Fund, JM Credit Fund in Asset Management
items.quote: recently launched JM Multi Asset Allocation Fund. On the AIF front, we launched our JM Pre-IPO fund as well as our JM Credit Fund.

items.statement: Wealth recurring AUM grew to INR33,400 crores; recurring proportion increased to 30%
items.quote: recurring AUM of our wealth business grew to approximately INR33,400 crores. The proportion of recurring to total AUM has now increased to 30%.

items.statement: Affordable Housing business targets separate listing in 2-3 years
items.quote: we focus on listing that separately in a span of 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Wealth Management hired 100+ RMs in last 18 months; RM gestation 2.5-3 years to profitability
items.quote: we hired about 100-plus RMs over the last 18 months. Now the average life of an RM to become profitable is roughly about 2.5 to 3 years.

items.statement: ARC expected to become debt-free with current cash generation and expected flows over next 6 months
items.quote: with this kind of cash that we've generated and the expected cash flows over the next 6 months, our ARC will be debt-free.

items.statement: NBFC dividend payout capped at 50% of PAT by RBI, constraining capital return
items.quote: as per RBI rules, we cannot distribute more than 50% of our PAT out as per the rules.

items.statement: Affordable Home Loans AUM up 28% Y-o-Y to INR3,715 crores; disbursements up 87% Y-o-Y
items.quote: AUM increased by 28% year-on-year to INR3,715 crores. For Q1 FY27, revenue increased by 22% Y-o-Y to INR123 crores and profit after tax and minority interests grew by 16% year-on-year to INR17 crores.

items.statement: Mutual fund non-liquid AUM up 16% Q-o-Q to INR10,900 crores
items.quote: the closing AUM from non-liquid funds showed signs of recovery and stood at approximately INR10,900 crores, up 16% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Wealth loan book grew 43% Y-o-Y to INR2,417 crores
items.quote: Wealth loan book grew by 43% year-on-year to INR2,417 crores

items.statement: Private Markets ROE dragged by low leverage (0.8x) and regulatory payout limits; recovery dependent on syndication ramp
items.quote: the business is immensely profitable. It's just that we are not taking in enough of transactions today and therefore, we don't have a need for leverage. As the syndication business starts ramping, the picture will change.

items.statement: AI adoption early; front-office efficiency limited by buy-side acceptance and regulatory disclosure requirements
items.quote: an AI-driven robot on the sell side is not yet acceptable to buy-side analysts. The day that starts happening, we'll see a tremendous amount of AI efficiency.

items.statement: No plans to enter gold loan business; focus remains on home loans
items.quote: No. So, Manish here from JM Financial Home Loans. Basically, there is no plan today to enter any of this noncore business. As of now, we are concentrating more on the home loans business.

items.statement: Demerger of Wealth and Asset Management evaluated only when more profitable and at scale; tax efficiency a consideration
items.quote: we still feel that compared to our Capital Markets, Corporate Advisory and Private Markets business, Wealth and Asset Management is still smal l. We want to make it larger, give it a lot more scale. And at that point in time we will evaluate whether this business needs to go public or needs to be demerged

items.statement: Management aspires to grow at about 20% in FY27 and FY28 but does not provide formal guidance
items.quote: we've always aspired to grow at about 20%, and we expect that FY 27& FY28 also we expect to grow that way.

items.statement: FY27 expected to be a year of growth; no indication of a flat year like FY25
items.quote: We continue to believe FY27 will be a year of growth for the company and remain focused on prudent financial management, operational excellence and creating long -term value for our stakeholders.

items.statement: Order book from pipeline molecules is encouraging and will pan out over next few quarters
items.quote: Having said that, the order book from pipeline molecules is quite encouraging, and we will see that panning out over the course of the next few quarters.

items.statement: Cash outflow of INR121.6 crores towards capex in Q1FY27, primarily for new R&D and peptide facilities
items.quote: As part of our investment, there was a cash outflow of INR121.6 crores towards capital expenditure during Q1FY27 , which was primarily driven by new R&D and peptide facilities.

items.statement: Approved capital investments of approximately INR203 crores, of which INR196 crores earmarked for strategic growth initiatives largely related to capacity expansion at Unit 1
items.quote: During the quarter, we also approved capital investments of approximately INR203 crores, of which INR196 crores is earmarked for strategic growth initiatives, largely related to capacity expansion at our Unit 1.

items.statement: Total approved capex of INR1,460 crores over last 13 quarters, INR870 crores spent to date, balance committed to projects under implementation
items.quote: Against total approved capex of INR1,460 crores over the last 13 quarters, we have spent INR870 crores to date, with the balance committed towards projects under implementation.

items.statement: Forward capex will be quantitatively higher and qualitatively different, moving into newer complex modalities and potentially overseas investments or M&A
items.quote: So you will see quantitatively more investments, and you will also see a qualitative move towards newer modalities because that's where we believe we have been successful, and that's where we would like to play.

items.statement: Peptide manufacturing plant to be commissioned next month; manufacturing qualification to be done by then; multiple projects lined up at various stages
items.quote: So the plant itself is going to be commissioned next month, and then it will be ready for manufacturing qualification will be done by then. We have multiple projects lined up at various stages.

items.statement: Acquired 6-7 acres adjacent land at Unit 1 for short-term expansion; looking at additional manufacturing sites with larger land parcels for long-term growth beyond 3-4 years
items.quote: we currently operate 3 manufacturing sites. We would be looking at additional manufacturing sites where we would have larger headroom for capacity. Ultimately, for the organizati on to grow beyond the 3-year, 4-year period, we would need to have possession of more industrial land, larger pieces of land, and that is something that you should expect from the company in the near future.

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 35.5% in Q1FY27; long-term expectation is 25%+ EBITDA margin; anything above is a bonus
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR231.1 crores with an EBITDA margin of 35.5%.

items.statement: Management expects long-term EBITDA margin of 25% plus; Q1 margin benefited from favorable exchange rates and mix
items.quote: In terms of EBITDA margins, again, I think we were a very conservative company. We always have been telling you guys that expect a 25% kind of an EBITDA from Neuland. I'm glad to see that we've been on the right side of that number. But also, I have to be honest to say that we've had favorable conditions in terms of exchange rates and things like that. Therefore, I would say you will see maybe hig

items.statement: Working capital days improved from 137 days at end of FY26 to 84 days in Q1FY27; focus on inventory optimization and cash conversion
items.quote: Working capital days improved from 137 days at the end of FY26 to 84 days in FY27. Optimal utilization of cash remains a key priority for us, and we continue to focus on inventory optimization, disciplined execution and further strengthening cash conversion across the business.

items.statement: Gross margin improved to 61.2% in Q1FY27 from 55.3% in Q1FY26 due to favorable business mix
items.quote: The gross margin for the quarter was 61.2% as compared to 55.3% in Q1FY26, again, a function of our business mix during the quarter.

items.statement: Commercial CMS revenue driven by a handful of molecules (about 3) with healthy future over next 5-6 years; expect 1 more commercialization this year and 1-2 next year increasing diversity
items.quote: Sajal, if you see, I think a big part of our growth is coming from CMS commercial and CMS commercial is being driven by a handful of molecules. There's not too many of them, I would say, maybe about 3 of them that really drive our business. And these molecules are fairly active. As we produce them every quarter, and we see a fairly healthy future for them over the next 5 to 6 years.

items.statement: Customer conversations increasingly capability-led and strategic; relationships with large pharma companies deepening; seeing interest in broader capability discussions rather than individual projects
items.quote: The depth o f customer conversations today is significantly stronger than it was a few years ago, and we are increasingly engaging on broader capability-led discussions rather than individual projects alone.

items.statement: Development revenue in FY26 was INR90-odd crores; historically higher but variable; launch quantities categorized as development revenue; pipeline quality improving
items.quote: if I say FY26, it was INR90-odd crores of development revenue. And if I go to FY24 or even earlier, it used to be much higher number in absolute terms. obviously, percentage terms also, we are at all-time low kind of a number because of good commercial sales

items.statement: At least 2 new advanced clinical projects added in FY27, including peptide projects not visualized a year ago; development quantities to be delivered this year paving way for future commercial volumes
items.quote: I think in FY27, we've seen at least 2 new projects come in. I would not say these are commercial, but these are fairly advanced in the clinic. So we are seeing a couple of new projects come in. And obviously, we'll be careful in painting a picture around these projects because they're still under development and you never know what could happen. But that kind of visibility and the potential of th

items.statement: Strategic collaboration with Gland Pharma for sterile API manufacturing; asset-light arrangement combining Neuland's complex API expertise with Gland's sterile manufacturing capabilities; long-term partnership expected
items.quote: We believe this partnership creates differentiated platform in sterile APIs by combining complementary strengths of both organizations. Beyond the immediate opportunity, it also demonstrates our commitment to the specialty GDS business and our strategy of building niche capabilities in areas where technical complexity creates meaningful differentiation.

items.statement: Peptide facility located in FDA-approved site; new building subject to FDA audit but not seen as gating issue; adjacent land acquisition helps with FDA approvals and environmental clearances
items.quote: This facility is in our FDA -approved manufacturing site. So in some ways, it is part of an FDA-approved facility. However, given that it is a new building, it's subject to FDA audit, but that is really dependent on how the FDA would look at the filing when it's made. So , we expect that there will be an FDA inspection in the future. but we don't necessarily see that as a gating issue because the

items.statement: Geopolitical developments, regulatory timelines, customer ordering patterns, and macroeconomic conditions can influence quarterly timing and shape of growth; variability is inherent characteristic of business
items.quote: Geopolitical developments, regulatory time lines, customer ordering patterns and broader macroeconomic conditions can influence the timing and shape of growth from quarter-to-quarter. As we consistently stated in the past, variability remains an inherent characteristic of our business and quarterly performance should be viewed in that context.

items.statement: No material impact from geopolitical environment on operations or supply chain so far; monitoring closely; no abrupt destocking risk expected in FY27
items.quote: While we have not experienced any material impact on our operations, supply chain continuity of customer commitments thus far, we remain vigilant and continue to monitor developments closely. Our focus remains on ensuring business continuity, maintaining customer service levels and managing risks in a proactive manner.

items.statement: Stock split/bonus suggestion from shareholders noted; Board matter to be discussed; no decision yet
items.quote: As you know, it's a Board matter, and we will definitely take the suggestio n and discuss it in our Board and look at all the elements that surround that decision, and we will try to see what can be done about that.

items.statement: Healthy engagement across development and commercial programs; customer interest across existing and emerging areas; supply chain diversification driving opportunities
items.quote: We continue to see healthy engagement across both the development and commercial programs. The depth o f customer conversations today is significantly stronger than it was a few years ago, and we are increasingly engaging on broader capability-led discussions rather than individual projects alone.

items.statement: Favorable exchange rates contributed to higher EBITDA margin in Q1FY27
items.quote: But also, I have to be honest to say that we've had favorable conditions in terms of exchange rates and things like that.

items.statement: Q4FY26 was exceptionally inflated due to Q3 spillovers; Q1FY27 not a normalized run rate; business inherently lumpy; no one-offs or destocking in Q1
items.quote: If you go back to the Q4 earnings call, Chirag, we had very emphatically said that Q4 was actually more of Q3 spillovers into Q4. And in fact, we were very relieved that we had a good Q4 so that at least we were more or less on par for FY26. So I would look at Q4 as an exceptionally inflated quarter because it was more of a Q3 plus Q4 kind of a performance.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target Rs 240-250 crore; FY28 target Rs 300-350 crore with acquisition
items.quote: Yes, Rs. 250 crores is possible. 240-250 is possible because we have done around Rs. 61 crores now. And I think this trend in the Q2 also gives me confidence. Similar level of achievement is possible going forward.

items.statement: PAT margin target 15-16% for now, may improve once Beryl contributes
items.quote: I will be glad to maintain this at 15%, but it can move up once Beryl starts contributing a little bit. So, for the time being, we can keep 15%-16% PAT margin as a target.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin 19% (23% per later comment) vs 11% last year; driven by auto division downsizing, no MTM losses, automation
items.quote: Yes. Actually, last Q1 was not so good. Actually, we made only Rs. 78 lakhs profit and a very low EBITDA. So, that way, there is nothing called seasonality.

items.statement: Automation and incentive system driving sustainable productivity gains
items.quote: But more than that, the real contributor is high automation what we brought in our operations and an incentive system which is driving the people towards higher productivity is visible in the last at least 3 to 5 months.

items.statement: Civil work on hand $4.5M vs $3.7M last year; MES work on hand $1.15M flat YoY
items.quote: Today, it is 4.5 million in civil as against 3.7 last year. So, we are confident that the next quarter also is going to be good. The work on hand is a very important measure for us.

items.statement: Strong civil demand; power distribution for data centers driving MES growth; $8-10M total addressable for Mold-Tek in power distribution
items.quote: See, the problem is, the opportunity is big. I wouldn't say it is a $100 million opportunity. All together, it can be almost $8 million-$10 million opportunity for our part of the business.

items.statement: Beryl expanding to Georgia; Master Purchase Order from Hillsborough County worth $1M over 12 months
items.quote: Their revenue rate will increase because of this Master Purchase Order they received from that county. And also, they are entering into Georgia now because earlier they restricted themselves to only Florida.

items.statement: No major capex mentioned; focus on automation and productivity tools
items.quote: company is definitely working towards improved efficiencies and improving output of per employee through automation and other tools that are available

items.statement: MES team reduced from 125-130 to 50-60; shifting auto engineers to poles/towers/substation design
items.quote: So, starting this year, we have started with a thin, small team. We want to continue in EV because once it comes back, maybe after 2-3 years, we should not be lagging in knowledge. So, we have kept a team of 50-60 people who are relatively busy now.

items.statement: Power distribution team doubling from 50-60 to ~100-120; new MSA client team growing from 10 to 20 by Oct-Nov
items.quote: We are doubling that team now in the last couple of months. We are aggressively shifting some of our automobile people into poles and towers design and also substation design.

items.statement: Beryl design team in India at 7-8 people, targeting 15-20 by Oct-Nov; 1 PE relocating to Florida
items.quote: That team has to grow up to another 15 to 20 people by at least October, November. And then most of the design work can be handled from India.

items.statement: In talks to acquire US structural engineering firm with 7-8 PEs, 10-20 employees; decision by Oct 2025
items.quote: We are now talking to a design firm which has both structural steel and residential background with about 7-8 PEs. And if the deal gets through, this combination can be really what makes us a complete civil engineering service provider.

items.statement: Future aspiration to acquire architectural firm for end-to-end civil services
items.quote: And I wish, because you are saying 5 years, not only structural engineering, we also want to have architectural services also in our gamut going forward so that right from project inception till the end, our services are required.

items.statement: New MSA with #1 US power distribution company; team of 10 started, scaling to 20; $1M annual revenue potential
items.quote: We got into a contract with a number one power distribution company in USA and a team is being formed for them. About 10 people have already started working and the team may grow up to 20, 30 people center for that company in the coming months.

items.statement: Beryl BD team being trained to sell Mold-Tek core structural services; contribution expected from Q3
items.quote: Now Beryl's BD team is also going to work for our regular core business. They have been trained how to handle the business development for our structural designing and structural detailing operations.

items.statement: Shift from auto EV (volatile) to power distribution/substation (steady); civil structural detailing strong
items.quote: Because we are holding the people and software, hoping that the EV market will revive. But there seems to be no real turnaround for EV market as of today. So, instead of keeping those people idle, we are shifting some of them into poles and towers design, substation design.

items.statement: Work on hand (civil) $4.5M vs $3.7M YoY; key leading indicator for revenue visibility
items.quote: What is the point of indicator of the growth is work on hand at any given time. That looks very solid now around 4.5 million as against 3.5 million last year same time.

items.statement: Beryl revenue ~$5.5M with 8% EBITDA margin; targeting break-even Q2, positive Q3 onward
items.quote: See, last year they did about 5.4 million in Beryl with a profitability of around 8%-9%. So, this year, I think, again, they will be able to sustain similar number

items.statement: FX gain ~Rs 1-1.2 crore in Q1 due to rupee strengthening
items.quote: It is about a crore. Rs. 1-1.2 crores

items.statement: Beryl integration risk: lost 2 key design staff post-acquisition; design team rebuild underway
items.quote: We just lost 2 out of the 38 people when we acquired. Those 2 both belong to design, unfortunately. So, that is what has given a little setback to them.

items.statement: Talent constraint: difficulty hiring US PEs; acquisition preferred over organic build
items.quote: No, building up a PE team in U.S. is next to impossible. Finding PEs who are willing to come and work to an Indian company and with a reputed 10-20 years of experience is very, very difficult.

items.statement: Government funding shutdown Jan-May impacted Beryl government project workflow
items.quote: The American government funding shutdown, government shutdown has happened for 4-5 months in the beginning of the year. So, that has an impact because these guys do more mostly government funded projects.

items.statement: CEO Prasad traveling to US Aug 16; Chairman visiting Sep end for acquisition talks
items.quote: Prasad who is here now currently in India is going back, our CEO, back to U.S. on 16th August. So, from then he will be interacting with them. And I am going there in the 2nd half of September

items.statement: No India market focus due to low rates; targeting US civil/structural only
items.quote: As of today India markets and rates are very, very low compared to what we can get from USA. So, we are not aiming at Indian work unless it is something exotic and needs good value addition.

items.statement: Management expects revenue to reach INR 1,800-2,000 crore and Q2 to remain strong
items.quote: See, absolutely. And it will be achieved. Not even INR 1,800 crores. We can go up to INR 2,000 crores also. It's a matter of some time now.

items.statement: Management expects next quarter revenue and profitability to remain strong
items.quote: My closing comments are that despite so many challenges in this quarter I feel the revenue and the profitability remain all well. And you can expect the next quarter also to be the same. It will be strong now.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin was 12.59%, up from previous 8-12% range
items.quote: The EBITDA basically oscillates between 8% to 12%. Sometimes 14% also. So, this quarter we have done 12.59%.

items.statement: Management expects current EBITDA margin levels to sustain for full year due to low-cost inventory
items.quote: Yes, we expect it to sustain it because we are sitting on stocks. You can check the figures.

items.statement: Gross margin improvement driven by low-cost procurement; expects similar levels to continue
items.quote: So, in this, there is a reason for major procurement if we talk about this quarter. That is the main reason for the margins. Procurement was done at lower price and we still have stocks. We will see in future also the benefit is going to come.

items.statement: Export selling price INR 98/kg, domestic INR 64/kg in Q1 FY27; highest since Q1 FY23
items.quote: Yes, that's right. So, in Q1 of FY27, our domestic selling price is INR 64. But our export selling price is INR 98.

items.statement: Ocean freight costs passed through to customers via CIF pricing; company quotes FOB and adds actual freight
items.quote: We are quoting only FOB these days and telling the buyers we will ship CIF, of course, because we have to secure our cargo also with the insurance. And the ocean freight will, the actual ocean freight as on that date will be added to the price to make it CIF.

items.statement: Demand remains strong for essential product; volumes depend on logistics and war situation
items.quote: It's an essential product. Demand is too much. And other question, we built up huge stock of low prices and starting from the commencement of season until mid-January, we bought a lot of rice.

items.statement: Q2 volumes premature to comment; depends on logistics and war de-escalation
items.quote: Q2, it's very little premature stage to comment because it's just beginning of the quarter 2. Demand is there. Now, it depends. Demand is there means buyer and seller are confident about the business. Now, it depends upon the logistic.

items.statement: New Saudi customer Al-Muhaidib (2.5 lakh tons annual) onboarded; first 500-ton shipment moving
items.quote: I have already explained about the new buyer which is one of the biggest. They buy more than 2 lakh tons, this Al-Muhaidib group. They have joined us. First shipment of 500 ton is going in any day.

items.statement: 20+ person team working 24x7 on new buyer development; 10+ customer queries daily
items.quote: Ma'am, let me add. We have a team of new buyer development. There are more than 20 people working in it, 24x7. The process of getting the buyer is incentivized. So, they work very hard to get new customers. So, there are 10 queries of customers in a day.

items.statement: Domestic focus increasing; reviving old distributors; Maharani brand second only to Lal Qilla
items.quote: We have to revive our old these distributors. It will grow. And I have seen we have, as far as brand is concerned, somebody has carried out some this survey. Next to Lal Qilla we are coming. I am happy. Domestic sales is very important now.

items.statement: Packing capacity 500-800 tons/day; machinery running at good efficiency; no idle capacity
items.quote: Average we do about 500 tons of packing. We can go up to 800 tons per day of packing. So, in terms of infrastructure there is no problem.

items.statement: Inventory mix: 30-45% paddy, rest rice; separate milling and packing capacities
items.quote: 45% to 30% is paddy, rest is all rice. And if you ask for the capacity, capacity for milling is different and buying rice and packing it is altogether a different capacity. We have multiple units for packing machines.

items.statement: Monsoon conditions favorable; early Basmati crop normal; farmers likely to increase acreage due to high prices
items.quote: Up till now, I don't see any impact. It is more in the news. Early, I mean one of the Basmati varieties C9, which comes early in the month of July, it is coming normal. So, I don't see any effect as of now.

items.statement: Export share increased from 73% (FY23) to 91% (FY26) of revenue; diversified across US, Canada, Europe, Russia, Africa
items.quote: In FY23, our export revenue as a percentage of sales was 73%. Export revenue as a percentage of total revenue was 73%. Today in FY26, it was 91%.

items.statement: Middle East/Red Sea route slowed; Jeddah shipment moving; not dependent on Hormuz-affected areas
items.quote: The movement to Middle East is low. Of course, through Red Sea, the countries like Egypt and this Aqaba port, Jordan and Lebanon is doing well and this part has slowed down now. But let's hope it goes well. Our 500 ton shipment to Jeddah is moving in a day or two.

items.statement: Limited competition due to complex 300+ private label model; focus on quality and service retention
items.quote: We don't do in 2, 3, 4 countries business. We do with the multiple. And it's a very tough one. Believe it, it is more than 300 brands of private label of the customers. And backing them and live up to their expectation is quite tough. And we are doing tough job. It's hard to do. So, we sometimes feel we have hardly much competition.

items.statement: Flagship Maharani brand; Mithas, Begum, Anarkali strong domestically; Diwan, Royal India strong in specific export markets
items.quote: Maharani of course is the flagship brand. Then we have Mithas brand which is also very strong. Then we have Begum, which is also very strong. And Anarkali is another brand which is also very strong. So, we have a lot of brands which show strength.

items.statement: Geopolitical risk (Iran-US war, Red Sea disruption) managed via diversified ports; no containers stuck, no claims
items.quote: This last quarter, this was a quarter which happened during the war of Iran and USA. So, it had different types of challenges. And if I talk about the performance of my company, then because of this war, there was absolutely no effect. The sales went fine, there were no claims, there were no containers which got stuck anywhere.

items.statement: Saudi customer demands profitability; will walk away if margins not met
items.quote: If they will give margin then we will increase the work. If they will not give margin then we will say goodbye to them.

items.statement: Family management involved in sales revival; Vijay handles quality production; need to meet distributors personally
items.quote: And what we really need is we, maybe personally me or Ankit or my son, because Vijay is involved in quality production in the factory. He's not fiee. We need to meet the people.

items.statement: Buyback suggestion noted but no commitment given
items.quote: I do take on record your suggestion Thank you.

items.statement: Management does not provide specific financial guidance but expects healthy steady growth and faster-growing profitability leading to better ROCE
items.quote: we may not be able to provide guidance for the future. But as a general rule or the way we have been working at various aspects and the way we are developing our pipeline, we can visualize a very healthy and steady growth.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex spend was INR114 crores, funded through internal accruals
items.quote: On the capex front, we have spent about INR114 crores in the first quarter, and the capex is primarily funded through our internal accruals and deployed across our different businesses.

items.statement: No significant new capex foreseen for Biologics and Albumin for next 3 years; continuing investment in API and some new Formulation molecules
items.quote: we don't foresee any significant capex today. That is what we want to inform all our investors.

items.statement: Peptide manufacturing capacity block in India to complete commissioning by end of FY27
items.quote: we are doing large capital investment in peptide manufacturing capacity in India, which will have capability of manufacturing from start to end in solid -phase synthesis and block will complete commissioning by end of

items.statement: 3 NCE programs in advanced phases to commercialize in FY28; 15 new oncology product validations on track for FY27; 25+ NCE programs in API division
items.quote: On the CDMO side, we have 3 NCE programs in advanced phases, which will get commercialized in FY28. We remain on track to complete 15 new oncology product validations on the generic side in FY27. In total, we are working on 25-plus NCE programs in our API division.

items.statement: 3 commercial 505(b)(2) products approved last year growing quarter-on-quarter; Abraxane, Enzalutamide, Abiraterone formulations on track for FY28 launch; Rotigotine transdermal patch approved in Europe, filed in US, partnered for FY28 launc
items.quote: Three commercial 505(b)(2)s, which were approved last year, are performing well as expected, and the sales are growing quarter-on-quarter. Three important near-term filings, which are Abraxane, Enzalutamide and Abiraterone formulation, are on track to be launched in FY28.

items.statement: More than 6 active NCE programs in Biologics CDMO; one entering human clinical studies in FY27; 2 NBE programs (mAbTree, Alveolus Bio) on track for human studies in FY27; first ADC biosimilar entering human studies in FY27; recombinant huma
items.quote: One of these programs will be entering human clinical studies in FY27 through our partner. Two NBE programs where we have done strategic investments, the programs with mAbTree and Alveolus Bio, are on track to enter human studies in FY27. Our first ADC biosimilar is also on track for entering human studies in FY27.

items.statement: Strong order trajectory for Nor-UDCA; complex FDA portfolio in US driving formulation growth; specialty CDMO traction from new client acquisition in developed markets
items.quote: Nor-UDCA as a product, we are also taking it globally. And in global market, we have successfully completed European and U.S. scientific advisers, and we will be starting global Phase II clinical studies in FY27.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 71%, EBITDA margin 30%; management expects margins to remain in similar range, being conservative
items.quote: we have been consistently able to maintain that around 30% levels. So there is consistent performance showing that we are in that particular range. At this stage, I wouldn't want to raise expectations too high. We would like to be conservative and overdeliver.

items.statement: Gross margin dip partly due to global raw material price increases from recent political situation; partial pass-through to customers possible
items.quote: that also has to do with the recent political situation globally -- raw material prices have gone up, which ends up impacting margins, at least for the time being. So that has been one of the reasons for the slight dip you have seen on the gross margin front.

items.statement: Formulation growth driven by complex FDA portfolio in US, supported by EU and ROW; Biologics growth from licensing, partnership and CDMO deals
items.quote: And ex licens ing income, the base business reported robust revenue growth of approximately 112% during the quarter, largely driven by complex FDA portfolio in U.S. region, supported by EU and ROW regions

items.statement: Over 20 CDMO customers across Shilpa Group; 2 Japanese customers onboarded for late-stage projects (details confidential)
items.quote: Yes, overall across the Shilpa Group, we have more than 20 customers on the CDMO side alone.

items.statement: Integrated one-stop capabilities (small molecules, large molecules, API, payloads, linkers, conjugation, ADCs, mAbs) differentiate Shilpa; few Indian peers have similar breadth
items.quote: if you look even in India today, there are not many companies that hav e the capability of doing small molecules, large molecules, API, payloads, linkers, conjugation, ADCs, and Mabs, right

items.statement: Regulatory pathway is critical risk; unexpected regulatory challenges could slow growth trajectory
items.quote: the regulatory pathway in pharmaceutical industry is a very critical aspect. Whilst we are working towards being very robust and compliant with our practices, once in a while, the way regulatory authorities look at us could be a bit different.

items.statement: US Biosecurity Act mainly aimed at China; no major impact seen on Shilpa as of date
items.quote: No, because the Biosecurity Act is mainly aimed at China, and that too, I think, is all there in the public domain. But I think these are matters that are more policy-related decisions, which happen at a regulatory level.

items.statement: Net debt-to-EBITDA improved to 1.3x from 6.7x three years ago; credit rating upgraded to AA- from A+
items.quote: Today, we have net debt to EBITDA of 1.3x, a ROCE of double digit, a credit rating just upgraded to A A-

items.statement: ROCE improved to 12.5% in FY25 from 8.8%; adjusted for Biologics and NBE businesses, ROCE stood at 18.3%
items.quote: improving our return ratios during the past 2 years with ROCE improving to 12.5% from 8.8% in FY25. And adjusted for the biologics and NBE businesses, the ROCE actually stood at 18.3%

items.statement: Dr. Uday Harle joined Shilpa Biologics; strong internal team plus external consultants with US/EU regulatory expertise
items.quote: we have a very strong team of different experience and wide experience. And not only the intern al team, we are also engaging some very good consultants who have a very good understanding of U.S. and EU regulations

items.statement: Company certified as Great Place to Work
items.quote: I'm also happy to announce that the company has been certified as a Great Place to Work, a recognition that reflects our culture, trust and commitment towards healthy work environment.

items.statement: Unicycive Therapeutics received CRL from USFDA; partner plans to refile in Q3 FY27
items.quote: They have mentioned that they will be -- they have received the CRL letter from USFDA, and they plan to refile in Q3.

items.statement: Tax rate expected to normalize at ~25% for coming quarters after Q1 negative rate due to deferred tax reversal from planned switch to new tax regime
items.quote: Going forward, we expect the tax rate to normalize at around 25% for the coming quarters.

items.statement: Formulation captive API sourcing >50%
items.quote: So in Formulation, the overall captive percentage, if I tell you, is more than 50%.

items.statement: Strategic investments in mAbTree and Alveolus Bio for NBE programs; selective equity investments in CDMO partners aligned with therapy areas and corporate strategy
items.quote: we, as a company, are very selective. It should fall within our therapy area, and it should fall within our corporate strategy -- only then do we take interest.

items.statement: Expect to more than offset absolute input cost increase during FY27 through pricing actions
items.quote: Given the current commodity cost trajectory, we are implementing further pricing actions and ex pect to more than offset the absolute increase in input cost during the financial year

items.statement: Strategic investments portfolio expected to reach INR750-800 crores revenue by end of FY27
items.quote: For the whole year, for all the start-ups, like for this quarter, we did INR160 crores. By the end of the year, I think we will be ending up anywhere between INR750 crores to INR800 crores.

items.statement: International business expected to show significant growth in Q3 and Q4 FY27
items.quote: Most likely, you will see a significant growth coming in from the third and the fourth quarter because we have got -- we have realigned our -- a lot of international business strategies have been realigned in the last 1, 2 quarters when all these disruptions were happening.

items.statement: Kesh King portfolio expected to deliver double-digit growth for full year FY27
items.quote: We are expecting a double-digit growth at the end of the year for Kesh King portfolio.

items.statement: Zandu OTC business expected to continue double-digit growth for rest of FY27
items.quote: We are fairly hopeful that at the rest of the year also, we'll be able to continue double-digit growth for the OTC business.

items.statement: Strategic investments portfolio targeting high single-digit EBITDA margin in 3 years
items.quote: I think you would expect high single digit probably at the 3-year point, and then we'll take it from there.

items.statement: Domestic business grew 20% YoY in Q1 FY27 with 12% like-to-like growth and 8% volume growth
items.quote: I'm pleased to report that our consolidated revenue grew by 15% to INR1,039 crores during the quarter. Our domestic business grew by 20% and on a like -to-like basis, growth stood at a healthy 12% with a volume growth of 8% after considering the previous year numbers of two of our start-ups, Axiom and IncNut.

items.statement: Hair and Scalp care category grew 11% in Q1 FY27 with Navratna Cool Oil posting strong double-digit growth
items.quote: Hair and Scalp care emerged as one of our strongest performing categories, delivering 11% growth during the quarter. Within the portfolio, Navratna Cool Oil posted strong double-digit growth, while Kesh King reported mid-single-digit growth.

items.statement: Strategic investments portfolio grew 61% like-to-like in Q1 FY27, now contributes 18% of domestic business
items.quote: On a like-to-like basis, this portfolio grew by an impressive 61%, which now contributes 18% of our domestic business, highlighting the increasing relevance of our new age growth engine.

items.statement: Organized channels grew 19% like-to-like in Q1 FY27, now 32% of domestic business
items.quote: Our channel transformation journey also continues to gather pace. Organized channels grew by 19% on a like-to-like basis and today contributes to 32% of our domestic business.

items.statement: International business declined 12% in Q1 FY27 due to West Asia conflict disruptions
items.quote: International business declined by 12% during the quarter, primarily due to disruptions in the West Asia conflict, which constrained our ability to execute orders.

items.statement: Input costs increased 360 bps in Q1 FY27 (200 bps from West Asia conflict, 160 bps from mix change)
items.quote: Our input cost, if you would see, has gone up by 360 basis points, okay? And out of which almost 200 basis points is due to the conflict, West Asia conflict and the balance 160 is because of the mix.

items.statement: EBITDA grew 6% to INR226 crores in Q1 FY27 despite cost pressures
items.quote: However, I'm pleased to highlight that despite of these cost pressures, EBITDA grew by 6% to INR226 crores and profit before tax grew by 4% to INR195 crores.

items.statement: Strategic investments portfolio at aggregate EBITDA neutral breakeven level
items.quote: At an aggregate level, I think they're about EBITDA neutral breakeven.

items.statement: Implemented measured price increases in Q1 FY27, further pricing actions planned to offset input cost inflation
items.quote: While we undertook measured price increases to mitigate the impact of cost inflation, the sharp rise in input costs during the quarter weighed on profitability. Given the current commodity cost trajectory, we are implementing further pricing actions and ex pect to more than offset the absolute increase in input cost during the financial year

items.statement: Inflationary pressures from higher crude oil prices and sustained packaging material cost increases in Q1 FY27
items.quote: On profitability, the quarter witnessed inflationary pressures led by higher crude oil prices and sustained cost increases across packaging material. making it one of the challenging cost environment for the sector in recent years.

items.statement: Transitioning from brand-wise to category-wise reporting framework due to portfolio diversification
items.quote: As our business continues to evolve, we are also transitioning our disclosure framework from brand-wise reporting to category -wise reporting. items.statement: Quick commerce now contributes 35% of e-commerce business in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Modern trade and e -com maintained strong momentum with quick commerce now contributes 35% of our e-com business.

items.statement: Actively looking for 2-3 more acquisitions to add to strategic investments portfolio
items.quote: Of course, new capabilities constantly need to be added. And so if we can get two or three more engines inside the two or three more acquisitions, then why not? So we are looking very aggressively in parallel to see who else we can roll up here.

items.statement: Seeking ministry approvals to resolve OTC pain management supply issues from India to Middle East
items.quote: We are trying to find solutions to get some approvals from the ministries. And hopefully, in a few days, we should be able to get something moved from India in that regard.

items.statement: Executing supply chain planning, inventory management and distribution visibility improvements to enhance working capital efficiency
items.quote: We are enhancing supply chain planning, inventory management and distribution visibility, which will help improve forecast accuracy, service levels and working capital efficiency.

items.statement: Axiom acquisition funded internally from surplus, will result in slightly lower other income vs last year
items.quote: Yes, Kunal, so it is funded internally. So whatever surplus we had, we have required that only for these acquisitions. And obviously, in this quarter, some of that has been factored and some bit of payments would be made going ahead. So there will be sligh tly lower other income obviously compared to last year

items.statement: Core domestic business (excl. strategic investments) grew 6% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: excluding the investments, the growth rate is... So excluding the domestic, if you look at our domestic business, that has grown by almost 6

items.statement: Effective tax rate normalized to 25-26% for FY27 vs lower rate in FY26 due to fiscal benefits
items.quote: It should be around 25%, 26% Vaibhav this year because still last year, we were enjoying some fiscal benefits. And from this year, we are back to normal taxation of 25%.

items.statement: West Asia conflict and commodity inflation remain key watch areas for FY27
items.quote: With commodity inflation and geopolitical developments remains areas to watch, we believe our diversified portfolio, strengthened distribution capabilities, robust innovation pipeline and disciplined cost management initiatives positions us well to deliver sustained and profitable growth during the -- through the remainder of FY27.

items.statement: Passed on around 50% of price hike to trade; no immediate plan to pass on full increase; will reassess after observing raw material prices for another quarter
items.quote: Price hike -- as far as price hike is concerned, we could pass on around 50% of the price hike to the trade. But we have not passed on the entire increase.

items.statement: No steady-state margin guidance given; will share outlook in Q2 FY27 call if visibility improves
items.quote: As far as the margin guidance and overall guidance is concerned, since the situation is quite volatile, we would like to wait for a few months.

items.statement: No formal guidance provided; will await another quarter for better visibility before giving outlook
items.quote: Given the current uncertainties, we believe it will be prudent to await another quarter to gain better visibility befo re providing formal guidance on our outlook

items.statement: Polymer prices easing and expected to normalize over coming quarters; worst of input cost pressure seen as behind
items.quote: Looking ahead, we are seeing polymer prices ease, and we expect them to normalize over the coming quarters.

items.statement: Improving product mix benefits expected to become increasingly visible as input cost pressure moderates
items.quote: The benefit of an improving product mix, disciplined execution and deepening strategic partnership are expected to become increasingly visible as near -term i nput cost pressure

items.statement: West Bengal manufacturing facility for Morris Korea JV expected operational by Q3 FY27
items.quote: The development of our subsidiary with Morris of Korea remains linked to the commissioning of the upcoming manufacturing facility in West Bengal which is expected to become operational by quarter 3 of FY '27.

items.statement: Kenya subsidiary sales momentum improving and expected to strengthen over coming quarters
items.quote: Sales momentum at our Kenya subsidiary has begun to improve, and we expect this positive trend to strengthen over the coming quarters.

items.statement: LINC On e-commerce subsidiary stable in Q1 FY27 and expected to gain momentum ahead
items.quote: LINC On has remained stable in the current quarter and is expected to gain momentum in periods ahead.

items.statement: Consumer demand remained resilient with spending shifting to higher value products; premiumization trend strengthened in personal care, beauty and packaged foods.

The premiumization trend continued to strengthen as consumers traded up in categories such as personal care, beauty and packaged foods, supporting value-led growth.

items.statement: Quick commerce and e-commerce remained primary growth engine with strong double-digit growth and continued share gains across categories.
items.quote: Quick commerce and e-commerce remained the primary growth engine, sustaining strong double-digit growth and continuing to gain share across categories.

items.statement: Input trends remained largely manageable despite divergent commodity prices and currency; company navigated pressures through disciplined pricing strategy, improved product mix and focus on premium offerings.
items.quote: On the cost front, input trends remained largely manageable despite divergent movements in commodity prices and currency. Company effectively navigated these pressures through disciplined pricing strategy and improved product mix and a continued focus on premium offerings.

items.statement: Organized channel saliency reached industry-leading 38% with modern trade contributing 17% and digital commerce about 21%.
