items.statement: Europe RM basket up 8% in Q1, hit in Q2; need ~10% price increase, only 3-4% implemented so far
items.quote: Europe, the impact immediately was smaller because the first hike up was on account of natural rubber. So in this quarter, Europe raw material basket went up by 8%, but they are getting the hit in the second quarter.

items.statement: Hungary PCR capacity expanding from 17,000 to 21,000 tyres/day; production starting H2 FY27
items.quote: Hungary would go up from about 17,000 car tyres to 21,000. India was started later, just a minute. The India capacity will probably, I think, start coming on stream towards the end of this year and then ramp up through FY '28.

items.statement: India capacity running in 90s% utilisation; FY27 will remain tight on capacity
items.quote: We are currently running into t he 90s. I would only say in hindsight that it's a beneficial thing that we took those decisions. If anything, we are a quarter late than

items.statement: India Operations recorded highest ever revenue INR 54.6 bn, up 15.6% YoY, 4.3% QoQ
items.quote: The revenue for the quarter was INR 54.6 billion, representing a healthy growth of 15.6% Y-o-Y and 4.3% sequentially.

items.statement: ~50% of RM imported; domestic rubber prices align to landed import cost parity
items.quote: So about 50% of RM is imported, but very large part of domestic RM in a global world very quickly aligns to a ladder, which is landed cost of imports.

items.statement: Secured several OEM approvals and nominations including multiple EV platforms
items.quote: Alongside securing several OEM approvals and nominations, including for multiple EV platforms, we expanded our replacement portfolio and delivered tangible improvements in product quality and cost optimisation.

items.statement: Competition has followed through with similar magnitude price increases; TBR replacement share >30%, PCR replacement share 21%+
items.quote: No. So competition has also taken price increases, could be a little up or down, there could be some timing differences. But in general, the competition has followed through with pricing increases, and let's say similar magnitude.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty on Chinese tyres positive for Apollo; benefits domestic players, Vredestein PCR not competing with Chinese tyres
items.quote: So we expect this to be positive. Clearly, Chinese were taking a certain amount of share at the lower end, which would feed into the Apollo brand volumes. The Vredestein brand of PCR does not compete with the Chinese tyres. But overall, it will definitely benefit the domestic players.

items.statement: CFO Gaurav Kumar resigning after 22+ years; will leave after Enschede project completion
items.quote: I had been thinking for some time to take up a new challenge and decided now that it is the appropriate time, having completed the Enschede project, which I was an integral part of over the last 18 plus months. It was an emotional decision to leave Apollo Tyres after 22 plus years career here.

items.statement: Geopolitical situation in West Asia creating headwinds in select international markets, cost volatility across RM, energy, logistics
items.quote: The geopolitical situation in West Asia continued to create headwinds in select international markets, leading to heightened uncertainty and cost volatility across raw materials, energy and logistics costs.

items.statement: Polycarbonate project commissioning targeted for H2 FY28-29; BPA plant a couple of months after polycarbonate
items.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning. And we would target BPA, which would be commissioned maybe a couple of months after that.

items.statement: INR 1,200 crore spent so far on INR 11,500 crore propylene-polycarbonate project; INR 1,000-1,500 crore more to be spent in FY27
items.quote: Pending now, we have spent around INR 1,200 crore. I mentioned yesterday also. Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.

items.statement: Total capex spend of ~INR 3,200 crore expected by end of FY27 on the INR 11,500 crore project
items.quote: So total spend will be around in the range of INR 3,200 crore.

items.statement: Peak debt for INR 11,500 crore project estimated at INR 8,000-8,500 crore including working capital; debt-to-equity to stay below 1x
items.quote: So today, at this INR 11,500 crore what we are having against that, we are borrowing around INR 6,800 crore plus working capital, whatever is required, in the business at the peak. So that would be somewhere around INR 8,000 crore to INR 8,500 crore.

items.statement: Phenol plant run rate reached ~1 lakh tonnes/quarter (4 lakh TPA); further debottlenecking of INR 70-100 crore planned to sustain 4 lakh TPA
items.quote: We are looking at opportunities to debottleneck further. And hopefully, we should in the short to medium term, be able to achieve the big 4 number.

items.statement: MIBK, MIBC and acetophenone plants to be commissioned in August; multipurpose agrochemical intermediates facility and other projects within Q2 FY27
items.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.

items.statement: Ammonia-to-amines integration chain (nitric acid, nitration, reduction) completed and stabilized; enables end-to-end nitrogen platform
items.quote: One of the most strategic and significant developments over the last few quarters has been the successful completion and stabilization of our ammonia-to-amines integration chain.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded to 21% in Q1 FY27 from 18% in Q4 FY26 and 11% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 21% compared to 18% in previous quarter and 11% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Phenolics EBIT margin expanded to 24% in Q1 FY27; AI EBIT margin at 8%
items.quote: EBIT rose to a record INR 418 crore, registering a 254% year -on-year and 46% quarter -on-quarter growth with EBIT margin expanding to 24%.

items.statement: Domestic demand improving across AI and Phenolics; export demand strengthening in select markets for AI
items.quote: Performance was driven by improving domestic demand, a better product mix and increasing synergies from our recent backward integration and growing contribution from other commissioned manufacturing assets.

items.statement: AI growth driven by demand recovery in existing products and capacity-led expansion in established lines; new molecules entering commercial pipeline
items.quote: Importantly, growth within AI is now being supported by two complementary drivers: the recovery in demand across our products that earlier experienced softer conditions and capacity-led expansion in established product lines that have continued to witness healthy customer demand.

items.statement: Competitive raw material procurement (propylene, ammonia, toluene, benzene, hydrogen) maintained despite volatility; propylene from PDH to further improve cost position
items.quote: Whether it is ammonia, whether it is toluene, whether it is benzene or propylene or hydrogen, I think it would be a reasonable assumption to make that we would be absolutely competitive compared to anybody else in the country.

items.statement: Working capital efficiency improved through tighter inventory management, receivables collections and supply chain optimization
items.quote: Working capital efficiency also improved through tighter inventory management discipline, receivables, collections and supply chain optimization, resulting in healthy operating cash generation.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue mix ~85% domestic / 15% export; AI ~50% export, Phenolics almost entirely domestic
items.quote: Our domestic business remains resilient with an 85 :15 domestic to export revenue mix. At the same time, exports recorded healthy growth, reflecting our expanding global presence and diversified customer base.

items.statement: Polycarbonate compounds qualified with marquee customers including Mahindra, Panasonic, Goldmedal, Tata AutoComp for EV, electronics, auto applications
items.quote: If I have to give you names of companies, I can give you names of companies like Mahindra, Panasonic, Goldmedal and Tata AutoComp, these are examples of names.

items.statement: Government reimposed import duty on phenol after temporary removal; supports domestic producers like Deepak and HOCL
items.quote: Through Q1, you would have noticed that for a large part of the quarter, I think the entirety of the quarter, the Government had actually removed the import duty on phenol. So this was a period of time where imports as they came, came in duty-free. And we're happy to note that the Government has reimposed this import duty on phenol moving forward.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments, pricing volatility, freight/insurance rate escalation, container/vessel availability disruptions continue to influence operating environment
items.quote: While geopolitical developments and pricing volatility may continue to influence the operating environment, Deepak today is significantly stronger, significantly more integrated and significantly more diversified.

items.statement: Flow chemistry platform reduces reaction time from 16-18 hours to 45-52 seconds for one product; enables rapid changeover and smaller hazardous inventory
items.quote: One product that we're making currently in a batch or in a semi batch, it takes us about 16 to 18 hours from feedstock to finished product. This gets completed in roughly between 45 to 52 seconds.

items.statement: R&D team expanding with cross-functional teams blending organic chemists, physical chemists and chemical engineers for flow chemistry and fluorination platforms
items.quote: So what we're actually now focusing on is a hybrid between organic chemists, physical chemists as well as chemical engineers addressing the problems together.

items.statement: No M&A discussed; organic growth via integrated polycarbonate project (INR 11,500 crore), downstream specialty platforms and debottlenecking
items.quote: As you are aware, as mentioned by Maulik, to ongoing propylene and polycarbonate project of INR 11,500 crore being funded by debt and equity ratio of 60:40.

items.statement: Debt funding for INR 11,500 crore project fully tied up at competitive rates; 60:40 debt-equity; 25% equity already infused
items.quote: We have already tied up with the banks for debt funding. We were required to put in around 25% of the equity, which we have already done. So the next tranche comes from the bank.

items.statement: No new global phenol capacity coming; China self-sufficient; Indian market short-supplied with strong domestic demand
items.quote: No new capacities are coming up. New capacities have come up in the last couple of years in China, but that is now all done and China is largely self-sufficient. So no new capacity. Today, if you see the demand is more or less balanced, and we are having enough market in India. In fact, whatever you are saying there's a lot of demand in India, supplies are actually limited.

items.statement: Natural gas shortage and contractual manpower unavailability delayed some pre-commissioning activities in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Q1 also h ad a disruption where contractual manpower was not available. There was a natural gas shortage across the country. And so some of those pre-commissioning activities, which should have been finished earlier are currently in process

items.statement: R&D pipeline robust across fluorination, amination, nitration, photochemical reactions; products progressing through customer qualification cycles of 2-12 months
items.quote: Several products across fluorination, amination, nitration and specialty chemistries are progressing through customer qualifications and commercialization. While each product addresses a specific market opportunity, collectively, they broaden our specialty portfolio, deepen customer engagement and create a more diversified and resilient earnings base.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target >30% YoY, EBITDA margin ~6%, PAT margin 3.5-4%
items.quote: Based on the current demand environment and our execution roadmap, we remain confident of delivering more than 30% revenue in the current financial year '27 along with the EBITDA margin of around 6% and a profit after tax in the range of 3.5 % to 4%.

items.statement: Healthy demand across apparel, home textile, industrial applications; Q1 challenges from input cost inflation not demand weakness
items.quote: Demand across apparel, home textile, industrial application continued to be healthy, and the challenges witnessed during the quarter were largely driven by input cost inflation rather than any weakness in end -market demand.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin 3.24% impacted by raw material volatility; expect gross margins >25% and EBITDA 6% for FY27
items.quote: We are very confident that we will be able to achieve our gross margins over 25% and maintain the same so that we can achieve our EBITDA levels.

items.statement: Order cycle ~15 days; no receivables >6 months; production affected by 15-day maintenance shutdown and raw material scarcity
items.quote: See, I would like to inform you that the production was affected due to the highly volatile and scarcity of raw material and plus we also took a maintenance shutdown for 15 days.

items.statement: Rights issue proceeds: INR100 Cr working capital, INR50 Cr Nakoda CP plant, INR23 Cr debt repayment, INR22 Cr solar plant
items.quote: Approximately INR100 crores will be utilized towards strengthening working capital to support higher production levels and efficient procurement of raw materials. Around INR50 crores will be invested towards the operationalization and integration of the new acquired CP plant. Approximately INR23 crores will be utilized for the repayment of borrowings, which is expected to lower our finance costs a

items.statement: Raw material price volatility (PTA, MEG) from crude spikes; pass-through possible if prices sustained 15 days; prices now moderating
items.quote: If the prices go up, we are able to pass it on immediately, but the prices are very volatile. Today it was going up, after 3 days it was coming down. So that is why the difference, the parity was too much in the demand and supply.

items.statement: Crude-driven PTA/MEG volatility and freight costs pressured margins; raw material availability now improved, supply chains normalized
items.quote: Due to the geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and US, there was a sharp increase in the crude oil prices, which resulted in significant volatility in our raw material, such as PTA and MEG, along with elevated freight and logistics costs.

items.statement: Receivables 30-45 days, payables ~30 days; INR100 Cr rights proceeds for working capital; no receivables >6 months
items.quote: We expect our payments approximately in 30 to 45 days we receive our payments. And the payable is also as per the credit. We get credit of around 30 days from our raw material suppliers.

items.statement: Rights issue: 16.84 Cr shares at INR11.86, raised INR199.75 Cr (net INR194.90 Cr); strong shareholder participation
items.quote: The board has approved the allotment of 16.84 crores equity shares at an issue price of INR11.86 per share, raising INR199.75 crores with net proceeds of approximately INR194.90 crores available for deployment towards our strategic growth initiatives.

items.statement: Nakoda CP plant acquired via CIRP for INR23.47 Cr; OCRPS conversion from 2024 takeover already completed
items.quote: Earlier in March, Sumeet Industries was declared the successful bidder for the acquisition of Narkoda Limited C P plant under the CIRP for a consideration of INR23.47 crores.

items.statement: No current exports; planning exports and doing deemed exports; no special certifications needed
items.quote: Presently, we didn't have any export, but now, yes, we are planning for export. We are already doing deemed exports, and we don't need any special certification to do any exports.

items.statement: Expect margin pressure in short term due to elevated costs from war; will pass on some but not all cost increases
items.quote: So, as of now, the costs are still fairly elevated. So at least in the short term, we expect there to be margin pressure, although, we would be passing on some of it to the market, not all of it, because we don't know, how long this is going to last.

items.statement: Expect significant growth in Mexico for summer of FY27 after two consecutive mild summers
items.quote: So, we hope and we expect that the summer of '27, statistically, it will be almost impossible for it to be a mild summer. It should be certainly a fairly robust summer, and the sales should grow significantly.

items.statement: Expect GSK China to continue momentum; Bonaire USA current quarter good but subsequent quarters muted due to seasonality
items.quote: So, we expect GSK China to continue the momentum, and the coming quarters are based on how much export orders are received. So, we believe that we should be able to do fairly good in GSK China and Bonaire USA, coming quarter should be good which is the current quarter.

items.statement: Domestic sales grew 15% in Q1 FY27 despite inventory overhang; modern trade and digital channels grew over 100%
items.quote: Domestic sales i.e. India revenue grew by 15%, despite huge inventory overhang before the summer and importantly all different segments of modern trade grew in excess of 100%, while digital channels including D2C are highly profitable.

items.statement: Middle East exports remain affected; shipping costs up significantly impacting buyer sentiment and demand
items.quote: So, the Middle East, which was primarily impacted, continues to remain affected. Rajesh Mishra: And from other regions, the costs have shoot up significantly. So, that is impacting the overall

items.statement: Consolidated gross margin 49.8% and EBITDA margin 12.6% in Q1 FY27; margins marginally increased despite headwinds
items.quote: As you can observe the gross margin despite all headwinds and geopolitical situation and pressure on commodity prices and also inventory overhang due to bad summer of '25, we have marginally increased the gross margin percentage to 49.8% , while EBITDA margin percentage to 12.6%.

items.statement: Price hikes of 7-10% taken in non-household cooler segments; household segment hikes pending
items.quote: In the other segment, we have taken 7% to 10% of a price hike. And in others, we will be taking hikes in the days to come.

items.statement: BISP (Beyond India Summer Products) contributed ₹560 crore (48% of consolidated TTM revenue) and ₹179 crore (23% of standalone TTM revenue)
items.quote: Also, noteworthy feature is BISP segment i.e. Beyond India Summer Products i.e. the sales, product wise or segment wise, not dependent upon Indian summer, constituted about ₹560 crore on a consol basis in trailing 12 months i.e. almost 48% reinforcing our strategic derisking and diversification from Indian summer.

items.statement: No further capital allocation to CTPL Australia; impairment and write-off completed in FY26
items.quote: CTPL Australia revenue continues to soften, but we are reinforcing our commitm ent, there won't be any further capital allocation. So, in terms of the impairment and write- off, it is completely behind us as it was recorded in FY '26

items.statement: Bonaire USA revenue grew 35% driven by successful scale-up of Air Force model (rebranded Indian SKU) and strong US Southwest summer
items.quote: Bonaire USA is now back to track and revenue grew by 35% with a robust profitability mainly on account of successful scale -up of new models of air -cooler.

items.statement: GSK China revenue grew 43%; now completely debt free after repaying all debt and interest to Symphony India
items.quote: GSK China revenue grew by 43% and operating leverage lifted the profitability, as well as now, GSK Ch ina on a standalone basis is completely debt free and has repaid all the debt along with interest to Symphony India

items.statement: Modern trade constitutes over 1/3rd of India topline; general trade 60-65%; MT profitability comparable to GT
items.quote: So basically, modern trade constitutes almost or in excess of 1/3rd of our top line in India, while general trade constitutes 60%-65%.

items.statement: Bonaire USA sells primarily to Home Depot and Lowe's; products mostly sourced from India and Mexico
items.quote: We have one major customer in USA, which is the Home Depot and other customer is Lowe's. These are two of the largest retailers in US in home care kind of category. And the products that we sell to them are mostly go from India, some even go from Mexico.

items.statement: Inventory overhang at trade and company level completely normalized as of 30 June 2026
items.quote: As of 30 th June '26 i.e. our season -end, there is no inventory overhang either at a trade level or at a company level, it is completely normalized.

items.statement: Standalone treasury ₹345 crore after repaying ₹225 crore to Australia (acquisition and working capital loans)
items.quote: This is after remitting to Australia and repaying their acquisition loan as well as working capital loan until 30th June '26 of approximately ₹225 crore. In other words, after repaying ₹225 crore of that, treasury stands at ₹345 crore.

items.statement: Board announced interim dividend of ₹1 per share (face value ₹2) with total payout ~₹7 crore
items.quote: For June '26 quarter, the Board of Directors had announced interim dividend of ₹1 per share on a face value of ₹2 with a total payout of about ₹7 crore.

items.statement: Standalone ROCE 164% (core capital employed ₹73 crore); Consolidated ROCE 67% (capital employed ₹206 crore)
items.quote: So, as on 30 th June '26, core capital employed on standalone is ₹73 crore versus ₹136 crore, translating into ROCE percentage of 164, while return on net worth at 22% and treasury stands at ₹345 crore versus ₹363 crore.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue ₹378 crore (+8% YoY), EBITDA ₹48 crore (+26% YoY), PAT ₹40 crore; adjusted EBITDA ₹53 crore, adjusted PAT ₹43 crore (+23%)
items.quote: On a consolidated basis for June '26, revenue stands at ₹378 crore, up by 8% YoY, EBITDA stands at ₹48 crore, up from ₹38 crore, up by 26%, while Consol PAT stands at ₹40 crore, down from ₹42 crore.

items.statement: Margin pressure expected in short term due to elevated commodity costs from war; difficult to quantify impact
items.quote: Despite all the value engineering, despite all the cost reduction that we will be attempting to do, there will be some impact. Difficult to quantify as yet how much, but there is likely to be some impact.

items.statement: Export demand muted due to high shipping costs and geopolitical uncertainties; Middle East still affected
items.quote: Overall, the costs have gone up, which is also impacting the buyer sentiment. So, people are more cautious because the landed costs have gone up and they are not able to pass on the entire increase.

items.statement: BISP includes large space ventilated air cooling, tabletop fans, water heaters, and exports; already launched in modern retail and GT across top cities
items.quote: It consists of large space ventilated air cooling and apart from exports, it consists of tabletop fans which sell around the year, water heater and exports.

items.statement: Coolers not viewed as poor man's AC outside India; US market driven by outdoor usage and portable plug-and-play advantage
items.quote: coolers are not viewed as a poor man's air conditioner everywhere outside India. It's only in India that it is seen as a substitute for air conditioners. You will find coolers being sold not only in the USA, b ut even across Europe

items.statement: CTPL Australia strategy: no additional capital deployment; focus on optimizing existing operations without new product or distribution initiatives
items.quote: First and foremost, our strategy is not to deploy any additional capital and whatever best can be done without deploying any additional capital in our Australian business.

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY27 PAT guidance of INR200-220 crores, representing 34-48% growth over FY26
items.quote: we remain confident of delivering our FY '27 profit after tax guidance of INR200 crores to INR220 crores, representing the healthy growth of 34% to 48% over FY '26.

items.statement: Board authorized INR190 crores additional investments, bringing total FY27 new projects to INR340 crores plus INR150 crores carryforward from FY26
items.quote: The Board has authorized additional investments towards new expansion projects of INR190 crores, bringing the total for FY '27 to INR340 crores. This is in addition to the INR150 crores worth of projects carried forward from FY '26.

items.statement: Expect to commercialize manufacturing capacities exceeding INR500 crores during FY27 including projects under implementation
items.quote: Including these investments and the projects already under implementation, we expect to commercialize manufacturing capacities exceeding INR500 crores during FY '27.

items.statement: Signed projects totaling around INR340 crores in FY27 so far across food & beverages, ice cream, and home & personal care
items.quote: we have already signed on various projects totaling to around INR340 crores in this financial year.

items.statement: Healthy demand across all business segments with Home & Personal Care at maximum capacity and strong beverage season
items.quote: Our Home and Personal Care business remains at maximum capacity, supported by consistent demand and efficient manufacturing operations.

items.statement: Footwear business faced INR6 crores impact in Q1 from higher raw material costs and revised wage rates; expect progressive mitigation
items.quote: The quarter numbers were impacted due to cost pressure faced in our footwear business arising from higher raw material costs and revised wage rates, which totaling to around INR6 crores impact for Q1 FY '27.

items.statement: Most contracts have pass-through mechanism for labor code changes and inflation; footwear has fixed pricing 6-8 months in advance making mid-season pass-through difficult
items.quote: most of our contracts other than shoes, we have a pass -through mechanism. And as a result, whether it is the changes in the labor code or whether it is the changes in the inflationary aspect of Middle East crisis, et cetera, we've been able to successfully pass on those costs.

items.statement: Footwear imports ~50% raw materials; polymer prices up 50-60%, freight rates up 4x due to Middle East crisis
items.quote: Right now, we have seen an increase of almost 50% to 60% in raw material prices -- polymer prices, fabric prices have increased. Even the freight rates have gone up by 4x.

items.statement: Footwear order book full for H2 FY27 with new customer wins from domestic and multinational brands; existing customers increased orders
items.quote: We have a full order book. This is on the back of a couple of things. One, yes, there have been new customer wins, both on the domestic front as well as multinational companies who have now started working with us.

items.statement: Export discussions with US personal care brand and UK/EU via FTAs on hold due to tariff ambiguity; Dr. Scholl portfolio exported to UK, EU, Australia, NZ, Japan
items.quote: the discussions are on, Akhil. Unfortunately, the ambiguity on the tariff continues. We -- in fact, Ganesh also mentioned this in his opening remarks that we've got some -- I would like to say orders, but we've actually -- potential orders for personal care products to be shipped to the U.S.

items.statement: FSSAI cleanup of food sector may cause short-term disruption but long-term positive for organized contract manufacturing
items.quote: I think the FSSAI cleanup of the food sector will lead to some amount of disruption in terms of the brands. But I think in the long run, it will help all of us because the products and the production will move towards the organized market more and that should help us.

items.statement: GST duty inversion continues to affect cash flows; profitability growing faster than revenue due to conversion cost model
items.quote: the duty inversion in GST continues to affect our cash flows of some of our business units. As the steps we have taken to address these issues, we will continue to see higher growth in our profitability numbers as compared to revenue numbers.

items.statement: Highest ever quarterly PAT of INR42.8 crores, up 33% YoY; EBITDA up 26% to INR106.3 crores; total income up 18% to INR1,207 crores
items.quote: Profit before tax grew 33% year -on-year to INR56.6 crores, while profit after tax increased -- also increased 33% to INR42.8 crores, marking our highest ever quarterly PAT.

items.statement: Silvassa brownfield expansion to commence production in Q2 FY27; Lucknow greenfield facility on track for commissioning later this year
items.quote: The brownfield expansion at Silvassa is expected to commence produc tion during the second quarter, while the greenfield Lucknow facility continues to progress as planned for commissioning later this year.

items.statement: Panipat ice cream facility successfully commissioned; expanding ice cream capacities; adding Greek yogurt facility in Goa
items.quote: During the quarter, we successfully commissioned our state -of-the-art Panipat facility and continu e to expand our ice cream manufacturing capacities.

items.statement: Beverages identified as major growth avenue; ice cream delivered strong quarter; HPC liquid category seeing double-digit volume growth
items.quote: The Beverage division had an excellent season and validates our belief that beverages will be one of the major avenues of growth for this division.

items.statement: Maintaining 1:1 debt-equity ratio for new projects; using internal accruals to fund growth without accessing outside funds
items.quote: What he's trying to highlight is that we will continue to maintain a 1:1 debt equity ratio even for these projects. And as a result, there will be some outflow on account of interest.

items.statement: Silvassa facility partially restored after record July rainfall; expect full operations by end-August; adequately insured, no material long-term impact
items.quote: Production has already been partially restored, and we expect the facility to be fully operational by the end of August. The facility is adequately insured, and we do not expect this incident to have any material impact on our long-term operations or growth plans.

items.statement: Footwear employs ~5,000 people; employee cost ~35-40% of total Q1 employee cost; Haryana minimum wages increased ~30%
items.quote: Okay. So we have about 5,000 people working in our shoe business. However, I do not have the number. In terms of quantification, the number that we came prepared for the discussion was that the effect of the minimum wages is INR3 crores for this quarter.

items.statement: Project pipeline of nearly INR1,000 crores under discussion across BUs; capex announced only after signing
items.quote: the pipeline is about INR1,000-odd crores. And that's the kind of investment that customers are looking at.

items.statement: HFL is largest and most diversified FMCG contract manufacturer in India; customers recognize execution capability across geographies and categories
items.quote: I think we definitely defined the FMCG contract manuf acturing industry in the country. We are the largest and the most diversified contract manufacturer.

items.statement: Class III medical devices certification initiated at Chennai facility for regulated international markets; Baddi facility approved for 2 more MNCs
items.quote: We also initiated the certification process for Class III medical devices at our Chennai facility, which will support our expansion into regulated international markets over time.

items.statement: Capex breakup: Food & Beverages INR210 crores (5 units), Ice Cream INR80 crores (Panipat), HPC INR50 crores (Lucknow)
items.quote: for food and beverages, it's going to be INR210 crores spread across 5 units, Coimbatore, Mysore, Goa, Aurangabad and Hyderabad. This would be for the beverage part. In ice cream, it would be INR80 crores at Panipat. And in Home & Personal Care, it is INR50 crores at Lucknow.

items.statement: Footwear business expected to return to profitability in coming months; full order book from Q2 FY27 onwards
items.quote: We are confident that our customers will support us in mitigating the losses incurred due to these causes and that the division will return to profitability in the coming months.

items.statement: No asset revaluation planned; business model not contingent on revaluation though assets hold unrealized value
items.quote: So Faisal, obviously, there's been no revaluation of the assets. And yes, you're right that a lot of these assets have been procured over a long period of time. Our business model is not contingent on that revaluation.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue target to cross INR15,000 crores with high-teens EBITDA growth and aspiration for 20% EBITDA growth
items.quote: We are confident of achieving high-teens EBITDA growth and aspire to touch 20% EBITDA growth during this year. We expect India to deliver high single-digit volume growth and international business to deliver mid-teens constant currency growth.

items.statement: India volume growth target of high single-digit for FY27 with aim for another double-digit volume quarter in next three quarters
items.quote: We expect India to deliver high single-digit volume growth and international business to deliver mid -teens constant currency growth. We will ce rtainly try and hit another double -digit quarter in India volume growth sometime in the next three quarters

items.statement: International business constant currency growth target of mid-teens for FY27
items.quote: We expect India to deliver high single-digit volume growth and international business to deliver mid-teens constant currency growth.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 tax rate guidance of about 18% and FY28 guidance of 19-20%
items.quote: Yes. So this year, tax this quarter, it was about 17.5%. I think from a full year perspective, you can take a guidance of about 18% for FY27 and maybe about 19% to 20% for FY28.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin improved 40 bps YoY to 20.7%
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved 40 basis points year-on-year to 20.7%.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin expansion expected in range of 140-150 bps YoY based on revenue and EBITDA growth targets
items.quote: if you do the reverse math and if you see that INR15,000 crores is something that we should definitely deliver, then the reverse math would suggest that EBITDA margin would expand in the range of about 140 to 150 basis points as compared to last year.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 30 bps YoY in Q1 FY27 led by softer copra prices and favourable mix
items.quote: gross margin expanded 30 basis points year-on-year, led by softer copra prices, a favourable channel and portfolio mix coming from our strong growth in premium portfolio, GT growth and profitable scale up of our food and digital-first portfolio.

items.statement: Gross margin guidance for FY27 difficult to give due to mixed input cost trends; aim to hold gross margin percentage
items.quote: very difficult to give on gross margin because we believe it will be a little bit of mix of both, but we would try and hold the gross margin percentage.

items.statement: Copra prices expected to remain range-bound at 30-35% below last year's peak levels with slight upward bias
items.quote: we believe that it will stay range bound with maybe a slight upward bias at this 30% - 35% kind of a level below the peak.

items.statement: Crude and vegetable oil input costs showing upward bias; expect higher input costs in Q2 FY27
items.quote: On the other side, crude and vegetable oils continue to exhibit an upward bias. And consequently, we expect input costs to be relatively higher in Q2.

items.statement: India domestic demand remained healthy with 11% volume growth and 21% revenue growth in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The India business delivered one of the strongest quarters in recent years with 11% volume growth and revenue growth of 21%, led by robust momentum in core business and continued scale-up of new growth engines.

items.statement: Quick commerce grew over 50% for core business; contributes ~5% of India business revenue excluding digital brands
items.quote: Quick commerce continued its accelerated scale up, reporting more than 50% growth for our core business. It now contributes to around 5% of India business revenues, excluding digital brands, and all digital channels put together account to over 20% of Indi a business revenues

items.statement: Almond oil franchise target to build INR100 crores+ ARR by FY28
items.quote: Our aim is to build it to INR100 crores plus ARR franchise by FY28.

items.statement: Parachute shampoo national launch targeting INR100 crores revenue in first year
items.quote: our first step is to get INR100 crores in the first year.

items.statement: Over 96% of business gained or sustained market share and over 99% gained or sustained penetration on MAT basis
items.quote: Over 96% of the business continued to gain or sustain market share and over 99% of the business continued to gain or sustain penetration on a MAT basis.

items.statement: Parachute Rigids gained over 400 bps volume share marking new high
items.quote: Parachute Rigids delivered 10% volume growth with strongest performance in the last 20 quarters and gained over 400 basis points in volume share, marking a new high.

items.statement: Project SETU strengthening general trade execution; now extended to Vietnam for go-to-market transformation
items.quote: We're already reaping the benefits of GTM transformation led by our Project SETU in India and now in Vietnam. The next leg of our journey will focus on sharpening execution through use of smart analytics, AI and integrated digital ecosystems.

items.statement: Digital brand acquisitions (4700BC, Cosmix, Plix) are capital outlay not impacting A&P investment capacity
items.quote: The assets that we have bought are capital outlay. So that does not impact our ability to invest behind the A&P line items.

items.statement: A&P spend grew 25% YoY in Q1 FY27 to support core and new product launches including shampoo
items.quote: Advertising and sales promotion expenses grew substantially at 25% as we continue to invest significantly behind our brands to strengthen their long-term equity, support innovation, some of the big innovations we have launched this quarter, and drive consumer salience.

items.statement: Digital-first brands profitability improving: Beardo double-digit EBITDA margin, Plix high single-digit trending to double-digit, Cosmix acquired at mid-to-high teens margin
items.value: Beardo double-digit; Plix high single-digit to double-digit; Cosmix mid-high teens
items.quote: Beardo has done double-digit profitability. Plix is in high single digit, t rending towards double digit. We acquired Cosmix, which was already on high teens profitability

items.statement: Parachute Rigids 10% volume growth strongest in 20 quarters; revenue grew 23% with pricing actions and anniversarization of prior hikes
items.quote: Parachute Rigids delivered 10% volume growth with strongest performance in the last 20 quarters and gained over 400 basis points in volume share, marking a new high. Revenue grew 23%, reflecting the anniversarization of prior year price increases and pricing actions done during the quarter.

items.statement: VAHO mid-premium segment delivered high-teens volume growth; expect to maintain double-digit trajectory targeting high-teens growth
items.quote: while we are focusing on mid- and premium segment, and that segment has delivered high-teen growth in volume terms. Of course, value growth is even higher. Now going ahead, we definitely expect that we will maintain the trajectory of double digits. We will definitely drive for even delivering high teens growth.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance 9-11% with EBITDA margin expansion of 50-100 bps over FY26
items.quote: On the outlook front, we reiterate our FY '27 guidance of 9% to 11% revenue growth with EBITDA margin expansion of 50 to 100 basis points over FY '26.

items.statement: Mid to long-term growth target of 12-15%
items.quote: Looking further ahead, we remain confident in our journey towards achieving 12% to 15% growth in mid - to long-term as we continue to scale our digital platforms across geographies, brands and channels.

items.statement: FY30 revenue target INR5,000-5,500 crores with improving EBITDA margin trend
items.quote: We have given a guidance to hit INR5,000 crores mark. In margin terms, it is continuously improving with the vertically integrated business model we have.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11%, up from 9.2% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA came in at INR102 crores, up 37% year-on-year with EBITDA margin at 11%, a strong improvement from 9.2% in Q1 FY '26.

items.statement: Gross margin 67% in Q1 FY27 reflecting vertical integration and in-house brand mix
items.quote: Gross margin for the quarter was 67%, reflecting the strength of our vertically integrated business model and our in -house brand mix.

items.statement: Digital native gross margin higher than TV business margin
items.quote: So gross margin on the native digital, pure e -com, is higher than our TV business margin, as it requires the higher spend on the social media marketing or the other paid mediums.

items.statement: US consumer confidence weak, households prioritizing essentials over discretionary
items.quote: In the U.S., consumer confidence stayed weak through the quarter, with households prioritizing essentials over discretionary categories in face of increased fuel costs.

items.statement: UK consumers cautious on discretionary spending, core TJC business subdued
items.quote: In the U.K., the overall operating environment remained challenging during the quarter with consumers staying cautious on discretio nary spending

items.statement: Germany consumer sentiment showing early signs of stabilization with improving income expectations
items.quote: In Germany, consumer sentiment showed early signs of stabilization on the back of improving income expectations.

items.statement: In-house brands contribute 57% of B2C sales, sustaining FY26 milestone
items.quote: Our in-house brands now contribute around 57% of B2C sales, sustaining the milestone we crossed during FY '26 and continuing to support our margins and sourcing efficiencies.

items.statement: Digital sales 45% of B2C revenue, on track for 50% by end FY27
items.quote: Digital sales accounted for 45% of B2C revenu e during the quarter. And we remain on track to reach our 50% digital mix target by the end of FY '27

items.statement: Lab-grown diamonds 13% of retail revenue, expected to grow to 14-16% in coming years
items.quote: Lab -grown diamonds continued the strong momentum at around 13% of retail revenue, broadening our price architecture and making a clear shift in consumer preference.

items.statement: Migrated all key e-commerce platforms from Salesforce to Shopify Enterprise
items.quote: During the quarter, we have successfully migrated all our key e -commerce platforms from Salesforce to Shopify Enterprise e-com platform.

items.statement: Implemented AI tools for product scheduling, content generation, personalized marketing and demand forecasting
items.quote: On AI initiatives, we have implemented many important AI tools encompassing product scheduling, content generation, personalized marketing and demand forecasting, et cetera.

items.statement: US average ticket size reduced from $50 to $46, volume traction at lower price points
items.quote: Our average ticket size in U.S. is reduced from $50 to $46. But the volume, we are seeing good traction.

items.statement: Digital marketing spend focused on acquiring higher quality customers with better lifetime value
items.quote: Our digital marketing spend remain focused on acquiring higher quality of customers with better lifetime value, which is helping strengthen long-term customer economics.

items.statement: Lifestyle products 40% of B2C revenue, medium-term target 50%
items.quote: Lifestyle products contribute around 40% of B2C revenue this quarter, with a medium -term target of 50%.

items.statement: Budget pay option (EMI) accounts for 36% of total retail revenue
items.quote: Our budget pay option, which allows consumer to pay for purchase on EMI, remained popular and accounted for 36% of our total retail revenue.

items.statement: Deliberate shift to higher value, higher lifetime value customers with lab-grown diamond scale-up (ASP ~$250)
items.quote: The moderation in customer count and retention reflects our deliberate shift towards higher value, higher lifetime value customers, primarily with scale-up of our lab -grown diamond portfolio, which has a higher ASP of around USD 250.

items.statement: Net cash position INR287 crores as of 30 June 2026
items.quote: Net cash position stood at INR287 crores as of 30 June 2026, giving us the flexibility to continue investing in growth while maintaining strong capital discipline.

items.statement: ROCE 24%, ROE 18%
items.quote: Returns ratio remained healthy, ROCE at 24%, ROE at 18%.

items.statement: First interim dividend of INR1.5 per equity share declared
items.quote: On capital allocation, the Board has recommended a first interim dividend of INR1.5 per equity share.

items.statement: No buyback until $50-100 million cash cushion maintained for acquisition opportunities
items.quote: Our internal assessment is that we need to create some cushion of $50 million to $100 million with us for any opportunity comes with us, for not only just acquisition or any other thing to expand our business.

items.statement: Future acquisitions must be complementary with strategic fit and supply chain synergy, not just EBITDA accretion
items.quote: So for us, any acquisition that we make in future should be complementary to our organization, not just for the EBITDA accretion, but also strategic fit for our business.

items.statement: Digital ROAS for new customer acquisition currently ~2, targeting 3+ in coming years
items.quote: The ROAS is roughly around right now currently at 2. And we are expecting to expand to over 3 in coming years.

items.statement: Digital customer profitability period currently 9-10 months, target 3 months
items.quote: The current profitability of a customer comes in around 10 months, 9 to 10 months. Our aim is to take it to 3 months.

items.statement: Macroeconomic volatility (wars, oil prices) cited as reason for conservative FY30 guidance range
items.quote: The macroeconomic environment is very volatile. It keeps on changing with how the world is moving towards different war, oil prices up and down. So considering all in our mind, we have kept our number like that.

items.statement: Music vertical revenue growth guidance maintained at 20-23% YoY for FY27
items.quote: If I have to look at on a full year basis, we maintain our guidance of the music vertical growing between 20% to 23% year-on-year.

items.statement: Annual music EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 60-65%
items.quote: For the music vertical, we maintain our medium-term guidance of 20% to 23% revenue growth and an annual music EBITDA margin guidance of 60% to 65%.

items.statement: New music content spend expected between Rs. 300-350 crores for FY27, mostly committed
items.quote: Our spend on new music content this year is expected to be anything between Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 350 crores. Most of that is already committed.

items.statement: Major film albums lined up for FY27 including Love and War, Dharman, Paradise, Naagzilla, and Bhansali-Tiger Shroff film
items.quote: Big albums lined up including Love and War, which is coming out in January, Rajinikanth's Dharman, which is a Kamal Haasan's Company's production; Telegu Cinema's most awaited film Paradise; Dharma's film with Kartik Aaryan called Naagzilla and another Bhansali Productions film with Tiger Shroff are some of the albums which are expected to release in this financial year.

items.statement: 60% of FY26 music revenue came from post-2000 releases, 45% from post-2020 releases
items.quote: In FY'26, 60% of all music revenue at Saregama came from music released post 2000. I'm repeating . 60% of the revenue in last financial year came from music of the 21st century.

items.statement: Catalog growing at 5,000-6,000 new releases annually, now at 180,000+ songs
items.quote: Our 180,000-odd song catalog growing at close to 5,000 to 6,000 new releases every year is exactly the kind of asset that compounds value over decades.

items.statement: Paid streaming penetration in India at 3% vs 67% in Sweden, 57% in US; management targets 100 million subscribers at Rs. 100/month
items.quote: Just to put the things in perspective, paid streaming penetration is 67% in Sweden, a 57% in the U.S. Even a Brazil and a China are closer to 18%, while we are just 3%.

items.statement: Artiste Management represents 309 artists with 440M+ combined followers on Instagram and YouTube
items.quote: At the end of this quarter, we represent 309 artists with more than 440 million follower and subscriber base for these artists on Instagram and YouTube combined.

items.statement: Music EBITDA margin dipped 1% YoY due to Artiste Management mix shift (lower margin, zero investment)
items.quote: If you see the segmental results that people have declared, you will see Artiste Management piece is also growing. And Artiste Management is always a lower margin. It takes zero investments.

items.statement: Live Events produced 23 Carvaan Live shows, 22 devotional shows, 48 standard packs in Q1; US tours with Ilaiyaraaja and Arjan Dhillon planned
items.quote: 23 such shows were produced in quarter 1. We further built up our devotional format with 22 shows featuring Manoj Muntashir, Backstage Siblings and Jaya Kishori during the quarter. We also staged 48 standard packs during this quarter.

items.statement: Pocket Aces reached breakeven in FY26, moving toward profitability in FY27; Bhansali Productions next releases in Q4 FY27
items.quote: Regarding our p artner companies, Pocket Aces reached breakeven in financial year '26 and is now moving towards profitability. This year, we should be seeing further building on the profitability of Pocket Aces. Bhansali Productions had no releases during the quarter. The next set of releases are planned in quarter 4 of this financial year

items.statement: New CFO Abhishek Kapoor appointed with 25+ years experience across Sula Vineyard, PepsiCo, HT Media
items.quote: Let me start the call by introducing our n ew CFO, Abhishek Kapoor. Abhishek brings in over 25 years of hardcore finance experience across Sula Vineyard, PepsiCo, HT Media, etc

items.statement: AI music video production cost as low as Rs. 70,000 per video; AI teams created for content creation and process optimization
items.quote: The cost of a music video, if it is done through AI can be Rs. 70,000 also. So the numbers are that small at this moment.

items.statement: Public performance licensing identified as large untapped revenue opportunity in India
items.quote: There is one more on the music side that is public performance. It is a relatively untapped opportunity in India. By public performance, I mean whenever music is played in a commercial place, the entity needs to go out there and take a separate license and that license money is distributed amongst the people whose music is played.

items.statement: Video segment revenue declined 52% YoY to Rs. 17 crores by design as Films business winds down over next 3-4 quarters
items.quote: This quarter saw the video vertical revenue declining by 52% to around Rs. 17 crores. Ladies and gentlemen, please keep in mind this is by design and not by chance.

items.statement: Other income declined due to cash diverted to Bhansali Productions investments
items.quote: the fact of life is that the cash that the people had right now has been diverted towards specific investments of us, namely Bhansali Productions. And that's why you see a reduction in the other income.

items.statement: US tour with Ilaiyaraaja underway, Arjan Dhillon tour planned for September; targeting diaspora superfans
items.quote: This year, we are increasing our focus on the American market. Our U.S. tour with South's Maestro Ilaiyaraaja is currently underway. And in September, we plan to tour with the Punjabi Superstar Arjan Dhillon.

items.statement: Short-format content revenue opportunity from shift to ad-share models; FilterCopy and Pocket Aces control 400-450M Gen Z followers
items.quote: They between their -- the entire social media presence are controlling anything between 400 million to 450 million follower and subscriber footprint across Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

items.statement: Management evaluates performance on rolling 12-month basis, not quarterly; quarterly fluctuations in YouTube views and revenue are normal
items.quote: I would again reiterate, like I've been doing right now for over 60 quarters, please evaluate ou r performance on a rolling 12 -month basis. Whether it's a good quarter or a bad quarter, don't judge us only on the basis of 1

items.statement: Expect to exceed full-year revenue growth guidance significantly; EBITDA growth may exceed original double-digit target slightly; volume growth may meet or slightly exceed; cash conversion may be squeezed
items.quote: We'll certainly exceed it on revenue growth pretty significantly. On EBITDA, we may exceed by a little bit the original number that we had set of double-digit EBITDA growth may go up a little bit.

items.statement: India volume growth expected around 8% for FY27, up ~100 bps annually; India EBITDA margin target 22-26% even in weak quarters
items.quote: I would say that 7% volume in India is probably at the lower end of the range that we may get. So, I think we'll probably be in and around maybe 100 bps more than this is around about where we should be in India this year.

items.statement: India EBITDA margin dropped ~450 bps sequentially in Q1 due to 3x cost inflation in LPG, kerosene, LABSA; expect recovery to normative 22-26% range by H2 FY27
items.quote: In the next couple of quarters, we should get back to normative margin in India. It's still a slightly complicated period right now because costs are yo-yoing so much that one doesn't know what to do with pricing.

items.statement: LPG, kerosene and LABSA prices trebled in Q1; LPG peaked at INR190/kg vs INR60 pre-war, now back to INR90; these three commodities caused ~6% cost impact on India business
items.quote: LPG before the war was INR60 a kilo. At the peak of the war, it went to INR190. I think our average consumption was about maybe, I don't know, a little lower than that, and it's now back to INR90 a kilo.

items.statement: Took ~5% weighted average price increase in India in Q1; may take similar increase in Q2; pricing calibrated to Brent at $80-85 range
items.quote: We've taken up prices by about 5%. We probably will still take up a little bit more, but you see we have to be prudent because now costs have come down again, and the last thing you want to do is to take down prices.

items.statement: Consolidated underlying volume growth 9% in Q1; India volume growth 7% (lower end due to poor HI season and fill rates); Indonesia 10% growth; GAUM exceptional FMCG-led growth
items.quote: At a consolidated level, revenues grew 19% year-on-year with underlying volume growth of 9%.

items.statement: Speedboats (Fab, GK Incense, Godrej Air) growing strongly; new entries in toilet cleaners, body wash, face wash, pet care meeting milestones; launched Godrej Rizz in liquid dishwash (INR2,500-3,000 cr category)
items.quote: Our Speedboats, Godrej Fab, GK Incense Sticks and Godrej Air globally continue to grow strongly and are becoming increasingly meaningful contributors to the overall company.

items.statement: Speedboat salience currently ~15%, targeting 20% by FY27 end; expect ~100-150 bps quarterly increase in salience
items.quote: It will be in each quarter go up 100, 150 bps. So that's what I expect in terms of salience of this business to go up.

items.statement: GAUM FMCG portfolio doubled media investment; air fresheners scaled across region; incense sticks pilot in Nigeria strong; EBITDA structurally improved from high single-digit to consistent mid-teens
items.quote: There has also been a structural improvement in EBITDA from high single digit to a consistent mid-teens level, and we are confident of holding this going forward.

items.statement: GAUM constant currency growth ~25% in Q1; mid-to-high teens growth seen sustainable for rest of FY27; FMCG now ~50% of GAUM revenue (was half-half split in FY26)
items.quote: I think for FY27, rest of the year, possibly so. I would say in the longer term, you may or may not get 17% volume growth may not be what we may sustainably get even with FMCG growth.

items.statement: African currency appreciation provided top-line tailwind but hit margins; tailwind likely to last 4-5 months then reduce in late H2
items.quote: Arnab, it's likely to stay for another 4 to 5 months and towards the lag end of second half, it is likely to reduce.

items.statement: Gained overall market share in household insecticides in Q1 FY27 after nearly a decade; driven by sharp share gain in incense sticks and deinfluencing of illegal incense sticks
items.quote: After almost a decade, we gained overall market share in the household insecticide category in Q1 FY27.

items.statement: India soap volumes grew positively in Q1; expect faster growth in Q2-Q3 but still early single digits
items.quote: See, we grew soaps volumes in the quarter, firstly, so, they were positive. And we expect soaps in this quarter and the next to grow faster. I t will still be early single digits

items.statement: Hair color INR15 creme pack now largest by volume, wider distribution than market leader in henna; driving overall volume and value growth in hair color
items.quote: And it's over the last 4, 5 years, become a really big success.

items.statement: Muuchstac acquisition grown 70-80% from run rate since acquisition; EPS accretive from day 1; profitable digital-first brand
items.quote: I think since we took over the acquisition itself, I think we have grown by about 70% or 80% from the run rate. So this rate of growth continues.

items.statement: Committed INR500 cr to pet care business; additional INR200 cr rights issue recently; achieved product-market fit in Tamil Nadu after 1.5 years; now expanding to rest of South India
items.quote: I think the important thing is that when we launched the pet care business, we committed INR500 crores of capital to pet care.

items.statement: Cash conversion may get slightly squeezed in FY27 due to commodity volatility
items.quote: Maybe one metric where we may not exceed this kind of volatility, a little bit on cash to get a little squeezed.

items.statement: El Nino may hurt India HI in H1 but benefit in H2 (warmer winter); Indonesia HI to benefit; palm crop impact from El Nino yet to be seen
items.quote: In India, probably quarter 2, as quarter 1 June was terrible for household insecticides. So, the results we delivered in India is with a terrible June with poor fill rates and extremely high costs.

items.statement: Media spend cut 7-8% in Q1 but media reach down only 3% due to deflation in conventional media and better technology/planning; share of voice maintained
items.quote: We've cut our media spend by maybe 7%, 8% this quarter. But we calculate another measure, which is media reach. And our media reach is down only 3% from the last year same quarter.

items.statement: LPG temporarily banned for commercial use by government during Q1 war period, exacerbating availability and cost issues
items.quote: And in fact, the government for a period of time had not even had banned from being used for commercial purposes.

items.statement: Restated historical segment reporting: home care ~INR100 cr, personal care ~INR1,400 cr, India total ~INR2,500 cr; unbranded exports virtually nil
items.quote: We've done that because we realize and we get into reconciliation every quarter. So, this time, you will see that both the categories actually tie up to the total and we also restated the historical numbers accordingly.

items.statement: Board approved INR90 crore capex for advanced materials adoption capacity funded through internal accruals
items.quote: The Board has approved a new capex of INR90 crores funded through internal accruals towards setting up adoption capacities for our advanced materials business.

items.statement: Phase 2 cGMP4 capex of INR125 crore initiated for CDMO business, expected to operationalize by Q4 FY27
items.quote: In addition to the capex in the advanced materials, we have initiated in our CDMO business, Phase 2 cGMP 4 capex of INR125 crores funded through internal accruals, expected to operationalize by Q4 FY '27.

items.statement: HFC capacity expansion of up to 15,000 metric tons R32 equivalent on track for Q3 FY27 commissioning
items.quote: The HFC capacity expansion, the additional HFC capacity equivalent to up to 15,000 metric tons of R32 remains on track for commission ing in Q3 FY '27

items.statement: MPP debottlenecking at Dahej facilities progressing well, expected completion by Q3 FY27
items.quote: MPP capacity expansion, debottlenecking activities at our Dahej MPP facilities are progressing well and are expecte d to be completed by Q3 FY '27

items.statement: INR15.73 crore investment in group captive hybrid renewable project for 14.9 MW to meet over 60% energy needs
items.quote: A renewable energy project, an investment of INR15.73 crores in a group captive hybrid renewable project for 14.9 megawatts of renewable power supports our sustainability and decarbonization goals.

items.statement: Target 35-45% of R32 capacity contracted over five-year period
items.quote: Our idea is, as we've said before, to look at about 35% to 45% of the total capacities will be contracted for the five-year period.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expected in 32-33% range plus/minus 1% over next 1-2 years
items.quote: So we've got enough to have confidence from a point of view of operating leverage that what we are talking about wi ll be in the range of that 32%, 33%, plus/minus 1% here or there

items.statement: R32 long-term demand constructive with demand doubling over decade while quota-driven supply shrinks by half
items.quote: We all know that over a decade, the demand for 32 is going to double, while the supply -- quota-driven supply is going to sort of shrink to half.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals seeing sustained momentum with good order visibility across existing and new molecules
items.quote: This business vertical continues to witness sustained momentum, supported by good order visibility across both existing and new molecules.

items.statement: CDMO business has strong outlook for FY27 with three molecules expected to have FDA readouts in next 8-12 months
items.quote: As I'm talking now with you, we have got three more molecules that are expected to go to an FDA readout over the next 8 to 12 months.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin at 34.2%, up 566 bps YoY
items.quote: The operating EBITDA margin stood at a solid 34.2%, a growth of 566 basis points versus Q1 of last year.

items.statement: HFC pricing environment remains constructive supported by favorable demand-supply dynamics
items.quote: The pricing environment of HFCs remain constructive, supported by favorable demand supply dynamics.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals facing pricing pressure particularly in LatAm market which is well supplied
items.quote: While volume growth is recovering, pricing pressure continues to remain, particularly in the LatAm market, which is already well supplied.

items.statement: Chemours project targeted for completion by end of Q2 FY27, Navin is sole supplier
items.quote: Chemours project, which also form a part of this vertical is targeted for completion by end of Q2 FY '27.

items.statement: CDMO Phase 2 capacity dedicated to European partner, entering MSA for extra molecule moving to API minus 1 position
items.quote: The new capacity will be dedicated to the European CDMO partner, and it's a reflection of the increasing demand on the molecule itself. We are also getting into an MSA for an extra molecule in the same supply chain. So this takes us to an API minus 1 effectively.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals has strong visibility for campaign orders of 4-5 molecules in agchem space
items.quote: And this year, we have strong visibility to campaign orders at least of four to five molecules in the agchem space, which gives us very good confidence of the growth this year and then going into next year as well.

items.statement: AHF capacity of 60,000 tons across Surat and Dahej sufficient for next 4-5 years
items.quote: Between Surat and Dahej, 60,000 should be good enough for us over the next sort of four to five years.

items.statement: Advanced materials adoption capex at Surat site creating two core platforms for commercial scale qualification of 5 lab-approved products
items.quote: This capacity will create sort of two core platforms and also augment our capabilities around equipment, etcetera, for analytical. We've already set up, but there is a need to augment those two.

items.statement: Advanced materials targeting niche applications in data centers, electronics, semiconductors, defense including chip fabrication, cooling, displays, fire suppressants, high-voltage electrical, wind energy
items.quote: The idea here, Ankur, is that this vertical will focus on niche sort of applications in high-growth sectors, mainly data centers, electronics, defense and semiconductors and will more specifically cater to applications that support the chip fabrication process, chip cooling process, manufacturing of display, OLEDs, data centers.

items.statement: CDMO portfolio balanced across commercial, late-stage and early-stage programs across oncology, respiratory, cardiovascular, neurology, animal health
items.quote: Our CDMO strategy remains firmly focused on maintaining a balanced portfolio comprising of healthy mix of commercial, late-stage and early-stage programs. We continue to increase our participation across several promising therapeutic areas, including oncology, respiratory, cardiovascular, neurology and animal health.

items.statement: Deepening relationship with European CDMO partner through Phase 2 capex and MSA for additional molecule
items.quote: Phase 2 of our capacity expansion is supported by growing demand from our European CDMO partner and an expanded footprint in their supply chain.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals broadening customer base with 13-14 new molecules last year and participation in innovator pipelines
items.quote: Like we said last year, we did about 13 to 14 new molecules. And this year, we have strong visibility to campaign orders at least of four to five molecules in the agchem space.

items.statement: Navin Fluorine positioned as lowest cost manufacturer of R32 with integrated HF value chain and productivity improvements
items.quote: What we actually do is we tend to remain as the most competitive cost manufacturer of 32. Our integrated HF value chain, the effort that we are doing on productivity improvements, along with the example of that being the hybrid power, et cetera, which will start to give in close to about 60% of our power coming from renewable sources and will also result into savings on power will ensure that our

items.statement: DRDO partnership for TDF project to develop indigenous specialty material for strategic autonomy
items.quote: We are proud to partner with DRDO, Ministry of Defense, Government of India on a critical TDF project to develop an indigenous specialty material. By transitioning of this highly critical imported chemical into a localized asset, we are directly contributing to nation's strategic autonomy.

items.statement: Net working capital days at 81 days of sales, within financial framework
items.quote: Our net working capital days stood at 81 days of sales, which is again within the financial frame.

items.statement: Company became net debt free during Q1 FY27
items.quote: Operating cash flows for Q1 stood at INR173 crores, and Navin also became net debt free during the quarter.

items.statement: CDMO cGMP4 capex of INR288 crore targeting 3x asset turn by FY29
items.quote: On the INR288 crores, we've talked of an asset turn of 3x, and I think we've said that by FY '29, if I remember correctly.

items.statement: Expect meaningful acceleration in biosimilars in H2 FY27
items.quote: Q1 performance was broadly in line with our expectations, and we expect momentum to build progressively through the year with meaningful acceleration in the second half of FY'27.

items.statement: Syngene expects single-digit revenue degrowth in FY27 and EBITDA margins back to mid-20s
items.quote: While revenues are expected to decline in the first half, performance should improve in the second half, resulting in a single-digit revenue degrowth in rupee terms for the full year and EBITDA margins back to mid-20s.

items.statement: Aim to launch a new product in US or Europe every year till end of decade
items.quote: The focus has always been to see that we have a new product launch either in the US or in Europe every year from here on till the end of the decade.

items.statement: Biosimilars EBITDA margin at 25% in Q1 FY27, up 10% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR728 crores, representing a growth of 10% year-on-year and this translates into an EBITDA margin of 25%

items.statement: Generics EBITDA margin improved to 7%, up 250 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA margin at 7% improved more than 250 basis points over Q4FY'26, driven by higher volumes and operating leverage.

items.statement: Normalized biosimilars margin baseline 24-25%, targeting expansion
items.quote: If you normalize last year's margins to maybe 24%, 25%. Yes, then we are all driving towards margin expansion.

items.statement: Syngene operating EBITDA margin at 12% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Operating EBITDA margin was at 12% for the quarter.

items.statement: Biosimilars revenue grew 16% YoY driven by North America
items.quote: Biosimilars revenue for quarter one stood at INR2,855 crores, representing a 16% year-on-year increase driven by the North America market.

items.statement: Generics revenue grew 21% YoY
items.quote: Revenues stood at INR760 crores, representing a 21% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: Services revenue declined 16% YoY due to lower offtake from key biologics client
items.quote: Revenues were down 16% year-on-year to INR736 crores

items.statement: Contracting for key biosimilar products underway for H2 scale-up
items.quote: We have been contracting for some of these products in recent days. You know that July to September is the window when most of these payor negotiations finalize for full year for the following calendar year, and I think what I can tell you at this point in time is we are in a good place to have those conversations.

items.statement: No plans to increase capex for new US manufacturing facilities, will use partnerships
items.quote: No, I don't believe that we will be increasing our capex in establishing new facilities or capacities in the US. We will look at it through partnerships, if required, and we already have some of our own manufacturing facilities, which we will obviously utilize.

items.statement: EMA approved second drug product line at Malaysia insulin facility; supplies started
items.quote: We achieved a significant manufacturing milestone with EMA approval for the second drug product line at our Malaysia insulin facility. Supplies from this line have started and should pick up further from Q2 FY'27.

items.statement: Generics profitability driven by API pricing premium, R&D optimization, and opex reduction
items.quote: One is some of the premium on API products, pricing premium; secondly, optimization of the R&D portfolio; and thirdly, opex.

items.statement: Five key biosimilar products (Aflibercept, Denosumab, Aspart, Ustekinumab, Bevacizumab) to drive growth
items.quote: The five products that we have always said we are going to be focusing growth on, two we just talked about Aflibercept, Denosumab. But there is beyond that Aspart, Ustekinumab, where you've seen a tremendous offtake in the past year. And then you've got bevacizumab, which is in in some sense understated at this point in time.

items.statement: Generics API to formulations split at 60:40, historically 67:33
items.quote: The split of API to formulations is about 60:40 this quarter. Historically it's been two thirds and one thirds.

items.statement: Syngene impacted by lower offtake from a key biologics client
items.quote: Syngene's Q1 FY'27 performance was impacted by lower offtake from a key biologics client and a forex hedge loss partly offset by cost optimization initiatives.

items.statement: Net debt increased INR1,100 crores QoQ due to working capital build for H2
items.quote: Net debt increase is linked to the working capital. It's not any other term loans.

items.statement: US generics and biosimilars currently exempt from tariffs; legislation would be needed to change
items.quote: Right now, the law states within the United States, generics and biosimilars are exempt. So, legislation would have to be passed and redone.

items.statement: Aflibercept ramp-up will take time; strong start expected building through H2
items.quote: Almost every ramp has a start and then it takes some time before it reaches peak. We should have a good straight-out-the-gates a good start to this, which will build up towards the second half of the year.

items.statement: Group operating revenue grew 10% YoY in Q1 FY27
items.quote: In Q1 FY '27, the group delivered 10% year-on-year growth in operating revenue.

items.statement: Reported net profit before exceptionals up 245% YoY to INR145 crores
items.quote: Reported net profit for the quarter before exceptionals was INR145 crores, representing a 245% year-on-year increase.

items.statement: Biosimilars R&D investment at 7% of revenue in Q1 FY27
items.quote: R&D investments for the quarter stood at 7% of revenues.

items.statement: Integration synergies delivering cost benefits; operating leverage from merged businesses
items.quote: One of the key objectives of the integration of Biocon and Biologics was to basically unlock a lot of synergies and avoid a lot of the duplication in our businesses which has actually been delivered and will continue to deliver.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of 18% plus for FY27
items.quote: EBITDA margins remaining resilient at 22.9% during the quarter. This is in line with our FY26 annual EBITDA margin of 22.8% and much above our guidance of 18% plus.

items.statement: Targeting 15-20% annualized revenue growth internally
items.quote: But I think we are -- internally, we are targeting the growth rates of 15% to 20% on an annualized basis.

items.statement: Expect growth closer to 15% than 20% for FY27
items.quote: It will be more closer to 15% than 20% is what my estimate at this point in time is.

items.statement: Consolidated order book at INR18,700 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Our consolidated order book as on June 30, 2026, stands at over INR18,700 crores, providing healthy revenue visibility over the next few years.

items.statement: Targeting INR8,000-10,000 crores of new orders in FY27
items.quote: But at an annualized basis, our order book has been growing, and we are sure that even in the FY27, we will be able to aggregate another INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores of order.

items.statement: WMEL order book at INR2,135 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, WMEL's order book stood at INR2,135 crores, well diversified across tunnels, pumping stations and rehabilitation projects.

items.statement: WMEL Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 21.3%
items.quote: For Q1 FY27, WMEL posted a revenue of INR179 crores with an EBITDA margin of 21.3%.

items.statement: Water treatment project pipeline of INR30,000 crores tracked, 40% in Maharashtra, 60% outside
items.quote: Currently, what we are tracking in the treatment space are projects in the ranges of about INR30,000 crores, which are on the anvil or in various stages of being developed by the client. Our estimate of these treatment plants is about -- which are on our horizon is that about 40% of them are within Maharashtra and 60% are outside Maharashtra.

items.statement: Dharavi Wastewater Treatment Facility 70% complete, on track for July 2027 commissioning
items.quote: Physical completion has now reached approximately 70%, and the project remains on track for commissioning by July 2027.

items.statement: UP Jal Jeevan Mission over 80% complete, on track for FY27 completion
items.quote: We have achieved over 80% physical progress across our projects and remain on track to complete the balance execution during FY27.

items.statement: Pune-Shirur Road project appointed date expected in Q3 FY27, INR500 crores revenue expected in FY27
items.quote: We expect the appointed date to take place in Q3 of FY27 for Pune-Shirur. We are expecting a revenue recognition of somewhere around INR500 crores in this financial year.

items.statement: Aunta-Simaria HAM project divestment at INR1,000 crores enterprise value, expected completion in Q2 FY27
items.quote: The proposed transaction values the asset at an aggregate enterprise value of approximately INR1,000 crores, subject to customary adjustments, approvals from NHAI and lenders and the fulfillment of other conditions precedent. We e xpect to complete the transaction during Q2 FY27

items.statement: Aunta-Simaria divestment expected to reduce debt by INR800 crores
items.quote: Upon completion, this transaction is expected to reduce around INR800 crores of debt from our balance sheet, further strengthening of our financial position and enabling redeployment of capital into future growth opportunities.

items.statement: Net debt at INR109 crores, cash and equivalents at INR1,792 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR1,792 crores with net debt at INR109 crores.

items.statement: Oil and gas revised FDP submitted for MB-OSN-2005/2, approval expected in 4-6 weeks
items.quote: as we speak, we have submitted to the client our re vised FDP for MB-OSN-2005/2. Hopefully, it will get approved in the next 4 to 6 weeks

items.statement: Water segment EBIT margins of 20-25% annually justified by technology differentiation
items.quote: We are not playing -- as I said, we don't target every project. So we target projects which can offer some technology play, which allow us to be differentiated. In the run-of-the-mill water pr oject, I'm not too very sure these margins are maintainable

items.statement: Revenue mix: water 41%, transport 35%, tunneling 24% in Q1 FY27
