items.quote: There can be a lot of geopolitical factors right now. See, we are living in such uncertain times. You don't know what will happen tomorrow. See, a lot of still supply chain in India, whatever things we make in India, there are a lot of things which we are dependent upon overseas suppliers. If we get any constraints on demand then that is one risk, which is there for the whole of the industry, not

items.statement: New CEO with vast AC experience driving strategy and operations; SAP implementation across 14 units and group companies; management development programs; Big 4 firm hired for SOPs
items.quote: we have now a new CEO who has come -- who has a very vast experience in the AC, is driving our strategy and also the whole operations and team, you meet him and you will realize from his vision what we are trying to do.

items.statement: JV Goodworth Electronics sales INR177.3 cr (up from INR147.5 cr), EBITDA INR6.3 cr (up from INR4.3 cr); subsidiary PG Technoplast sales INR1,600 cr
items.quote: Our JV, Goodworth Electronics posted sales of INR177.3 crores versus INR147.5 crores last year. And EBITDA for the JV was INR6.3 crores versus INR4.3 crores last year. Our subsidiary, wholly-owned subsidiary, PG Technoplast, reported strong sales of INR1,600 crores for the quarter.

name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd

items.statement: Q1 FY27 total income grew 85% YoY to INR752 crores; revenue from operations grew 88% to INR702 crores; EBITDA more than doubled to INR544 crores at 72% margin; PAT at INR413 crores
items.quote: So, during the quarter, our total income increased by 85% to INR752 crores and revenue from operations grew to INR702 crores, which is an 88% growth. EBITDA more than doubled to INR544 crores, and there is a good EBITDA margin of 72% with a PAT at INR413 crores.

items.statement: Average Daily Turnover (ADT) reached INR10.5 lakh crores in Q1 FY27; Futures ADT grew 47% YoY; Notional Options ADT grew 266% YoY
items.quote: The quarter witnessed very strong growth across the Average Daily Turnover, the ADT. This grew to INR10.5 lakh crores. Futures ADT grew by 47% year -on-year, and overall ADT showed growth over last quarter.

items.statement: Traded client base doubled YoY to 13.72 lakh clients in Q1 FY27, reflecting increasing acceptance of commodity derivatives for hedging and investment
items.quote: Client participation is encouraging. Our traded client base doubled from previous year to 13.72 lakh clients this quarter. And this really highlights the increasing acceptance of commodity derivatives as an effective tool for both hedging as well as investments.

items.statement: Successfully launched Silver 100 Grams Futures contract in response to market demand; product has seen very good performance and provides more accessible hedging and investment option
items.quote: We've had a whopper of a contract! We've had a very successful launch of the Silver 100 Grams Futures contract. This was a demand from the market given the price of silver. In a quick response to market demand , the product was launched and has already seen a very good performance, which we will talk about subsequently.

items.statement: At least 50+ AMCs now using MCX bullion price as reference for AUM calculations following regulatory directive for exchange-discovered price usage
items.quote: We have worked very closely with the industry and have a number of AMCs, at least 50-plus AMCs, who are today using MCX bullion price as a reference for AUM calculations.

items.statement: Expanded Good Delivery Norms to include silver and empanelled first domestic silver refiner; three more domestic gold refiners empanelled; framework extended across all contracts to promote domestic refining and self-reliance
items.quote: In line with a lot of policy narratives around the country on bullion, we've included silver and also empanelled the country's first domestic silver refiner. These norms align with best-in-class global standards at par with all global norms that have so far been followed in the country.

items.statement: Incorporated MCX Coal Exchange of India after regulatory approval; procedural items underway to create transparent, efficient, technology-driven national coal trading ecosystem aligned with government market reforms
items.quote: On approval from the regulator, we have incorporated the MCX Coal Exchange of India and other procedural items are in play towards the next steps on this. This will cr eate a transparent, efficient technology -driven national coal trading ecosystem aligned with the government's market reforms as well as our long -term strategy of expanding into new commodity segments.

items.statement: MCX ranked world's largest Commodity Options Exchange and fourth largest Commodity Derivatives Exchange by contracts traded in FY2025
items.quote: As per FY2025 statistics, MCX is the world's largest Commodity Options Exchange and fourth largest Commodity Derivatives Exchange by number of contracts traded.

items.statement: Top focus on risk management; strong risk posture maintained over last year enabling new participation, product innovation and enhancements despite volatile environments
items.quote: I would also like to highlight a very, very strong focus for MCX on risk management. I think I have been asked this in a few discussions, where, in volatile environments and the purpose of MCX being to operate as a platform of hedging, the action that has our top focus is risk management and being able to react quickly to signals from across the world, over the course of the last one year , has he

items.statement: RBI bank guarantee regulation now in force after 90-day absorption period; not expecting significant detrimental impact; industry finding mechanisms to deal with cost of funds implications
items.quote: The regulation from RBI that was meant to come into effect in April had a 90 -day sort of time period for this to get absorbed by the industry is now in force. I don't want to comment because this is really more of a Q2 action than a Q1 action. Having said that, we are not expecting this to have a very significant detrimental impact.

items.statement: ADT grew from INR3 lakh crores in Q1 FY26 to INR6.6 lakh crores in Q4 FY26 to INR10.5 lakh crores in Q1 FY27; premium ratio normalization observed as expected due to global volatility trends
items.quote: We are very happy to see the growth in ADT from about INR3 lakh crores in Q1 last year to about INR6.6 lakh crores in Q4. We have seen INR10.5 lakh crores of ADT, which demonstrates highly engaged participation across the contracts. Yes, there is a normalization of the premium ratio. And this is as expected because as we look at volatility trends globally, there will be a normalization of the way

items.statement: Traded UCCs flat QoQ after strong growth in previous quarters; underlying trend of new members and participants remains positive; closed FY26 at 20 lakh UCCs, expect higher in FY27 with substantive headroom
items.quote: So, we've had growth in UCCs quarter -on-quarter over the last few quarters. This is the impact of new members as well as expanded interest by participants in the commodity markets. We see a tad change this quarter, but I would say it's like more or less at pa r with the last quarter.

items.statement: Electricity futures Q1 ADT at INR37 crores with ~55% market share; open interest of ~1,630 lots across 3 months with >70% market share reflecting strong commercial utilization
items.quote: So, electricity futures Q1 ADT is about INR37 crores. We stand at, I think, about 55% or so from a market share standpoint when it comes to ADT. However, what we've done over the course of the year is really look at studying our market needs very carefully. And we have a strong reinforcement that our contract is very much aligned to market needs.

items.statement: Expect electricity derivatives-to-spot ratio to evolve to global market levels over medium term; lead indicators positive with right participation and open interest buildup; working with global power exchanges to learn best practices
items.quote: We absolutely expect this to be reflective of what we see in global markets. So, we are in the really early phase of this journey. And like I said, all the lead indicators are looking strong. We have a strong feedback from market because any new product introduced also, we need to be really sure that despite having done the work, all the approvals that the product meets purpose.

items.statement: BULLDEX index product rework underway on both Futures and Options; indices remain primary focus across bullion, metals and overall commodity space; several plans in pipeline to hit market over next few months
items.quote: The BULLDEX that was launched last year, I think there's a rework on the product that is in play, both on the Futures and Options. So, I think we are expecting that to give a good bump up on Indices. And Indices is something that is a primary focus both across the bullion metal and the overall commodity space as well.

items.statement: SGF contribution varies monthly based on SEBI-prescribed methodology and buffer assessment; employee cost increase driven by new hires, increments and ~8-9% one-time variable pay in subsidiary not recurring
items.quote: So, depending on that, the analysis is done and the contribution is done. So that's the reason maybe you can see some variation in the SGF number. And in terms of employee cost, it's a mix of both , addition of new employees plus increments , and also a bit of maybe a slightly higher variable pay in our subsidiary, which has come up in this year.

items.statement: Bullion Options volume healthy: Gold options ADV ~300 metric tons (100% QoQ increase); Silver options ADV ~9,400 metric tons (~2% QoQ increase); premium ratio decline driven by volatility normalization, not contract mix or participation shi
items.quote: So, we are looking at, for example, in gold, something like AD V - Average Daily Volume, in options of about 300 metric tons, which is a 100% increase over last quarter. Similarly, we are looking at in silver, about 9,400 metric tons, which is again approximately 2% or more increase over last quarter. So, volume-wise, it's healthy. There is that sort of price impact kicking in. Volatility is certa

items.statement: Open interest increased: Gold all-variant options OI 17.3 tonnes (vs 16.9 previous quarter); Silver all-variant options OI 583 tonnes (vs 522 previous quarter); products seeing more usage for intended hedging purpose
items.quote: If you see the silver all variant option AOI as well as the gold all variant AOI in options, which is about 17.3 tonnes, marginally higher than 16.9. In the case of silver, 583 tonnes as opposed to 522 tonnes in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Technology capacity well-positioned: handled >3 billion transactions/day (from <1 billion/day four quarters ago) with capacity for >2x current volume; new ED for Critical Operations focused on scale, resilience and cost efficiency
items.quote: In fact, just in the last one year, we have very successfully handled large volume of transactions. We would have started the year at less than a billion. And when I say a year, I'm talking of maybe four quarters back, a billion transactions a day, and we've already handled more than 3 billion transactions a day with the capacity to handle more than double that.

items.statement: Float income on margin money was INR30 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: That is around INR30 crores for this quarter.

items.statement: Growth momentum at fundamental level expected to continue strong in FY27; Q4 FY26 was exceptional due to macro factors but controllable indicators remain strong
items.quote: So, we do see growth to be on a strong track this year. While the very strong macro factors may or may not necessarily kick in, that's not something that is in our control. But all the controllables have strong indicators, and we do expect the numbers to be strong.

items.statement: Energy and bullion segments show counterbalancing effect; bullion volatility not very low, market still requires hedging; Silver 100g and Gold 10g contracts seeing retail interest with home delivery model
items.quote: Between our two big pillars of product segments, which is energy and bullion, we do see a sort of a counterbalancing that tends to happen. Of course, sometimes both are highly volatile. But otherwise, we do have energy sort of kicking in and contributing to numbers at times when bullion tends to be a little more tepid and vice versa.

items.statement: 12 new members joined in Q1 FY27; 35 new FPIs taking total to ~220; FPI contribution ~2.5% at INR10 lakh+ crore base; monitoring competitive actions (expiry date changes) but main contracts holding strong
items.quote: In the last quarter, we've had 12 new members who have joined. We've had 35 new FPIs, taking our FPI count to about 220. At a higher base of INR10 lakh-plus crores, we have about 2.5% contribution coming from FPIs.

items.statement: Competitive moats include deep commodity risk understanding, Good Delivery standards, warehouse inventories, delivery-based contract integrity, and strong technology platform
items.quote: Nobody understands the commodity market risk like we do. I think be it Good Delivery standards, be it inventories being held in our warehouses, the hard work that has gone into creating these delivery -based contracts, which gives a high level of integrity to price discovery with a derivative contract, merging with a physical contract, creating that price that market accepts as being true and of h

items.statement: SEBI has independent teams at senior levels working on commodity segment; MCX working with focus to resolve open items (position limits, colocation) but cannot comment on timelines
items.quote: There is a strong focus at SEBI. There are independent teams within MRD at reasonably senior levels that now work on the commodity segment. So, I think your understanding is correct there. And the rest follows, I guess.

items.statement: Crude oil options volume flat QoQ despite three months of heightened prices/volatility vs one month in Q4; market-driven volatility impacts volume changes; core trend line remains healthy
items.quote: You're right, the numbers are flat. And I think that's in line with what we discussed earlier that the last quarter was a heightened sort of a one -off. And if we look at the core trend line per se, I think this quarter actually continues to be quite healthy.

items.statement: Bullion volumes softer in June due to lower volatility; Silver 100g launch well accepted for affordability; Gold 10g futures seeing retail interest via home delivery model introduced by members
items.quote: The numbers on bullion are softer. We spoke a lot about it in the previous questions also. The Silver 100 Grams launch has been accepted and received very well in the market, reflecting a kind of a product that has more affordability for hedging across the industry as well as investors.

items.statement: Management expects double-digit growth for FY27 and 10-15% top-line growth across all segments
items.quote: We're still positive in long term. And we're hopeful that for the year, we can still close out on double-digit growth.

items.statement: Cash tax rate of 18.88% expected to continue for 7-8 years due to MAT credit utilization
items.quote: We will be paying at the rate of 18.88% for at least 7, 8 years. So, we have a large amount of accumulated MAT credit, which we will be utilizing over the next 7, 8 years.

items.statement: Market has de-grown in operating regions due to West Asia crisis since April; market share intact
items.quote: The market share is intact only. The market has de-grown in the markets that we operate in. Basically, it's due to the war situation only, that's been going on since April.

items.statement: June and July volumes similar to Q1 trend; July impacted by weather restrictions at ports
items.quote: June was similar only. Even July is similar. We can't give specifics because this is a Q1 call and being listed, we have that restriction. But I mean, broadly, the trend remains the same.

items.statement: Ankleshwar ICD received initial customs permission; EXIM operations expected by September 2025
items.quote: Ankleshwar, they have received their initial customs permission, and we should be operational there for EXIM operations by September.

items.statement: Indore ICD construction ongoing; 26.4 acres acquired; full swing construction after September; operational by 2028
items.quote: we've acquired 2.5 more acres. So now we're at 26.4 acres roughly. Construction is ongoing in Indore. We've already awarded some tenders. But due to rains and all, it's a bit slow. But after, say, September, we'll be in full swing construction there

items.statement: Jaipur ICD legal hearing listed for final arguments in September; hopeful for closure within a hearing or two
items.quote: On Jaipur, there's no update. We've given it in our notes also that the last hearing took place, but it's -- just another date was given. So, it's still listed for final arguments in September now. We're hopeful that it can get closed within a hearing or two.

items.statement: DFC last connection to JNPT complete; first double stack from JNPT to NCR started; early to assess cargo shift
items.quote: So, the last connection, which was pending on the DFC stretch, now it is complete. So, in fact, we were the one who started the first double stack from JNPT towards NCR.

items.statement: Rail EBITDA lower due to volume mix shift (declining imports, rising exports), port imbalance, lower double stacking, higher empty running, fuel and wage cost increases
items.quote: It's a function of the volume mix also. So, a decline in imports and increasing exports while maintaining the same volume would be lower margin for us. So, a little bit of that. Port imbalance also, specifically within Mundra and Pipavav has also been there. Lower double stacking, higher underframe, higher empty running all contributed to a lower rail EBITDA in this quarter.

items.statement: Haryana minimum wages increased 35%; passed on to customers with time lag; fuel cost pass-through mostly done; impact more visible in Q2
items.quote: Just for example, Haryana had an increase by 35% in minimum wages. We've tried to pass it on to customers, but there is a time lag in that also. Fuel also, most of it, we've been able to pass on. So that impact will be more visible in Q2.

items.statement: Double stacking at 39%, dipped from 40-42% last year
items.quote: On double stack, basically, we're at 39%. So, it has dipped a bit from last year where we were at like 40% to 42% depending on the quarter.

items.statement: Snowman warehousing pricing increased 5-7% on average across customers in Q1
items.quote: In terms of percentage, I cannot say right away, but in a range between 5% to 7% on an average is what we have got from most of the customers.

items.statement: Snowman 5PL service margin 5-6%; helps gain warehousing and transportation volumes; blended margin maintained
items.quote: It's again a mixed blend because if we talk about 5PL, typically, the service margin remains between 5% to 6%. Other than that, it helps us gain more volumes in our warehousing and distribution, which is transportation services and the blended margin stays there for those particular units.

items.statement: Snowman adding 24,000 pallets by end of FY27; Pune operational in couple of months, Patna to follow; similar additions planned for subsequent years
items.quote: So, this year, we'll be adding -- I mean, Pune will be up in another couple of months. And post that Patna is going to come up. So, this year we'll see around 24,000 additional pallets, I mean, by end of this year. And subsequently, similar numbers is what we are planning for subsequent years.

items.statement: Ankleshwar ICD estimated to ramp to ~5,000 TEUs/month within 3-4 years, similar to existing ICD in region
items.quote: But we also estimate that, say, within 3, 4 years, we should be doing a similar number.

items.statement: JNPT currently 5% of rail volumes; expected to increase as Ankleshwar and Indore operationalize; shipping lines prefer single dip at JNPT over double dip at Gujarat ports
items.quote: Currently, it's about 5%, but we are hopeful that this will increase going forward, especially as we add Ankleshwar and Indore, both are very dependent on JNPT. Most of their volume is JNPT only.

items.statement: CONCOR is the biggest competitor in ICD space
items.quote: Yes, CONCOR is the biggest.

items.statement: CFS business sale explored 1.5 years ago but valuation not right; not actively looking to sell due to net debt-zero position; open to good deal
items.quote: So, we undertook an exercise, but we didn't get the right valuation. This was about 1.5 years ago. And since then, we've not been actively looking because we reached about a net debt-zero position earlier in the year when we paid out the special dividend.

items.statement: Contingent liabilities of INR 6,000 crores; 95% are bonds to government authorities (mainly customs) for bonded cargo; not true contingent liability
items.quote: Almost 95% of that amount are bonds given to government authorities, mainly customs. So that is because we hold cargo, on which the customs are bonded in nature. So, it's not really a contingent liability in the sense that there is some claim which will come up or something like that.

items.statement: JNPT rail haulage 6 slabs higher than Mundra; Indian Railways rationalization requested; JNPT port THC competitive to increase rail share from 14-15%
items.quote: So, if we look at the distance, one of the disadvantages like you were also telling that it is a distance. So, there is 6 slabs higher compared to Mundra. So, which makes it slightly expensive as far as the rail haulage is concerned.

items.statement: West Asia crisis causing volume disruption since April; uncertainty on ceasefire; global macros key risk to growth outlook
items.quote: There's still uncertainty in the middle, there was a ceasefire, but again, it happened like the attack started again. So, it's led to a disruption in everything. We don't know when it will clear up, but we're still positive in long term.

items.statement: JNPT currently higher cost for North India due to extra distance; special haulage charges discussed but nothing confirmed; shipping line decisions will drive volume shift
items.quote: Yes. I think in current pricing, JNPT is more expensive for Northern India because of the extra distance. There have been talks maybe that they'll come out with some special haulage, but there's nothing confirmed on it yet.

items.statement: Land bank ~475 acres across India in prime locations; mostly freehold; Garhi land 85-90 acres valued at INR 25-30 crores/acre outright
items.quote: Our overall land bank is about 475 acres across India in prime locations. Most of them -- some are industrial locations, some are port leases, but most of it is freehold. So, the value is there.

items.statement: Domestic volumes currently ~500 containers/month; potential to increase significantly with network expansion
items.quote: Right now, domestic we'd be doing only about -- it's like 500 containers a month roughly. We could be increasing that to a lot higher, when we have more of our network in place.

items.statement: Snowman 5PL grew 6% YoY in Q1; new customer additions expected by Q3 or Q4
items.quote: 5PL has seen a hike of around 6% year-on-year, I would say. That is an additional only on the distribution part of it.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 75% YoY and consolidated EBITDA margin of 20-22% maintained
items.quote: And we maintain that revenue guidance of 75% growth over the previous year and an EBITDA margin of 20% to 22% on a consol basis is what we maintain our guidance for the full year basis.

items.statement: Order book stands at 4.4 GW as of July 2026 with 59% equipment supply and 41% turnkey from third parties
items.quote: With this, our order book stands at approximately 4.4 gigawatt. Just to repeat Inox Wind Limited & again, an order backlog of 4.4 gigawatt as on July 2026

items.statement: Signed MOU for 1.5 GW with INOX Clean Energy in June; firm orders for 500 MW signed, balance 1 GW to follow
items.quote: We are pleased to inform you that INOX Wind has signed an MOU for 1.5 gigawatt. I'll repeat again, 1.5 gigawatt with INOX Clean Energy in June, out of which firm orders have been signed for 500 megawatts so far.

items.statement: Received LOA for 200 MW from NLC India in July, a repeat order through tendering process
items.quote: In another positive development in the first quarter, we have received an LOA for 200 megawatt from NLC India. This is a repeat order from NLC in the month of July through an extensive tendering process.

items.statement: 4X wind turbine prototype installation on track for August 2026 with commercial launch by end of FY26
items.quote: We are on track to install the first prototype in the month of August with commercial launch expected by end of FY26.

items.statement: Expanding transformer manufacturing to 4.9 MVA for 4X series, adding 8-20 MVA and 100+ MVA transformers, plus inverters, unit substations, capacitor systems; USS commercial launch in FY27
items.quote: Our operational Jaipur transformer factory is gearing up to manufacture our next bigger capacity, which is 4.9 MVA transformers for our 4X series. We also plan to further increase our trafo manufacturing capacity, including medium-sized trafos between 8 to 20 MVA as well as large transformers, which is 100 MVA plus. We also own our own fleet of cranes. Presently, we have 4 of them in

items.statement: Crane fleet expanding from 4 currently to more within FY27
items.quote: We also own our own fleet of cranes. Presently, we have 4 of them in operations and more to come in within this financial year.

items.statement: NCLT Ahmedabad approved acquisition of Wind World India Limited; formalities to complete in Q2 FY27, then financial consolidation
items.quote: We are pleased to inform you that we have received the approval from honorable NCLT, Ahmedabad for the acquisition of Wind World India Limited. The acquisitions formalities are expected to be completed in Q2 FY27, post which the financial consolidation will take place.

items.statement: INOX Green O&M portfolio at 13.3 GW peak as of June 2026 (10.5 GW wind, balance solar), including 6.5 GW acquired assets
items.quote: INOX Green's portfolio stood at approximately 13.3 gigawatt peak as on June 2026, comprising of approximately 10.5 gigawatt of Wind operating assets and the balance being solar assets. This also includes the investments made to acquire approximately 6.5 gigawatts of operational Wind O&M assets.

items.statement: India wind capacity additions expected at 8-10 GW annually over next few years driven by RTC, FDRE, hybrid tenders; 25% of Q1 renewable tenders were standalone wind
items.quote: We expect to see strong annual wind capacity additions ranging between 8 to 10 gigawatt over the next few years, driven by RTC, FDRE and hybrid capacity additions. In fact, out of the total renewable capacity of 9.34 Inox Wind Limited & gigawatt awarded through tenders in quarter 1, 2.35 gigawatt, that is 25%, comprised of stand- alone wind tenders alone

items.statement: Receivables to drop significantly in Q2/Q3 as pivot to equipment supply improves working capital cycle; receivable days on downward trajectory
items.quote: As we are moving towards the equipment supply, as you rightly said, the receivable numbers will start dropping significantly, and you will see a lot of improvement in quarter 2 and quarter 3 onwards.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved last quarter; annualized working capital guidance maintained
items.quote: But as we have guided, we are sticking to our working capital guidance, which we have provided on an annualized basis, and we keep improving in terms of the last quarter. Our working capital cycle has been improved.

items.statement: Interest cost expected to decrease as focus shifts from turnkey to equipment supply model
items.quote: As we focus more on delivery rather than turnkey, should we see the interest cost coming down?

items.statement: Demerger of power evacuation infrastructure from INOX Green to INOX Renewable Solutions completed August 1, 2026; IRSL auto-listing pending regulatory approvals
items.quote: Further, the demerger of the power evacuation infrastructure business from INOX Green into INOX Renewable Solution has been completed as on August 1, 2026, being the record date. IRSL would now be automatically listed on the stock exchange post receipt of regulatory approvals.

items.statement: INOX Renewable Solutions listing expected within 2-3 months post record date; procedural aspects underway
items.quote: The record date is already over. Now this is the procedural aspects, which we can't comment on. We expect it to happen sooner. 2 months, 3 months, 1 month, we are the best -- we can just judge about it. So 2 months, 3 months is what it should take, not beyond that.

items.statement: INOX Clean Energy treated as arm's-length customer; no preferential pricing; group synergies expected to drive 3 GW+ annual capacity additions benefiting Wind, Green, RESCO
items.quote: We do the business in a most ethical and legal binding way. So all our contracts between entities, entities are arm's length, Inox Wind Limited & the terms of payments, the inspections, the way we work, it's INOX Clean for INOX Wind is a customer, yes. They are treated as a customer, the behavior as a customer

items.statement: Only force majeure events (e.g., Middle East crisis) seen as risk to meeting 75% revenue guidance; equipment supply pivot reduces execution risks
items.quote: And I would say only force majeure, things which are beyond our control. I mean no one had an inkling about this Middle East crisis. So something like that. Otherwise, this pivot to move to equipment supply, honestly, we don't see a risk of not meeting our deliverables.

items.statement: No current plans to increase promoter shareholding; will evaluate over time
items.quote: No plans as of now, but we'll keep evaluating over a period of time. So there's no firm plans as of now.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated: Revenue INR872 cr, Adj EBITDA INR237 cr, PBT INR95 cr, PAT INR64 cr, Cash profit INR153 cr

items.statement: INOX Green Q1 FY27: Total income INR101 cr (+17% YoY), EBITDA INR57 cr (+19% YoY), PBT INR54 cr (+74% YoY), PAT INR41 cr (+86% YoY), Cash PAT INR55 cr (+25% YoY)

items.statement: INOX Green machine availability averaged ~96.3% for entire portfolio in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Machine availability for the entire portfolio averaged approximately 96.3%.

items.statement: FY28-30 revenue growth of 25-30% YoY targeting INR1,500 crores by FY30
items.quote: I think we have developed a revenue model wherein we believe by 2030 we can easily reach INR1,500 crores revenue mark. So we are talking about doubling our revenues before end of FY30. So we will see a year-on-year growth of 25% to 30%.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to reach 29-30% at INR1,000 crores revenue
items.quote: Sir, but you will see a growth in EBITDA margins. I think at INR1,000 crore s revenue, the EBITDA should be roughly around 30%. So close to 30% considering th at the operating costs will not increase that much

items.statement: Oncology expansion to complete by March 2027 adding 45-50% capacity
items.quote: we are making an expansion in the oncology facility. So, o nce that expansion is completed, again an additional 45% to 50% capacity will be

items.quote: Also, there are we are making certain machinery improvements and extending a little area in th e general facility as well, which will add at least 20% more to the existing

items.quote: Ma'am, the general facility I think by 75% to 80% has already been utilized and the oncology also the existing facility is again 75% to 80% utilized. Remaining of the units, biologics has not commercialized, cepha and beta I think they are roughly around 20%, 25%.

items.statement: 60-70 registrations received in last three quarters, each contributing ~INR1.5-2 million yearly sales

items.quote: We have received the final report, and we submitted the CAPA. Now the assessors are reviewing the CAPA. So, we expect the TGA certification also to come through in the coming months. We have received an order for one of the products from Australia, and we are going to start supplies, I think, in the next two to three months.

items.statement: NIP and OTF portfolio contributed ~18% of Q1 FY27 revenue; returned to normalized contribution level
items.quote: I am also pleased to share that our new innovative product portfolio and oral insulin business returned to a normalized level of contribution during the quarter, accounting for approximately 18% of our revenue.

items.statement: Exports contributed ~84% of total operating income in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Exports continue to account for approximately 84% of our total income.

items.statement: Gross margin ~58.1% in Q1 FY27 due to product mix; normalized range 55-58%
items.quote: You are right. It will be around 55 -58% because of the product mix in the first quarter.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 3.7% in Q1 FY27 impacted by planned investments: higher employee costs, utility/fuel/power, consulting for EU-GMP financing
items.quote: Our EBITDA margins for the quarter were impacted by planned investments in the business. These included higher employee costs following the strengthening of our senior leadership team, increased utility, fuel and power expenses, and consulting costs associated with financing of our EU-GMP remediation program.

items.statement: Major capex completed; only INR 15-20 crore remaining for enzyme and Nutra plant upgrades in FY27
items.quote: CapEx is mostly completed now. We have been able to close all our CapEx , and the projects are going to start somewhere in the second quarter. So , as such, only normal upgradation expenses may be there. CapEx will be there. And the amount what we have assumed from the press, that will be the only requirement which is there, which has to be completed, which is around INR 15-20 crores to upgrade th

items.statement: Targeting debtor days reduction from ~100 to ~80 days; controlling inventory levels to improve cash flow
items.quote: We are now improving our cash flows by increasing our collection in debtors, which is from around 100 days. We are targeting to reduce it to around 80 days.

items.statement: Total debt INR 145.2 crore as of 30 June 2026; cost of borrowing below 10%
items.quote: The total debt stood at approximately INR 145.2 crore as on 30th June 2026 . We remain focused on improving operating cash flow, optimizing working capital, and managing leverage.

items.statement: Cost of capital below 10%
items.quote: It's where similar to earlier quarters, Below 10.

items.statement: 8-10 product MAs expected in Europe once EU-GMP received; filings completed, queries answered, near end of 210-day clock
items.quote: We will have MAs for about 8 to 10 products once the EU-GMP comes.

items.statement: Australia market: USD 20M product size, few competitors; order received, supplies starting in 2-3 months post TGA certification
items.quote: Market size for that product in Australia is about USD 20 million, but there are only a few players there. So , we expect to get a good chunk of the market.

items.statement: Neuraxpharm buprenorphine MA held by partner; launch in UK planned post EU-GMP; development complete, license fee received
items.quote: So, yes, Neuraxpharm has their agreement states that they'll be launching in UK also. Their business plans were put on hold because of the fact that we were under EU-GMP remediation. They have given us a positive outlook on the product once the EU-GMP comes back.

items.statement: Alternate manufacturing site batches completed, under stability; can supply from there post stability completion as risk mitigation
items.quote: completed the batches. The batches are under stability right now. Once the stability completes, we'll be in a position to supply from those plants as well

items.statement: Senior leadership team strengthened; key hire: Business Development President with experience in new markets; more leadership hires planned
items.quote: The biggest hire has been the business development president that has come in. He brings with him a lot of experience into newer markets where we were not present.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 one-time expenses: TGA audit INR 30 lakh, EU-GMP audit consulting, repairs & maintenance, MIDC charges INR 1.9 crore; not recurring next quarter
items.quote: Specifically, one-time expenses are in the form of TGA audit, that is Australian audi t of around INR 30 lakhs. I'm certainly engaged for this European audit, and some repairing and maintenance has been taken out to for a smooth EU-GMP audit. And so, MIDC charges that constitute near about INR 1.9 crores.

items.statement: Employee cost run-rate normalized at ~INR 19 crore/quarter excluding one-time items; few more hires pending
items.quote: So, as you said, the run rate will be on the similar side except for the few around what Mr. Patro suggested, that some of the expenditure of amounting to around INR 1.25 crore in this quarter was one-time. Rest, all expenses have been now completed except for few hiring which Zain mentioned.

items.statement: Key risk: EU-GMP certification timeline; if delayed beyond 3-4 months, MA filings may need refiling
items.quote: Obviously, if it goes beyond three to four months, it'll have to be redone. But right now, with the timeline that we have in front of us, it won't need a refiling.

items.statement: Middle East geopolitical disruption impacted Q1 but regularizing; could worsen and impact business
items.quote: We did see some impact in the first quarter, but right now, it seems to be regularizing. It is not playing that bigger role, and we feel like, it might regularize further if this isn't how the situation is. But you can never know, if it worsens, then definitely it will happen have an impact.

items.statement: EU-GMP certification expected in August 2026; CAPA submission 2-3 months post final report; first EU supplies expected in Q4 FY27
items.quote: in the month of August. We do expect it to still be on timeline and come within the next two weeks. Rupesh Tatiya And then how much time after that for CAPA and then final approval? Zain Daud I think it will take about two to three months. So , by the end of the year, we should be ready to be in a position to supply to Europe. So maybe Q4, we can see some revenue starting to come in

items.statement: EU-GMP approval expected to unlock 60-70% of FY28 growth; base business growing steadily
items.quote: See, I think at least 60% of that growth is attributed to the E U-GMP, 60-70%, because that is where the value unlock will happen.

items.statement: Few players in India with oral thin film technology; fewer with EU-GMP certified facility; Zim has EU filings/approvals for sildenafil and rizatriptan OTF
items.quote: You are right. There are a few players only in the oral thin film space and fewer when it comes to a European GMP-certified facility. We are one of the few people who have filings and approvals in Europe.

items.statement: R&D spend INR 82 million in Q1 FY27; viewed as long-term investment for developed market revenue unlock post EU-GMP
items.quote: The company invested INR 82 million towards R&D during the quarter. Overall, the first quarter reflects an organization investing for long-term growth and maintaining healthy business momentum.

items.statement: Indian primary market saw 53 issues mobilizing INR 6,895 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: During the quarter, the Indian primary market saw 53 issues collectively mobilize approximately INR 6,895 crores.

items.statement: Mainboard IPOs: 8 issues raised INR 5,000 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Of these, 8 mainboard IPOs raised approximately INR 5,000 crores, while the small and medium enterprise platform contributed the balance across 45 issues.

items.statement: FY26 mainboard: 108 companies raised over INR 1.76 lakh crores
items.quote: The mainb oard activity represents a significant and disciplined deceleration compared to the record -breaking volume of the preceding financial year, FY26, where 108 mainboard companies raised over INR 1.76 lakh crores

items.statement: Signed 3 new advisory mandates in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Turning to the operational highlights for the quarter, we signed 3 new advisory mandates, reflecting the continued strength of our origination engine.

items.statement: Secured listing mandate with West Bengal-based ferroalloy company
items.quote: We secured a listing mandate with a West Bengal-based ferroalloy company, and we filed the DRHP for Sky Alloys and Power Limited on both NSE and BSE.

items.statement: Bahutex received Category-II AIF registration with Gretex as partner
items.quote: On the alternative investment front, Bahutex received its registration for a Category-II AIF during the quarter, with Gretex as a partner in the fund.

items.statement: Expect minimum 3 to 4 IPO listings in current quarter Q2 FY27
items.quote: Yeah, in terms of listing, if I am not wrong on the question, for the current quarter which is going on, we expect a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings should happen.

items.statement: Gretex Share Broking Limited progressing towards proposed listing
items.quote: Our subsidiary, Gretex Share Broking Limited, continues to progress towards its proposed listing, and its strong contribution this quarter reaffirmed the strategic value of scaling our broking and market-making operations.

items.statement: Domestic equity participation robust with growing investor base and financialization of savings
items.quote: At the same time, domestic participation in the equity market has remained robust, supported by a growing inves tor base and increasing financialization of savings

items.statement: Gradual shift towards professionally managed investment solutions across mutual funds, PMS and AIF platforms
items.quote: We are also seein g a gradual shift towards professionally managed investment solutions, with rising interest across mutual funds, PMS and alternative investment platforms

items.statement: Industry navigating headwinds from evolving geopolitical uncertainties
items.quote: While the industry continues to navigate headwinds arising from evolving geopolitical uncertainties, we remain confident in the long-term growth prospects of the Indian capital markets.

items.statement: Mid-teen revenue growth guided for FY27; FY28 may approach 20% growth
items.quote: we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27. This quarter's headline number does not fully reflect that trajectory for the reasons I have just walked through. But the fundamentals underneath it is a healthy order book, improving product mix, expanding margins, reengaging export customers, and a clean, debt-free balance sheet give us the confidence

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 22.6%, up 100 bps YoY; PAT margin 19.8%, up 290 bps YoY
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR69 crores. I'm not considering other income, which is up by 12% on comparing with the Q1 FY26, with the EBITDA margin at a percentage of 22.6%, which is up by 100 basis points, again, on comparing with Q1 FY26. Profit after tax grew by 22% year-on-year to INR60 crores, with PAT margin at 19.8%, again up by 290 basis points year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Export auto component demand recovering as US customers re-engage after tariff uncertainty; Europe strong
items.quote: What stands out most in export is a change in customer behavior. Buyers who had been a bit cautious and holding back through in fiscal '26, with a wait-and-watch mode as tariff uncertainty and certain adverse market factors played out, are now placing orders again with confidence. That shift matters because it tells us that demand overseas is genuinely picking up and that the relationship we have

items.statement: Order book healthy; Q1 output constrained by labor shortage, not demand
items.quote: Though this looks short of our guided growth, our order book through the quarter was healthy, and the constraint we faced was not demand. It was an execution issue. A shortage of labor on the shop floor meant we could not convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted to.

items.statement: Annual capex guided at INR 30-40 crores for FY27 and FY28
items.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores. Disha: On an annual basis? Hiren Doshi: Yes. No, no, on an annual basis, year-on-year

items.statement: No customer lost during tariff/war disruptions; relationships converting back to volumes
items.quote: As we had flagged and informed previously also, we have not lost a single customer through the tariff disruption or even the war impact in European markets in the last year or even previous to last year. What we are seeing now is those very relationships beginning to convert back into meaningful volumes and revenues.

items.statement: Raw material and forex pass-through in contracts; value-add not automatically passed through
items.quote: It is always on the raw material and forex; what the fluctuation is passed through or to recover. So that's why, conservatively, I would like to be there in between 21%-22% because the simple reason in the month-end of June or mid of June, the ocean freight has started shooting up.

items.statement: US customs duty refunds started, marginal amount received in Q1; major chunk pending
items.quote: Yes, it has already started, and we successfully registered with the U.S. customs authority. And though it has not started in full swing, some marginal amount that we have received as a U.S. customs duty refund, which has already been accounted for in this number. But the major chunk is yet to be received.

items.statement: Company fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations; carrying cash surpluses
items.quote: As of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations. Moreover, we are carrying cash surpluses.

items.statement: Exploring JV with overseas player for value-added processes and ready market access; global agency appointed, 6-9 months timeline
items.quote: We are also looking for inorganic growth or maybe some association or some JV with an overseas player to be based in India, wherein the base of the utilization of Rolex facilities will increase and more value-added processes where the third party has some expertise and a ready market available. That kind of association, that kind of JV, what we are exploring, it is in a primary stage. We have alre

items.statement: Initiated government registrations and approvals for defense/aerospace; defense revenue possible in 12 months
items.quote: We have initiated certain steps, or rather certain registrations, as I just indicated, for the defense era. Again, in aerospace, we explore. But there we got some kind of registration also, initial registration, initial approval certification also. But coming to the revenue, it will take some good time. But I am a bit hopeful for the defense; maybe down the line, in 12 months, we would be having s

items.statement: Labor shortage in April-May due to seasonal migration (vacation, wedding, crop season); resolved by June; temporary labor added at extra cost
items.quote: No, there is no specific reason because it's a general phenomenon, and it's a hot summer in our region. And we do have a good amount of out-of-state labor force also. You better know, it's a vacation period as well as wedding season. And it's an agricultural, what you say, crop season where these people used to visit their native places and they take more than 15, 20 days, 30 days or something lik

items.statement: Geopolitical shipping disruptions (Middle East) causing container/vessel shortages and freight spikes; may persist into Q2
items.quote: See, availability of containers at a proper cost is an issue. As we are committed to our customers, we are just trying to get as many as containers that are reasonable. But as I told you earlier, ocean freight is shooting up, and it is more than 2x or 2.5x what it generally is. But still, we are trying to manage the availability of containers. But sometimes the availability of containers in a part

items.statement: Domestic auto components down 13% YoY in Q1 due to OEM production deferrals; expected recovery from Q2
items.quote: See, domestic auto components- what it was there with me in the last year, it was somewhere about INR52 crores. And here, it is INR45 crores in this Q1 FY27. That is mainly because of the deferring of certain production plans of a couple of OEM of automotive. And Stellantis, again, they started with the revenue, though it is not at the level we had last year. But gradually, it is picking up, and i

items.statement: Management guides for 10-15% top-line growth across all segments for the year
items.quote: We're looking at growth of, say, 10% to 15% on top line and it will be across all the segments.

items.statement: Market has de-grown in operating regions due to West Asia crisis; market share intact
items.quote: The market has de-grown in the markets that we operate in. Basically, it's due to the war situation only, that's been going on since April.

items.statement: Hopeful to close the year with double-digit volume growth despite current disruption
items.quote: We're still positive in long term. And we're hopeful that for the year, we can still close out on double-digit growth.

items.statement: Ankleshwar ICD received initial customs permission; EXIM operations expected by September
items.quote: Ankleshwar, they have received their initial custom s permission, and we should be operational there for EXIM operations by September

items.statement: Indore ICD construction ongoing; 2.5 acres added taking total to 26.4 acres; full swing after September
items.quote: we've acquired 2.5 more acres. So now we're at 26.4 acres roughly. Construction is ongoing in Indore. We've already awarded some tenders. But due to rains and all, it's a bit slow. But after, say, September, we'll be in full swing construction there

items.statement: Jaipur ICD hearing listed for final arguments in September; hopeful to close within a hearing or two
items.quote: On Jaipur, there's no update. We've given it in our notes also that the last hearing took place, but it's -- just another date was given. So, it's still listed for final arguments in September now. We're hopeful that it can get closed within a hearing or two.

items.statement: Rail EBITDA lower due to import decline, export increase, port imbalance, lower double stacking, higher empty running, fuel and wage hikes
items.quote: It's a function of the volume mix also. So, a decline in imports and increasing exports while maintaining the same volume would be lower margin for us. So, a little bit of that. Port imbalance also, specifically within Mundra and Pipavav has also been there. Lower double stacking, higher underframe, higher empty running all contributed to a lower rail EBITDA in this quarter.

items.statement: Haryana minimum wages increased 35%; fuel and wage hikes being passed to customers with time lag; impact more visible in Q2
items.quote: Just for example, Haryana had an increase by 35% in minimum wages. We've tried to pass it on to customers, but there is a time lag in that also. Fuel also, most of it, we've been able to pass on. So that impact will be more visible in Q2.

items.statement: Double stacking dipped to 39% from 40-42% last year
items.quote: On double stack, basically, we're at 39%. So, it has dipped a bit from last year where we were at like 40% to 42% depending on the quarter.

items.statement: CFS margin improvement possible in Q2 after pricing increase to offset fuel and wage hikes
items.quote: It doesn't help with the DFC, but some volume improvements have come in the CFS as well as with this fuel and wage hike, we took a pricing increase. So, a little bit margin improvement possibility is also there, which you might see again in Q2.

items.statement: Cash tax rate of 18.88% to continue for 7-8 years using accumulated MAT credit
items.quote: We will be paying at the rate of 18.88% for at least 7, 8 years. So, we have a large amount of accumulated MAT credit, which we will be utilizing over the next 7, 8 years.

items.statement: Cash tax outgo increased only INR 1-2 crore vs last year despite higher reported tax rate
items.quote: Actual cash tax outgo hasn't really changed that much. That's only increased by about maybe INR1 crore or INR2 crores compared to last year.

items.statement: Contingent liabilities of INR 6,000 crore are 95% bonds to government authorities mainly customs; not real contingent claims
items.quote: Almost 95% of that amount are bonds given to government authorities, mainly customs. So that is because we hold cargo, on which the customs are bonded in nature. So, it's not really a contingent liability in the sense that there is some claim w hich will come up or something like

items.statement: June and July volumes similar to Q1 trend; July impacted by weather restrictions on double stacking and port operations
items.quote: June was similar only. Even July is similar. We can't give specifics because this is a Q1 call and being listed, we have that restriction. But I mean, broadly, the trend remains the same. Market share remains intact. Arrivals have been good, but actually July volumes got impacted because of the weather.

items.statement: Ankleshwar ICD to add direct revenue and EBITDA by catering to excess EXIM volume; currently zero EXIM, ramping to ~5,000 TEUs in 3-4 years
items.quote: it's going to be a new EXIM location for us. So, it's -- right now, it's served by only one ICD, which is full. So, everything excess, we would be in a position to cater to it and bring it to the ICD operating out of that. So that will be a direct addition to our revenue and EBITDA by adding more volume

items.statement: Snowman adding ~24,000 pallets this year (Pune in couple of months, Patna later); similar additions planned for subsequent years
items.quote: So, this year, we'll be adding -- I mean, Pune will be up in another couple of months. And post that Patna is going to come up. So, this year we'll see around 24,000 additional pallets, I mean, by end of this year. And subsequently, similar numbers is what we are planning for subsequent years.

items.statement: Snowman achieved 5-7% average pricing hike across warehousing customers; further revisions on renewals
items.quote: In terms of percentage, I cannot say right away, but in a range between 5% to 7% on an average is what we have got from most of the customers.

items.statement: Snowman 5PL service margin 5-6%; grew 6% YoY in Q1; contributes to warehousing and transportation volumes
items.quote: It's again a mixed blend because if we talk abou t 5PL, typically, the service margin remains between 5% to 6%. Other than that, it helps us gain more volumes in our warehousing and distribution, which is transportation services and the blended margin stays there for those particular units

items.statement: No new 5PL customers in Q1; discussions ongoing, may see additions by Q3 or Q4
items.quote: Not in quarter 1, but discussions are still on. We may see some new names coming up by quarter 3 or quarter 4.

items.statement: Transition from unorganized to organized warehousing continues; FSSAI changes in Mumbai driving shifts
items.quote: See, in general, the transition is there from unorganized to organized, which will continue to happen. If you see in Mumbai itself with the new FSSAI Commissioner, a lot of changes have happened in the last 2 to 3 days itself.

items.statement: DFC connection to JNPT complete; first double stack from JNPT to NCR run; early days for cargo shift
items.quote: The last connection, which was pending on the DFC stretch, now it is complete. So, in fact, we were the one who started the first double stack from JNPT towards NCR.

items.statement: Import volumes improving from June-July after April-May dry-up; Mundra/Pipavav congestion may shift cargo to JNPT
items.quote: After this West Asia crisis, wherein imports dried up in the months of April, May, there has been some improvement on the import side from June, July onwards. But we need to see how now Mundra and Pipavav ports, they are going to cope up with the congestion because ultimately, we also experienced some congestions at the port and towards major ports.

items.statement: JNPT currently 5% of rail volumes; expected to increase as Ankleshwar and Indore operationalize
items.quote: Currently, it's about 5%, but we are hopeful that this will increase going forward, especially as we add Ankleshwar and Indore, both are very dependent on JNPT. Most of their volume is JNPT only. So as those operationalize, our JNPT share should increase.

items.statement: Special haulage charges for JNPT discussed but nothing concrete; shipping lines in exploratory stage for single dip
items.quote: We don't have any insight, but it's just like industry rumors that it's on everyone's wish list, but there's nothing concrete that anything has come on this.

items.statement: DFC volume shift incremental 1-2% per year; long-term positive but wait-and-watch
items.quote: Every year, maybe 1% -1%, 2%-2% incrementally can happen. But long term, it's a good positive development for us.

items.statement: Market share by first year premium income was 60.10% for Q1 FY27 vs 63.51% a year ago
items.quote: Our market share by first year premium income for three months ending 30th June '26 is 60.10% as per IRDAI as compared to 63.51% for the similar period ended 30th June 2025.

items.statement: Individual business market share was 38.89% and group business market share was 70.90% for Q1 FY27
items.quote: On a comparable basis for the three months ending June 30, 2025, the respective market share for individual and group business were 38.76% and 76.54%, respectively.

items.statement: Total premium income grew 6.75% YoY to Rs 127,250 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: For the quarter ended 30th June 2026, we have recorded a total premium income of 127,250 crore rupees as compared to total premium income of 119,200 crore rupees for the quarter ended 30th June 2025, registering a growth of 6.75% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Individual new business premium grew 14.48% YoY to Rs 14,351 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The individual new business premium income for quarter ended 30 June '26 was 14,351 crore rupees as compared to 12,536 crore rupees for the corresponding period last year, thereby registering a growth of 14.48% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Group total premium grew 8.61% YoY to Rs 51,834 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Therefore, for this quarter ended 30th June '26, the total group premium has increased by 8.61% as compared to the similar period of previous year.

items.statement: Total APE grew 8.22% YoY to Rs 13,692 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Total annualized premium equivalent for the quarter ended 30th June '26 is 13,692 crore rupees, which comprised individual APE of 7,532 crore rupees and group APE of 6,160 crore rupees.

items.statement: Non-par share of individual APE rose to 32.49% in Q1 FY27 from 30.34% a year ago
items.quote: Therefore, our non-par share of individual APE is 32.49% and par is 67.51% for the quarter ended 30th June '26. As you may recall, for the quarter ended 30th June 2025, our non-par share of total individual business based on APE stood at 30.34%.

items.statement: Net VNB margin improved 750 bps YoY to 22.9% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The net VNB margin has improved by 750 basis points on a year-on-year basis from 15.4% for the quarter ended 30 June '25 to 22.9% for the first quarter of the current year.

items.statement: Net VNB grew 61.32% YoY to Rs 3,136 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Further, the net VNB has registered a growth of 61.32% on a year-on-year basis from 1,944 crore rupees for the quarter ended 30th June '25 to 3,136 crore rupees for the quarter ended 30th June '26.

items.statement: Profit after tax grew 22.81% YoY to Rs 13,492 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The profit after tax for the quarter ended 30th June '26 was 13,492 crore rupees as compared to 10,986 crore rupees for the quarter ended 30th June '25, registering a growth of 22.81% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: VNB margin improvement driven by 6.5% positive mix impact from non-par savings and protection growth
items.quote: So this, along with if you recall in our earlier meetings that we had in the year 2024 come out with products with a higher ticket size. So those also have impacted the business mix and the business growth, which I have just told you. These two have contributed to 6.5% positively to the VNB growth.

items.statement: Assumption changes contributed 2.9% positive impact to VNB margin from RFR and persistency alignment
items.quote: As regards assumptions, we have shown 2.9% positive growth on this, which is the combined impact of RFR during the year and the experience on persistency on both individual and group has been aligned with the current experience.

items.statement: Expense assumptions including GST ITC loss contributed -1.9% negative impact to VNB margin
items.quote: If you look at the expense assumptions, expense assumptions, along with the impact of input tax credit, that has contributed to a negative of minus 1.9%.

items.statement: Management expects VNB margins to improve further from Q1 FY27 levels targeting mid-20s
items.quote: We expect the margin to grow something more than where we currently are and settle something around the industry average.

items.statement: Segmental VNB margins: par 19.4%, non-par individual 49.3%, group 29.4%
items.quote: So if you look at the proportion of par business, which is 37.1%, which gives a VNB margin of 19.4%. The proportion of non-par individual is INR1,678 crores, which gives a margin of 49.3%. And the group business is the third group, which is 45% on APE, which gives VNB margin of 29.4%.

items.statement: AUM grew 4.1% YoY to Rs 59,39,384.39 crore as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Our assets under management has registered a growth of 4.1% on a year-on-year basis from 57,05,341.44 crore rupees as on 30th June '25 to 59,39,384.39 crore rupees as on 30th June 2026.

items.statement: Total agents decreased 2.73% YoY to 14,45,692 as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As on June 30, 2026, the total number of agents was 14,45,692 as compared to 14,86,222 as on June 30, 2025, registering a decrease of 2.73% year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Agent count reduction due to weeding out non-serious Bima Sakhi candidates
items.quote: On the agent front, yes, the number of agents reduction has been because of a good number of candidates who have taken up Bima Sakhi without fully understanding the requirement.

items.statement: Bima Sakhi program covered 62% of gram panchayats with 2.87 lakh women designated
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, a total of 2.87 lakh women have been designated as Bima Sakhis, successfully selling 4.52 lakh insurance policies and generating a new business premium income of 656.91 crore rupees.

items.statement: ULIP premium reduction due to market volatility; focus on margin-accretive non-par savings and protection
items.quote: ULIP premium reduction is naturally a function of the market scenario when confidence in the market gets affected due to the high volatility in the market functioning. And naturally, that's also one. I'll put it the other way that we have been focusing on the margin-accretive business lines, and we have shown a good growth, as you would have seen, in both non-par savings as well as non-par protect

items.statement: Overall expense ratio increased 16 bps YoY to 10.63% due to GST ITC loss
items.quote: For the quarter ended 30th June 2026, the overall expense ratio was 10.63% as compared to 10.47% for the same period last year. Therefore, an increase of 16 basis points in our overall expense ratio on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: GST ITC loss impact on expense ratio expected to normalize after Q2 FY27 as comparison base aligns
items.quote: Once the assumption change has been incorporated, I don't think it should have much of an impact in the subsequent quarters. items.statement: Net working capital at 139 days of trailing 12-month revenue as of June 30, 2026

items.statement: Net cash position of INR190 crores at end of Q1 FY27; debt-free balance sheet

items.statement: Strong balance sheet with INR190 crores cash provides powder for acquisitions; would raise debt if needed for inorganic opportunities

items.statement: Fabrication vertical expected to become meaningful in 18-24 months; organic capex includes fabrication growth
items.quote: We do believe that the fabrication vertical will become a meaning ful vertical. In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical

items.quote: Just to put this in context, when we declared the special dividend of INR 101 crores in October of '25, our cash balance was approximately INR210 crores. Therefore, in just 10 months through focused operations and business growth, we have rebuilt to that

items.quote: Our confidence is in the underlying growth opportunity remaining strong, and we continue to target a 20-25% revenue growth CAGR over the next five years.

items.statement: Expects FY27 revenue growth around 25% YoY
items.quote: In FY27, in the next three quarters, we expect EBITDA to be in the line of INR 7-8 per SCM, operating EBITDA. Our revenue growth will be around 25%. That's what is we expect.

items.statement: Expects FY27 volume growth of 10-12%
items.quote: Volume-wise, we expect around 10-12% growth in volume.

items.statement: Expects FY27 EBITDA per SCM of INR 7-8 for next three quarters
items.quote: In FY27, in the next three quarters, we expect EBITDA to be in the line of INR 7-8 per SCM, operating EBITDA.

items.statement: Expects FY27 full-year volume of 250 MMSCM

items.statement: Expects Namakkal & Trichy GA volume of 25-30 MMSCM in FY27
items.quote: It will be in the range of 25-30 MMSCM.

items.statement: Incurred INR 67 crore capex in Q1 FY27, cumulative capex around INR 1,090 crore
items.quote: We have incurred CapEx of approximately INR 67 crore in three months quarter in FY27 this year, given FY27 this year, taking our cumulative CapEx to around INR 1,090 crore in that range.

items.statement: Utilized INR 337 crore of IPO proceeds out of INR 496 crore (68%) as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: We have utilized almost INR 337 crores out of the total net proceeds of INR 496 crores as on 30th June, 2026. This nearly represents 68% utilization.

items.quote: As on 30th June 2026, we operated 153 CNG stations, and 153 stations is a 37% YoY growth in our station, supported by 564 dispensing points on those locations across our all our 4 GAs.

items.quote: Our volumes reached an all-time high of 50.9 MMSCM, growing 8% YoY. This was primarily driven by CNG volume that grew around 22% YoY and strong momentum on CNG commercial volume, which grew 75% YoY.

items.statement: PNG domestic customers up 13% YoY to 86,590; commercial up 36% to 589; industrial up 5% to 228
items.quote: We continue to deepen our P NG customer base during this quarter, like domestic P NG customers increased to 86,590, to be precise, commercial customers increased to 589 and industrial customers stood at 228 numbers. This represents YoY growth of 13% in domestic customers, 36% in commercial customers and 5% on industrial customers.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR 62 crore (up 139% YoY), margin 19%; PAT INR 34 crore (up 140% YoY), margin 10.5%
items.quote: During the quarter, our revenue from operations stood at INR 326 crore, registering a growth of 24% YoY and 17% QoQ. EBITDA, excluding other income, increased sharply to INR 62 crore, reflecting a growth of 139% YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding to 19% of profit after tax, which stood at INR 34 crore, which is up 140% YoY, with PAT margin improving to 10.5%.

items.statement: EBITDA per SCM improved due to gas sourcing optimization and pricing; expects INR 6-7 minimum if pricing sustains
items.quote: If it remains continue d, then the EBITDA per SCM would be around INR 6-7 very minimum

items.statement: No further price hikes planned as Brent cools; will maintain current industrial prices due to sourcing lag
items.quote: As of now, since the Brent has also started cooling down, we will not pass on and spoil our upcoming market by making another price hike. But at the same time, whatever we have been able to take from market, particularly industrial volumes that we will continue for some time.

items.statement: Commenced CNG sales to TNSTC with 80+ buses operational; expects 200+ buses soon
items.quote: In Namakkal, we commenced CNG sales to TNSTC, the Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation buses, with more than 80 buses currently operational. That way, we have got more orders, and shortly, we will be connecting more buses of Namakkal and Trichy. They are going to assure us more than 200 buses in near future.

items.statement: Converted entire commercial segment in Diu to PNG; Nagoa beach (250+ establishments) now fully connected
items.quote: Similarly, for Diu, we have successfully converted the entire commercial segment of PNG. Now that, we can call Diu as a central territory, both totally LP G-free. There, we have got, all the commercial connections connected to P NG now.

items.statement: Government notification March 9, 2026 cut industrial gas allocation by ~80% due to West Asia supply disruption; CNG/PNG domestic/commercial unaffected
items.quote: P NG industrial volume s were impacted during the quarter following the government notification dated 9th March 2026, which resulted in an around 80% of the gas allocation amidst supply disruption arising out of the West Asia conflict. This notification was especially only for industrial supplies, not impacting CNG and PNG domestic areas or even commercial areas.

items.statement: Appointed seasoned industry leaders as Director of Finance and Chief Operating Officer in Q1 FY27
items.quote: During this quarter, we have reinforced our team and have appointed a seasoned industry leader to the key positions, including Director of Finance and Chief Operating Officer, both of whom bring extensive experience from leading Indian conglomerates.

items.statement: Revised AUM growth guidance to 20% for FY27
items.quote: We have revised our guidance to 20%. We feel that with the momentum that we have in the quarter 1 and looking at the festive season approaching us and the way the liquidity is available to us and the demand that is there at the ground, we definitely feel that 20% is a growth that we can easily achieve.

items.statement: NIM guidance range 12.3% to 12.5% for FY27
items.quote: Our NIM guidance is around 12.5% on the upper spectrum and lower spectrum 12.3%. So we definitely believe that NIM will expand both on the side of the yield also as more and more of good portfolio becomes a part of the larger pool and the yield on the portfolio improves and collection also from the NPA improves.

items.statement: ROA guidance upper spectrum 3.3% and ROE upper spectrum 18% for FY27
items.quote: ROA, we have guided for around 3.3% on the upper spectrum, and ROE of around 18% on the upper spectrum.

items.statement: Credit cost guidance revised lower; currently at 2.6% vs guided 2.7%-3.5%
items.quote: We have given the guidance of around 2.7% to 3.5%. We are already below the lower spectrum of around 2.7%. We are already at 2.6% for the first quarter. And definitely, going forward, it will be improving in the coming quarters, so we have revised the guidance in terms of our credit cost.

items.statement: Target cost of funds in single digits by end of FY27
items.quote: We feel that in the financial year, we should be able to come into single digits in terms of our cost of fund and availability of fund is already there.

items.statement: Digital collection target 75% by 2030 expected to be achieved earlier
items.quote: And the guidance that we have given of around 75% digital collection by 2030, I think we should be able to achieve that much earlier.

items.statement: Branch network target 1,740-1,750 branches for FY27
items.quote: So we will be in the range of 1,750 to 1,740 branches. We are right now around 1,670 branches.

items.statement: Long-term ROA target 5% by FY30
items.quote: If you look at our guidance for FY30, we are trying to achieve at around 5% ROA and this journey is in that direction.

items.statement: Long-term operating expense target 5.5%-5.75%
items.quote: The operating expenses already started to come down. We are at around 6.3%, which we were at 6.4%. This we feel in the long run should be at around 5.5% to 5.75%.

items.statement: Long-term branch productivity target INR 12-13 crores per branch
items.quote: We feel that we can take it to around INR 12 crores to INR13 crores outstanding per branch, so that will improve the efficiency of the overall system.

items.statement: Disbursement momentum strong; Q1 disbursement INR 2,644 crores, 49% YoY increase
items.quote: We di d around INR2,644 crores of disbursement, which is the ever highest disbursement in the Q1 as compared to the last quarter, it is around 49% improvement over the disbursement last financial year in the Q1 itself

items.statement: Monthly disbursement run-rate targeting INR 1,000 crores; full year disbursement excess of INR 12,000 crores
items.quote: On an average, if you see the disbursement that we are planning would be in excess of INR 12,000 crores, so INR1,000 crores per month kind of a disbursement number would be achieved.

items.statement: Gold loan disbursement INR 100 crores per month post Q1; INR 360 crores disbursed so far
items.quote: Post the first quarter, every month, we are disbursing INR 100 crores. Already, we have disbursed around INR360 crores of gold loans, and it is scaling up really well.

items.statement: Consumer durable loan pilot of INR 500 crores approved; yield 22%-23%
items.quote: We are starting with a pilot of around INR 500 crores. And this is something which we have strategically thought. If you look at our PTC transactions and our CP transaction, they are happening at a coupon rate of around 7.7%.

items.statement: Individual loan portfolio INR 3,200 crores with 0.02% 30+ delinquency
items.quote: We have focused on individual loans. So that portfolio stands around INR3,200 crores, and that is really, really performing well. There is absolutely very minimal delinquency, 0.02% is the 30-plus, and there is no 60-plus as of now, no 90-plus.

items.statement: AUM grew 18% YoY; 76% JLG, 24% non-JLG mix
items.quote: In terms of our overall performance, we have seen the AUM growth of 18% year -on-year. We will continue to build this AUM with quality and look at the customers' need and continue to improvise on products and focus on products which are catering to our cust omers' needs

items.statement: Gold loan co-lending target INR 1,200 crores disbursement and INR 500 crores portfolio; likely to overachieve

items.quote: Our aim is to have around INR1,200 crores of disbursement and around INR500 crores of gold portfolio. We are likely to overachieve this number for sure.

items.statement: Cost of funds reduced 14 bps to 10.13% in Q1; incremental borrowing cost 9.8%
items.quote: In the quarter, we have reduced our cost of fund from 10.27% to 10.13%, 14 basis point reduction has already happened in the Q1 itself. And this is before the benefit of the rating upgrade.

items.statement: Blended portfolio yield ~23%; JLG 24.85%, individual 23.5%, LAP 18-22%, gold ~20%
items.quote: On the yield part, if you look at our portfolio, the overall lending mix is there, so we are doing group loans at around 24.85%, individual loans at around 23.5%. Then there is a LAP loan, which is between 18% to 22%, and gold loan, which is at around 20%. So blended yield, if you look at the portfolio, would be somewhere around 23%.

items.statement: NIM expanded 50 bps YoY to 12%; Q1 flat QoQ due to liquidity carry

items.statement: Operating cost reduced to 6.3% from 6.4%; further reduction expected with scale

items.quote: And second aspect is we take natural calamity insurance for all our customers, so that impact is not there at all in our portfolio, even if there is some flood that may come, we don't have any impact on our portfolio.

items.quote: on the price hike, we had increased the rate at the end of the quarter, so we had increased the rate by around from 23.5% to 24.85%. So there has been an increase in the yield definitely because of the risk and the credit cost that was there last y ear. This year

items.quote: Another important role that SRO is playing is to provide liquidity to the sector. items.quote: Overall collection also has reached to around 40% digital. And every quarter, we are seeing almost 6% improvement in the digital journey.

items.quote: Our portfolio, hardly 2% of our customers are directly dependent on these activities, which are in sensitive areas, which there could be a shortfall of rain or rain deficit. Som e of the parts of Maharashtra, Karnataka that are sensitive to it

items.quote: I'm sure that we will have 3x revenue growth compared to last year as well as EBITDA breakeven in quarter 4, '27.

items.quote: Today, we have an order book of almost INR200 crores for our AC/DC chargers in India, including exports of about USD2 million.

items.statement: EV passenger car registrations hit record ~31,000 in Q1 FY27 driving charger demand
items.quote: For the first time, we had nearly 31,000 registrations of passenger cars, which is the highest number till date. That has resulting of a lot of new launches across Maruti, Tata, Mahindra, some of the luxury carmakers.

items.statement: AC charger monthly run rate up 50% from Nov-Dec levels; expects another 50% increase in next 3 months
items.quote: I see our AC charger monthly volume has already increased by 50% as we speak from like levels of last, let's say, December or November, December. And it's further going to increase by 50% over the next 3 months.

items.statement: Standalone gross margin 29.1% in Q1 FY27, up 2% QoQ on better pricing and mix; down 3.6% YoY on US input cost pressure
items.quote: Stand-alone gross margins for Q1 stood at 29.1%, which is 2% above the previous quarter, which is Q4 of last year on better pricing and customer mix in both the segments. On a year-on-year basis, gross margin was down by about 3.6%, primarily on account of the U.S.-led input cost pressure, partially offset by the favorable segment mix that we had.

items.statement: AC charger utilization near 100%; DC power systems 90-100%; PCBA and battery lines near 100%; DC chargers ~65% utilization
items.quote: On AC charger, I see close to 100%. On DC power system line, I see close to between 90% and 100%. items.quote: I think the capacity there can service 2.5x of this revenue. So roughly, let's say, USD100 million, slightly more maybe. And we are doing 1/4 of that today.
