items.quote: NeoPark and NeoSquare together contributed 8,000 square feet of sales, with a booking value of INR 14 crores and collection of INR 9 crores.

items.statement: Commercial portfolio Q1 FY27: Futurex 4,000 sq ft sold, INR 19 cr booking value, INR 23 cr collections; Millennium 1,000 sq ft sold, INR 3 cr booking value, INR 1 cr collections
items.quote: At Marathon Futurex on a combined basis, including the post-merger position, we sold approximately 4,000 square feet during the quarter with a booking value of INR 19 crores and collection of INR 23 crores. Millennium sold over 1,000 square feet with a booking value of INR 3 crores and collection of INR 1 crore.

items.statement: FY27 priorities: execution across ongoing MMR projects, driving sales and collections, launching next projects at appropriate time, selectively adding new development opportunities
items.quote: Looking ahead, our priorities for FY27 are clear. We will remain focused on execution across our ongoing projects in MMR, driving sales and collections, bringing the next set of projects to market at the appropriate time and selectively adding new development opportunities for future.

items.statement: INR 200 cr of acquisition capital to be fully deployed in FY27 for new projects
items.quote: most likely the surplus capital that we have currently will be fully deployed in this financial year. So that's about INR 200 crores of capital that we will deploy in new projects.

items.statement: Monte South Tower A OC received; Tower B RCC up to 65th floor, part OC up to 45th floor, remaining OC expected FY27; Tower C RCC up to 28th floor
items.quote: Tower A, as you already know, we have received occupation certificate, while Tower B has achieved RCC completion up to 65th floor tariff, and it is also having part occupation certificate up to 45th floor. The occupation certificate for remaining part up to 65th floor is expected during this financial year. Tower C has also progressed rapidly with RCC work completed up to 28th floor.

items.statement: Nexzone Cedar and Daffodil Towers received full OC enabling handovers
items.quote: Importantly, we achieved full occupation certificate for the Cedar and Daffodil Towers, enabling customer handovers and supporting collections.

items.statement: Bhandup NeoSquare OC received; NeoValley and NeoPark construction on schedule
items.quote: NeoSquare, as you know, has already received its occupation certificate, while construction at NeoValley and NeoPark continues as planned.

items.statement: Futurex OC received; Millennium construction on schedule
items.quote: Futurex, as you know, has already received its occupation certificate, while construction at Millennium continues as planned.

items.statement: Merger consolidation to bring 400+ acres land, ongoing projects, Futurex ready inventory; stakeholder meetings in first week Sep, second NCLT hearing after
items.quote: The proposed merger is another important part. It is designed to consolidate and optimize the group's real estate assets that were not part of a listed entity. The consolidation will bring over 400 acres of land, several ongoing projects and some ready inventory at Futurex into the company's portfolio.

items.statement: Unsold GDV in existing portfolio ~INR 8,000 cr; broader land bank from consolidation adds substantial future visibility
items.quote: Our existing portfolio has an estimated unsold GDV of approximately INR 8,000 crores, while our broader land bank, which is coming through the consolidation provides substantial visibility for future development.

items.statement: Upcoming pipeline GDV: Monte South Commercial INR 3,400 cr, Monte South Residential Tower D INR 1,600 cr, Bhandup Neo Series INR 2,800 cr
items.quote: Our upcoming projects are as follows: Monte South Commercial with an estimated GDV of INR 3,400 crores, Monte South Residential Tower D with an estimated GDV of INR 1,600 crores, and in Bhandup, Marathon Neo Series represents an estimated GDV of approximately INR 2,800 crores.

items.statement: Post QIP of INR 900 cr, net cash position with INR 200 cr acquisition capital, debt-free balance sheet
items.quote: Following the successful QIP of INR 900 crores, we remain in a net cash position with approximately INR 200 crores of acquisition capital available for new acquisitions and a debt-free balance sheet.

items.statement: Strong demand across commercial leasing and outright sales at Futurex; Monte South footfalls dramatically increased; Bhandup new phase showing good numbers; Panvel new launches
items.quote: Our Monte South project in terms of footfalls has dramatically increased. And in the next few quarters, you shall be seeing a much better result than what we have already performed. In terms of Bhandup, we have recently launched an additional phase of an existing project. So that itself is also showing good numbers.

items.statement: PTC sales vertical in Bhandup seeing huge demand from neighboring redevelopment projects; presales expected in next few quarters
items.quote: And for redevelopment to become more viable, they require this PTC area. So especially in the newer deals, people are actually initially coming to us and seeking this area. So in the next few quarters, you might even see some presales from PTC area.

items.statement: Target EBITDA margins 30-35% for acquiring projects; strict financial metrics and expected profit margins for redevelopment deals
items.quote: We have always had our EBITDA margins of 30-35% as a target for acquiring projects.

items.statement: Ready-to-move inventory (Futurex, Monte South Tower A & B up to 45th floor) drives 100% collections within ~3 months; Monte South Tower C at 28th slab ~40% collections; FY27 collections expected heavier
items.quote: a lot of our projects have ready-to-move-in inventory. From that perspective, if we sell that ready-to-move-in inventory, the collections are directly 100%. So, for example, our Futurex, whatever sales happen from that project, the collection of that comes within a TAT of around 3 months of sale. Similarly, in Monte South, we have Tower A and Tower B till the 45th floor. Whatever we sell, the TAT

items.statement: Merger stakeholder meetings planned first week Sep; second NCLT hearing after; timeline uncertain due to NCLT bench workload
items.quote: all the stakeholders' meeting, some of the meetings have been waived by secured creditors and other meetings, whatever were planned are supposed to be done in the first week of September, including the shareholders' meeting of our company. So these are the meetings. After that, there will be a second hearing and then the merger would proceed.

items.statement: Redevelopment deals with very high offers often get stuck later; financially balanced approach needed for occupant viability
items.quote: Important thing to note here is when the offers are very high, we have seen so many of redevelopment projects that get stuck later on. So, it is a good idea to have a financially balanced approach even from the perspective of the occupants that if you seek very high amount and pricy deal, there is a chance that those deals will not go through that we have seen in many of these instances in suburbs

items.statement: Built redevelopment team and gained experience over last 1-2 years; actively evaluating selective opportunities
items.quote: the Versova and Sewri opportunities, they sort of reflect our work that we have done over the last year or 2 on the redevelopment front. And of course, we are still actively looking for many opportunities, and this has sort of helped us build a team and gain some experience in the entire redevelopment process.

items.statement: Monte South commercial launch planned leveraging Futurex relationships and limited Grade A supply in vicinity
items.quote: with the recently planned Monte South commercial being 5 minutes' drive from Futurex, it gives us good confidence to launch this commercial project in the vicinity by leveraging our existing relationships and capitalizing on the limited supply of commercial grade A space in the vicinity.

items.statement: Panvel infrastructure tailwinds: Navi Mumbai Airport operational, Atal Setu improving connectivity, Panvel-Karjat corridor deadline Dec 2026, local train connectivity expanding
items.quote: The Navi Mumbai International Airport is now operational. Atal Setu has significantly improved connectivity and the broader Panvel-Karjat corridor is progressing, with the deadline being December 2026. With this, the peripheral areas of Panvel, which were connected by road will now be connected by Mumbai local trains as well.

items.statement: Goregaon-Mulund Link Road (GMLR) twin tunnels started; 350+ slum families rehoused in June; will strengthen East-West connectivity
items.quote: In June this year, more than 350 slum-dwelling families were rehoused by the government to pave the way for the construction of the Goregaon-Mulund Link Road (GMLR). The Project's twin tunnels have started for connection of Goregaon and Mulund. The GMLR will further strengthen connectivity between the Eastern and Western suburbs.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 total income INR 217 cr (multi-quarter high), EBITDA INR 66 cr, PAT INR 52 cr
items.quote: we have started FY27 on a good note with the total income for the quarter standing at INR 217 crores, which is a multi-quarter high, while EBITDA stood at INR 66 crores and profit after tax at INR 52 crores.

items.statement: FY27 group revenue target 18-20% growth with EBITDA margin around 17.5%
items.quote: For FY27, we continue to continue to have a target group revenue target of about 18% to 20%, with margins being in the range of about 17-odd percent, a little bit maybe 17.5% because we're still working out the whole impact of the inflationary pressures.

items.statement: Export revenue target 35% of total by FY28
items.quote: We are targeting to take our exports to 35% by FY28.

items.statement: Gasket division expected to grow ~17% in FY27
items.quote: We expect the same because the market is very buoyant and we see the same type of growth by the year-end, we expect to grow about 17% this year, overall.

items.statement: Forging division expected to grow 15-20% in FY27
items.quote: And by the year-end, this business will definitely grow between 15% to 20%.

items.statement: EV revenue contribution target minimum 5% in next 2-3 years
items.quote: First quarter, it is around 3.27% of this year. We expect in next 2 year it should go up 5%.

items.statement: Gasket division revenue target INR 850-900 crores by FY30
items.quote: INR850 crore, forging INR600 crores revenue by FY '30.

items.statement: Planned capex INR 103 crores for FY27 across gaskets, forgings, heat shields
items.quote: Our planned capex is about INR103 crores for the year across gaskets, forgings, heat shields and to try and meet the demands of the OEM.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 17.6% under temporary pressure from elevated commodity prices
items.quote: EBITDA at INR43 crores at a margin of 17.6%. Margins during the quarter witnessed temporary pressure on account of elevated commodity prices, particularly steel and aluminium as well as other inflation costs such as labour increases in some states.

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin expected around 17%
items.quote: Around 17%, you can assume.

items.statement: Secured new orders from Kia, Cummins, Stellantis; Marelli order book ~INR 500 crores over 5 years
items.quote: Some serious order book is coming our way, almost about INR500 crores for 5 years, INR100 crores per annum.

items.statement: Data centre gasket revenue potential INR 30-40 crores annually, targeting INR 100 crores in 2-3 years
items.quote: We estimate the current revenue potential from this segment, so a little bit nominal can be about INR30 crores to INR40 crores annually. So that is a nice new segment to enter into.

items.statement: Gasket & heat shield division 52% of revenue, grew 21% YoY; Forging division 4% YoY growth
items.quote: Our gasket and heat shield division continue to remain the largest contributor to our business, giving a 52% share in the revenue. The division reported revenue of INR164 crores of the INR242 crores I mentioned to you, growing by 21% year-on-year.

items.statement: New business from Volvo (gaskets), JLR (plastic EV components), BMW (increased share), Stellantis (chassis & forging)
items.quote: Volvo as a potential new customer with the gasket business, Marelli has just opened up its doors with Stellantis. So new customer from the chassis business line as well as the forging business line. We are working with Jaguar Land Rover on new components for the first time, which are plastic

items.statement: Cummins America expected INR 30-40 crores business by FY27-28 across wire harness, aftermarket, data centre gaskets
items.quote: Cummins America, as I keep mentioned to you, is a very slow starter. It's like a tortoise, but I'm very, very hopeful bY27, '28, you see at least INR30 crores, INR40 crores of business coming from America Cummins with wire harness gaskets, with aftermarket gasket with data centre gaskets.

items.statement: Commodity cost pressure (steel, aluminium, labour) expected to be passed through to OEMs in coming quarters
items.quote: But we are very positive that we will get these increases from the OEMs in the coming quarters.

items.statement: EV sales contribution 3.27% of total revenue in Q1 FY27, up from 2.9% YoY
items.quote: Just for your information in this quarter alone, EV supply to my total EV sales is all divisions around INR12.5 crores. Tt was around INR9 crores last year sales and INR10 crores in Qd, it has gone up by INR2 crores. Right. And has grown 5% as compared Q1 of FY26. We are quite hopeful that we grow further up. It's now 3.27%, last year it was 2.9%, last quarter it was 2.56% for 2 years, exactly

items.statement: Ashish appointed CEO of Talbros Automotive on April 1, spending 50% time on forging division
items.quote: As you know, Ashish appointed CEO of Talbros Automotive on April 1. He's spending about 50% of his time in forging as well.

items.statement: Marelli stake sale progress pending court proceedings, clarity expected by end September
items.quote: So, we will have a better picture for you around end of September. You know our strategy. So, 1 think they are in the middle of court proceedings. So, by 30 September, we'll have a better picture.

items.statement: Maintain ~50% market share in domestic gasket market, single source for many OEMs
items.quote: We continue to maintain our leadership position with nearly 50% market share in the domestic gasket market and a single source of many, many OEMs.

items.statement: Plastic components new orders ~INR 25 crores, maturing from next financial year
items.quote: And we have plastic components, we are getting order of about INR25 crores for plastic components, more orders are coming that will start maturing from next financial year.

items.statement: Management declined to provide full-year EBITDA margin guidance due to market uncertainty.
items.quote: No, I mean, with this kind of uncertainty in the market, I will not be in a position to give you a guidance on the EBITDA margin for the year.

items.statement: Ad revenue declined 11% YoY in Q1 due to Middle East conflict impacting advertiser spending in April-May.
items.quote: Coming to advertising revenues. It declined by 11% year -on-year, largely due to the Middle East conflict severely impacting us during April and May as the advertisers remain very cautious.

items.statement: Management sees green shoots in ad revenue from June and expects festive season and improved market share to drive recovery.
items.quote: In June, there were some green shoots which were visible post the acquisition of FIFA 2026, digital and broadcasting rights wherein advertisers actively engaged with us to secure premium sponsorship opportunities across platforms.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA was INR 789 million with 4.1% margin, impacted by operating deleverage from ad revenue decline and higher FIFA-related costs.
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 789 million, impacted by operating deleverage due to Middle East crisis impacting the advertising revenue. As a result, EBITDA margins were at 4.1%.

items.statement: Digital business delivered INR 44 million EBITDA in Q1 despite increased marketing spend on FIFA and Bullet.
items.quote: Despite the above -mentioned investments the digital business delivered EBITDA of INR 44 million during the quarter.

items.statement: Secured FIFA digital and broadcasting rights for 39 events until 2034, including 2030 World Cup.
items.quote: In June 2026, in line with our strategic approach to establish a strong presence across high potential growth segments and invest in upcoming sports, the company partnered with FIFA to bring the world's biggest football property and secure digital and broa dcasting rights for various FIFA events until 2034 for the Indian market

items.statement: Acquired Bundesliga and Serie A rights for international football content.
items.quote: We have signed, as I just stated, Bundesliga and Serie A from the international football world, we are working on creating a domestic calendar as well in terms of how we can have a robust sports strategy going forward.

items.statement: FIFA rights payments staggered over 8 years with higher outflows for 2030 World Cup.
items.quote: And the payments like Punit mentioned are staggered. So, there will be a higher amount, which will be attributable to the 2030 world cup, for sure.

items.statement: Launched 4 Unite8 sports channels in June 2026 for FIFA World Cup and other sports.
items.quote: Additionally, in June 2026, we launched 4 new sports channels called “Unite8” to broadcast FIFA 2026 World Cup and other sports.

items.statement: ZEE5 released 38 shows and movies including 15 originals across 7 languages in Q1.
items.quote: During the quarter, we released 38 shows and movies, including 15 original shows. This enhanced content offering across 7 languages, coupled with a revised pricing strategy on FIFA 2026, ZEE5 witnessed continued growth momentum.

items.statement: ZEE5 revenue grew 58% YoY to INR 4,571 million driven by FIFA pricing strategy and content slate.
items.quote: Revenue grew 58% year -on-year in quarter 1 to INR 4,571 million. Further, we continue to invest for future growth by increasing our marketing spend in Bullet which has a huge potential in capturing the attention of new age consumers.

items.statement: Linear subscription price hikes expected at next NTO cycle in February next year.
items.quote: In terms of price hikes on the linear side, as you know, that we are regulated by NTO and as and when the next NTO cycle happens, which is, I think, February next year, we would be looking at price hikes there as well.

items.statement: ZEE5 subscription growth driven by language packs and FIFA; renewal base indicates sustainability beyond sports events.
items.quote: On digital side, Kavish, it's very clear that as long as we can sustainably give content to the consumer of their preference and liking they will continue to renew their subscriptions. And this is not just a FIFA driven event we have seen renewal base that has happened during FIFA or even after that, which gives us the confidence that it is quite sustainable and grow from that perspective.

items.statement: ZEE5 more than doubled B2C subscriber base in Q1; B2B partnership discussions ongoing for FIFA.
items.quote: So, on the B2C additions in the last quarter itself, we have more than doubled our subscriber base and a large part of that may be due to FIFA, but there is also a consumer base that comes in for non -sports is what I can say. The movement of B2B deals, certai nly, we are in discussion with the B2B partners.

items.statement: Marquee advertisers engaged for FIFA sponsorships; some may stay if value delivery continues.
items.quote: So Abneesh, you're right, some of the marquee advertisers may exit because they only come in for sports. But I am pretty confident that if we have the relationship and we have delivered on FIFA to them or on the sports business. Some of them will certainly stay with us as long as we continue to deliver value to them.

items.statement: Achieved all-time high network share of 20% in Q1 (17.9% for reported weeks), up 110 bps YoY.
items.quote: This, along with our engaging linear GEC content, increased our viewership share to around 20% during the quarter making it our highest market share in the last 7 years. For the quarter, it stood at 17.9%, which represents a gain of 110 basis points on a year -on-year basis.

items.statement: Zee TV maintained prime-time leadership for 32+ consecutive weeks with top 3 fiction shows.
items.quote: It has been a leader in prime time for over 32 consecutive weeks reflecting the growing resonance of the new shows with o ur viewers.

items.statement: Zee Cinema led movie genre with 27% viewership in week 22 driven by world TV premieres.
items.quote: In the movie genre, the Zee Cinema consolidated the crown as the leading channel with a viewership of 27% in week 22. The growth was driven by world television premieres of popular films, including ‘Akhanda 2 – Thaandavam’, ‘Kishkindhapuri’ and ‘Dil Madharaasi’.

items.statement: Star arbitration final hearings held in July; outcome expected in Q3 FY27.
items.quote: The Star arbitration hearings were held in July, which we have disclosed. And now further procedural steps will follow, and we are looking at an outcome possibly in Q3 of this year.

items.statement: Fundraising timeline under regulatory review; company approached regulator and SAT for clarification.
items.quote: So Abneesh, as far as the fundraising, we have already written to the regulator seeking clarification. And we have not received any response from there. We have also approached Securities Appellate Tribunal, and we have filed an appeal there.

items.statement: Shareholders approved 'Truly Yours' ESOP plan at recent EGM.
items.quote: One of the company's strongest pillars is its human capital. And I remain confident that the ‘Truly Yours’ employee stock option plan approved by the shareholders, will further enable the team to truly function as co -owners of this precious institution and achieve newer heights.

items.statement: Preferential allotment approval valid for 1 year but matter sub judice due to regulatory proceedings.
items.quote: The usual approval Jinesh is valid for 1 year. Having said that, I mean, since we have approached the regulator as well as the Tribunal, the matter is sub judice, so we would refrain from any further disclosure around this at this point.

items.statement: Inventory increased in Q1 due to FIFA outflows; will flow through P&L in Q2.
items.quote: So, in inventory, one of the reasons for the increase is FIFA because in quarter 1, the outflows have happened, it will flow through the P&L in quarter 2. So that is one major reason.

items.statement: Cash and treasury investments stood at INR 22.1 billion as of June 2026.
items.quote: Cash and treasury investments as of June’ 26 stood at a healthy INR 22.1 billion, comprising of cash balance of INR 4.4 billion, fixed deposits and other treasury investments of INR 5.9 billion and mutual fund investments of INR 11.8 billion.

items.statement: ZEE5 revenue grew 58% YoY for third consecutive quarter; digital EBITDA positive at INR 44 million.
items.quote: Zee5 continued to display profitable growth for the third consecutive quarter, attaining a 58% increase in revenue year -on-year.

items.statement: Subscription revenue grew 16% YoY driven by digital ARPU, subscriber growth and linear price increases.
items.quote: Moving to subscription revenues. It registered a 16% year-on-year growth, as Punit mentioned, primarily driven by a higher ARPU and growth in subscribers in our digital business and increased pricing in our linear business.

items.statement: West Asia conflict and advertising uncertainty remain key risks; cautiously optimistic on recovery.
items.quote: Overall, we are witnessing a marginal recovery in the macro -economic environment, and we remain optimistic of stronger green shoots in the upcoming festive season.

items.statement: Expect high-teen revenue growth on base case over next 3-5 years
items.quote: on a base case basis, we want to grow on high-teen basis, I can say.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 47.5% in Q1 FY27, up 867 bps YoY; hybrid power plant to further improve margins from September
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter grew by 49.4% year-on-year to INR20.8 crores with an EBITDA margin of 47.5%, up by 867 basis points.

items.statement: MicroBiopharm Japan acquisition closing by August end; Sanofi brand acquisition long stop date June next year with 50+ country approvals
items.quote: one of them gets closed right now. The second one is still probably about 6 months or 9 months, if not longer away because the long stop date over there is June next year.

items.statement: Planning equity raise up to INR1,000 crores; debt amount flexible for optimal mix
items.quote: Right now, I think what we have decided is that we are raising equity up to INR1,000 crores. That is what we are looking at right now to raise equity up to INR1,000 crores.

items.statement: Interest cost lower in Japan and France geographies vs India's 10%; acquisitions expected cash flow positive
items.quote: in the two geographies that we are looking at, the interest cost is significantly lower than the 10% that you have mentioned. So we don't see interest outflow to the tune of the number that you mentioned.

items.statement: Global fermentation CDMO peers include Lonza, WuXi, Anthem Biosciences; few players cover full capability set
items.quote: I think the large ones are obviously the likes o f Lonza and perhaps WuXi, in China. And of course, in India, we've got Anthem Biosciences

items.statement: No inventory issue during Optimus Drugs dispute; sold out capacity to other buyers
items.quote: there are more than enough buyers for the same product in the country. So that was not a problem. And over the last 6 or 9 months, we have not supplied to them and still we could easily sell out our capacity.

items.statement: Aim to diversify customer concentration by selling intermediates to all API manufacturers domestically and globally
items.quote: our endeavor is to get into the supply chain and sell intermediate to anyone in the country and outside who is manufacturing these APIs.

items.statement: Rifapentine requires more Rifamycin-S per kg than Rifampicin; company ready with both APIs
items.quote: the requirement of Rifa-S to manufacture 1 kilo of Rifapentine is more than what y ou require to manufacture Rifampicin. And from our perspective, it doesn't matter either way because we are ready with both the APIs

items.statement: Asset turn on new INR200 crores fermentation+API capex expected at 1.4x-1.5x
items.quote: if I can say on asset turn basis, it is around INR200 crores, you can say 1.4x to 1.5x is the asset turn.

items.statement: Promoter pledge ~48% as of June; expect significant reduction within 12-15 months
items.quote: I think within a year, it should be going down year to 15 months should be going down significantly.

items.statement: MicroBiopharm has strong management continuing post-acquisition; no intention to manage Japan operations directly
items.quote: for example, in MBJ, a very strong management, which continues to be there. So we are not getting into any geography or any business where we are taking the responsibility of turning the business around.

items.statement: Hybrid power plant Phase 1 expected live in September, Phase 2 two months later; will significantly lower power cost
items.quote: We are expecting Phase 1 to go live in September. And then 2 months later, the second phase will start. And it should improve our EBITDA margins for sure, this will allow us to get power at a significantly lower price.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated topline growth guided at ~20% with commensurate bottom-line increase
items.quote: The Company expects topline to grow by about 20% in FY26-27 on overall basis with commensurate increase in bottom-line.

items.statement: New businesses (specialty chemicals, rigid packaging, consumer) expected to grow ~60% in FY27
items.quote: Further four new businesses are expected to grow about 60%.

items.statement: US subsidiary business expected to grow 25-30% in FY27 post duty rationalization
items.quote: U.S. itself is expected to grow anywhere between 25% to 30% this year post the duty rationalization in USA, specialty sales growth and lot of other cost efficiency measures that we are taking.

items.statement: ROCE target of 15-20% over next 12-24 months from current ~11%
items.quote: We are now working to improve these ROCE over the next 12 to 24 months. We intend to take it to anywhere between 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Net debt to EBITDA target below 2x within next 12 months from current 2.3x
items.quote: We are expecting net debt to EBITDA to reduce to below 2 times to EBITDA in next 12 months.

items.statement: Plastech revenue target Rs 150-160 crore in FY27 and Rs 200+ crore in FY28
items.quote: So, this year we expect to grow from Rs. 100 crores of last year's revenue to Rs. 150 crores-Rs. 160 crores this year, and next year we would like to take this business to Rs. 200 plus crores.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals revenue target Rs 400-500 crore by FY30 likely to be surpassed by FY29
items.quote: There is a good likelihood that by FY '29 itself, we will surpass this target.

items.statement: Zigly breakeven expected around Rs 250 crore revenue; Cosmo Consumer breakeven earlier than Rs 100 crore
items.quote: Zigly breakeven should happen around Rs. 250 crores of revenue. Cosmo Consumer can make money even earlier than Rs. 100 crores.

items.statement: Capex cycle largely complete after Rs 1,200 crore invested over last 3 years; focus now on leveraging assets
items.quote: Capex cycle of the Company is largely complete. Now the focus will be to fully leverage the strategic capex done in last 3 years (₹1,200 Cr.).

items.statement: Plastech adding 50% capacity over next 2 quarters with minimal capex
items.quote: The business is also augmenting 50% growth in capacity over the next 2 quarters with minimal capex, which will pave future growth in the next financial year and bring efficiencies of scale.

items.statement: Film business utilization at 85% in Q1 FY27 with 15% spare capacity expected to be utilized over next 2 quarters
items.quote: Yes, in the film business, it is 85%.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals has 15-20% additional capacity headroom
items.quote: Specialty chemicals easily have 15% to 20% capacity more.

items.statement: Specialty film mix target 70% from current 61%; capability to reach 85-90% without significant capex
items.quote: The current mix of 61% is anyways the highest that we have in the last five quarters. And as a company, our objective is to move it to 70%. So, any incremental capacity can always be allocated to specialty films.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA Rs 147 crore (+26% YoY) at 12.6% margin vs 14.5% YoY; gross margin per kg improved across all categories
items.quote: The Company has done well to manage the uncertainty caused by West Asia war and posted EBITDA increase by 26% in June 2026Q to Rs. 147 crores compared to Rs 116 crores during June 2025Q.

items.statement: BOPP gross margin Rs 30/kg in Q1 FY27 vs Rs 20/kg in Q4 FY26 and Rs 23/kg YoY (includes stock gain)
items.quote: BOPP gross margins was running at Rs 30/- per kg in June 2026Q vs Rs 20 per kg in March 2026Q and Rs 23/- per kg in June 2025Q. This includes stock gain as well which is non-repetitive.

items.statement: BOPET gross margin Rs 9/kg in Q1 FY27 vs Rs 18/kg in Q4 FY26 and Rs 13/kg YoY; expected to improve with anti-dumping duty
items.quote: BOPET gross margin was running at Rs 9/- per kg in June 2026Q vs Rs 18/- per kg in March-26 quarter & Rs 13/- per kg in June-25 quarter.

items.statement: Semi-specialty margin improved to Rs 45/kg from Rs 36/kg in Q4; specialty film margin stable at Rs 63/kg
items.quote: Semi-specialty contribution improved to ₹45 per kg from ₹36 in Q4. Our speciality film margins remain stable at Rs 63 per kg.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals EBITDA margin 25% in Q1 FY27, improved 2% QoQ despite 34% topline growth
items.quote: In fact, in this quarter itself, we have improved our EBITDA margins by 2% in specialty chemical in spite of such phenomenal growth in the specialty chemical segment.

items.statement: Plastech normalized EBITDA margin 7% (ex-incentives) in Q1 FY27; 10%+ including incentives
items.quote: Plastic again, which till last year was a loss-making business, has a normalized EBITDA of 7% excluding incentives. Including incentives, they are 10% plus this quarter.

items.statement: Cosmo Consumer gross margins improved from 15-17% to 25%; targeting 35-40% gross margins at scale
items.quote: Last year, when we started the business, we were operating at around 15%-17% margins. It has already gone up to 25% margins. As we continue to scale up, the gross margins are expected to be in the range of 35%-40%.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals 34% YoY topline growth in Q1 FY27; external sales growing faster than internal
items.quote: The Specialty Chemical subsidiary has continued to achieve tractions and posted 34% topline growth on YoY basis with 25% EBITDA in June 2026Q.

items.statement: Rigid packaging (Plastech) 58% YoY topline growth in Q1 FY27; turned EBITDA positive at 7%
items.quote: Cosmo Plastech (Rigid packaging vertical) has posted over 58% topline growth in June 2026Q on YoY basis and has turned EBITDA positive (7%).

items.statement: Zigly 70% YoY growth in Q1 FY27; monthly run rate ~Rs 100 crore annualized; 47 centers, 29k customers
items.quote: Zigly maintained its strong growth trajectory with around 70% year-on-year growth, supported by continued expansion of its retail footprint and increasing adoption of its private label products.

items.statement: Cosmo Consumer grew 4.5x YoY in FY26; targeting >3x growth in FY27; 150 dealers in 100+ cities
items.quote: Last year, base was quite small, but vis-à-vis last year we have grown 4.5x. This year itself, we should grow more than 3x.

items.statement: Revenue rose 46% YoY while volume grew 9%; gap due to raw material price pass-through post West Asia conflict
items.quote: Revenue rose 46% while volumes rose only 9%. The gap is raw material prices pass through following the West Asia conflict. Polymer prices moved up sharply and in pass through business, that inflates both revenue and the denominator of the margin ratio.

items.statement: EBITDA per kg improved ~15% on 9% volume growth; contribution per kg improved across all categories
items.quote: EBITDA is up 26% in absolute terms on 9% volume growth. This means that EBITDA per Kilogram improved roughly 15%. That is real operating environment.

items.statement: Net debt flat at Rs 1,166 crore (2.3x EBITDA) despite Rs 85 crore working capital increase from raw material prices
items.quote: Net Debt at June 2026 end was flat at Q4, FY26 level (Rs 1,166 crores which is 2.3 times to EBITDA) despite net working capital increase by Rs 85 crores due to increased raw material prices post West Asia war.

items.statement: Target to reduce net debt by Rs 400-500 crore over next 2 years through EBITDA growth and debt repayment
items.quote: So, basically, over the next two years, we are containing any significant Capex and at the same time, we continue to improve our ROCE and EBITDA numbers. So, you will see a reasonable reduction of Rs. 400 crores to Rs. 500 crores of our debt in the next two years.

items.statement: US subsidiary received ~USD 7 million refund in July 2026 post reversal of additional customs duty imposed in FY26
items.quote: Post reversal of additional custom duty imposed in FY 25-26 on imports from India into the USA, the US subsidiary received a refund of about USD 7 million in July-2026 which has not been appropriated pending finalization of customers' refunds there against.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty levied on BOPET expected to improve BOPET margins in coming quarters
items.quote: The BOPET margins have marginally come down, but with the anti-dumping duty, which has been levied recently, we expect that the BOPET margins should go up.

items.statement: Port congestion caused 13% lower export volumes in Q1 FY27; in-transit volumes exceptionally high
items.quote: EBITDA was suppressed in June 2026Q due to lower export volumes caused by port congestion (13%)

items.statement: Raw material availability challenged as Indian petrochemical companies shifted to LPG; Cosmo managed supply efficiently
items.quote: Actually, the larger question right now is the raw material availability. And as I said earlier, we must compliment Cosmo management team to timely arrange the raw material in the last quarter.

items.statement: Specialty film mix at 61% in Q1 FY27 (highest in 5 quarters); target 70% in FY27
items.quote: The current mix of 61% is anyways the highest that we have in the last five quarters. And as a company, our objective is to move it to 70%.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals 80% backward integrated; external sales growing faster, targeting balanced mix medium-term
items.quote: Right now 80% business is still backward integration, but the good news is that the external business is also going at a good pace though the internal business is also growing because a lot of new products are being made for film or consumer or other businesses.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 1,310 crores, bifurcated rig-wise and day rate-wise with year-wise split
items.quote: The order book stands at INR1,310 crores, and we've also bifurcated the order book year-wise.

items.statement: Three rigs expected to be dehired within current financial year, with 4-6 month refurbishment period before redeployment
items.quote: A key point to note here would be that three of our rigs are expected to be dehired within the current financial year.

items.statement: Revenue will decline in H2 FY27 due to three rigs going into refurbishment, but EBITDA decline will not be proportional
items.quote: Yes, absolutely right. Because these three rigs will get dehired, they will go into refurbishment. No revenue will accrue till they get redeployed. So revenue will decline in the second half of this financial year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin may increase in H2 FY27 despite absolute earnings decline, as dehiring rigs include one owned and one rented at good rate
items.quote: Therefore, earnings will not decline in proportion. And you might even see an increase in the EBITDA margin, although absolute earnings would see a decline in the second half of the current financial year.

items.statement: Blended EBITDA margin target guided at 35% for revenue assessment
items.quote: we've guided earlier that you should target a blended EBITDA of 3 5%

items.statement: Refurbishment cost estimated at INR 90-110 crores per rig considering inflationary trends
items.quote: Considering the recent inflationary trend and the increase in labor cost and transit cost of materials, I think a figure between INR90 crores to INR110 crores would be a fair estimate per rig.

items.statement: Jindal Pioneer refurbishment expected to complete by first week of September with deployment in October 2026
items.quote: We expect the refurbishment exercise to be completed by first week of September and deployment of this rig to take place in the month of October.

items.statement: New ONGC contract for Pioneer at fixed INR day rate of ~INR 45 lakhs, denominated in INR not USD
items.quote: It's at a fixed day rate of INR45 lakhs approximately. This contract was denominated in INR.

items.statement: Expect day rates to improve for three rigs up for redeployment, but recent contract saw rate pushed down from $62k to ~$47.8k
items.quote: We expect day rates to improve. But then again, we were also expecting day rates to improve in the current contract that we received. Unfortunately, that has not been the case in this contract.

items.statement: All three dehiring rigs must participate in fresh tenders for redeployment with ONGC
items.quote: We have to participate in a tender. For each of the rigs, we'll have to participate in a tender.

items.statement: Not currently looking at acquisitions, focusing on redeploying three dehiring rigs to minimize risk
items.quote: As of now, we are not looking at any acquisitions right now. We are only looking at the ability to redeploy the 3 rigs, which are going to get dehired in the later part of this financial year.

items.statement: Conserving cash for upcoming refurbishment of three rigs as refurbishment required after every contract
items.quote: For refurbishment, we need to conserve cash because it's the nature of this industry that refurbishment exercise has to be undertaken after every contract.

items.statement: Samudra Manthan initiative expected to benefit shallow water rigs indirectly through increased overall drilling activity
items.quote: when there is a general increase in drilling activity, whether in deepwater or ultra -deepwater, then shallow water also will get the relevant benefit

items.statement: ONGC legal dispute ongoing for 14-15 years in Supreme Court; potential liability of ~INR 163 crores including interest and forex if case lost
items.quote: The original receivable was denominated in USD. So, the total amount is close to INR163 crores.

items.statement: Joint venture loss of ~INR 5 crores in Q1 FY27 due to Pioneer refurbishment expenses per sale agreement
items.quote: The loss in that entity is on account of the refurbishment expenses that are being incurred by that entity so as to bring the rig into a certain condition before Jindal Drilling takes delivery of the rig.

items.statement: Primarily targeting domestic redeployment for three rigs; international deployment considered only if opportunity arises but faces counterparty and country risks
items.quote: We are looking at domestic primarily. However, if an international opportunity comes up, then we are okay to consider that.

items.statement: Six rigs total: five on long-term contracts with ONGC, sixth (Pioneer) recently contracted, three dehiring in FY27
items.quote: We have 5 rigs on long -term contracts, which are currently deployed with ONGC, with the 6th rig having rec ently received a new contract.

items.statement: Management targets ROCE of 25% for FY27 and debt-to-equity around 0.7 by year-end.
items.quote: ROCE for the year, I mean, our stated target is higher at around 30%, but we will definitely be over 20% for Q2, higher than that. For the year as an average, I think we said 25% that's at -- 25%, we can comment.

items.statement: Management targets PBT margin of 7% over the next 3 years, up from current 5.38%.
items.quote: What we have guided to is over the next 3 years, reaching a PBT of 7%. We are right now at around 5% change, I think, 5.3, probably 5.38 I'm told is where we're at.

items.statement: Management expects PAT growth of at least 20% for FY27.
items.quote: Yes, that is our stated goal that we achieve these numbers.

items.statement: Boilers order backlog at INR150.75 crores, highest ever.
items.quote: Boilers again highest ever order backlog in over INR150.75 crores.

items.quote: activity in the U.S. has slowed, to Europe has done well the introduction of some tariffs, uncertainty, even though it's the Senate and not the house, the expectation that something may come in is causing order backlog to order bookings to run a little lower than we expect.

items.quote: PBT margin was at 5.38%, up from 4.77% last year. Mix moving in the right direction, higher-margin businesses, PEB U.S. and engineering services are growing faster and the group margin follows.

items.statement: Steel price increases largely passed through to customers; temporary lag caused margin dip.
items.quote: We were able to get the vast majority of the pass-through steel price increase pass-through, that did happen. Some I think there was a little bit of a bleed effect where it took some pain for us to get those increases.

items.quote: Mix moving in the right direction, higher-margin businesses, PEB U.S. and engineering services are growing faster and the group margin follows. So same trend that we've been on for the last 3, 4 years, and we expect this to continue.

As the scale improves, we expect that the cost to normalize as a percentage of revenue.

items.statement: Promoters committed INR50 crores via warrants at INR168; INR20 crores already deployed.
items.quote: There's also -- I mean, speaking from a promoter point of view, there's about INR50 crores of capital that's been brought in, but INR20 crores has been brought in already. items.statement: Custom Design Building Solutions (PEB India + PEB U.S.) revenue grew from INR411 crores to INR507 crores YoY.
items.quote: As a result, revenue from the business in the custom design building solution has gone from INR411 crores to INR507 crores and continues to be an important driver for our transformation journey.

items.statement: ROCE ~20% and ROE ~12% in Q1; targeting ROCE 25%+ and ROE >10% for FY27.
items.quote: And capital efficiency rose was around 20% and ROE around 12%. We're on board to move higher. items.statement: Employee costs rose 16% YoY to INR107.32 crores; U.S. operations up 37% due to sales, BD, and execution hiring.

These investments are focused on sales and business development activities, project execution capabilities, and the growth initiatives in the U.S. market.

items.statement: Solar JV (ZAP91) with Zetwerk: 2 GW capacity, INR4,000 crores revenue potential; Pennar holds 45% via Network.
items.quote: Considering the capacity being set up is 2 gigawatts, which has a top line revenue potential of about INR4,000 crores, and Penner holds 45%, I believe, in that. So I mean you would have to value what a profitable company with that kind of revenue stream would be worth.

items.statement: Consolidated sales growth guidance for FY27 raised to 15% excluding Foskor and Awuko, up from prior 11-12% comparable guidance
items.quote: Given our current order load and forecasts from customers, the growth could be 15% without the sales from Foskor and Awuko in both the periods.

items.quote: We feel that this could go up to 23%-25%.

items.quote: This could be 9% to 10%. We retained the same guidance.

items.quote: Consolidated Abrasive margins were expected to be around 9.5% to 10% . In FY'26, the reported margin was 4.3%. However, if we exclude the Awuko loss, the comparable margin for FY'26 would be 7.9%. So, we retained the earlier guidance.

items.statement: Consolidated ceramic margin guidance retained at 20.5-21% for FY27
items.quote: Consolidated ceramic margins were expected to be 20.5% to 21%. We maintain our same guidance here.

items.statement: Consolidated Electrominerals margin guidance retained at 9-9.5% for FY27
items.quote: Consolidated Electrominerals margins were expected to be 9% to 9.5%. In FY'26, the reported margin was 5.6%. However, if we exclude the loss of Foskor Zirconia and compare it, the FY'26 margin would be 9.1%. We retained the same guidance.

items.statement: Capex guidance retained at INR 400 crores for FY27

items.quote: During the last call, we said Rhodius could grow by 5% in FY '27 and that there could be a small loss at the PAT level. We maintain the same guidance.

items.statement: Standalone Electrominerals sales grew 33% YoY, largely volume-driven and export-centric

On a sequential basis, sales increased by 12.2% from INR 252 crores to INR 282 crores in Q1 FY'27. Growth was largely volume driven, predominantly exports centric.

items.statement: Standalone Abrasives growth 14.7% YoY, predominantly volume-driven with very small price increase
items.quote: Growth was predominantly volume-driven and very small price increase.

items.statement: Ceramics growth optimism across all segments except wear ceramics; Metallized Cylinders and Engineered Ceramics seeing increased momentum
items.quote: So, we see the growth optimism in all segments other than the wear segment, which is going to be a normal growth. I mean, definitely this quarter we have seen, after several quarters, the growth in Wear Ceramics as well. As you rightly said, the Metallized Cylinder, Engineered Ceramics, all segments are seeing increased growth momentum and hence we revise d the guidance.

items.statement: Standalone Abrasives PBIT margin declined to 10.4% in Q1 FY27 from 13.1% YoY due to INR 16 crore cost push from oil-based raw materials and volume drop
items.quote: PBIT margin declined from 13.1% to 10.4%. Last year full year, the PBIT margin of Abrasives standalone was 15.3%. Considering this, there is a drop of INR 15 crores to INR 16 crores of PBIT in this quarter. items.quote: PBIT of IC remained flat despite the topline going up. The reasons are cost increase in fuel, alumina, unabsorbed cost in new lines of semicon and aerospace and defence capacities.
