items.quote: Our Central India catchment was the fastest growing region during this quarter, with footfalls increasing by 48% and revenue growing by 44% Y-o-Y.

items.statement: Three-pronged strategy: build footfall via targeted reach, increase dwell time via experiences/IP events, drive repeat visits via Magic Pass and corporate tie-ups
items.quote: Our three-pronged approach to improve revenue with A, to build footfall by increased targeted customer reach, B, to increase dwell time through experiences and IP events to stay longer and thus increasing non -ticketing re venue, and third being to drive repeat visitation through our unique Magic Pass

items.statement: Hello Park targets ticket price INR800-900; ticketing ~65-70% of revenue, rest F&B and merchandise
items.quote: The tickets would be currently we are targeting ticket price of INR800 to INR900 on an average for the Hello Park entry ticket. And in year also there will be non-ticket revenues such as F&B and merchandise. So typical ticketing revenues would be around 70%, 65% to 70% on an average.

items.statement: Geographical diversification across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Central India reduces concentration risk; adding Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Goa
items.quote: Geographically, we are actively evaluating opportunities across key markets such as Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Goa, and other large population centers.

items.statement: Focus on schools and corporates to expand base and boost off-season footfall and revenue
items.quote: We are also focusing a lot on schools and corporates now, that has always been the focus but we are even going one level ahead now and pushing it further.

items.statement: Organized amusement park industry nascent with fragmented regional operators; high entry barriers create opportunity for organized players
items.quote: The organized amusement park and water park industry in India is still at a very nascent stage. A large part of our market remains fragmented with several regional operators running relatively small parks spread over a few acres.

items.statement: Spiritual tourism expansion requires government support for land and infrastructure; active talks with state governments for 1-2 locations in 2-3 years
items.quote: we are in active talks, as of now we have not concluded on any locations so the talks are ongoing. Because wit hout government supports the project become unviable, specifically in terms of the spiritual bit of it

items.statement: Target debt/EBITDA 2.5-3x average, up to 3-3.5x for limited period; banking limits approved with leading banks
items.quote: the debt to EBITDA of the company we have been clear in this regard that that will be kept in a certain range and at best i t could be 3 to 3.5x for a limited period, but the average debt to EBITDA would be in the range of around 2.5 to

items.statement: Promoter warrants conversion at INR73.5 will happen before deadline; promoters positive on long-term prospects
items.quote: So, from the promoter group, we are very positive on the business and overall long-term prospects of it. So, the conversion will happen before the given date and requirement which is there.

items.statement: Heatwave caused non-operational days at Khopoli; school calendar shifts impacted footfall; hotel bookings tapered
items.quote: This year witnessed an unprecedented heat wave, leading to some non-operational days at Khopoli Park, coupled with a shift in school holiday calendar in some catchment schools.

items.statement: Gas trading profit guidance maintained at INR 1,100-1,200 crores for FY27
items.quote: Yes, on a conservative basis, we are giving at INR 1,100 crores. We stick to the earlier guidance which we have given.

items.statement: CGD EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 5.5-6.5 Rs/scm
items.quote: We have given a guidance of 5.5 to 6.5 Rs/scm. We'll still stick to that guidance.

items.statement: Capex guidance for CGD business at INR 1,000 crores for FY27
items.quote: There is no capex on the gas trading segment, but there will be capex on the CGD segment, which practically we are giving a guidance of close to INR1,000 crores.

items.statement: Plans to add 75+ new CNG stations and upgrade ~70 stations in FY27
items.quote: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that the company is now planning to add more than 75 new CNG stations and upgrade approximately 70 CNG stations during the current financial year.

items.statement: Plans to set up own propane import and storage facility near Morbi market
items.quote: Yes, we have plans to have our own propane import facility. We have basically shortlisted a few sites in Gujarat where we can put up our own terminal.

items.statement: Gas trading sourced 10 LNG cargoes in Q1 FY27 despite supply disruptions
items.quote: During the quarter, the company sourced 10 LNG cargoes despite unprecedented circumstances, demonstrating the resilience of our procurement network and our commitment to uninterrupted customer service.

items.statement: CNG volume grew 13% YoY to 3.76 mmscmd in Q1 FY27
items.quote: In the CNG segment, we achieved a new benchmark with CNG volume of 3.76 mmscmd during this quarter compared to 3.33 mmscmd in the previous year same quarter, registering a growth of 13%.

items.statement: Domestic PNG connections added 59,000 in Q1 FY27, cumulative base 24.77 lakh
items.quote: During the current quarter, the company added approximately 59,000 new domestic PNG customers, taking our cumulative domestic PNG customer base to more than 24.77 lakh households.

items.statement: Industrial PNG volume grew 64% YoY to 7.17 mmscmd in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The PNG Industrial segment delivered a strong performance during the quarter. Industrial sales volumes increased to 7.17 mmscmd in Q1 FY27 from 4.71 mmscmd in Q1 FY26, registering a growth of 64%.

items.statement: Morbi cluster volume surged 181% QoQ to 5.67 mmscmd average in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Morbi cluster volume registered an increase of 181% in Q1 FY27 compared to Q4 FY26. It is especially noteworthy that during the quarter, the availability of alternate fuels such as propane remained adversely impacted.

items.statement: Current Morbi gas run rate at 3 mmscmd post-July as propane availability improved
items.quote: So as far as the current run rate is concerned, I think we are delivering close to 3 million gas in Morbi and close to 5.3 million- 5.4 million equivalent gas is being delivered as propane.

items.statement: Morbi industrial gas price at 78 Rs/scm vs propane at 65 Rs/scm
items.quote: Ours is close to 78 Rs/scm and propane is close to 65 Rs/scm.

items.statement: Non-Morbi industrial gas price at ~70 Rs/scm in Q1 FY27
items.quote: It close to INR70 for the non-Morbi segment.

items.statement: Gas trading EBIT grew 206% YoY to INR 726 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The Gas Trading segment delivered strong profitability with earnings before tax increasing to INR726 crores in this quarter as against INR237 crores in the previous year same quarter, reflecting a growth of 206%.

items.statement: Gas trading margin target 4-5% overall, exceptional quarters possible
items.quote: I think what we have told as a guidance earlier also, basically, we make a margin of close to 4% to 5% in the gas trading business. Yes, there will be exceptional quarters, which would be there, but we stick to that guidance again.

items.statement: CGD EBITDA margin at 5.18 Rs/scm in Q1 FY27, below guidance range
items.quote: I think it's around 5.18 Rs/scm and we have a bigger volume now to be divided. So that's the reason it's 5.18.

items.statement: Gas sourcing mix: 20% term contracts, 12.5% domestic gas, 67.5% spot
items.quote: On an overall level, we are doing close to 20% on term contract basis. Domestic gas is close to 12.5% and the rest is spot.

items.statement: CNG infrastructure expanded to 844 stations, added 6 new and upgraded 9 in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our CNG infrastructure has expanded to 844 stations. During the quarter, the company added 6 new CNG stations and upgraded 9 CNG stations.

items.statement: Pipeline network spans ~45,900 km across 6 states and 1 UT
items.quote: The company's total pipeline network spans approximately 45,900 kilometers across six states and one union territory.

items.statement: Added 86 new industrial customers in non-Morbi areas from April-June 2026
items.quote: Just to share that in the non-Morbi section, we have added almost 86 new industries in the past -- from April to June. This will result in handy growth in the volumes from these areas.

items.statement: Morbi ceramic cluster remains largest industrial partner at 5.67 mmscmd average
items.quote: The Morbi Ceramic cluster continues to remain our largest partner in the PNG industrial segment. Our successful supply strategy provided significant support to the Morbi ceramic industry during the crisis period. The average volume in the Morbi ceramic cluster during the quarter was 5.67 mmscmd.

items.statement: Non-Morbi industrial growth constrained by infrastructure development and alternate fuels (briquettes, solid fuels, Steamhouse)
items.quote: See, while we are discussing on the non-Morbi areas, the main reason is not only price, we are in the process of developing the infrastructure also. In Ahmedabad rural, Thane, etc, our pipeline network is in advanced stages, and we are reaching the industrial areas.

items.statement: Government mandate for PNG over LPG in domestic/commercial segments, not industrial
items.quote: Right now, the mandatory push is more on the domestic segment, domestic as well as the commercial, but not on the industrial. Industrial, it is open competition is there from alternate fuels.

items.statement: Tax refund of ~INR 900 crores expected over ~1 year from revised returns filing
items.quote: Right. And the expected quantum is about, what, INR900-odd crores, if I'm right? Management: Yes, you're right

items.statement: Cash balance of INR 7,200 crores as of Q1 FY27
items.quote: Yes, we have cash of around INR7,200 crores, so we have a capex plan of around INR1,000 crores for the CGD business.

items.statement: Overall sales volume 15.66 mmscmd, gas trading 12.22 mmscmd, CGD 12.34 mmscmd in Q1 FY27
items.quote: On the volume front, our overall sales volume stood at 15.66 mmscmd. Notably, the gas trading segment continued to witness strong traction with sales volumes reaching 12.22 mmscmd.

items.statement: Revenue grew 63% YoY to INR 9,670 crores, EBITDA 65% to INR 1,482 crores, PAT 78% to INR 998 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: For Q1 FY27, we reported revenue from operations of INR9,670 crores compared to INR5,924 crores in Q1 FY26, representing a year-on-year growth of 63%. EBITDA stood at INR1,482 crores compared to INR896 crores in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of 65%. Profit after tax stood at INR998 crores compared to INR561 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a growth of 78%.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty and Middle East crisis continue to impact gas prices and supply
items.quote: Looking ahead, global energy markets are likely to remain uncertain due to continuing geopolitical developments. However, we remain confident in our strategy.

items.statement: Blended revenue growth of 30-35% for next 3 years from new brands, vintage business, and capacity additions
items.quote: So a blended growth of somewhere around 35% to 30% for the next 3 years is kind of on the charts and it's going to be a combination of all the new brands and our existing ones, plus the increase in the capacities that we are building currently at our own facility.

items.statement: GX domestic business expected to grow 25-35% YoY for next 5 years from small base of INR100-110 crores
items.quote: We expect 25% to 35% growth in this business year-on-year, even for the next 5 years, we don't anticipate any hiccup because we are at a very small base.

items.statement: GX line expected to grow 30-35% for next 4 years with huge market potential
items.quote: But for the next 4 years, we can easily consider around 30% to 35% growth on the GX line as well.

items.statement: Capex plan of INR30-40 crores for FY27 and similar for next year, targeting INR35-45 crores per year for next 2 years
items.quote: We have a plan of about INR30 crores to INR40 crores of CapEx in this financial year from now. From onwards, maybe the same plan for the next year as well, about INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

items.statement: Goal to be one of largest single-location manufacturing units by end of December 2028/early 2029 with 5 plants in Palghar and 43 manufacturing locations
items.period: by end of December 2028 and early 2029
items.quote: Our goal by end of December 2028 and earlY29 is to be one of the largest manufacturing units at a single location in the country. We have a plan of about INR30 crores to INR40 crores of CapEx in this financial year from now.

items.statement: Booked additional orders in Q4 FY26 at lower price increases to boost Q1 FY27 order book
items.quote: We, as a company, used to always have a slightly higher number of stock. We could book orders at old prices with our customers and got a better order book.

items.statement: Pet care margins 45-55%, mobility 40-50%, nutrition 35-50%, dermaceutics 70-75%; blended margin improvement expected over 8-11 quarters
items.quote: Pet care works at around 45% to 55%. Mobility works at around 40% to 50%. Nutrition has a higher intrinsic margin, but right now, we are expansion. So we are looking at around 35% to 45%, maybe even 45% to 50%. Dermaceutics has a gross margin of 70% to 75%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 90.44% YoY to INR228.25 crores; EBITDA grew 92.90% to INR32.78 crores; net profit grew 94.63% to INR13.17 crores
items.quote: During Q1 FY27, stand-alone total income stood at INR228.25 crores, registering a strong Y-on-Y growth of 90.44%. EBITDA stood at INR32.78 crores, reflecting a growth of 92.90% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: New age brands growing 35-45% YoY, vintage business growing 15-20% YoY; pet care, mobility, nutra, cosmetics driving growth
items.quote: One is our new age brands, which are growing at around 35% to 45% year-on-year. Some are growing even faster because they are at a lower base. And our vintage business is growing at around 15% to 20% year-on-year.

items.statement: GX expanded to 19 states from 17; strong distribution acceptance across therapeutic ranges with high repeatability
items.quote: So GX is currently now in around 19 states. And we are at a very small base of this year, about INR100 crores, INR110 crores only.

items.statement: Working capital at INR170-175 crores at INR850 crore run rate with 50% as cash on hand; absolute working capital will increase with revenue growth
items.quote: We have a working capital of somewhere around INR170 crores, INR175 crores, which is not a high working capital for a company our size. We also have a lot of debtors. We have a good stock, and we have almost 50% of our working capital as cash on hand.

items.statement: Inventory days target 135-140 days, aiming for 120 days within 4 quarters, long-term range 110-125 days due to SKU complexity
items.quote: We are looking at around 140, 135 days of inventory. Hopefully, within the next 4 quarters, it will come to around 120 days. It will always hover between 110 to 125 days because of the nature of the business and the number of SKUs that we have.

items.statement: Interest costs reducing as cash flows improve and credit rating upgraded from BBB to BBB+; using less working capital limits
items.quote: Interest costs are slowly reducing. Our cash flows are getting better. So the interest is I mean we are using less and less of our limits. So that is also there.

items.statement: Revenue target for FY27 around INR800 crores, on track to overachieve; FY26 achieved INR635 crores vs INR570 crore target
items.quote: This year, our target was somewhere around INR800 crores. I think we are in line to achieve that. We will cross that hopefully.

items.statement: Pet care revenue targeting INR100 crores within 3-3.5 years from new plant launches; functional foods targeting INR18-24 crores this year
items.quote: So that itself, we are planning to be INR100 crore say within 3 years from launching or within 3.5 years from launching our plants that we are building right now for increasing functional food capacity.

items.statement: Pet care overall targeting 40-50% growth for next 3-4 years from INR40-45 crore base; cat food launch by Q3/Q4 FY27
items.quote: Overall, we are looking, again, at 40% to 50% growth in those numbers for the next 3, 4 years. We have a very small base of INR40 crores, INR45 crores overall with this.

items.statement: Acquisitions planned in pet care space - some small, some big - as fundamental parts of long-term growth story
items.quote: We have also in line certain acquisitions coming in. We will be updating our investors. We'll be updating the markets and everything for those acquisitions which are coming in, which may -- some are small, some are big, but they are all fundamental parts of the long-term growth story.

items.statement: Management focuses on long-term impact over short-term margins; willing to sacrifice margins for penetration and product acceptance
items.quote: Again, our focus is not just solely to increase profits. Right now, for the next few years, our focus is to increase penetration, increase product acceptance, increase the conversion rates in terms of repeat orders. For that, if we have to sacrifice on some of the margins, we will do it.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue guidance of INR 11,000-13,000 crores (35%+ growth) and EPS of INR 8.75-9.5 per share on post-split face value of INR 10
items.quote: So far as our F Y27 outlook is concerned, our company expects F Y27 consolidated revenue to be in the range of INR 11,000 crores to INR 13,000 crores, that is growth of around 35% and above and also expects the FY27 EPS to be in the range of INR8.75 to INR9.5 per share, which is based on the proposed post corporate action face value of INR10 per share.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guardrail set at ~15% to protect core profitability while reinvesting incremental accruals into AI and growth initiatives
items.quote: The guardrails that you can establish is about 15%. That's like a guardrail, if you ask me. We always want to have guardrails, which is we never want to go below that certain amount rather than going into how much EBITDA we can improve and so on and so for th, we want to set up certain guardrails that enable us to ensure that we continue reinvesting into our future and maintain certain profitabili

items.statement: Q1 FY27 transaction processing volume grew 74% YoY to INR 1,479 billion with strength across utility, government, retail, B2B and hospitality
items.quote: Our transaction processing volume for the quarter grew 74% year -on-year to INR 1,479 billion with continued strength across utility payments, government payments, retail, B2B and hospitality.

items.statement: Cost base remains front-loaded with investment in AI infrastructure, international expansion and financial services capabilities; not building for short-term margin spike but structurally stronger margin profile through FY27-28
items.quote: Our cost base remains front -loaded as we invest in AI infrastructure, international expansion and our new financial services capabilities. We are, therefore, not building for a short -term margin spike. We are building for a structurally stronger and more s calable margin profile through FY27 and F Y28 as these businesses begin to compound.

items.statement: RediffPay UPI platform exiting CUG into production this month; RediffOne evolving into enterprise operating platform for commerce, communication, compliance and intelligence
items.quote: RediffPay is progressing well as our UPI -based consumer payments platform. It will be out of CUG this month and into production. RediffOne is evolving into an operating platform for businesses bringing together commerce, communication, compliance and intel ligence.

items.statement: Launched PayCentral, India's first agentic payment platform on Google's Agent Payments Protocol, enabling AI agents to transact directly; early commercial traction, consumer agent adoption still in early phases
items.quote: Through Phronetic AI, we launched PayCentral, which we believe is India's first agentic payment platform built on Google's Agent Payments Protocol. It enables AI agents to transact directly with one another without requiring a person to manually initiate every payment.

items.statement: Developing on-prem enterprise AI solutions using small language models (1B-10B parameters) for data sovereignty, security and consent; targeting financial institutions and critical operations
items.quote: Through Phronetic AI, we are developing on-prem AI solutions using small language models, in specific about $1 billion to $10 billion parameter range. These models can be deployed, trained, monitored and retained within clients' own infrastructure with sensitive data remaining inside the organization.

items.statement: Board approved merger of 100% AI subsidiary Neuromind into AvenuesAI for synergies, cost benefits and data consent; reverse stock split increasing face value from INR 1 to INR 10 per share
items.quote: First, Nueromind, which is our fully owned AI-based subsidiary is being merged into AvenuesAI. This will give us synergies and seamless operations and lead to cost benefits and data consent also. The second we are doing is a reverse split, which is a face value of share, which was INR1 now is being increased to INR 10 per share.

items.statement: Progressed strategic minority investments: up to 2.5% in RatnaFin Capital (RBI-registered NBFC with SME lending franchise) and up to 7% in Online PSB Loans (India's largest public sector-backed digital credit platform)
items.value: up to 2.5% in RatnaFin; up to 7% in OPL
items.quote: We have progressed well in proposed investments of up to 2.5% in RatnaFin Capital, which is an RBI registered NBFC with a very strong SME lending franchisee. We also approved a strategic investment of up to 7% in online PSB loans, India's largest public sector-backed digital credit platform.

items.statement: Strategy to expand horizontally and target larger merchant clients domestically and internationally; currently not on large platforms like Amazon/quick commerce; disclosed marquee clients in presentation
items.quote: You won't see CCAvenue on the Amazon or some of the large merchants if you transact online. You see it in airlines and a few others, but not on the likes of quick commerce and Amazon and others. So we think that going after the larger client base s hould be our strategy.

items.statement: UPI MDR bill passed Lok Sabha, awaits Rajya Sabha and Presidential assent; 22% of transactions on UPI; monetization expected on large merchants/high-value transactions; 8-10% online acquiring market share; no consolidation threat on acquiri
items.quote: Today, almost 22% of our transactions are on UPI. So any kind of monetization on that UPI will add additional revenues definitely to our platform. Right now, as we stand, the act has been passed by the Lok Sabha. It still awaits Rajya Sabha and still awaits President's approval and then the gazette and then we will know what kind of pricing and monetization that NPCI and RBI is allowing to be done

items.statement: UPI MDR legislation progressing; final pricing and monetization framework pending NPCI/RBI guidelines after gazette notification
items.quote: It still awaits Rajya Sabha and still awaits President's approval and then the gazette and then we will know what kind of pricing and monetization that NPCI and RBI is allowing to be done.

items.statement: AI-driven transaction intelligence scores and financial behavior graphs under development using proprietary payments data; monetization expected in 9-18 months via risk/fraud/identity scores for credit distribution
items.quote: We start with transactions. We have universe of transactions. That is our biggest advantage. We have frequency, transaction value, merchant category, tickets, repeat purchase, refunds, chargebacks, you name it. And we want to be able to evaluate using AI, how does this business behave financially or how does this person behave financially.

items.statement: Macroeconomic impact on Middle East growth (UAE, Saudi) seen as short-term; utility payments and local commerce resilient; no material FX impact yet; US expansion aspirations may increase currency relevance
items.quote: See, I think from a macroeconomic perspective, potentially some growth in the Middle East would have been impacted as a result of the macroeconomic impact should have been there. We don't see it too much though. It is there for sure. But we think that, tha t should come back.

items.statement: AI vertical (Phronetic/Neuromind) fully integrated into AvenuesAI via merger; all AI people and capabilities now part of main entity
items.quote: AI is completely as part of AvenuesAI. So Phronetic is being merged into AvenuesAI, which is Neuromind as a subsidiary, which is 100% subsidiary, is merged into AvenuesAI now. So the entire AI vertical, all the people and everyone else will be part of AvenuesAI.

items.statement: Rediff IPO process followed due process; updates visible on SEBI website; corporate actions (face value change, Neuromind merger) separate and not impacting Rediff listing timeline
items.quote: It's slightly early to directly talk about it. But yes, I think that we have followed the due process. And you can see some updates which are there on the SEBI website.

items.statement: Promoters are long-term investors; no specific timeline for promoter equity participation; material information already in public domain
items.quote: See, promoters are long -term investors. So that much I can tell you. I think whatever is material information out there is what is already out there in the open. But yes, we are long term as far as the promoters are concerned.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue guidance of INR 2,000 crores reiterated with growth weighted to H2
items.quote: Based on current customer discussions, our receipt order visibility, expected capacity ramp -up and planned utilization levels, we remain confident of achieving our previously stated consolidating revenue guidance of INR 2,000 crores for FY27.

items.statement: Garment division EBITDA margin guided above 15% for full year including Sri Lanka
items.quote: See, with respect to margins, we have already guided for a consolidated like garment division that is between Young Brand and S.P. Apparels put together, we will be anywhere above 15% for the whole year.

items.statement: Young Brand Apparel revenue target INR 340-350 crores for FY27
items.quote: What we are looking at is that last year, we have performed that INR 300 crores of revenue. We should reach anywhere between INR 340 crores to INR 350 crores of top line.

items.statement: Infant export revenue target INR 1,300-1,400 crores for FY27
items.quote: INR 1,100 crores was last year number. And we are expecting to reach INR 1,300 crores to INR 1,400 crores this year.

items.statement: Standalone adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 17.5% in Q1 FY27 from 15.2% YoY
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA margins improved to 17.5% compared to 15.2% Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Garment division adjusted EBITDA margin at 17.6% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our Garment division, including the Young Brand Apparel reported an adjusted operational revenue of INR 337.3 crores for the Q1FY27 with an adjusted EBITDA of INR 59.2 crores and the EBITDA margin stood at 17.6%.

items.statement: Young Brand Apparel adjusted EBITDA margin 17.7% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Young Brand Apparels alone reported a revenue of INR 72.7 crores for the current quarter and the adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 12.6 crores with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 17.7%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue soft due to U.S. tariff impact and shipment spillover; H2 expected stronger
items.quote: The first quarter was relatively soft from a top line perspective, U.S. tariff impact late last quarter and certain spillover of orders and shipment schedules.

items.statement: Customer engagement improving from U.K. and EU markets due to FTA benefits
items.quote: We are seeing encouraging signs of this transition with customers actively evaluating India and Sri Lanka as reliable sourcing destinations for long-term procurement requirements.

items.statement: Group customer portfolio diversified to over 15 customers reducing concentration risk
items.quote: Over the last few quarters, we have broadened our customer base and today operate with a more diversified customer portfolio of over 15 customers as a group.

items.statement: Added 750 machines in India in FY27; Salem facility trial production started, full capacity post-Diwali
items.quote: We have added additional 1,000 machines for this -- sorry, 750 machines for the current financial year. And utilization levels have come down purely because of the order slowness.

items.statement: Young Brand Palladum facility commenced production; all units commercial by October; adding bra product line
items.quote: Production has commenced at the Palladum facility, while commercial production from another approved facility is expected to begin in the coming months. By October, we expect all planned units of Young Brand Apparels to be in commercial production.

items.statement: Sri Lanka capacity expansion paused for 1 year; exploring job work for 500-600 additional machines
items.quote: With regard to Sri Lanka, at the moment, we have taken silent period for everything to settle down for another one year. But however, in the meantime, in Sri Lanka, the advantages we can go for job work with the customer approved factories without any investments.

items.statement: Air freight cost in SPUK was GBP 50,000 in Q1 FY27 due to small air shipments
items.quote: The cost of air freight was around 50,000 GBP in SPUK. That was the cost in the air freight in SPUK.

items.statement: Standalone gross debt INR 258 crores, cash INR 46.6 crores, net debt INR 211 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: On a standalone basis, gross debt stood at INR 258 crores. Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 46.6 crores and net debt stood at INR 211 crores for the current quarter as on 30th June 2026.

items.statement: Board approved dividend of INR 3 per share and proposed stock split from INR 10 to INR 2 face value
items.quote: I'm pleased to inform our shareholders that the Board has approved a dividend of INR 3 per share for the year and has also proposed a stock split of the company's equity shares from a face value of INR 10 per share to INR 2 per share.

items.statement: Export sales quantity: SP Apparels 15.7 million pieces, Young Brand 5 million pieces in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Export sales quantity of S.P. Apparels stood at 15.7 million pieces for Q1FY27, while export sales quantity for Young Brand stood at 5 million pieces.

items.statement: U.S. tariff uncertainty remains; customers cautious but order book safe until January
items.quote: the moment, whatever interactions we've had with the customers, they are not expecting that to happen. But also, they are cautious in telling us that it's very unknown in terms of uncertain in terms of how the Congress or the President, they take decisions

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 35% YoY to Rs 515 cr, highest ever Q1 revenue
items.quote: Revenue from operations grew 35% year-on-year to 515 crores. Our highest ever first quarter revenue and remained above 500 cr level despite Q1 typically being a seasonally light Quarter.

items.statement: EBITDA margin moderated to 12.26% in Q1 FY27 due to input cost volatility and revenue mix change
items.quote: On profitability, EBITDA grew during the quarter although EBITDA margins moderated to 12.26%.

items.statement: Cash profit increased 21% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Cash profit increased to 21% increased by 21%.

items.statement: Order book stands at Rs 3,200 cr as of 7th August 2026 with metering accounting for over 96%
items.quote: Our order book stands at 3,200 CRS as on 7th August 26 with metering and systems accounting for more than 96% of the total orders.

items.statement: Consumer & Industrial segment delivered highest ever quarterly revenue of Rs 278 cr, growing 55% YoY
items.quote: Consumer and industrial delivered its highest ever quarterly revenue of 278 crores growing 55% year on year and contributed approximately 54% of the revenue during the quarter.

items.statement: Wire and cable revenue grew 79% to Rs 146 cr with diversified demand across builders, OEMs, solar, telecom, retail and institutional
items.quote: Wire and cable continues its strong momentum with revenue growing 79% to 146 crores. Demand remains diversified across builders, industrial OEMs, solar, telecom, retail and institutional customers.

items.statement: Lighting grew 78% to Rs 56 cr, industrial switchgear grew 19% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Lighting grew 78%. 56 crores industrial switch gear grew 19%.

items.statement: Smart metering revenue grew ~17% YoY to Rs 234 cr, entering stable execution-led phase

items.statement: AdColony SDK integration to activate 100,000 apps and 500 million devices in Developed Markets organically this year.
items.quote: Within this year, we will activate 100,000 mobile app publishers and that should result in 500 million connected devices in Developed Markets and that is a significant competitive advantage being unlocked in the process.

items.statement: No material change in collection risk; on track for robust OCF to PAT for full year.

items.statement: Full capex plan expected to add Rs 400 crores incremental revenue at peak utilization (0.8x asset turnover).
items.quote: So, on a fixed asset basis, we should be able to turn in at around 0.8times. So, we are looking at somewhere around INR 400 crores of incremental revenue over and above what we have in our facilities existing through the entire 4-year CAPEX plan.

items.statement: Peak revenue potential from expanded capacity estimated at Rs 750-800 crores.
items.quote: I would say more like INR 750 crores, what I discussed in our calls earlier. INR 750 crores to INR 800 crores, not INR 900 crores. Yes.

items.statement: Raw material prices volatile - peaked 6 weeks ago, dipped sharply, then moved up again over last two weeks.
items.quote: The input costs were at its peak, maybe six weeks ago and then started dipping down with a peace agreement and other things in place. There was a sharp decline over the next 10 days. But over the last two weeks, again, we have started seeing input costs move up sharply.

items.statement: Limited ability to pass on cost increases internationally; relying on rupee depreciation for offset.
items.quote: We have not been able to take much of a price hike in the international markets. It is close to zero and we are relying more on the depreciation of the currency in those markets because the rupee has significantly depreciated over the years.

items.statement: Q1 growth driven predominantly by existing portfolio; new capacities and products yet to ramp up.
items.quote: Importantly, this growth delivered in the quarter has been driven predominantly by our existing product portfolio, with negligible contributions coming from our incremental capacities and newly introduced product categories.

items.statement: Bioprocess containers and roller bottles fully commercialized; cell culture consumables not yet contributing.
items.quote: No, not from the cell culture consumables, but it has got contribution from the bioprocess containers and so on, which are the media bottles and roller bottles.

items.statement: Government share of domestic market estimated at 15-20%; GEM portal reduced volumes by abolishing rate contracts.
items.quote: On the INR 1,300 crores market, I believe the government market would account for about 15%, at best 20% of that market.

items.statement: Chinese competition intense internationally but minimal in India; global peers have stronger balance sheets but Tarsons offers quality at reasonable prices.
items.quote: We do face intense Chinese competition internationally from Chinese players in different parts of the world, in Europe and U.S. and that intensity has not reduced.

items.statement: German subsidiary Nerbe grew 6% YoY in constant currency; 70% revenue from Germany, 30% rest of EU.
items.quote: During the quarter, our German-based subsidiary delivered a resilient performance, with revenue growing approximately 6% year-on-year in constant currency terms.

items.statement: Gross debt ~Rs 380 crores, net debt ~Rs 330-340 crores; interest run rate ~Rs 20 crores/year, expected to decline in FY28.
items.value: Rs 380 crores gross, Rs 330-340 crores net
items.quote: The gross debt for the company is about to be INR 380 crores, and the net debt is about to be INR 330-340 crores, something like that.

items.statement: Senior sales hire (SMP) made; building domestic and international teams under him; local hiring planned as international revenues scale.
items.quote: So, the key hiring, what we have done for sales in a senior level position in an SMB position that was already communicated to the markets and he would be involved in a lot of revenue and strategy and growth for the company and a lot of teams are being built below him domestically, as well as in certain key geographies.

items.statement: No government grants or incentives received for Panchla and Amta capex.
items.quote: No, no, we have not engaged with the government for any of our capacity expansion of new facilities.

items.statement: Export shipments subject to vessel availability and buyer-nominated logistics; could cause quarterly volatility unrelated to business performance.
items.quote: So, we could have a bad quarter for exports in the next quarter or the quarter after that or any of the quarters in the future and that could mean nothing to our business performance in that quarter.

items.statement: Standalone revenue grew 21% YoY to Rs 86 crores, highest ever Q1; consolidated revenue grew 20.7% to Rs 110.2 crores.
items.quote: We delivered a healthy performance in Q1 FY'27 with consolidated revenue of Rs. 110 crores, growing by almost 21% Y-o-Y.

The consolidated margin improved significantly to the 2.39% compared with the 0.5% in Q1 of last year.

items.statement: FY26 standalone revenue grew ~39% YoY to ~INR 6,769 crore
items.quote: On the standalone basis, the revenue increased to INR 6,769 approximately crores from INR 4,862 crores approximately in last FY 2024-25, representing the growth of approximately 39% in last financial year.

items.statement: FY26 standalone EBITDA margin improved from 2.4% to 3.12%
items.quote: Standalone EBITDA increased by approximately 80% with the EBITDA margin improving from 2.4 -3.12%.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin improved from 3.57% to 4.11%
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA increased approximately from 3.57 -4.11%.

items.statement: Value-added products not showing good market response; focus remains on core buffalo meat exports
items.quote: Regarding value addition, as of now, the value addition in the main product is not showing a good response to the market. Because in value addition, when we are changing the generic of any product, it is called value addition. We are still focusing on our main product, which is the buffalo meat.

items.statement: Pet food market seen as good opportunity; company in very initial stage with separate research team for product development
items.quote: You also raised the concern about the pet food. Yes, pet food market is good, and it's growing, globally. We see a good opportunity in pet food market, and we are working on a separate research team for product development to see the more possibility where we can increase our export, where we can have our new clients. This is related to our business because the byproduct of our activities are used

items.statement: Other income increase driven by foreign exchange gains, duty drawback, and interest on FDs
items.quote: Regarding other income, as he asked me about the other income, so this other income is the income as we all know, like, HMA is doing major chunk of his business from the export. With other income, we have earned basically from the foreign exchange gain. It also from the duty drawback, and also from the interest on the FDs what HMA will have with the certain banks.

items.statement: Core revenue growth driven by export of buffalo products
items.quote: The revenue from operation, basically, is the biggest part of revenue from operation we are generating from the export of the buffalo products. This is our main core business, which is helping us to create this growth, this momentum, and this revenue.

items.statement: Focus on sustaining growth momentum, improving operational efficiency, strengthening market presence, optimizing profitability, and maintaining disciplined financial management
items.quote: Going forward, our focus will remain on sustaining this growth and momentum, improving operational efficiency, strengthening our market presence, optimizing profitability , and maintaining disciplined financial management.

items.statement: Aspiration to reach 4% PBT margin by FY28, with mid-teens revenue growth in FY27
items.quote: Whether we will reach that 4% in this year-end, I would say it's our aspiration. But FY '28 , definitely, we will be achieving our aspiration of 4%.

items.statement: Targeting ISCS EBITDA margin of 9.5% to 10% by Q4 FY27
items.quote: Seeing it sequentially going up, and our plan is to take it about 9.5% to 10% by Q4.

items.statement: Expect GFS EBITDA margin to reach 4.5% to 5%
items.quote: GFS we saw a 4% EBITDA margin. And ideally, we would expect this to be about 4.5% to 5%.

items.statement: New business wins of Rs. 543 crores in Q1 FY27, representing 21% of quarterly revenue
items.quote: In Q1, we recorded new business wins, which is an all -time high in a quarter of Rs. 543 crores, which represents 21% of our quarterly revenue, a clear sign of traction across key geographies.

items.statement: Order pipeline stands at Rs. 7,500 crores plus
items.quote: Our order pipeline remains robust at Rs. 7,500 crores plus, giving us a view of the road ahead for the coming quarters.

items.statement: Pipeline conversion rate historically 20% to 25% over 12-18 months
items.quote: The pipeline, the past track record that we have had has been between 20% to 25%. Now recently, we have had a lot of sales effort in increasing the pipeline and the pipeline has gone up. So, I would say that in the 12 to 15 or 18 -month period, definitely a similar conversion of 20% to 25%, we should be able to achieve.

items.statement: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin improved 30 bps to 7% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: On the profitability front, for Q1 FY '27, the adjusted EBITDA was Rs. 232.2 crores as compared to Rs. 173.3 crores on a year-on-year basis and a very good growth of 34%, registering margin improvement of 30 bps to 7%.

items.statement: ISCS EBITDA margin at 8.1% in Q1 FY27, down from 8.3% due to implementation costs for new contracts
items.quote: Overall, ISCS EBITDA margin was marginally lower at 8.1% due to the initial implementation costs that we incurred for the new contracts that we onboarded. This will stabilize in the coming quarters as those sites become fully operational.

items.statement: GFS EBITDA margin improved to 4.1% in Q1 FY27 from 2.1% a year ago
items.quote: GFS delivered an improved performance in Q1 FY '27 with adjusted EBITDA of Rs. 38 crores at 4.1% margin, up from Rs. 13 crores at 2.1% margin in Q1 FY '26 and Rs. 18 crores at 2.4% margin in Q4 FY '26.

items.statement: Expect ISCS EBITDA margin to return to above 9% in Q2 FY27
items.quote: No, we will sequentially improve the margin. And I am fairly confident that in Q2 itself, we will achieve 9%.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 28.7% YoY to Rs. 3,335.2 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our consolidated revenue for the quarter reached Rs. 3,335.2 crores versus Rs. 2,592.3 crores in Q1 FY '26 and Rs. 3,032.2 crores in Q4 FY '26, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 28.7% and a sequential growth of 10%.

items.statement: India geography registered 44% YoY growth driven by new business wins and freight volumes
items.quote: India geography registered an impressive 44% year-on-year growth, aided by record new business wins and significant volume in the freight business.

items.statement: GFS revenue grew 50.6% YoY to Rs. 918 crores driven by ocean freight volumes in India and higher freight rates
items.quote: GFS segment clocked a revenue of Rs. 918 crores in Q1 FY '27 compared to Rs. 609 crores in Q1 FY '26 and Rs. 749 crores in Q4 FY '26, marking a significant growth of 50.6% year-on-year and 22.6% sequentially, largely led by the growth in the ocean freight volumes in India and the benefits of a freight rate moving upwards.

items.statement: Implemented Oracle ERP for India ISCS business; adding automation and robotics in warehouses
items.quote: We have recently implemented Oracle ERP for our India ISCS business, which will help us make processes faster and allow customers and vendors to integrate with our systems well. On the warehouse side, we continue to add more automation and robotics.

items.statement: Warehouse utilization around 85% with room to improve; capacity driven by customer contracts
items.quote: I would say, by and large, our warehouses are fairly well utilized and in the vicinity of 85%, but there is definitely room to improve, and we continue to explore investing more into even the racking and automation for the warehouse so that we can increase the capacity of the warehouse.

items.statement: Fuel cost increases passed on to customers through contract structures across all geographies
items.quote: I think the way we do the contracting with the customer is that as and when there is a fuel cost increase, it is passed on to the customers. I think that is how the contracts are done, not just in India, but across all the geographies, I think that is how the contracting is done with the customer.

items.statement: Container cost increases passed on to customers; contracts structured for cost pass-through
items.quote: The way our contracts are structured is that we pass on these costs to the customer. And eventually, it is borne by the customer. And I think it is pretty much visible in the way we have been able to deliver 4.1% EBITDA margins in this particular quarter.

items.statement: New wins from marquee customers across renewable energy, clean energy, kitchen appliances, beverages, glassware, premium motorcycles, retail media, sustainable packaging, telecom, engineering, automation, home appliances
items.quote: On the ISCS side, we secured mandates from India and major international markets, including a leading renewable energy provider, a specialist clean energy solution organization, a leading kitchen appliances manufacturer, a leading Indian consumer beverages company, a glassware and consumer product specialist in India, a premium motorcycle manufacturer in E urope, a global retail media and analytic

items.statement: Roughly 2/3 of new business from existing customers, 1/3 from new logos
items.quote: Probably I would say roughly about 2/3 would be from the existing customers where we get new contracts and 1/3 is probably the new logos.

items.statement: Completed acquisition of Swamy & Sons 3PL in Q1; results include 40 days of performance
items.quote: We have completed the acquisition of Swamy & Sons 3PL in Q1, and our results for Q1 include its performance for 40 days in the quarter.

items.statement: Joint venture with ALA Group for defence and aerospace; revenue to commence in H2 FY27, targeting Rs. 2,000 crores by year 5
items.quote: We will see some revenue coming in the second half of this year. But as I would say, this is the beginning of a partnership, which will also mushroom more as the aerospace and defence sector becomes more localized. And that is one of our government's biggest initiatives. So going forward, we will have much bigger numbers. This year, H2, we will have our revenues commence for this particular ventur

items.statement: Merger of 100% subsidiaries into parent for compliance cost savings and operational ease; no equity dilution
items.quote: All these things are already 100% subsidiaries of TVS Supply Chain Solutions, and we are only merging these entities into a single entity. Two things.. one is there will be a lot of reduction in the compliance costs, right? Because today, each of these are separate legal entities. We have a separate audit costs, other compliance costs. Once we merge into a single entity, I think there will be some

items.statement: FIT 3PL to remain separate entity for GST reasons related to FMCG customers
items.quote: I think FIT 3PL, I think we want to keep it as a separate entity as such because of some GST reasons, we operate a different GST mechanism for some of our FMCG customers. So, we would like to offer those services from FIT 3PL. And that is why we would like to keep it as a separate legal entity instead of merging it with the parent company.

items.statement: Biggest risk is potential recession from geopolitical issues; mitigated by close customer contact and supply chain visibility
items.quote: I think like any other company at this moment, the biggest risk that I see is a recession coming. And because of where the financial markets are today or because of the war situation, w e have only seen first -level consequences of all of this today. And if tomorrow, there are major supply chain disruptions causing recession, that will be the biggest risk.

items.statement: Revenue and costs in local currencies across geographies; FX has no major impact on profitability
items.quote: I would like to say that since we operate in those local countries, our revenue and our costs, both are in that local market. So, this has no impact on our profitability as such because our procurement also happens in those particular markets. So, FX doesn't as such play a major role on our overall profitability numbers.

items.statement: Adjusted PBT grew 70.7% YoY to Rs. 32.1 crores in Q1 FY27
items.quote: This quarter, on a year-on-year basis, revenue grew by 28.7%, adjusted EBITDA grew by 34%, and adjusted PBT grew by 70.7%.

items.statement: Operational PAT grew 156% YoY to Rs. 22.5 crores in Q1 FY27 (excluding InvIT gain in prior year)
items.quote: PAT for Q1 FY '27 was Rs. 22.5 crores as compared to Rs. 71.1 crores in Q1 FY '26. Kindly note that Q1 FY '26 included an InvIT gain from TVS ILP. Excluding the InvIT gain and the exceptional items in Q1 FY '26, operational PAT was Rs. 8.8 crores, recording a year -on-year growth of 156% in Q1 FY '27.

items.statement: Manpower availability a full-year risk across geographies; managed via dedicated teams and cost pass-through
items.quote: I think this is probably a full-year phenomenon, not just a particular season. Each geography has a different risk in terms of manpower availability. And we focus on this in terms of having dedicated teams, which ensure that the manpower's are available at the right time and any increase in the cost is also passed on to the customers.

items.statement: Revenue growth in Q1 FY27 was in line with guidance shared in previous quarter
items.quote: We are pleased to report a healthy performance of Quarter 1 fiscal 27 delivering a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Demand looks good and promising for Q2; Q3 will be led by retail with all stores operational
items.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching. And Quarter 3 will be led by retail, and in Quarter 3, we are all our stores are going to be operational.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin 14.9% impacted by stagnant gold prices (no inventory gain), lease amortization INR76L, lease liability INR115L, and new store pre-opening costs
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y -o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

items.statement: IIJS show was encouraging with buyer growth and good order backing; July-August order kitty full
items.quote: IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

items.statement: Surat store capex ~INR10 crores; large format stores INR125-150 cr inventory deployment, mid format ~INR50 cr; capex break-even in a year or less
items.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store. I am sorry can you repeat the second half? The revenue forecast,let us step into it. It is too early for all the forecast.

items.statement: Factory capacity 1.8-2 tons/year; current utilization ~50% (900-1000 kg); seasonal peaks 70-90%
items.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year. And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

items.statement: Average gold rate stagnant leading to negligible inventory gain; lease amortization INR76L and lease liability INR115L impacted margins
items.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So , on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

items.statement: B2B sales mix shifting from 100% 22-carat to ~20% 18-carat by end of FY27; occasion wear focus remains
items.quote: So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

So penetration has been high.

items.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

items.statement: Surat store launch last week of September (Q2); Rajkot early Q3; Maninagar, Gandhinagar, East Ahmedabad in Q3 (mid-format, may open November)
items.quote: So, Surat store date is coming approximately coming on the last week of September. It's coming closer to Navratri. The whole thing is that, can it be closer to Navratri . If Surat and Rajkot both the mega stores are opening closer to Navratri, it is best. Navratri is at 11th of October. So, Surat might be in quarter two and Rajkot might be in quarter three.

items.statement: ~52-60 employees hired for Surat store; HR build-out includes head merchandisers, supply chain, vigilance, security; employee cost on rising trend
items.quote: Approximately 52 to 60 people were hired. And we are also making because there is good number of stores coming up, the whole change on HR is happening. Be it the roles of head merchandisers, head supply chain, head vigilance and security.

items.statement: Gold price volatility risk managed via GML hedging; commodity risk on USD gold prices; custom duty and FX impact on INR gold price
items.quote: So Deepesh, how I see is that the commodity of gold is volatile. In India, it becomes stable because of dollar appreciation and custom duty. items.statement: Long-term vision: transform Harit Zaveri Jewellers into India's leading Indian jewellery brand; franchise route after brand robustness established
items.quote: Our long-term vision is to transform Harit Zaveri Jewellers into India's leading Indian jewellery brand , recognized by exceptional design, superior craftsmanship and transparent business practices and an outstanding customer experience.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue growth guidance of approximately 23% year-on-year excluding new acquisitions, EBITDA margin of 5%, and EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion of 50%
items.value: 23% revenue growth, 5% EBITDA margin, 50% OCF conversion
items.quote: We remain firmly committed to our stated FY27 guidance of consolidated revenue growth of approximately 23% year-on-year, excluding any contribution from new acquisitions, alongside an EBITDA margin of 5% and EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion of 50%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin reached 5%, achieving full-year FY27 guidance in first quarter; gross margin expanded 147 bps to 11.4%
items.quote: We are pleased to have delivered our full year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance in the very first quarter of the year.

items.statement: Organic revenue growth of 17.8% reported and 19.6% like-for-like, comfortably ahead of underlying pharmaceutical market growth of 13.8%
items.quote: Organic revenue growth for the quarter was 17.8% on a reported basis and 19.6% on a like-for-like basis, comfortably ahead of the underlying pharmaceutical market growth of 13.8%.

items.statement: MedTech revenue on track to cross INR1,000 crores in FY27 organically, carrying higher gross and EBITDA margins than core pharma distribution
items.quote: Our MedTech segment, will continue to be the most important structural lever in our medium - term margin story. items.statement: Net working capital days improved to 61 days from 66 days a year ago, continuing structural efficiency gains
items.quote: Net working capital days improved to 61 days from 66 days a year ago, continuing the structural efficiency gains from the initiatives we have been taking since the past few quarters.

items.statement: Interest costs to remain broadly in same range for rest of FY27, not expected to significantly go down or up
items.quote: This will be broadly in the same range. We don't expect it to significantly go down, but it will be broadly in the same range. We don't exceed it going up as well.

items.statement: No major acquisitions planned for FY27; focus on consolidation and integration; open to compelling opportunities especially in Q4 FY27
items.quote: We are not looking for any major acquisition in FY27. We have the pipeline, but we don't see doing big acquisitions during this year.

items.statement: ROCE doubled year-on-year from 11.5% to 21.1%; ROE improved from 9% to 20.4%
items.quote: Return ratios showed significant improvement in this quarter. ROCE yearly doubled year-on-year from 11.5% to 21.1% and ROE moved from 9% to 20.4%.

items.statement: Internal target to grow at excess of 20% over next 3-4 years organically; ROCE target of 25-30% in 3-4 years with no acquisitions
items.quote: Anywhere, in the range of 25% to 30%.

items.statement: Internal aspiration for EBITDA margin is more than 6% over next 3-4 years at 20% growth rate
items.quote: Yes. Yes. We have internal aspiration and target would be more than 6% for sure.

items.statement: FY27 effective tax rate guidance of 22.5%; deferred tax assets exist; FY28 guidance to be provided closer to FY27 close
items.quote: The guidance for FY27, we've given a 22.5%. Guidance for FY28 and beyond, we will come to it when we are closer to close of FY27.

items.statement: Serve over 72,000 retail customers and 2,300+ hospital customers; growth driven by wallet share expansion from better fill rates and product availability
items.quote: We now serve over 72,000 retail customers and more than 2,300 hospital customers, distribute over 83,400 SKUs and maintain relationships with more than 3,000 health care product manufacturers, supported by 138 warehouses acr oss 475 districts in 19

items.statement: Two-way network effect between 3,000+ manufacturers and 72,000+ retailers creates difficult-to-replicate moat; MedTech has fewer competitors than pharma distribution
items.quote: This scale and the 2-way network effect, it creates between our supplier base and our customer base remains, in our view, the core and extremely difficult to replicate moat that anchors this business.

items.statement: Gross margin expansion driven by scale-led procurement economies, growing MedTech share with full commercial role, and exit from low-margin accounts
items.quote: This margin expansion was driven by 3 levers, scale led procurement economies, a growing share of revenue from the MedTech business, where we play a full commercial role rather than pure fulfillment role and the deliberate exit from certain low-margin accounts.

items.statement: Unable to isolate specific factor driving IPM growth acceleration from 7-9% to double digits; cannot forecast sustainability of higher IPM growth rate
items.quote: We are not able to decipher the exact reason of why there is a meaningful change in the growth rate, even though we are experiencing that growth, but we are not able to isolate any specific reason or factor for that.

items.statement: Minority stake buyouts (2-5 year timeline) to be funded from parent or subsidiary level; OCF after working capital changes to be deployed for maximum EPS improvement
items.quote: We will evaluate what is the best way to acquire minority interest, whether to fund from parent company or to fund from subsidiary. We have all the options available.

items.statement: Employee cost increments effective April 1; no major increase expected in employee expenses for rest of FY27
items.quote: So, for employee expenses, most of the impact comes in quarter 1 only because that's where the increment cycle goes on effective from first of April. So you should not expect any major increase on employee expenses from here on.

items.statement: Inorganic growth of 20.4% in Q1 FY27 entirely from calendarization of prior year acquisitions; no new acquisitions in Q1
items.quote: Inorganic growth was a t 20.4% and the entirety of this growth came from the calendarization of acquisitions completed in last year. There were no new acquisitions during Q1 FY27

items.statement: Government project billing preponement in Q4 FY26 pulled Q1 revenues forward, impacting sequential inorganic growth comparison
items.quote: In the last call also, I said there were certain government projects that we're doing. And there were a preponement of billing in last quarter itself because of the government budget is getting closed down.

items.statement: Minority interest of INR14 crores (27% of profit before minority) reflects non-wholly subsidiary outperformance; call options at original acquisition multiples over 2-5 years
items.quote: A non-wholly subsidiary that outperforms, w ill show a larger minority interest and this is a function of that business doing well, not of value leaking out to third parties

items.statement: Low-margin business exits primarily from sub-distribution, not hospital supplies; will first try to improve margins before exiting further businesses
items.quote: So, it didn't primarily come from hospital, came primarily from our sub-distribution business, okay. And there are opportunities for further taking out some business, but we are taking -- first, our -- always our first priority is to improve the margins from those businesses before we take a decision to let them go.

items.statement: FY27 pre-sales target of INR 1,000 crores (INR 500 crores from new launches, INR 500 crores from ongoing inventory)
items.quote: So, we expect about 500 crores of pre-sales from these projects and from the ongoing projects, we expect about 500 crores of the pre-sales in balanced financial year, you know, which is the unsold value as of 30th June is about 700 crores.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin target of 25-26%
items.quote: But we expect to maintain EBITDA margin of about 25-26% over the year.

items.statement: FY28 launch target of INR 5,000 crores+ including Filmistan project
items.quote: And next year also we are like banking on a 5000 crore plus launch. So, all these numbers shift from say 1500 to 3000, 3000 to 5000 crore launches.

items.statement: Development pipeline of INR 12,800 crores GDV across 4.2 million sq ft saleable carpet area
items.quote: Our development pipeline has now reached an estimated gross development value of approximately INR 12,800 crores, spread across nearly 4,200,000 square feet of saleable carpet area.

items.statement: FY27 planned launches of INR 3,000 crores GDV
items.quote: Of this, projects with an estimated gross development value of nearly INR 3,000 crores are planned to be launched during FY27, providing strong visibility for near-term business momentum.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 pre-sales increased 9% YoY to INR 155 crores
items.quote: Our pre-sales for the quarter increased by 9% year-on-year to INR 155 crores, reflecting the strength of our project portfolio and continued customer confidence.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 29.1%, EBITDA margin 18.9%, PAT margin 13%
items.quote: Gross-profit margins remained resilient at 29.1%, demonstrating the strength of our project economy. Operating EBITDA stood at Rs. 28 crores, resulting in EBITDA margins of 18.9%, while net profit for the quarter stood at Rs. 19 crores, with a PAT margin of 13%.

items.statement: Employee base expanded from 213 to 277 to support growing business and project pipeline
items.quote: Secondly, employee costs increased as we continued to strengthen our capabilities, with our employee base expanding from 213 employees as of June 25 to 277 employees as of June 26, to support our growing business and expanding project pipeline.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 collections healthy at INR 164 crores
items.quote: From a business perspective, collections remained healthy at Rs. 164 crores, while pre sales increased by 9% year-on-year to Rs. 155 crores, reflecting continued customer confidence and the strength of our project portfolio.

items.statement: Net debt of INR 5 crores, net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.01x as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, net debt stood at only Rs. 5 crores, with a net debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.01 times. This conservative capital structure provides us with significant flexibility to pursue attractive business development opportunities while maintaining a prudent leverage level.

items.statement: May opt for construction finance at lower interest rates if required for outright projects
items.quote: So, we may look at construction finance like all the projects, the outright projects are already paid for. We are currently at almost net debt and if required, we will opt for construction finances which is coming at a much lesser interest rate and which is normally very healthy and sustainable.

items.statement: Construction cost inflation absorbed by incremental residential unit rates
items.quote: So, normally construction cost inflation is absorbed by the incremental rate in the residential units, you know, and it balances out. Normally, that's what happens.

items.statement: Planned commercial development vertical for revenue diversification and annuity income
items.quote: Alongside our residential portfolio, the company's planned commercial development vertical is expected to provide additional revenue for business diversification while creating a steady stream of annuity income over the long term.

items.quote: No, we are letting them go, Vikas, because accounts that we don't feel have any potential to scale or we are in a situation where we are marginalized, we are just letting go.

items.statement: West Bengal expansion leverages existing skilled manpower; fewer new hires needed, especially at senior level

items.statement: TOPCon upgrade fundable through internal accruals; may evaluate debt financing to optimize liquidity

items.statement: CRISIL rating BBB+ stable unchanged
