items.quote: With healthy volume momentum, expanding channels, disciplined cost management and an improving pricing environment, we remain optimistic about the outlook with revenue expected to grow by 10% to 12% in the coming quarter and EBITDA margin expected to remain in the range of 9% to 10%.

items.statement: Revenue grew 10% YoY in Q1 FY27 driven by healthy volume traction across portfolio
items.quote: We started FY27 on a positive note with revenue growing by 10% witnessing steady momentum across the portfolio. Healthy volume traction remained a key driver of growth during the quarter.

items.statement: Advertising spend at 10.5% of revenue in Q1 to be rationalized to 6%-7% going forward
items.quote: During Quarter 1, the advertisement and marketing spend comes to around 10.5% of the total revenue and going forward, the same would be rationalized to 6% to 7%.

items.statement: Yarn prices on upward trajectory creating favorable pricing environment; calibrated pricing approach adopted
items.quote: Yarn prices are currently on an upward trajectory creating a favorable pricing environment for the company. While competitive intensity remains elevated, we continue to adopt the calibrated pricing approach with the objective of progressively translating the favorable pricing environment into improved utilizations and

items.statement: Price hike of 4%-5% taken in Q1 but diluted by competitive schemes; new rates to be implemented in August with further 4%-5% hike planned
items.quote: We took a price hike of 4%to 5% in Quarter 1. But that was gradually again transferred to trade because of intensive competition in terms of extra scheme and all. So, probably in the august the new rate will be implemented. And we look for a further price hike of 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Thermal segment has sound and healthy order book for FY27; expects better contribution than last year depending on winter
items.quote: For thermals, we have a sound and healthy order book. And we expect that this year thermal will contribute better compared to last year. So, the expectations are high. And probably, lastly, it largely depends on how winter gets through this year.

items.statement: Modern trade and e-commerce at 5% of revenue; building infrastructure for e-commerce targeting 20%-25% growth
items.quote: Exports contributed 4% to overall revenue during the quarter while modern trade including e -commerce contributed 5% to the revenues. Both these c hannels continued to gain traction and provide meaningful opportunities to further scale our market presence and expand our reach.

items.statement: E-commerce targeting 20%-25% growth; building senior team and IT infrastructure
items.quote: On trade, we see huge potential. So, we have been able to appoint senior heads for the e -commerce business and we are building the right infrastructure for that. So, either it is your warehouse, your inventory management, your dispatches and all. So, your IT, so everything is getting in place and we are quite hopeful. And we are looking at double digit, more than double digit growth in e-commerce

items.statement: Women's segment at 8%-10% of revenue; rebranding Softline with new fabrics and strong team to improve performance
items.quote: So, one major is that the main brand in our women's segment is Softline. So, where we have gone a big change, we have changed the brand, the font of the brand is going under a major change. And we are again building up a very relevant portfolio in terms of product range with, like, lot of new fabrics and all and building up a strong team for that.

items.statement: Athleisure de-grew 5%-7% YoY in Q1 but expects double-digit growth for full year
items.quote: It was 5% to 7% de-growth compared to Quarter 1 last year. Shubhankar Gupta: For the whole year, how much are you expecting for athleisure to take up? Vikash Agarwal: More than double-digit growth for an annual basis

items.statement: High competitive intensity from organized players using extra discounts and extended sale periods to gain market share
items.quote: Few players are probably using this, giving extra discounts and all just to gain market share and all. So, this is how the industry is surviving now. This is how you need to be there to be in market.

items.statement: Implementing SAP and AI initiatives for better inventory control and visibility; DMS rollout planned state-wise over 1-2 years
items.quote: We are doing lot of initiatives in IT where we have better control on the inventory and we have a better visibility of stocks where it is stuck. So, yes. Better implementation of SAP and all will help us to, better implementation of AI also we are taking few initiatives and all.

items.statement: Maintained net cash surplus of Rs 7 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As on June 30 th, 2026, company has maintained a net cash surplus position of INR 7 crores reflecting our continued focus on liquidity discipline and financial flexibility.

items.statement: Building strong team for women's segment with NSM and ZSMs in place; appointed senior heads for e-commerce
items.quote: So, in terms of, now for Rupa again, we are having NSM with a strong set of ZSMs which are already in place. And under ZSMs, we are building up a strong team for each brand for retailing Rupa & and all

items.statement: Condolences expressed for demise of Independent Director Mr. Ashok Bhandari on August 3, 2026
items.quote: Before I begin, I would like to take a moment to express our deepest condolences on the unfortunate demise of Mr. Ashok Bhandari – Non-Executive Independent Director of the company who passed away on August 3 rd, 2026.

items.statement: ROCE and ROE suppressed at ~10% and single digits; structural improvement expected via shift to secondary-driven market and new channels
items.quote: Of course, the ROCE and ROE, whatever you mentioned, is not desirable. But as the industry is going through a very tough time in terms of competitive scenario and all. But we are taking a lot of initiatives in terms of moving completely from wholesale driven market to secondary driven market and all.

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue guidance to INR2,600 crores with a small chance of exceeding it
items.quote: Guidance, we revised our guidance for FY '27 at INR2,600 crores with a small chance that we may even cross this number.

items.statement: Manufacturing order book at INR22.08 billion with breakdown by segment
items.quote: Order book for the Manufacturing segment is INR22.08 billion, out of which INR19.29 billion is the generator and motor manufacturing business, INR2.11 billion is railway business, spares and aftermarket is INR0.22 billion and INR0.46 billion is the Turkey business.

items.statement: Order inflow of INR7.34 billion in Q1, up 87% Q-o-Q, with 93% from exports
items.quote: Order inflow during the quarter is INR7.34 billion, an increase of 87% on a Q-on-Q basis. Order inflow from direct and deemed exports is INR6.84 billion compared to INR2.57 billion, 93% of our quarterly order inflows, exports by 7% is domestic.

items.statement: Expects around INR700 crores order inflow per quarter, totaling INR2,800 crores for full year
items.quote: are expecting around INR700 crores per quarter. So, we will be somewhere in between. Nishita: Okay. Per quarter order inflow. Nikhil Kumar: Yes, something like INR2,800 crores plus we'll have for the whole year, order

items.statement: Current capacity sufficient for FY28 around INR22 billion; debottlenecking with INR500 million investment to reach INR32 billion capacity for FY28
items.quote: As mentioned above, at the moment, we have sufficient capacity for FY '28 around INR22 billion. Although we will do some debottlenecking with investments around INR500 million.

items.statement: Close to signing agreements for large generator segment (>100 MW); announcement expected in August
items.quote: Regarding the opportunity in the large generator segment, we are close to signing agreements with the relevant parties and we will inform the market growth probably in the month of August about these unique opportunities.

items.statement: Very buoyant market across all segments driven by AI data centres, grid stabilization, renewables; strong order inflow expected to continue
items.quote: In general, we see a very buoyant market for TDPS in all segments of business. The basic factors that are driving growth continue to play out, AI data centres, grid stabilization, basic power generation push towards renewables, which drives demand for geothermal, hydro, waste -to-energy, etcetera.

items.statement: Tremendous shortage of power generation equipment globally; demand forecasts very strong
items.quote: Despite differing views on the sustainability of this buoyancy in the media, the ground reality is that there is a tremendous shortage of power generation equipment, specifically in gas turbines, gas engines, transformers and generators. The forecast of demand at the moment are very strong

items.statement: Guided to maintain gross contribution margin within plus/minus 1% range through pricing, cost reduction, product mix, and exchange rate levers
items.quote: Look, I can't tell you we have guided in the last call that we will maintain our approximately plus/minus 1% here and there, we maintain the gross contribution margin for the company.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guided at 18-19%; driven by multiple factors including pricing, cost reductions, exchange rates, raw material prices, and capacity utilization
items.quote: There are a number of factors that drive margins. One is pricing, one is cost reductions, one is exchange rates, raw material prices, and then there's also EBITDA margins, also dependent on the factory loading capacity utilization.

items.statement: Price variation clauses implemented where applicable; contracts have price variation clauses that have been implemented
items.quote: We have contracts with our customers where we have price variation clauses and wherever we have price variation clauses, those have been implemented, yes.

items.statement: No major client additions; working deeper with existing major OEM customers; a couple of smaller client additions in pipeline
items.quote: We don't have any major client additions at the moment. We have a couple of smaller client additions which in the pipeline, which we are hopeful to close in this quarter and of course, all the major clients, major engine makers, major turbine makers, we're already working with them very closely.

items.statement: Working capital to remain in line; current liabilities increased due to customer advances and tax provisions from higher business volume
items.quote: Yes. Actually, working capital will continue to remain on the same line because we see a significant growth from last year to this year and on the current liabilities, yes, there are customer advances and also the provision for taxation because of the increased volume of business.

items.statement: Payment terms fixed with customers; cannot alter significantly without risking business continuity
items.quote: We have payment terms fixed with our customers, and we're not going to be able to alter them dramatically to be able to do what you're saying we should do. We need to make sure that our business continuity with our customers is the number 1 priority.

items.statement: Employee count scaling from 1,750 to 2,600; wage hike already built into expenses
items.quote: You see that the business is also increasing. We have almost 75% growth over the last quarter. So, I think there could be some more additions to the employees list because we are scaling up from 1,750 to 2,600. So, it is

items.statement: Service revenue remains 5-6% of overall sales; generators require minimal service for first 10 years
items.quote: So earlier, the proportion used to be 5%, 6%. And now since the sales, it still remains around 5%, 6% of our overall sales. So, the sales are also growing at 30%, 40% per year. So, our service business is also still growing at that rate, keeping the percentage remains the same of our overall business.

items.statement: Turkey facility has EUR3-3.5 million orders for execution this year; will continue as service backup/insurance facility for European market
items.quote: We have about EUR3 million, EUR3.5 million worth of orders for execution this year, and we will execute that EUR3.5 million this year. We don't see a big pipeline for business for next year right now, but the Turkey facility still continues to be like an insurance facility in case we have to do major client for service.

items.statement: Domestic demand subdued at 10-12% growth; no explosive growth expected; no meaningful AI/hyperscaler demand in India due to gas/water constraints
items.quote: In India, the demand is fairly subdued. I mean, it's in the region of 10%, 12%, like what we have guided and I've been saying this not just now, but I've been saying this for the past 5, 6 quarters, and that is what it is and that's -- we don't expect anything more and it is correct what I'm saying.

items.statement: OEM customers have taken significant non-refundable advances from end customers, providing confidence in demand visibility for FY29-30
items.quote: Our OEM customers have taken significant amounts of non -refundable advances from the people who want to buy their equipment and that is the reason why we have confidence, and they have confidence that the demand will be there in the years ahead.

items.statement: Board meeting scheduled for Friday to discuss fundraise; details to be disclosed after meeting
items.quote: We have issued a notification to the exchange that we'll be having a Board meeting on Friday and I cannot discuss anything before the Board meeting takes place on Friday. After Friday, after we finish the Board meeting, naturally, we'll have to disclose to the market what we plan to do

items.statement: Revenue guidance: 7-8% volume growth for FY27, down from earlier 7-9% range
items.quote: I would say we will be having a healthy run for market growth. I still believe we can deliver 7%-8% volume growth but not 9%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 13% for FY27
items.quote: We have given a guidance of 13%. We still remain firm with that guidance.

items.statement: Capex guidance maintained at INR 80-100 crores annually for FY27
items.quote: Actually, the long term of whatever we said, INR80 crores to INR100 crores capex every year, we are maintaining still the same statement.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 14.5% from 10.8% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved significantly to 14.5% compared to 10.8% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Margin improvement driven by steelmaking portfolio execution, price realization, operating leverage and productivity initiatives
items.quote: This improvement in profitability was driven by strong execution across our steelmaking portfolio, favourable price realization, operating leverage and ongoing productivity initiatives.

items.statement: Healthy demand across steel and cement end markets with steady steel production growth and cement capacity expansion
items.quote: Encouragingly, demand across all our key end markets remains healthy. In the steel sector, major steel producers reported steady growth in production and volumes aided by strong domestic demand and high-capacity utilization levels.

items.statement: No project orders in Q1; coke oven project near final negotiation, glass projects in advanced discussion for H2
items.quote: So, if we talk about the glass project, the silica project and coke oven project. So, coke oven project is almost at the final stage of our negotiation. There's a bit of pricing adjustment, which we are doing with our customer s. So it should be concluded anytime. And we will start the production from next month

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex only INR 8 crores vs annual guidance of INR 80-100 crores
items.quote: I think we did INR 8 crores of capex only in Q1 versus INR150 crores guidance.

items.statement: MINPRO JV initial investment ~INR 35 crores over 2 years, targeting 8-10% EBITDA margin, <3 year payback
items.quote: It is roughly INR35 crores initial investment in next 2 years' time. And we believe EBITDA should be around 8% to 10% and payback period should be less than 3 years or so after production.

items.statement: Quartzite mines (Chiraipani and Bhikampali) expected to open by end of Q2 FY27, benefits from Q3
items.quote: We are very close to opening up this mine and now our take is, towards the end of this quarter we should be able to open these mines. So this would definitely give us a solid structural benefit in terms of cost structure. The benefits we expect should start coming up from next quarter.

items.statement: MINPRO JV greenfield mineral processing facility in Odisha expected to start production in Q4 FY27
items.quote: We are very hopeful. We will be looking somewhere towards the quarter 4 of this financial year to start.

items.statement: Magnesite prices up 6-8% in last 2 months; working on absorption and pass-through
items.quote: So magnesite price has already gone up by 6% to 8% from, last 2 months or so. We are trying to see how we can absorb this and how we can pass on to our end user.

items.statement: Alumina prices stable for last 6 months with no significant movement
items.quote: Alumina price has stabilized from last 6 months to last quarter of last financial year It was static; there's no significant movement.

items.statement: Flow control products driving margin growth; Dalmia business flat, RHI Magnesita India growing
items.quote: In RHI Magnesita India, most of the products are flow control products, be it the Bhiwadi plant or Jamshedpur plant, and that was our focus area where we could manage to get price increases. So, the growth has come from IN whereas IR remains flat.

items.statement: 35% of revenue from core business; flow control market share doubled in one big group over 6 months
items.quote: Just to give you an update Rajesh, 35 percentage is coming from core business, our total revenue. I think that has answered your question...

items.statement: Backward integration via quartzite mining and recycling rates increasing for cost competitiveness
items.quote: Fourth, we remain focused on driving cost competitiveness through backward integration, progress in quartzite mining and increasing recycling rates, which would strengthen both our resilience and sustainability.

items.statement: Working capital well controlled; strategically increased inventory for supply continuity
items.quote: Working capital remained well controlled even as we strategically increased inventory levels to strengthen supply continuity and support customer requirements in the upcoming quarters.

items.statement: Net cash positive balance sheet with INR 452 crores cash and equivalents
items.quote: We have cash and cash equivalents of INR452 crores, and our balance sheet shows a strong improvement in working capital. Our balance sheet remained net cash positive with strong KPIs.

items.statement: MINPRO JV funded 51% by RHI Magnesita, 49% by Khemka for first 2 years, then self-sustaining
items.quote: First 2 years, we and our JV partner Khemka as per the shareholding, 51% we will infuse, 49% they will infuse in capex as well as in working capital for first 2 years and then the JV will have self-sustainable money and from that they will do further expansion or ramp-up of the facility.

items.statement: Pankaj Malhan appointed as new MD & CEO; Parmod Sagar continues as Chairman
items.quote: I'm delighted to welcome Mr. Pankaj Malhan as our new Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, while I continue to serve as Chairman.

items.statement: Steel sector capex expected INR 50,000-60,000 crores in FY27; steel demand growth 7-8% in H1
items.quote: I think if I just do a very broad-cut number, not to be exact, but I think steel sector itself would be seeing a capex of not less than INR50,000 crores to INR60,000 crores coming up this financial year.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty (Ukraine-Russia, Middle East wars) impacting export growth and raw material costs
items.quote: Sometimes Ukraine-Russia war, now Middle East war, something or the other is happening, though we keep on striving and we did some very successful trials.

items.statement: Vesuvius crucible business not new; RHI open to opportunities fitting strategy
items.quote: Actually, if you talk about our good friend Vesuvius, they are from the very beginning with Foseco. They are quite with Foseco 30 years back and this crucible business was there throughout. It is not a new diversification, as per my knowledge.

items.statement: Auditor resignation aligned with group auditor rotation; new auditors to be adopted at upcoming AGM
items.quote: So we are aligning with our group's strategy to ensure that we have same auditors. So this mandatory rotation for group also it made sense for us to have a productive discussion with our auditors and they had said that they also had intent to resign and we will be adopting Sensitivity: Internal the same auditors in the upcoming AGM to ensure that we get the right governance and also synergies alon

items.statement: Goodwill impairment of Dalmia business complete; no further impairment expected, non-cash item below EBITDA
items.quote: So, goodwill was one time and all we can confirm is that all the goodwill of Dalmia is already off our balance sheet now. And by the way, just to kind of remind everybody to the investor, these are non-cash goodwill, non-cash impairment, no impact on our profitability. It is below EBITDA line.

items.statement: Export share reduced from last quarter; targeting flow control/isostatic product exports growth in coming months
items.quote: But the current performance, Sahil, it's actually reduced from last quarter to this quarter. So it's actually reducing at the moment for us.

items.statement: Industry production grew 22% YoY to 93.6 lakh units in Q1 FY27 with broad-based momentum across segments
items.quote: Overall, industry performance during the quarter reflected broad-based momentum with domestic automobile production increasing over 22% year -on-year to 93.6 lakh units, underscoring strong OEM activity and healthy demand visible across automobile value chain.

items.statement: No formal guidance provided; growth drivers identified as lightweighting orders, export SOPs, temperature-controlled tubes, and domestic OEM volumes
items.quote: The key contributors to FY27 growth include the full year benefits of previously announced lightweighting order s, ramp -up of additional lightweighting programs, the temperature-controlled tube adjacencies, SOPs of North American export orders and the supportive outlook for domestic OEM volumes.

items.statement: North American export orders worth $10.7M annual value and $58.5M lifetime value with SOPs expected in Q3 and Q4 FY27
items.value: US$10.7 million annual, US$58.5 million lifetime
items.quote: Our previously announced 3 orders from a North American engine and genset manufacturer with a combined annual value of approximately US$10.7 million and a lifetime value of approximately US$58.5 million remain aligned to revised customer schedules.

items.statement: Most direct materials on pass-through basis; one-time premium RM procurement due to geopolitical situation absorbed in Q1 gross profit
items.quote: Most of the direct materials are on pass -through basis. And there was small impact of premium RM procurement, which is built into the gross profit growth of 8% because of the geopolitical situation.

items.statement: Uttarakhand facility investment of ~INR 20 crores progressing per customer plan; Chakan 3 lightweighting facility commenced SOP with modular capacity
items.quote: Our new Uttarakhand facility is progressing in line with the customer implementation plan. The project involves an investment of approximately INR 20 crores and has been planned closer to customers' manufacturing location to improve logistics, responsiveness and JIT alignment.

items.statement: Chakan 3 lightweighting facility commenced SOP and ramping up; Uttarakhand facility to support relocation and co-location of existing business
items.quote: Our Chakan 3 lightweighting facility has commenced SOP and is ramping up in line with customer schedules. The facil ity has been designed with modular capacity, allowing investment to remain linked to confirmed programs and future customer demand

items.statement: Diversifying across products, powertrains, geographies; expanding lightweighting portfolio beyond control arms into subframe and torsion beams via Donghee partnership
items.quote: technology licensing agreement with Donghee expands our lightweighting portfolio beyond control arms into subframe and torsion beams

items.statement: Export strategy focused on CV emission components, temperature-controlled tubes, genset emission components, small agri genset exhaust systems; RFQ pipeline across focus areas
items.quote: Our export market strategy essentially is focusing around CV emission components, temperature-controlled tubes, genset emission components and small agri genset exhaust systems.

items.statement: Built M&A capabilities and disciplined framework; ready to be more assertive in strategic acquisitions while maintaining ROCE and integration filters
items.quote: Having established these capabilities, we believe we are now ready to be more assertive in pursuing strategic acquisitions. However, this does not mean compromising on discipline. Any transaction must continue to meet our filters of strategic fit, customer and technology relevance, valuation, integration feasibility and ROCE.

items.statement: Lightweighting addressable market estimated at INR 8,000-9,000 crores in 5 years; targeting mid-to-high teen percentage share
items.quote: Our internal assessment on this portfolio is around 5 years from now, it can be between INR8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores. And we firmly believe that we can actually build a mid -teen to high-teen percentage share in that portfolio.

items.statement: Mindful of risks from evolving geopolitical conditions; premium RM procurement impact in Q1 due to geopolitical situation
items.quote: As we move ahead, the operating environment remains supportive, although we remain mindful of certain risks arising out of evolving geopolitical conditions.

items.statement: Filed 2 additional patents in Q1 FY27; total patent filings 24 with 4 awarded; R&D supporting WLTP, Euro-7, hybrid, flex fuel, temperature control tubes, lightweighting localization
items.quote: During Q1 FY2 7, we filed 2 additional patents. This takes the total number of patents filing to 24 with 4 patents awarded. Our R&D team are also supporting WLTP, Euro-7 benchmarking, hybrid solutions, flex fuel readiness, temperature control tubes and the localization of lightweighting technology.

items.statement: Raw material pass-through timelines vary by customer; no vacuum in numbers due to lag as previous quarter recovery occurs in current quarter
items.quote: For this quarter, I will get next quarter. So, there will be a lag. But that lag doesn't create any vacuum for a particular quarter because you get for the previous quarter. So therefore, you won't see any vacuum because of this reason in the numbers.

items.statement: Lightweighting market share was 14% at end of FY26; expected to increase with current order visibility and SOPs in Q3 FY27
items.quote: We have given the market share of 14% in the last financial year. We do market share analysis every year. We don't do it every quarter. So, it was 14% at the end of the financial year. With the SOPs and what visibility we have, which we see now happening even in the third quarter, this market share will certainly go up.

items.statement: Purem JV program started Q4 FY26, ramping up in FY27; JV provides technology access but limited PAT share; evaluating deeper participation in CV >4L segment
items.quote: So, Manpreet, as far as that program, which we mentioned last time, that program is concerned, it started in Q4 last year and it will gradually ramp up during the course of FY27. So that's very much on track.

items.statement: Received 600+ orders from Vodafone Idea in mid-June; converted 95 towers (150 tenancies) in June; 700+ tenancies in pipeline for Q2
items.quote: We had declared on the exchange also that we got around 600-plus orders from Vodafone, out of which we converted 95 towers which is equal to 150 tenancies in month of June itself.

items.statement: Targeting 3,000 additional tenancies from Vodafone Idea in FY27 on conservative basis; 80% new towers, 20% on existing
items.quote: We are planning 3,000 sites for Vodafone Idea with an average revenue of INR31,000 without EV, around INR50,000 with EV.

items.statement: Expect quarterly revenue of INR100 crore by Q4 FY27; annualized INR400 crore; PAT margin target 22-24%
items.quote: We can see it from Q4.

items.statement: EBITDA margin at 59.3% with electricity reimbursement in top line; expect to maintain ~59% EBITDA margin and ~20% PAT margin
items.quote: We will have the same EBITDA margin with EV, which I have shown right now which is around 59%. We will maintain the same EBITDA margin for coming quarters also.

items.statement: Zinc battery (100% made in India) ready for launch by mid-September at INR33,000 per 100H vs lithium at INR48,000; will reduce CapEx and operating cost
items.quote: Zinc battery is ready. It's under production right now and we should get first batch for around 10, 15 sites in by mid of September. And pricing of zinc battery is similar to old pricing of lithium battery.

items.statement: Lithium battery prices doubled in 2.5 months from INR33,500 to INR48,000 per 100H due to China subsidy removal and rupee depreciation; all cells imported from China
items.quote: The battery which was purchasing at the rate of INR33,500 for Grade H went up to -- current price is INR48,000. So, which is almost 50% increase in last couple of months.

items.statement: Revenue share: Airtel 48.1%, Vi 27%, Jio 22.6%, BSNL 2.3%; targeting Vi share to 30-32% after rollout
items.quote: Right now, we are saying we want to take Vodafone to 30%, 32%. We are eyeing around 32% of revenue from Vodafone once we are able to do these 3,000 or more sites from Vodafone.

items.statement: Vodafone Idea plans 45,000 site rollout in 18-24 months (3,000-3,500 sites/month); BSNL plans 2 lakh sites in 5 years (INR77,000 crore CapEx) but rollout delayed by Tejas equipment issues
items.quote: Vodafone has already declared close to 45,000 site rollout plan in next 18-24 months. They are targeting to do 3,000, 3,500 site every month which they have already started.

items.statement: Tenancy ratio 1.22x (7,468 tenancies / 6,103 towers); targeting 1.8x by early FY29 driven by macro site rollouts; Q1 rollout achieved 1.58x (150 tenancies / 95 towers)
items.quote: We are targeting to reach 1.8 in coming 3 to 4 years, so it should be a very decent risk for industry.

items.statement: No immediate fundraising planned; internal accruals sufficient for 3,000 tenancies; may consider if larger orders from Vi/BSNL materialize
items.quote: As of now, we have enough funds from internal accruals. We are not seeing any major fundraising right now. But depends if I get more orders than expected, then we may decide on fundraising.

items.statement: Revenue per tower (ex-EV) stable at INR31,000-31,500 for last 4 quarters; with EV ~INR50,000
items.quote: Revenue per tower has been constant at INR31,000, INR31,500 for us from last four quarters.

items.statement: 186 BSNL sites pending billing for 1-1.5 years; Tejas equipment issues resolving; expect billing to start in Q2
items.quote: Right now, it's 186. So, in this quarter, they have not added anything because they are busy resolving their Tejas issue. But yes, 186 site billing is still pending, which we are expecting now.

items.statement: FY28 target: additional 5,000 tenancies from Vodafone (total 8,000-10,000 over two years); visibility limited beyond FY28 due to industry dynamics
items.quote: If we go in FY28, we are eyeing another 5,000 sites from Vodafone. Out of 45,000 sites, we are saying we will do around 8,000 to 10,000 tenancies from Vodafone in two financial years.

items.statement: Fibre revenue 5-8% of total in FY27; no major jump expected as Vi rollout on microwave; EBITDA margin similar to towers
items.quote: In terms of revenue, it will be very marginal. Right now, we are focused on more of macro sites and more and more sites are coming to rural villages where they go on a microwave rather than fibre.

items.statement: BSNL rollout uncertain due to Tejas equipment issues and slow execution; Vi funding beyond INR6,400 crore not yet secured; company dependent on customer rollout pace
items.quote: Only challenge for BSNL, that I am not as confident as Vodafone is because we are yet to see resolution of Tejas equipment which they are facing issues with Tejas equipment due to which their entire rollout has been delayed from past 1, 1.5 years.

items.statement: Execution capacity and team ready; achieved 150 tenancies in 13-15 days in rainy season; confident of scaling
items.quote: Even in rainy season, we have been doing 100 sites frequency, 150 tenancies in mid-June, which was rainy for parts of India. We are very confident. We have execution capacity.

items.statement: Order book stood at INR990 crores at end of Q1 FY27, up from INR880 crores previous quarter after INR157 crores execution and INR143 crores fresh inflows.
items.quote: Our order book stood at INR990 crores at the end of quarter, providing a healthy base for the revenue visibility going forward.

items.statement: Fresh order inflows of INR143 crores secured during Q1 FY27.
items.quote: the quarter saw continued momentum in our order inflows, with the company securing fresh contracts worth INR143 crores during the period

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 505 bps YoY to 24.4% in Q1 FY27, driven by project delivery efficiency gains.
items.quote: EBITDA increased substantially by 27% on a year-on-year basis to INR39 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 24.4%, representing an expansion of 505 basis points over the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Geospatial Engineering Services revenue grew 30% YoY to INR94 crores; Technology Solutions revenue declined 25% YoY to INR63 crores.
items.quote: our Geospatial Engineering Services revenue for the quarter increased by 30% year-on-year to INR94 crores, while Technology Solutions side, revenue declined by around 25% year-on-year to INR63 crores

items.statement: Management does not provide forward guidance on revenue, order inflow or margins as per company policy.
items.quote: We don't give the forward guidance because that's not within our policy.

items.statement: Approved investment up to INR25 crores in 50:50 JV with AI Fabric USA to build sovereign AI cloud for defense, cybersecurity and government; first INR5 crores for incorporation, then INR20 crores post due diligence.
items.quote: We have approved an investment up to INR25 crores in joint venture with AI Fabric USA to be incorporated to create a sovereign AI new cloud in India for Indian government, citizens and companies focused on cybersecurity, services and defense to offer GPU-as-a-service, model-as-a-service and AI service, to build or lease data center capacity.

items.statement: Working capital cycle at 164 days in Q1 FY27; expect meaningful improvement over next 2-3 quarters as Maharashtra government releases stuck IoT/JJM funds.
items.quote: On working capital cycle stood at 164 days during the quarter broadly in line with the levels seen over the previous 2 quarters. We expect recent – we have received recent government institution issued by Maharashtra government towards allocation of funds for the dues related to IoT and other projects to support collection and meaningfully improve the working capital cycle over the next 2 to 3 qua

items.statement: CFO expects INR100 crores of IoT debtors from JJM projects to be collected by end of Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We have IoT debtors and received from IP approximately UBR of around total amount of INR100 crores, and we are expecting to get these funds by end of third quarter, most probably.

items.statement: Order book execution timeline weighted average 12-18 months; some orders 3-6 months, O&M portions extend 2-5 years.
items.quote: On an average, the execution time line weighted average will be between 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Received LOI from Madhya Pradesh Urban Administration for PMAY manpower agency contract worth ~INR67 crores over 3 years.
items.quote: We have received a Letter of Intent from the Director of Urban Administration and Development, Madhya Pradesh for the selection and appointment of a manpower agency for beneficiary led constant vertical under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana with a total contract value of approximately INR67 crores, which is going to be gained over the next 3 years.

items.statement: Received LOI from Bhandara Municipal Council for AMR water meters under AMRUT 2.0 worth INR17 crores, execution over 12 months.
items.quote: We recently issued a Letter of Intent from Bhandara Municipal Counsel for a supply, installation, commissioning of a consumer, domestic ultrasonic and electromagnetic AMR water meters under the Amrut 2.0 with an order value of INR17 crores.

items.statement: International geospatial orders from T Second worth INR30 crores for NVMe drives, AI-powered building/road extraction, BRYCK AI platform and enterprise geospatial imagery repository.
items.quote: our early engagement with T Second includes NVMe drive supply as well as AI-powered building and road extraction encroachment and asset monitoring through BRYCK AI platform, along with enterprise geospatial imagery repository and AI feature extraction capabilities. The aggregate value of these purchase orders was INR30 crores.

items.statement: Run-rate businesses (Mobility, Product Solutions) contributed ~INR130 crores (20-25%) of FY26 revenue and are not captured in order book.
items.quote: FY26, we had business, as I mentioned, are the 2 segments, which are without order book was INR130 crores, which includes Mobility and the Product Solutions business.

items.statement: Evaluating acquisition targets for vertical integration and margin expansion; INR238 crores raised (INR100 crores Sep'24, INR130 crores Mar'26) but no deals closed yet.
items.quote: We don't want to invest just for the sake of investing we want to see that investments are in line with what we are doing either it is vertical integration backward or vertical integration forward within our line of business so that it enables the margin expansion.

items.statement: Phaneesh Murthy resigned in April 2026 for personal reasons; management denies any link to share price decline.
items.quote: Phaneesh Murthy-ji has resigned in the month of April 2026 and not November 2025. So there is a correction in the date. And there is no relevance of share price and exit of Mr. Phaneesh Murthy. He has resigned because of his personal reasons.

items.statement: CFO rejects share buyback, stating funds raised are for growth investments not surplus cash; promoters invested confidently.
items.quote: Share buyback generally happens when you have cash surplus from operations. Whatever funds we have is the promoters who are invested in the company because they are confident about the growth and the future prospects of the company.

items.statement: International subsidiary (US) showed top-line growth and margin improvement in Q1 FY27; expect good traction in coming year.
items.quote: Top line has also increased for our overseas business in this quarter, even the margins have improved in that business. So, we foresee a good traction in the U.S. subsidiary also in this coming year.

items.statement: JJM project fund delays caused unbilled revenue pile-up of INR320 crores (50% of standalone revenue); expect billing conversion in next 2 quarters.
items.quote: this unbilled revenue, major portion is of JJM things and which we have clarified in our, just a few, in one of the calls that we have got the clarity from the department and this amount will be billed in this next 2 quarters and this unbilled revenue will automatically go down in next 2 quarters once we have this funds from the JJM projects.

items.statement: No specific debt discussion; working capital management focus on collecting government dues.
items.quote: whatever we are billing, we are collecting, so there is no additional buildup of working capital cycle.

items.statement: Mobility business (Allygrow) seeing improvement since Dec 2025; Grammer AG JV (Allygram) not consolidated but Grammer order book improving for CY2026.
items.quote: Grammer also has seen that there is an improvement in the order book for the calendar year 2026, and that is a general improvement overall in the Mobility business.

items.statement: Maharashtra government GR released for disbursement of stuck IoT/JJM funds; expect clearance of overdues before March 31.
items.quote: the Government of Maharashtra has issued a GR where they have said that the majority of the funds which was stuck earlier for the IoT-related projects under the Jal Jeevan mission, they have already resolved that the major funds will be disbursed.

items.statement: International geospatial mobility business showing meaningful improvement with new business development and contract awards gaining momentum.
items.quote: Our international geospatial mobility business showed a meaningful improvement during the quarter with new business development opportunities and contract awards gaining momentum.

items.statement: Margin improvement from 15-17% two years ago to 24% now driven by shift from data acquisition to enterprise solutions and better technology solutions mix.
items.quote: earlier, the margins were, let's say, when we began before 2 years, margins were around 15% to 17%, and we are now going up to 24%.

items.statement: Expect to surpass last year's order inflow numbers; strong funnel with several L1 positions awaiting final award.
items.quote: Funnel is pretty strong and we'll see, we are surpassing our last year's numbers. That's for sure that I will maintain it and reiterate it, we have a very strong funnel across our order book.

items.statement: Transport domain (ITMS/ATMS) capabilities built; partner tie-ups done; expect positive developments in next 1-2 quarters.
items.quote: we have already gathered the capabilities. In some of the cases where we did not have, we already tied up with the partners, and we are already in discussion with the government for some more opportunities. So, we expect some positive developments in the next 1 or 2 quarters on the transport domain.

items.statement: Large mission-mode projects (like JM INR350 cr) take 1-2 years to build; expect one such game-changer project this year or Q1 next year.
items.period: this year or Q1 next year
items.quote: We can anticipate to get one of those in this year, fingers crossed. I cannot put a number over there. But if not fourth quarter, first quarter of next year, we will definitely have one of such kind of projects.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target Rs 1,250-1,400 crore with PAT margin 8.5-9%
items.quote: If you look at a theoretical calculation, it would go somewhere to 2,000. But I believe once Unit 6 comes into operation, then 1,700 or so will not be a difficult task for us.

items.statement: FY28 revenue potential Rs 1,700-1,750 crore with full year Unit 6 operation
items.quote: Next year, we will have the full year for Unit 6, whereas this year we only have five or six months. So with a full 12 months, I see the possibility of crossing 1,700 to 1,750.

items.statement: Q2 demand becoming more apparent, expects better than Q1
items.quote: In Q2, the demand is becoming even more apparent. Also, Q1 being the start of the financial year and the beginning of the conflict, people were a bit slow in purchasing as they wanted to wait and see how things behaved.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11.4%, PAT margin 8.2%, targeting 8.5-9% PAT margin for FY27
items.quote: EBITDA increased by 9.7% year-on-year to Rs. 31.9 crores with a margin of 11.4%, while profit after tax grew by 9.4% to Rs. 22.9 crores with a margin of 8.2%.

items.statement: Management expects PAT margin to return to 8.5-9% levels from current 8.2%
items.quote: No, sir, you don't expect 10%. I did not say 10%. I said that we will come to the level of 8.5%-9%. I hope so.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex Rs 20 crore, cumulative Rs 209 crore of Rs 512 crore planned
items.quote: Moving to our capital expenditure program, we incurred approximately Rs. 20 crores during Q1 FY27 across ongoing expansion initiatives. With this, cumulative capex incurred stands at Rs. 209 crores as of June 30, 2026, against the total planned capex of Rs. 512 crores.

items.statement: Land acquisition of 30,000 sqm at Lote Parshuram for Rs 9.33 crore
items.quote: During the quarter, the company acquired approximately 30,000 square meters of additional land at Lote Parshuram for Rs. 9.33 crores, located near the existing Unit 1.

items.statement: Meghnagar expansion progressing, adds 4,50,000 MT fertilizer and 72,000 MT chemical capacity
items.quote: Together, these projects are expected to add 4,50,000 metric tons per annum of fertilizer capacity and 72,000 metric tons per annum of the chemical capacity additionally, significantly expanding the company's manufacturing base.

items.statement: 10 MW DC solar project at Nanded nearing completion, total solar capacity to reach 20.6 MW DC
items.quote: The 10 megawatt DC solar power project at Nanded is nearing completion and once co mmissioned, we will take the company's total installed solar capacity to 20.6 megawatt on DC

items.statement: Sulphur prices reset from USD 250-300 to USD 1,100, acid plants on low load due to working capital stress
items.quote: Specifically, if I talk about sulphur, sulphur, which used to be in the range of USD250-USD300, in today's date, only sulphur is in the range of USD1,100. We do not expect that these prices will again come back.

items.statement: K-acid price moved from Rs 550 to Rs 700+, company is largest K-acid manufacturer in India
items.quote: Today, we are the largest manufacturer of K-acid in India. No one else is in K-acid. The price of the product has moved from Rs. 550 to Rs. 700-plus.

items.statement: Fertilizer 51%, Chemical 49% of sales value in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The fertilizer business recorded sales value of Rs. 142 crores, representing growth of 4% year-on-year basis, while the chemical business reported sales value of Rs. 138 crores, grown by 17.10% on year-on-year basis. Two businesses contributed 51% and 49%, respectively, to the sales value during the quarter.

items.statement: Acid plants on low load due to working capital stress - sulphur requires advance payment, acid sold on credit
items.quote: Secondly, 1 kg of sulfur makes 3 kg of acid. Today, sulfur requires advance payment, while acid is sold entirely on credit. If I am earning two cents, I will do it. When I am not earning those two cents, why should I block working capital?

items.statement: Rs 125 crore non-lien deposits as of June 30, 2026, funded through internal accruals and preferential issue proceeds
items.quote: From a liquidity perspective, the company continues to maintain a comfortable position with Rs. 125 crores in non-lien deposits as on June 30, 2026.

items.statement: Fertilizer volume 66,527 MT (down from 76,288 MT), Chemical volume 9,113 MT (down from 14,837 MT)
items.quote: The fertilizer business recorded the sales volume of 66,527 metric tons compared to 76,288 metric tons in Q1 FY26, while volumes in the chemical business were 9,113 metric tons compared to 14,837 metric tons in the corresponding period.

items.statement: Fertilizer sales value Rs 142 crore (+4% YoY), Chemical sales value Rs 138 crore (+17.1% YoY)
items.quote: The fertilizer business reported sales value of Rs. 142 crores, growing by 4% on year-on-year basis, while the chemical business recorded sales value of Rs. 138 crores, registering growth of 17.10% year-on-year basis.

items.statement: West Asia conflict and Hormuz closure caused raw material supply disruption, now improving
items.quote: Like ammonia is a major raw material into that, sulphur is a major raw material into that, and suddenly there was acute shortage of these two raw materials because of the closure of the Hormuz.

items.statement: DAP availability challenge limits farmer shift from NPK/SSP despite price hikes
items.quote: DAP import prices, sale prices, and availability. If a product is available, a consumer will shift. But if DAP is available, who would pay more for NPK or SSP? If he gets DAP at a cheaper price, any consumer would shift

items.statement: No plans for battery-grade phosphoric acid, focused on current expansions first
items.quote: No, sir. As of now, very honestly sp eaking, we are totally focused towards our goal and objective. So regarding the battery-grade and other things are not on our agenda as of

items.statement: Madhya Pradesh plant fully integrated with 800 TPD chemical plant for backward integration into NPK
items.quote: In Madhya Pradesh, the capacity is double that of Unit 6. There is also an 800-ton-per-day chemical plant there, but that will be used for backward integration into the finished NPK products.

items.statement: Management expects double-digit revenue growth for FY27 and EBITDA margin to return to ~30%
items.quote: As of now, we feel yes. Even this quarter, we lost around INR 10 crores because of the sales reversal, which will come in the next quarter. As of now, we think we should be able to grow in double digits.

items.statement: US business growth expected at 8-10% steady state
items.quote: We don't expect at least at this juncture beyond 8-10% of growth.

items.statement: FY27 capex of INR 123 crore; INR 20 cr maintenance, INR 50 cr R&D, balance growth capex
items.quote: INR 123 crores, you rightly said that we have explained in the AGM, correct? Abhishek Navalgund Yeah. Beni Prasad Rauka This is what we are going to spend

items.statement: Fermentation utilisation at 70-75%; capacity expansion decision next quarter
items.quote: We are close to 70-75%, and we will take the call in the next quarter, and we may start some of the CapEx expenditure for increasing our capacity.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 27% vs 30% YoY and 31% QoQ due to lower realisation, higher power/fuel, mix shift
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter came in at INR 510 million, down 10% YoY and 19% QoQ. Consequently, the EBITDA margin stood at 27% compared to 30% in Q1 FY26 and 31% in Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margin to normalise to ~30% for full year
items.quote: Yes. We expect that it shall come back to the normal level of about 30% of EBITDA.

items.statement: INR 100 million incremental sales reversal in Q1 due to goods in transit; already recorded as of call date
items.quote: On account of revenue recognition accounting principles, this quarter was impacted by an additional sales reversal amounting to INR 100 million over and above reversal of revenue generally being accounted in every quarter.

items.statement: Top 10 customers 23% of revenue vs 27% YoY and 26% QoQ; top 10 products 45% vs 45% YoY and 49% QoQ
items.quote: I would like to give you some numbers about our top 10 customer s. It is about 23% during this quarter as compared to 27%, last year Q1 and as compared to 26% in Q4 FY26. Our top 10 products has contributed about 45%, as compared to 45% last year and 49% in last quarter of FY26

items.statement: Power and fuel costs elevated due to global energy disruption; pricing better this quarter with some price increases
items.quote: Our consolidated margins moderated primarily due to three factors: lower top-line realization, elevated power and fuel costs driven by global energy disruption, and a temporary shift in the sales mix.

items.statement: Realisation improved vs Q4 and Q1 FY26 due to price hikes
items.quote: Pricing is better in this particular quarter because we have increased some prices. It's better in that sense. Realization is better than Q4 and Q1 of last year.

items.statement: Inventory INR 190 cr, receivables INR 131 cr, payables INR 41 cr; working capital cycle 125-138 days
items.quote: Inventory, 30th June 2026, was about INR 190 crores. We had a receivable of about INR 131 crores. Payables were about INR 41 crores. INR 280 crores was roughly invested in the working capital. In terms of number of days, generally our working capital cycle is about 125-138 days.

items.statement: Debt at ~20% of revenue vs 22% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Our debt is about 20% of our revenue as compared to 22% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Board approved buyback of INR 697 million at ceiling price INR 500/share via open market; starts 14 Aug
items.quote: We are pleased to announce that the Board has approved a buyback of INR 697 million at a ceiling price of INR 500 per share via open market route.

items.statement: Acquired remaining 4.28% stake in JC Biotech for INR 79.79 million, now 100% owned
items.quote: The company has also announced the acquisition of the remaining stake of 4.28% for a consideration of INR 79.79 million in our existing subsidiary, JC Biotech, resulting in a total stake of 100%, making it wholly-owned subsidiary.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions, trade uncertainties, supply chain disruptions, energy/raw material volatility impacting US and global ops
items.quote: The global economy has been experiencing significant disturbance for quite some time, primarily driven by geographical tensions, trade and uncertainties, and continued disruption across global supply chain.

items.statement: R&D spend INR 90 million (4.75% of revenue) in Q1 FY27 vs INR 86 million (4.62%) YoY
items.quote: R&D expenditure, we have spent about INR 90 million in the Q1 of FY27 as compared to INR 86 million in Q1 of FY26. This is about 4.75% during this quarter as compared to 4.62% in the corresponding Q1 of FY26.

items.statement: Hiring challenges in US market noted as operational issue
items.quote: Even hiring people have become a big challenge in the process.

items.statement: Serratiopeptidase FDC ban impact minimal (~1%)
items.quote: There will not be any meaningful impact. Maybe 1% here and there.

items.statement: Algae DHA project at JC Biotech paused; may revisit after new R&D facility
items.quote: Algae DHA, yeah. We are not going forward with the DHA as of now, which was JC Biotech's molecule. As of now, we are not really working on that at current level.

items.statement: Patents: US patent granted on Alternansucrase (sugar management) and protein hydrolysis; third biocatalysis patent in process
items.quote: We got one patent on Alternansucrase on the sugar management. We already granted U.S. patent. On the protein as well, I guess, I need to check, but I guess we got that one, too, and the third one is under the process.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 30%-40% for FY27 remains on track
items.quote: Our goal to reach net debt positive on a standalone balance sheet by FY28 remains firmly on track. Let me assure you guys and it will be supported by the combined cash generation from the EPC, MDO and the rising InvIT distributions. I reiterate that our debt reduction guidance of Rs. 600 to 800 crores that we mentioned at the start of the year is on track and we will achieve that. At the same time

items.statement: Standalone net debt reduction guidance of Rs. 600-800 crores for FY27 maintained
items.quote: I reiterate that our debt reduction guidance of Rs. 600 to 800 crores that we mentioned at the start of the year is on track and we will achieve that.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of 10%-12% for FY27 maintained
items.quote: Yes, the guidance is as we had indicated earlier only Shravan ji. We have given the guidance of around 10% to 12% so that guidance is still the same.

items.statement: Standalone net debt to reach near zero by FY28
items.quote: Our goal to reach net debt positive on a standalone balance sheet by FY28 remains firmly on track.

items.statement: Order book stood at Rs. 27,691 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Our order book stood at Rs. 27,691 crores as of June 30th, 2026.

items.statement: Order inflow of Rs. 268 crores in Q1 FY27; full year guidance of Rs. 10,000-12,000 crores maintained
items.quote: In FY27 Quarter 1, order inflow stood at approximately Rs. 268 crores. As I mentioned, this is the 1st Quarter and the ordering activity usually picks up at the end of the financial year, and we are very hopeful of maintaining our guidance of Rs. 10,000-12,000 crores of new order in this financial year.

items.statement: Declared L1 bidder for Sikasar to Kodar Reservoir Link Canal Pipeline project worth Rs. 2,524 crores
items.quote: Additionally, I am pleased to share that DBL has been declared the L1 bidder for the construction of Sikasar to Kodar Reservoir Link Canal Pipeline project in Chhattisgarh on a lump-sum basis, which is valued at about Rs. 2,524 crores.

items.statement: Bid pipeline of approximately Rs. 1.5 lakh crores across sectors
items.quote: Currently, our bid pipeline stands at approximately Rs. 1.5 lakh crores across sectors.

items.statement: Standalone CAPEX guidance of less than Rs. 100 crores for FY27 maintained
items.quote: Yes, that will remain the same. There is no big CAPEX envisaged in Quarter 1. So, we can consider Rs. 100 crores and some replacement CAPEX we can do against some important equipments.

items.statement: Coal production of 4.79 million tonnes in Q1 FY27; FY29 target of 57 million tonnes maintained
items.quote: However, we remain firmly on course to reach our previously guided coal production of approximately 57 million tonnes by FY29.

items.statement: Siarmal coal production target of 27 million tonnes for FY27; Pachhwara target of 7 million tonnes
items.quote: We have planned around 27 million metric tonnes of the coal production in Siarmal for this year. It is less in the 1 st Quarter because the evacuation was less and another 2nd Quarter and 3rd Quarter we will close with the 27 million tonnes in this year. And 7 million tonnes will be in Pachhwara project

items.statement: Coal handling plant at Siarmal to be completed in ~1.5 years; COD at 42.5 million tonnes peak rated capacity
items.quote: It will take about 1.5 years to complete this coal handling plant. So, accordingly, this year the coal production ramp up will be 27 million, next year it will be about 35 million, and after that the coal handling plant will be 50 million.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin expanded to 10.32% in Q1 FY27 from 10.11% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: The EBITDA margin was 10.32%, marginally expanded from 10.11% in Quarter 1 FY26, reflecting steady cost management even in a quarter of moderate execution.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin of 18.05% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The EBITDA excluding other income was Rs. 429 crores with EBITDA margin of 18.05%.

items.statement: MDO margins to remain stable until coal handling plant completion; significant improvement expected post-COD
items.quote: Now Shravan ji, if we talk about the margin level of Siarmal, until we complete the CHP the margin will be almost same. It may slightly vary a bit due to inflation and once the CHP will start and then 78% will become 100%, then there will be a tremendous positive change in the margin profile.

items.statement: Government reimbursing 60%-65% of fuel and bitumen cost increases; cement, steel also impacted
items.quote: The government has given some relaxation in commodity prices, especially in the case of the fuel and bitumen, 60%-65% will be reimbursed. But overall there was an impact on the margins of higher commodity prices because due to disruption of transportation, other things also have become expensive such as cement, bitumen, cement, steel and everything.

items.statement: CFO expects working capital days to reach ~90 days by FY28
items.quote: So, working capital, basically, like Rohan said, by this year-end, we may reach to 120 days. And next year, probably around 90 days of total.

items.statement: Standalone net debt increased to Rs. 2,106 crores from Rs. 1,880 crores QoQ due to seasonal working capital build-up
items.quote: On net debt; on a standalone basis, as on 30 th June 2026, stood at Rs. 2,106 crores compared with Rs. 1,880 crores as on 31 st March 2026. Now, this moment reflects a normal seasonal build-up in working capital that is typical in the first two quarters of the fiscal year.

items.statement: Consolidated net debt at Rs. 7,801 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: The consolidated net debt as on 30 th June 2026 stood at Rs. 7,801 crores.

items.statement: Full year finance cost targeted at Rs. 350 crores due to lower working capital utilization in H2
items.quote: So, the finance cost for full year would be total Rs. 350 crores because we are basically expecting some lesser utilization of working capital during Q3 and Q4. So, our targeted cost is around Rs. 350 crores.

items.statement: Raised Rs. 900 crores structured equity for transmission and solar projects
items.quote: We have also arranged structured equity of about Rs. 900 crores. So, if you refer the HNI line, so almost 85% equity will be sourced through investor and through structured equity.

items.statement: Board approved stake sale in under-construction power transmission and solar projects (combined cost ~Rs. 8,400 crores) to Alpha Alternatives; Alpha to co-invest 49% during construction
items.quote: I am very happy and glad to share that the board has considered and approved a stake sale in our under-construction power transmission and solar projects, which represent a combined project cost of approximately Rs. 8,400 crores to Alpha Alternatives. Now, this deal is like the past deals that we have done with Alpha Alternatives, where the consideration under this transaction will be received in

items.statement: Alpha Alternatives to invest ~Rs. 800 crores equity (49%) in transmission and solar projects; DBL to invest remaining ~Rs. 800 crores
items.quote: Yes, you are very right, in both of these projects put together is some (+1,600) crores of equity needed. Now Alpha will be putting 49% during construction. So, which means (+800) crores odd of equity somewhere around in that range will come from Alpha and only the remaining 800 will need to be put from DBL's side.

items.statement: NHAI FY27 pipeline: 54 highway/expressway projects, 2,442 km, Rs. 1.80 lakh crores capex; 26 EPC, 21 HAM, 7 BOT
items.quote: During the quarter, NHAI articulated its FY2027 project pipeline of 54 highways and expressway projects, covering 2442 kilometers, with a total capital cost of approximately Rs. 1.80 lakh crores, spread across 13 states. Of these, 26 projects are proposed under the EPC route, 21 under the HAM route, and 7 under the BOT route.

items.statement: NHAI monetization: 17 highway stretches (1,693 km) for TOT/InvIT in FY27, expected proceeds Rs. 30,000-35,000 crores
items.quote: NHAI has finalized 17 highway stretches spanning approximately 1693 kilometers for monetization in FY27 through its TOT and InvIT routes, and which is expected to generate proceeds in the range of Rs. 30,000 to 35,000 crores.

items.statement: Anantam Highway Trust: DBL group holds units worth Rs. 1,521 crores face value (Rs. 1,314 crores Anantam + Rs. 207 crores Shrem)
items.quote: As of 30th June 2026, DBL along with its associates and economic interests hold units of approximately Rs. 1,314 crores at face value in Anantam Highway Trust and approximately Rs. 207 crores face value of units in Shrem InvIT. Taking the total value of units held by the group to approximately Rs. 1,521 crores.

items.statement: Next tranche of 11 HAM assets to be transferred to Anantam InvIT by March 2027; requires <Rs. 81 crores incremental equity, generates ~Rs. 1,750 crores InvIT units
items.quote: We remain on track to transfer the balanced HAM assets in phases through March 2027. The next tranche of 11 assets that will be flipped is expected to require less than Rs. 81 crores of incremental equity investment while generating InvIT units valued at approximately Rs. (+1,750) crores.

items.statement: Kerala tunnel collapse deemed natural calamity by Supreme Court-guided committee; no impact on technical score or tunneling bids
items.quote: The committee has visited in Kerala project and they were given the record. That was a natural calamity and while constructing the tunnel there are always two portals. One portal is on the side and mostly by using the second portal the construction of the tunnel will start by the end of this month. In the mean time they will do the due diligence process at the portal where this accident has happen

items.statement: Organic revenue growth target of 15-20% for next 5 years
items.quote: our target is to grow 15% to 20% for the next 5 years. And if you see the first quarter numbers, we have surpassed that.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin target to maintain at 28.3%
items.quote: As a consolidated entity, our EBITDA margin is at 28.3%.

items.statement: Visa segment EBITDA margin target to maintain at 40%
items.quote: in the Visa business, we have achieved around 40% EBITDA margin. And our Digital Service business, the EBITDA margin has grown up to 8.0% now, which was 7.3% before. Our target is to maintain those margins

items.statement: Effective tax rate estimated at 12% for full year
items.quote: Our estimate is that we should close the financial year at around 12%.

items.statement: Revenue per application growth expected at 12-15%
items.quote: We look at the growth in the travel industry, which is about 7% to 8% CAGR, and then try to improve it by another 5%. So, we expect revenue growth of somewhere between 12% and 15%.

items.statement: Aadhaar project capex of INR 125 crores total, INR 75 crores spent so far
items.quote: We have invested about INR 75 crores so far, and the entire project will be completed with an investment of about INR 125 crores.

items.statement: Aadhaar project full investment completion expected next quarter
items.quote: We will complete the entire investment in the next quarter, and by the fourth quarter, we expect the full revenue to start coming in.

items.statement: Multiple visa tenders in pipeline for next 8-12 months and beyond
