items.quote: Our machine costs somewhere around 4.5 lakhs. And we are well placed in terms of placing our machine with an average selling price of around 7.5.

items.statement: Plans to set up 50 dialysis centers across India in FY27
items.quote: As you see in the guidance given by the management, they plan to set up 50 dialysis centers across India in this financial year.

items.statement: Sickle cell test (IIT Bombay tech) awaiting ICMR/CDSCO approval; commercial launch expected Q4 FY27
items.quote: Commercial launch is expected to be at the end of this financial year in the fourth quarter.

items.statement: Onco Diagnoscope/Spot/TB Truth (BARC tech) prototype ready; ICMR/CDSCO approval in progress; launch expected Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28
items.quote: We expect to have these products probably launched in the fourth quarter of this financial year or by early first quarter of next financial year.

items.statement: Sickle cell target market: 18 crore population in India; government allocated Rs 3,000 crore for elimination mission
items.quote: 18 crore population in India is suffering from sickle cell anemia. So one focus of the government is also to test sickle cell and eliminate it. To eliminate it, proteins and vitamins are needed. So the government has allocated 3000 crores for the elimination of sickle cell.

items.statement: Dialysis machines to be reimbursed under Ayushman Bharat; discussions ongoing to include preventive testing products
items.quote: So dialysis is something which is part of Ayushman. The other technological, the other products which are preventive healthcare and testing products, we are in the discussion stage with the government to include in the Ayushman Bharat for the benefit of the mass at large.

items.statement: Promoter holding 80%; must dilute to 75% per SEBI norms via OFS and/or rights issue/QIP; decision pending
items.quote: See Kunal, the thing is that 80% stake is with the promoter today, and as you know, sooner or later I have to dilute it, and I will have to do it because of the listing norms. Correct? So there are two ways of diluting and bringing the equity down to 75% a s per the SEBI norms. One is the OFS, the other is the rights issue or a pref or QIP

items.statement: Aviatic Private Limited is a new incorporation, not an acquisition; disclosures to follow
items.quote: Aviatic Private Limited is not an acquisition, it's a new company which is incorporated for some business which the company plans and probably disclosure will follow on this.

items.statement: Each vertical has dedicated team; promoter described as workaholic driving multi-segment expansion
items.quote: Darshan, I would only say that God gives us strength to work hard. Promoter works day in, day out. He is a workaholic and very enthusiastic with regard to his business. Plus the entire team is there for every vertical, every product, there is a different t eam who focuses on their divisions and products

items.statement: No confirmed sickle cell government orders yet; pricing to be determined via tender after approvals
items.quote: As of now, there is no confirmed order as such because that order doesn't come like this. Once the technology is approved, we'll approach the government and probably a gadget would be issued and a tender would be issued. And then the price would be declared by the government.

items.statement: Using OEM manufacturing (BEL and others) for dialysis machines to avoid heavy upfront capex; may set up own facility after scale stabilizes
items.quote: We didn't want to be capital heavy at the start. Correct? So better is that we get it manufactured through OEM and once the scale gets stabilized, we set up our own capex.

items.statement: Medtech products (dialysis, Onco, sickle cell) expected to contribute >=30% of total revenue
items.quote: I think from t he overall revenue, they should contribute no less than 30% of our total revenue. And that would be an addition to my total revenue in terms of adding to IVD Medtech, renewable energy and plus this Medtech

items.statement: Breast cancer testing technology acquired from C-MET added recently to product pipeline
items.quote: But we have consistently in terms of adding more products. So this year also we recently added our product which is breast cancer testing technology from C-MET.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue ~Rs 280 crore; PAT ~Rs 32 crore
items.quote: Yes, financials Q1 numbers have been declared, and in terms of topline, we have achieved around 280 crores of topline, and in terms of bottom line, it is around 32 crores.

items.statement: Standalone Q1 revenue Rs 280 crore; consolidated Q1 revenue Rs 307 crore
items.quote: You said 1550 crores is our revenue guidance for FY27. And you rightly said 280 crores on a consolidated basis, we did 307 crores, on a standalone basis we did 280 crores.

items.statement: Company commits to 15-20% year-over-year revenue growth as bare minimum
items.quote: 15% to 20% is what we commit to you that would be a bare minimum.

items.statement: Expected revenue for FY27 is around INR 1,100 crores
items.quote: Basically, if you see the expected revenue from our side for '26, '27 will in the rage of around INR1100 crores.

items.statement: No major capex planned; adding product lines within existing Indore investment of ~INR 300 crores
items.quote: In the existing capex, we are just adding product lines, nothing else.

items.statement: Indore capacity utilization expected to reach 40-45% by end of FY27 from current 30-35%
items.quote: And hopefully, like I said, we should end up the year on around 40%, 45% capacity utilization.

items.statement: Peak revenue potential without further capex estimated at INR 1,600-1,800 crores with current product mix
items.quote: So totally, when I add both of them up, INR800 crores plus around 800 plus INR1,000 crores, it comes around INR1,600 crores to INR2,000 crores is the maximum capex I mean, maximum revenue, which is possible with current product basket and current legacy.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 18.09% in Q1 FY27 from 14.6% in Q1 FY26; 18% seen as start of margin improvement
items.quote: EBITDA margin in Q1 of '25-'26 was 14.6% whereas Q1 of '26-'27 is 18.09%.

items.statement: Indore product mix shifting toward complex injectables (depot, liposomal) targeting higher revenue per vial (INR 300-1,500 vs INR 80-100)
items.quote: We hope that going forward with the product mix changing, we go to around INR300 and INR400 and eventually then to an average INR500 per vial model, then another price benefit or revenue extraction is possible.

items.statement: GLP-1 CMO operations with Hetero started in Q1; traction expected to pick up from Q2, meaningful in Q3
items.quote: So we hope that the traction will pick up from Q2. Some traction has happened in the month of July, much more we see in August.

items.statement: Filler partnership with Revanesse Prollenium (Canada); registration expected by Q2-Q3, launch by December/January
items.quote: So we feel that maybe by Q2 or mid of Q3, we should get the registration. And we hope at least December, if not December, maybe January, we should launch the filler in the Indian market.

items.statement: International model shifting from distributor-led to IP-led with own field force in emerging markets; team recruited in Q1
items.quote: So this recruitment has happened in the Q1.

items.statement: Indore EU certification expected in 1-2 months; US partner submission triggered, site visit expected in a quarter or two
items.quote: So hopefully, in the next maybe a month or 2, we should be hearing something from them.

items.statement: Secured approvals across 8 countries in Q1; 5 presentations cleared in single therapy area in one country
items.quote: On our registrations front, we secured approvals across 8 countries during the quarter and in one of them, 5 presentations in a single therapy area cleared on the same day.

items.statement: CHAI Foundation partnership for liposomal amphotericin B to access 100+ markets; bioequivalence study ready by August/September
items.quote: And they will help us to access more than 100 markets of the molecule of liposomal amphotericin B.

items.statement: Indore EU certification pending; compliance submissions made, final data submitted, awaiting authority feedback
items.quote: The Indore certificate would I think we are just waiting for the feedback from the authority. There were some compliance which we already have applied since the last 2-3 months and even the final data also has gone.

items.statement: Employee additions mainly for Indore ramp-up, international expansion (20-25 people), and domestic expansion (50-60 people); prior year increase due to contract-to-permanent conversion
items.quote: The majority chunk would be -- it would be Indore as well as maybe just like, say, around 50 to 60 people, which will be acted on a domestic business side in terms of domestic expansion.

items.statement: Botulinum toxin (Stunnox/Zarbot) remains #2 brand in India; filler market estimated at INR 200 crores
items.quote: On botulinum toxin, we remain the number 2 brand in India in toxin type A manufactured from our own strain.

items.statement: Critical Care launched monobactam/beta-lactamase inhibitor combo on patent expiry; early acceptance encouraging in large institutions
items.quote: In Critical Care, we launched our monobactam and beta-lactamase inhibitor combination immediately on expiry of the innovator patent, and it is now introduced across corporate, tertiary and secondary care networks.

items.statement: Sparsh division completed full quarter on rebuilt channel; outstanding days within standard trade terms; hospital onboarding resumed at scale
items.quote: Sparsh has completed a full quarter on the rebuild channel. Outstanding days are within standard trade terms. Hospital onboarding has resumed at scale and coverage is now balanced between nursing homes and corporate chains.

items.statement: Focus shifted to own manufactured brands for margin and supply reliability; dual chamber bag gaining acceptance in major institutions
items.quote: Our focus has moved towards our own manufactured brands, which help both margin and supply reliability and the dual chamber bag is gaining acceptance in major institutions.

items.statement: Zenova shifting from injectables to prescription-led chronic therapies; antioxidant range now meaningful growth driver
items.quote: Zenova continues its planned shift away from injectables towards prescription-led chronic therapies. The antioxidant range we introduced is now a meaningful growth player.

items.statement: Nutraceutical/Ayurveda lead joint care range outperformed relevant product market in Q1
items.quote: In the nutraceutical and Ayurveda division, our lead joint care range outperformed its relevant product market this quarter.

items.statement: Asset blocker building GI therapy as second pillar alongside pain; first entry into allopathic pain management segment launching this year
items.quote: Our asset blocker continues to build gastrointestinal therapy into second pillar alongside pain, and the division has prepared its first entry into an alopathic pain management segment, which launches during the year.

items.statement: In-licensed pillar and biostimulator portfolio progressing through supply and regulatory steps for launch this financial year with no significant capex
items.quote: The in-licensed pillar and biostimulator portfolio is progressing through its supply and regulatory steps for launch during this financial year with no significant capital expenditure from us.

items.statement: Sparsh division outstanding days within standard trade terms after channel rebuild
items.quote: Outstanding days are within standard trade terms.

items.statement: Botulinum toxin export limited by current WHO Phase 1 facility capacity; global market registration strategy post next year
items.quote: Our current facility is only WHO Phase 1 with limited capacity. So we are right now looking to register them only in the Southeast Asian markets, African markets to start off with.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue guidance of INR4,300-4,500 crores with EBITDA margin range of 11-13%
items.quote: On that basis, we are firmly on track to deliver a full year top line in the range of INR4,300 crores to INR4,500 crores. And to do so while holding the margin profile you have seen this quarter, not sacrificing it for the volume.

items.statement: FY28 revenue target of INR7,500 crores confirmed
items.quote: Ajeet Sethi: Okay. And sir, just a clarification from the call before. So we expect INR7,500 crores in FY28. Have you mentioned that? Management: Yes. Yes.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded ~200 bps to 12.3% despite gross margin pressure from metal lag and mix
items.quote: What I would draw your attention to is despite these gross margin pressures, our EBITDA margin still expanded by close to 200 basis points to 12.3%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 is 11-13% range depending on metal prices
items.quote: Our guidance is between 11% to 13%. This again depends upon the metal price.

items.statement: Two aluminum corrugation lines approved with minimal capex of INR17 crores to expand 66kV and 132kV capacity
items.quote: First and foremost, we have just approved in the board two aluminum corrugation lines that will materially expand our 66 kV cable capacity and 132 kV cable capacity. This let us convert capacity fr om 33 kV up to 66 and 132, where margins are lower, moving our cable mix decisively up the value curve

items.quote: So, the rod mill should start by 15th of October. The incremental MV silane line should start somewhere by 15th of September, and the CCV line will start in March 2027.

items.quote: So, conductors should be around 40%, and cables should be around 50%, 52%. Nishant Bagrecha: This is for FY27? Management: '27. Nishant Bagrecha: Okay. And for '28? items.quote: As on August 11, 2026, it stood at INR3,688 crores, roughly $445 million, and about 2 times of last year's revenue across 12 product lines, and it continues to grow with over INR1,000 crores of fresh wins since April.

items.quote: Along with the fact that we are adding between INR275 crores to INR325 crores of order every month. So we are confident that when we begin the next year, we would have got the next year targets more than 50% to 60% order book in place.

items.quote: Gujarat is expected to flow INR22,000 crores of disaster management orders in the next 3 years. Out of this INR16,000 crores is going to be the cost of 11 kV and 33 kV medium voltage cables.

items.quote: Internally, we have given the team a target of getting at least INR1,000 crores of data center orders before 31st March 2027. And in the current year, we are expecting that our data center sales will contribute around INR750 crores before the month of March.

items.quote: For this year, we have targeted that we will get an order book of at least INR500 crores before we end the year, and this shall be our first year. We will target conductor business and medium voltage business in the current year.

items.statement: QIP raised INR1,640 crores (~$195M), achieved MPS compliance; funds deployed: INR130 cr LV, INR74 cr balancing, INR325 cr GCP, INR350 cr promoter loan repayment, ~INR750 cr working capital
items.quote: We completed a QIP placement raising INR1,640 crores, close to $195 million, achieving full minimum public shareholding compliance and welcoming marquee institutions into our register.

items.statement: Net worth turned positive INR691 crores post-QIP (was -INR922 crores); peak debt minimal through FY28, only vendor/dealer financing considered
items.quote: So, as on 30th June '26, our net worth is negative by INR922 crores. But after this QIP proceed from QIP, which is INR1,614 crores, our as on today, our net worth is positive by INR691 crores.

items.statement: Long-term borrowings largely 0.01% 30-year promoter-held bonds (NPV INR47 crores) and INR400 cr unsecured promoter loan repaid post-QIP
items.quote: So, basically, that was INR1,900 crores of bonds, 0.01% bonds payable after 30 years. These bonds are owned by the promoter. The next part was a INR400 crores unsecured loan from the promoter, which has been paid back post-QIP.

items.statement: QIP funds ~INR750 crores allocated to long-term working capital funding; exploring vendor/dealer financing to improve cash flow
items.quote: The remaining will go towards long-term funding of the working capital. So around INR750 crores will go towards infusion towards working capital.

items.quote: as you go to quarter 2, quarter 3, quarter 4, the product mix will change a little bit medium and high voltage product offtake will increase a s a percentage to sales. So EBITDA will be stronger

items.quote: You would expect the conductor business to do between 30% to 35%, the low voltage cable business to do between 10% to 15%, and the remaining 55% to 50% will continue to be in medium and extra high voltage.

items.statement: Adani ~40%+ of current order book; board mandate to reduce to 20% by year-end; 670+ active customers, 200+ in order book
items.quote: The present order book from Adani is around 40% plus. Our Board mandate is to bring it down to 20% in the end of the year. Presently, we are engaging with around 670 active customers across various verticals.

items.quote: This quarter, we welcome Mr. Umesh Chhaya to our leadership team as an industry veteran and retail specialist with more than three decades in the cabling industry and a recognized authority on costing, pricing, and distribution that sells.

items.quote: Things like the Iran war suddenly resulted in increase in polymer prices. The metal prices went up. You need to suddenly have 20%, 30% more of incremental working capital.

items.quote: We did about INR1,600 crores last year. We can expect the same 18%-odd growth for this year also. So we should be looking at turnover in the region of around INR1,800 crores to INR1,900 crores.

items.statement: Machining mix expected to hover at 65-68% of sales for rest of FY27
items.quote: Yes. I think it should hover in the 65% to 68% range.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned at ~INR150 crores including INR30-50 crores replacement/debottlenecking
items.quote: Yes, approximately INR150-odd crores.

items.statement: 16,500 ton press to go into production by Q4 FY27; 4,000 ton press recently commissioned
items.quote: They're adding the 16,500 ton press, which will go into production by end of this fiscal, in Q4. And we also have a 4,000 ton press that has gone into production in the last couple of weeks.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 volume 20,200 tons; targeting 23,000-25,000 tons/quarter from Q2, aiming to cross 90,000 tons in FY27 and challenge 100,000-110,000 tons
items.quote: last year we did about 78,000 tons of sales. And this, now we are on we have done about 20,000 tons in Q1. So we should as discussed or as we have been guiding, would expect to cross the 90,000 ton mark in this year. And next year, challenge the 1 lakh

items.statement: All machining and forging cells running at full capability from July; 15-20% further debottlenecking potential identified
items.quote: I would say 10% to 20%, not just 7%. I would say it will go over between 15% to 20%. So there is a good growth potential further ahead, and we are pushing those numbers from July onwards.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target of 20%+ (2-3% improvement from current 18%) through productivity gains and cost reduction
items.quote: I would say all previous listing, our target would remain a 20-plus goal. We have to squeeze out 2%, 3% from the system. 1% is I can. I have clear visibility for 1% to 2%. But I would say 2% to 3% that should be our goal, and that's challenge for the team.

items.statement: Strong demand across domestic CV, tractor, passenger car and US Class 8 truck markets driving 16% revenue growth in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Basically, we've seen considerable improvement in the markets as far as Q1 is concerned, and we see the same optimism going through the rest of calendar and fiscal '27 and going into calendar '27 as well with strong momentum from both domestic as well as export markets, particularly the U.S.A.

items.statement: Hyperscaler demand filtering into domestic forging market; Abhinava Rizel customer in SOP ramp-up phase
items.quote: Naveen, yes, the hyperscaler business is filtering out into the domestic forging market, and there is a strong demand from such companies. You are right.

items.statement: Machining share rose to 67% of sales (vs 33% direct forged) due to 3 years of machining investments
items.quote: A lot of money has been invested by the company in the last 3 years in machining, and that has led to a higher machining mix as a percentage of sales.

items.quote: Sales per ton has gone up from 193,000 to 202,000 meaning, 2.02 lakhs versus INR1.93 lakhs in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Power and fuel cost spike in Q1 due to West Asian conflict (freight via Strait of Hormuz) and Tamil Nadu EV power cost policy
items.quote: There has been a huge increase in fuel cost in Q1 on account of the West Asian conflict. That has been, of course, over after Q1, it has reasonably stabilized. So gross debt will remain at the approximately the same levels.

items.statement: QIP enabling resolution active; will consider at appropriate time for sharp market opportunities

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA declined 14.5% YoY to INR8.1 crore due to planned growth investments
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was INR8.1 crores, 14.5% lower compared to INR9.5 crores in quarter 1 FY '26, primarily due to our planned growth investments.

items.statement: Uniware standalone adjusted EBITDA increased from INR9.1 crore to INR11 crore YoY despite continued investment
items.quote: Uniware continues to scale well. Its stand-alone adjusted EBITDA increased from INR9.1 crores in quarter 1 FY '26 to INR11 crores in quarter 1 FY27 despite continued investment in the platform.

items.statement: ESOP expense ~INR2.5 crore this quarter; expected to trend INR2.5-4 crore per quarter over next year
items.quote: In this quarter, we have seen near about INR2.5 crores of ESOP expense in this quarter. As per the amortization cycle of the ESOPs, we expect the ESOPs to get amortized over a period of 4 years from the date of grant. We granted these ESOPs sometime last year. So over the period of next year, the spend would be trending in the similar range of INR2.5 crores to INR4 crores per quarter.

items.statement: Investments of a few crores in sales & marketing, AI product development, talent; front-loaded in H1 FY27
items.quote: Investments are largely in the area of sales and marketing, AI-led product development as well as some select talent capabilities. The investment in terms of absolute is in the range of a few crores and will continue for the current quarter, post which we anticipate some of these investments to start demonstrating results and show improvement in our growth percentage as well.

items.statement: ARPA stable at ~INR1 lakh/month for Uniware enterprise customers
items.quote: Our ARPA continue has stayed broadly similar. We've always maintained that the average realization from Uniware enterprise customers is about INR1 lakh a month. It has continued to be in the similar ballpark.

items.statement: Shipway-Uniware customer overlap at 10%+; absolute overlap increasing as both bases grow
items.quote: The overlap of Shipway in the Unicommerce ecosystem continues to be 10% plus, while we have maintained this 10% plus number for the last couple of quarters. The number may seem stagnant, but actually, the absolute overlap of clients between Shipway and Unicommerce continues to increase because the client base is increasing at both Uniware and Shipway.

items.statement: Uniware remains market leader with premium positioning; competitive intensity stable
items.quote: We continue to be a market leader on the Uniware side. We continue to be a premium player. So we continue to hold that position even now.

items.statement: Shipway in INR4,000+ crore courier aggregation market with single-digit share; large headroom
items.quote: Shipway, as we've mentioned multiple times before that Shipway operates in courier aggregation, which is a large market opportunity. As per our estimates, it's INR4,000 crores plus market, where we are a relatively early-stage player, single-digit market share today with a significant headroom for growth.

items.statement: Courier aggregation has low switching costs; brands prefer multiple partners creating share-of-wallet opportunity
items.quote: in courier aggregation, the good part is that the benefit of the challenger is that courier aggregator is not very sticky. The switching costs are fairly low. Also, by design, a brand prefers to work with multiple courier aggregators or multiple logistics partners to diversify their risk. That's the nature of the market. Unicommerce e So there is always a fight of share of wallet in that space

items.statement: Mahindra Logistics onboarded Uniware OMS and WMS for e-commerce fulfilment
items.quote: The partnership of Mahindra Logistics is with Uniware business. They have onboarded the OMS and WMS. Typically, the logistics players offer e-commerce fulfilment, which is e-commerce warehousing.

items.statement: Cash and bank balances grew 72.1% YoY to INR92.6 crore
items.quote: Our cash and bank balances increased from INR53.8 crores at end of the quarter 1 FY '26 to INR92.6 crores at the end of quarter 1 FY '27 with the growth of 72.1% Y-o-Y.

items.statement: No fund raise needed; cash flows sufficient for M&A and investments
items.quote: We are adding cash to our balance sheet on a regular basis. Cash balances increased to INR92 crores, 70% growth over last year. We will use -- we'll potentially use this cash for M&A, but Unicommerce e we don't foresee the need of doing a fund raise because we are adding cash flows to our balance sheet on a regular basis

items.statement: Actively evaluating a few start-ups for inorganic opportunities; criteria: customer fit, product/team quality, valuation, profitability path
items.quote: We continue to evaluate inorganic opportunities. We continue to explore start-ups in respective areas, which could be adjacent to us. The 3 criteria that we look for inorganic are: one, it should make sense for existing customers. Two, it should be a good product, good team. Three, it should be available at the right valuation. And sorry, fourth, one more is that it should either be profitable or

items.statement: Selectively strengthened leadership across functions; added talent with AI capabilities
items.quote: Over the last few quarters, we have selectively strengthened leadership across functions and added talent with AI capabilities. These investments will support faster execution, stronger customer relationships and more scalable systems and processes.

items.statement: Revenue grew 14.3% YoY to INR51.4 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Revenue grew 14.3% year-on-year to INR51.4 crores, supported by continued double-digit growth across both Uniware and Shipway.

items.statement: PAT increased 20.2% YoY to INR4.7 crore due to tax benefits
items.quote: Profit after tax increased by 20.2% to INR4.7 crores compared with INR3.9 crores in the same quarter last year. The increase in PAT is due to tax benefits recognized during the quarter.

items.statement: E-commerce brand mortality high for long-tail brands; NRR protected as scaled brands grow
items.quote: See, normally, we've seen the mortality being high for long-tail brands who have not hit a certain scale. After a brand hits a certain scale on e-commerce, typically, they tend to survive and grow the business. So -- and that's why while in terms of number of logos, you may see a higher churn because of the mortality of those brands. But in terms of the GRR and NRR, it does not impact the metrics

items.statement: Product development cycle 18-24 months; pace accelerated with 3 modules launched in last 12-18 months
items.quote: Typically, every product development cycle has 18 to 24-month gestation period. And hence, we want to now see some of these investments play out. And as I mentioned, we are also front-loading some of the investments and a few of those investments are into AI-led product development. So you will see some of launches coming in that area as well.

items.statement: Mid-teens revenue growth with stable EBITDA margins guided for Belrise as a whole
items.quote: What we are guiding for is the business as a whole, which is for Belrise as a whole, which is mid -teens revenue growth with stable EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable compared to FY26 levels
items.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to FY26 levels.

items.statement: Chassis system order from fast-growing 2W/3W OEM with annual revenue >INR650M, SOP Q4 FY27 at Bangalore brownfield
items.quote: The program is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR650 million and will be added to our existing brownfield facility in Bangalore, with start of production expected in Q4 of this fiscal year.

items.statement: Suspension and braking systems order from Vietnamese 2W OEM entering India, project timelines confidential
items.quote: We have now secured an order from a fifth OEM, a leading Vietnamese two-wheeler manufacturer entering the Indian market. For this customer, we'll manufacture both suspension and braking systems for its upcoming models.

items.statement: Complete brake assemblies order from legacy 3W OEM in South India, SOP Q4 FY27, modest initial size but strategic entry
items.quote: We expect supplies under this program to commence in the Quarter 4 of this fiscal year. While the initial order size is modest, this is a strategically important win for us as it gives us an entry into one of the fastest growing three -wheeler OEMs in the south of India

items.statement: 59 unique assemblies for Indian 4W EV OEM localization program, expansion at Maharashtra facilities, plus tooling/fixtures/automation order
items.quote: We have been selected to manufacture 59 unique assemblies as part of their localization program for one of their highest-selling EV models. The localization program is progressing rapidly, and we expect to support this program through an expansion at our existing facilities in Maharashtra.

items.statement: 2W chassis order for existing model from largest 2W OEM for Sambhajinagar facility, ~INR500M annual revenue, ramp from Q4 FY27
items.quote: Supplies are expected to ramp up from Quarter 4 of this fiscal year, with the program representing an annual revenue potential of approximately INR500 million.

items.statement: Cumulative order book with fast-growing 2W/3W OEM at INR1,550M annual run rate (fuel tank, exhaust, chassis); suspension and braking wins additional, total ~INR2,000M run rate
items.quote: We have already won around INR1,550 million of orders in the fuel tank, exhaust system, and chassis system. The suspensions and braking wins are over and above these wins. So one can say that we are already at a INR2,000 million or a n INR2 billion run rate with this particular OEM

items.statement: INR17,000M QIP proceeds to be deployed significantly within FY27, primarily for inorganic opportunities and select organic growth
items.quote: With respect to our fund raise of INR17,000 million, we intend to deploy a significant majority of these net proceeds within this fiscal year, primarily towards high -quality inorganic opportunities and also towards select organic growth initiatives.

items.statement: 4W/CV M&A focus in India: targets with differentiated capabilities, strong customer relationships, product technologies to add new categories and increase content per vehicle
items.quote: In the four-wheeler and commercial vehicle segments, our acquisition strategy will primarily be focused on India. While we already work with almost all major four -wheeler and commercial vehicle OEMs in the country, we are looking for businesses that bring differentiated capabilities, strong customer relationships, and product technologies that would otherwise take us considerable time to develop

items.statement: H-One technology collaboration concluded, enabling high tensile steel applications up to 1,470 MPa (~3x India industry standard) for PV and CV segments
items.quote: We have also now successfully concluded our technology collaboration with H-One Japan during this quarter, thus strengthening our capabilities for high tensile steel applications up to 1470 megapascal, which is approximately 3x the industry standard today in India.

items.statement: 2W/3W business benefits from industry volume recovery and new platform launches at marquee customers; growing engagement with two marquee OEMs building robust order book
items.quote: Our two and three-wheeler business, which remains the largest contributor to revenue, continued to benefit from the industry-wide volume recovery and from new platform launches at our marquee customers. Our growing engagement with two m arquee OEMs where we previously had limited presence continues to build a robust order book for us.

items.statement: 4W and CV segments fastest growing in FY26, momentum continued in Q1 FY27 with 18% YoY revenue growth driven by new business wins across expanding customer base
items.quote: The four-wheeler and commercial vehicle business were the fastest growing segments of our portfolio in FY26 and this momentum has continued into Q1 FY27, with revenues growing 18% year-on-year driven by new business wins across an expanding customer base.

items.statement: Input costs (steel, polymer) elevated in Q1; back-to-back pricing model passes fluctuations to customers with slight lag; no material margin impact expected in FY27
items.quote: Input costs, particularly steel and polymer, remained elevated through Q1 FY27. As we have shared before, our back-to-back pricing model means these fluctuations are largely passed to our customers with a slight lag, and we do not expect this to have a material impact on our margin profile in this fiscal year.

items.statement: Worst of cost pressures behind; commodity, staff, energy/transport costs largely peaked; margins expected to improve in coming quarters to maintain FY26 EBITDA margin level
items.quote: We believe that we are largely through the cost pressure or cost pain that we felt in the first quarter, and we can expect our margins to go up in the coming quarters so that we are able to maintain our EBITDA margin as compared to FY26.

items.statement: Back-to-back pricing model passes input cost fluctuations to customers with slight lag; commodity cost cycle largely played out in Q1
items.quote: We do believe that the commodity costs pressure that was there in quarter one, we will get the pass -through of that in the coming quarters, which means that the commodity cost cycle f or us has largely played out.

items.statement: Content per vehicle rising fast with fast-growing 2W/3W OEM: fuel tanks, exhaust, chassis, suspension, braking systems; basket of products exceeded only by largest OEM
items.quote: So we are doing fuel tanks for them, we are doing exhaust systems, we are doing chassis systems, we are doing suspension systems, as well as braking systems. So in general, it's the basket of products that we have been able to penetrate with this particular OEM, which apart from say our largest OEM, we do not enjoy this type of content for vehicle across any other OEM.

items.statement: Hyva acquisition adds leading European CV OEM not previously served; opportunity to leverage broader portfolio and increase wallet share
items.quote: The business supplies to a leading European commercial vehicle OEM with whom Belrise has not worked historically. This gives us an opportunity and an immediate entry point into this customer and importantly, an opportunity to leverage our broader product portfolio and progressively increase our wallet share with this OEM as well.

items.statement: Target aerospace and defense to reach 10% of manufacturing revenue in short to medium term
items.quote: Sumedh, already mentioned in the last earnings call that we want aerospace and defense to get to 10% of our manufacturing revenue in a short to medium term.

items.statement: Trading business declined 19% YoY due to Middle East crisis impacting logistics and demand in African, Asian, Middle Eastern regions; worst behind, expect normalization
items.quote: Due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East, there was a lot of pressure in terms of business scenario in the Middle East over this quarter. And since most of our trading business comes from outside India, and largely from the African, Asian and Middle Eastern regions, it was fairly muted due to everything that was ongoing in terms of logistics as well as demand over there from April to June.

items.statement: Plasan Sasa partnership for armored vehicle assembly in India; Hyva heavy fabrication capabilities seen as synergistic for defense/armored vehicles opportunity
items.quote: Belrise already has a strategic partnership with Plasan Sasa, the Israeli company under which we intend to assemble armored vehicles for the Indian defense market. We believe the heavy fabrication know -how, manufacturing processes, and capabilities that come with the Hyva business will be highly synergistic with this initiative.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue declined 11% YoY to Rs 168.5 cr due to delayed and uneven monsoon impacting Kharif sowing and crop protection demand
items.quote: On a consolidation basis, our revenue from operations stood at Rs. 168.5 crores in Ql] FY27 compared with Rs. 189.4 crores in Q1 FY26, representing an 11% year-over-year decline

items.statement: Gross margin improved to 28% from 22% YoY; EBITDA margin improved to 5.7% from 5.2% YoY
items.quote: Our gross margins improved meaningfully to 28% from 22% in QI FY26, while EBITDA margins improved to 5.7% from 5.2

items.statement: Capacity utilization increased to 70% in Q1 FY27 from 52% in FY26
items.quote: From an operational perspective, capacity utilization increased to 70% during the quarter compared with 52% in FY26.

items.statement: Capital work-in-progress stood at Rs 76.4 cr in FY26 vs Rs 57.1 cr in FY25 reflecting ongoing investments at Barwasni and DF facility
items.quote: Our capital work-in-progress stood at Rs. 76.4 crores in FY26 and compared with Rs. 57.1 crores in FY25, reflecting these ongoing investments.

items.statement: Management declined to commit to FY27 revenue growth figure; aims to perform to best capabilities
items.quote: We are looking forward and we are working aggressively for achieving good growth. And this quarter is an important quarter for us. We are looking forward to growth, but we don't want to commit for any figures.

items.statement: Current capacity supports peak revenue of Rs 1,100-1,200 cr; expanded capacity can support Rs 1,800 cr+ over 4-5 years
items.quote: With the existing capacity? Yes, sir. Yes, it should be around Rs. 1100 crores - Rs. 1200 crores, up to that

items.statement: Crop protection 87% of Q1 FY27 revenue; biologicals and plant nutrients 3% each; B2C 47%, B2B 40%, exports 13%
items.quote: Crop protection contributed 87% of Ql FY27 revenue, while biologicals and plant nutrients contributed 3% each, with the balance coming from other

items.statement: 189 global registrations (120+ valid, 10+ under renewal); progress in Taiwan, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Venezuela, Brazil, Africa
items.quote: Overall, we have 189 registrations globally, of which more than 120 are valid and more than 10 are under renewal.

items.statement: Raw material prices corrected in Q2 after Q1 spike; packaging material ~40% higher YoY; logistics and some intermediates still elevated
items.quote: In Q2, because of you can say a little lower demands and more availability, the prices of raw materials were corrected and they came down and I think now the things are almost stable but still a little incremental as compared to last year, especially the packaging material, which is almost 40% higher, the plastics and all these things that has an impact.

items.statement: Finance cost rose 19% YoY due to inventory buildup anticipating sales; expect reduction as inventory liquidates and collections improve
items.quote: We have bought the material anticipating that there will be a good sales, but you know as Sanjay Ji has explained the things that due to poor rainfall and shifting of crops also impacted the sales. But we are expecting near time we will liquidate this inventory, and the collections will be better and so we are hoping that we will be able to reduce the finance cost.

items.statement: Exploring M&A for new technology and market expansion globally; nothing concrete yet; focus on domestic brand expansion first
items.quote: We are in touch with some of the good consultants also for merger acquisitions across the globe, specifically for two areas, one is for some kind of newer technology which can add value and second is for any kind of market expansion where we can get some value addition. So, we are in discussion, but presently nothing concrete has happened so far.

items.statement: Industry attempted price hikes but weak demand and elevated Chinese supply limited sustainability; pricing could not offset volume impact
items.quote: However, the weak demand environment limited the industry's availability to sustain these increases. Prices of several molecules remained under pressure as global supply remained elevated, particularly with continued availability of intermediates and technical products from China.

items.statement: Channel inventory cautious due to El Nino; dealers conservative, low liquidity after fertilizer stocking; pressure on inventory and prices
items.quote: See, actually this year, the decision making across the complete value chain, including the farmers, dealers, and distributors are quite conservative because everyone wants to take the decisions at the time of real users. So, the impact would be seen now since it is the peak time and the turnovers are better and increased compared to last quarter. So, the pressure on inventory is there because of

items.statement: Biological and plant nutrition share of branded sales doubled to 22% in Q1 FY27 from 11% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Secondly, I would like to add even we are growing in this segment. If we will compare with the last quarter, we have our biological and plant nutrition sale to the brand sale was 11% which has gone to 22%.

items.statement: Expect better Kharif quarter closing; sustainability and growth in both Kharif and Rabi but very high expectations not possible this year
items.quote: But we are hoping for a better Kharif quarter closing. We are working towards that direction. And overall, we can see that very high expectations cannot be possible this year. But definitely, the sustainability and growth should be there in both Rabi and Kharif it should be there.

items.statement: El Nino declared; not expecting promising monsoons ahead; heat/drought resistant products under 3-year ICAR-IARI project
items.quote: We are not expecting very promising monsoons even in the coming days because this El Nino has already been declared. But yes, wherever there are opportunities, there are rains or there are no water issues, our team is working and we are able to grow the business.

items.statement: Two of three specialty products for FY27 already launched; new fungicide on track for Q2 launch subject to patent expiry
items.quote: Two of the three speciality products planned for FY27 are already in the market, while our new fungicide remains on track for launch this quarter, subject to the relevant patent expiry.

items.statement: Key levers for ROCE/ROE improvement: product mix shift to biologicals/nutrition, manufacturing yield, energy efficiency, procurement optimization, asset utilization, working capital efficiency
items.quote: The key lever of improving ROCE is by improving the product mix. Because as sir has told that we are changing the product mix and all the things. And due to that our margins will be definitely increasing. We are trying high margin projects such as a biologicals, plant nutrition and all that. items.quote: So, the impact of this China reducing the incentives on exports has an impact on basically technical requirements across the globe. items.quote: Australia Company 1s basically a registration holding Company and that is giving support for OECD registrations wherever OECD registrations are required.
