And we have still more opportunities in LATAM and African markets and Middle East. So, Australia will not be in

items.statement: Management expects LFL growth to be 5-7% above passenger traffic in normal years, targeting 14-15% LFL when traffic grows 8-9%.
items.quote: We've traditionally been where, we're used to passenger traffic somewhere around 8% to 9% in normal years, and drive maybe 5% to 7% more of LFL growth over that to kind of reach an LFL percentage maybe around 14% -15%.

items.statement: Overall passenger traffic was flat YoY in Q1 FY27 due to a significant decline in international traffic, while domestic traffic registered modest growth.
items.quote: Domestic traffic re gistered modest growth, but a significant decline in international traffic resulted in overall passenger traffic being broadly flat year-on-year for the quarter

items.statement: Adjusted gross profit margin was around 81% in Q1 FY27, within guided range, after reclassifying INR223 million of lounge aggregation costs.
items.quote: Adjusting for this reclassification of INR223 million of lounge aggregation cost from other expenses to cost of sales, the adjusted gross profit stands at INR3.65 billion, translating into an adjusted gross profit margin of around 81%, which remains well within our guided range.

items.statement: EBITDA margin moderated to 35.8% in Q1 FY27 due to higher employee and operating costs from new airport commissions and ramp-up.
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR1 .6 billion, up 11% year -on-year, and EBITDA margin moderated to 35.8% for the quarter, reflecting the impact of higher employee cost and operating cost associated with recently commissioned airports and new business initiatives.

items.statement: 50 outlets are under development across the network, expected to open in FY27 and ramp over 12-24 months.
items.quote: We also have a strong pipeline of growth opportunities, with over 50 outlets currently under development across our network. As these locations open and then mature over the coming 12 to 18 months, they are expected to provide a meaningful uplift to both revenue and earnings.

items.statement: Net contract gains were 15.9% YoY at system-wide level and 20.2% at consolidated level in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: We sustained strong momentum in new outlet openings, backed by recent contract wins and a robust pipeline, which translated into net contract gains of 15.9% year -on-year at the system -wide level.

items.statement: Added 87 travel QSR outlets and two lounges over the last 12 months across Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Cochin, Navi Mumbai, and Noida airports.
items.quote: Over the last 12 months, we have added 87 travel QSR outlets and two lounges across the network, with significant additions at Mumba i, Delhi, Hyderabad, Cochin, Navi Mumbai, and Noida airports.

items.statement: System-wide footprint stands at 580 travel QSR outlets and lounges across 21 airports with 153 brands as of June 2026.
items.quote: Our system-wide footprint as of June end stands at 580 travel QSR outlets and lounges, while our brand portfolio has expanded to 153 brands.

items.statement: Commenced operations at Noida International Airport and launched passenger services under Elite Assist brand including meet-and-greet and porter services.
items.quote: During the quarter, we commenced operations at Noida International Airport, taking our system-wide presence to 21 airports.

items.statement: Bhogapuram Airport opening on 17th August 2026 with multiple outlets under JV GHL; pipeline includes Bangalore T1, Pune, and other AAI airports.
items.quote: The opening of Bhogapuram Airport on 17th August marks another significant milestone where we will operate multiple outlets under our JV, GHL.

items.statement: No significant price escalation in Q1 FY27; LFL growth driven by premiumization, bundling, and limited brand edits rather than pricing.
items.quote: we've not done a significant price escalation as well this year , with the challenge around it, we've been a bit tempered in that.

items.statement: Debt-free balance sheet with consolidated cash balance of approximately INR9.7 billion as of June 30, 2026.
items.quote: As of June 30th, we maintain a debt-free balance sheet and a consolidated cash balance of approximately INR9.7 billion.

items.statement: Company maintains a debt-free balance sheet providing headroom for airport expansions, lounges, highways, and passenger services.
items.quote: Our balance sheet remains a signi ficant source of strength. As of June 30th, we maintain a debt-free balance sheet and a consolidated cash balance of approximately INR9.7 billion.

items.statement: Delhi T3 contract expires 30th September 2026; GHL JV has bid for renewal but results not yet out. Chennai and Kolkata airports up for renewal end of March 2027 and early Q1 FY28.
items.quote: Delhi T3 which is a material subsidiary, the contract is till 30th September 2026. The JV GHL has bid for the contract, but the results are not out at this moment.

items.statement: System-wide sales grew 18% YoY to INR8.4 billion; consolidated revenue from operations grew 20.6% YoY to INR4.5 billion in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: System-wide sales for the quarter reached INR8 .4 billion, representing a growth of 18% year-on-year.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT increased 35.6% YoY to INR1.3 billion; PAT margin expanded to 28.5% from 25.3% in Q1 FY26.
items.quote: Consolidated profit after tax increased by 35.6% year -on-year to INR1 .3 billion, and PAT margin expanded to 28.5% compared with 25.3% in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.statement: Consolidated LFL sales growth was 4.2% in Q1 FY27; excluding Mumbai, Guwahati, and South India markets, LFL grew around 7% YoY.
items.quote: As a result, system-wide LFL sales growth was 0.8% for the quarter. Importantly, excluding these specific markets, like-for-like sales grew around 7% year-on-year across our wider network.

items.statement: Employee cost increased due to annual compensation revisions, onboarding for new outlets at Noida and Cochin, and staffing for passenger services at Noida.
items.quote: employee cost increased during the quarter, primarily due to annual compensation revisions and the onboarding of additional manpower to support recently opened outlets at Noida and Cochin airports, both of which are currently in the ramp-up phase.

items.statement: New labour code impact minimal at INR8-10 crores; majority of 5,000+ employees on company roll.
items.quote: The impact of the new labour code is very minimal for us, which we had clarified earlier, and it was below like INR8 crores to INR10 crores kind of a number.

items.statement: International traffic decline impacted South India markets with higher Middle East exposure; domestic traffic hit record high in May 2026.
items.quote: certain South India markets given their relatively higher exposure to Middle East traffic.

items.statement: Majority of airports operate on direct concession model; JVs typical only for multi-airport operators. TFS wins contracts through execution discipline and brand portfolio.
items.quote: globally, more often than not , by a wide margin, they are direct concessions is the norm. JVs tend to be in these type of examples where you have, say an operator maybe running 5, 6, 7 airports.

items.statement: Middle East conflict caused international traffic disruptions in April and June 2026; recovery expected from September-October with airline route restorations.
items.quote: I think they've already come out and called that you start seeing from September & October, restoration of many of those long-haul international routes. And that's automatically where we expect to see that flow through.

items.statement: Contract renewal rate dipped from 94% to 92% due to non-renewal of smaller highway pilot outlets not aligned with WSA strategy.
items.quote: it was some highway outlets, which part of our strategy, which were some we entered earlier , which we didn't see a intention to renew.

items.statement: Launched passenger services at Noida Airport under Elite Assist brand (meet-and-greet, porter) integrated with EATS technology platform.
items.quote: Another important milestone during the quarter was the successful launch of our passenger services at Noida International Airport under our Elite Assist brand, including meet -and-greet and porter services.

items.statement: International expansion focus on Asia (Malaysia, Hong Kong, Indonesia) with entities in Dubai and Indonesia; Middle East on hold until normalization.
items.quote: We have set up an entity in Dubai to focus at the region. We set up another entity recently in Indonesia to look at opportunities there because you need those local entities to be able to bid for opportunities in the markets.

items.statement: ~5,000+ employees, majority on company roll; labour cost semi-variable with flexibility to move staff between international and domestic terminals.
items.quote: we roughly have around 5,000 plus employees and majority are on company roll.

items.statement: Highway wayside amenities (WSA) opportunity emerging with ~1,000 sites announced by government; TFS engaging with partners, brands, landlords, OMCs for medium-long term calibrated entry.
items.quote: there's about a thousand wayside amenity plan already announce d by the government. But that is to come. So what I've been announcing is that we will be targeting those as those come online.

items.statement: Targeted turnover for FY27 is INR 850 crore and for FY28 is INR 1,200 crore
items.quote: Sir, targeted turnover for the FY26-27 is almost INR 850 crores and for FY27-28 is INR 1,200 crores.

items.statement: Consolidated order book stood at approximately INR 778 crore as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Our consolidated order book stood at approximately INR 778 crore s as of June 30, 2026, providing a healthy visibility of future execution

items.statement: New toll projects worth INR 120 crore secured in Tamil Nadu, taking total work order to INR 900 crore (EPC ~INR 500 crore, toll ~INR 400 crore)
items.quote: Recently we secured INR 120 crores new toll projects in Tamil Nadu. And so , adding this, we have INR 900 crores of work order, out of which EPC is almost INR 500 crores and the rest for toll segment.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target of INR 850 crore with INR 700 crore from toll and INR 150 crore from EPC
items.quote: For FY 27, we are targeted INR 850 crore s turnover, out of which INR 700 crore s we are targeting for toll and rest for remaining for EPC business

items.statement: EPC order book of INR 500 crore executable over three years: INR 150 crore in FY27 and INR 200 crore in FY28
items.quote: Sir, we are having 24 projects in executable. So, in the current year, we will realize approximately INR 150 crore s in FY27 and in FY28 we will do INR 200 crore s. So, it is executable in three years

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin impacted by temporary geopolitical factors at Moti Naroli toll plaza; recovery expected as traffic trends normalize
items.quote: During the quarter, profitability was impacted by a combination of temporary factors, including lower traffic volumes at the Moti Naroli toll project due to geopolitical developments and global trade disruptions.

items.statement: Geopolitical impact absorbed in Q1; no spillover expected into Q2 if no new developments
items.quote: And this was localized to Q1, because I think the trends have become near to normal. The traffic has started to grow back. The businesses have resumed to their normal working.

items.statement: Traffic recovery underway; most regions back to normal, Western port-linked corridors still recovering but improving
items.quote: I think it is important to mention that the traffic in some regions has resumed to normal, the regions which were not very close to the ports on the Western Front. But on the Western Front, I still feel that substantially it will take some time to resume to what the earlier trend was.

items.statement: Secured two new NHAI toll contracts in Tamil Nadu on NH-44: Kozhinjipatti (INR 28.7 crore) and Krishnagiri-Thumbipadi (INR 80 crore)
items.quote: We secured a new tollway collection contract valued at approximately INR 28.7 crore s for the Kozhinjipatti toll plaza on the Dindigul - Samayanallur stretch of the NH-44 in Tamil Nadu. We also received the letter of acceptance for toll operations at the fee plaza located at kilometer 154.5 on the Krishnagiri-Thumbipadi section of NH-44 with a contract value of approximately INR 80 crores

items.statement: Expanding geographic footprint into South India (Tamil Nadu) and targeting East (West Bengal, Assam) and Andhra Pradesh/Telangana
items.quote: This is the first time we are entering into Tamil Nadu, which was a very big achievement for us. And going forward, we see a lot of scope in the eastern part of India also, which we have started to capitalize now Tamil Nadu, we are very focused, keen on Andhra Pradesh, Telangana. Going forward, West Bengal has also shown a lot of attractive propositions and we are active , the team is actively res

items.statement: Strategy to balance government and private EPC work; actively increasing private works to reduce concentration risk
items.quote: In terms of private works, we are actively trying to increase our private works to create a good balance between government and private. With government, this kind of portfolio will always help us going forward because it reduces the risk in any one front.

items.statement: Technology integration focus: leveraging AI, data analytics, BIM to improve project management efficiency, reduce manpower, and enhance margins across pan-India operations
items.quote: So, going forward in the future, let's say 5-10 years down the line, you will see that we will come out as a more technology -driven infrastructure company because that is very important. The machines are going to be the same, the way that we construct is going to be the same. But how do we manage all of this is very crucial.

items.statement: Temporary NHAI bidding restriction and voluntary surrender of unviable toll project due to geopolitical impact; does not alter long-term fundamentals
items.quote: A temporary bidding restriction from NHAI and the voluntary surrender of a toll project where economics had been unfavorable due to the same reason. These factors led to a short-term impact on profitability but do not alter the long -term fundamentals of the business.

items.statement: Renewable energy EPC (production and transmission) identified as future focus; active research underway but no bids yet; will take time to build capability
items.quote: So, like I mentioned in my previous calls, definitely renewable energy production and transmission is something that will be in focus in the coming years. The team and all of us are actively looking on how do we capitalize it, but it is very important to u nderstand that it will take some time

items.statement: Building internal technology team to develop proprietary systems for site management, resource optimization, and predictive analytics
items.quote: And simultaneously, we are also developing a good team internally to focus on that front and how do we leverage this technology to increase our efficiency on our core business as well, which is how do I reduce the manpower at the site. How do I increase efficiency in terms of how multiple sites are managed from one core location from the HO.

items.statement: Commissioned doubled crushing capacity from 825 to 1650 MTPD on 26 May 2026 alongside new liquid glucose (180 TPD), maltodextrin (50 TPD) and cogeneration expansion from 7.1 to 15.8 MW
items.quote: The centerpiece of this phase was the commissioning on 26 May 2026 of a doubling of a crushing capacity from 825 metric ton per day to 1650 metric ton per day alongside a new liquid glucose facility of 180 tons per day, a Maltodextrin powder facility of 50 metric tons per day, an expansion of a captive cogeneration power plant from 7.1 megawatt to 15.8 megawatt.

items.statement: Expect FY27 maize crushing above 400,000 tons versus 265,000 tons in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting that the crushing will go up above 4,00,000 tons in the entire year.

items.statement: Target value-added products at 20-22% of turnover in FY27 versus 3% in FY26
items.quote: Last year, we had about 3% of our entire turnover as value -added products. This year, we are expecting it to go up to 20 %-22% of our entire turnover as value -added products.

items.statement: Value-added margin expanded to 39.8% in Q1 FY27 from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 driven by shift to manufacturing-led revenue
items.quote: Value-added grew 30.3% year -on-year to Rs. 80.53 crores, with value -added margin expanded to 39.8% from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 , driven by a decisive shift towards higher margin, manufacturing led revenue.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 540 bps to 15.3% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The operating EBITDA rose 26.6% year -on-year to Rs . 30.98 crores, with EBITDA margin expanding 540 basis points to 15.3%.

items.statement: Of Rs 664 crore total project outlay, Rs 552 crore incurred by 30 June 2026; major capex cycle substantially complete
items.quote: Of the total project outlay of approximately Rs. 664 crores, around Rs. 552 crores had been incurred as of 30 June 2026, with the major phase of CAPEX cycle now substantially behind us.

items.statement: Building additional 50,000 tons storage across two silos, 50,000 sq ft maize godown and 1.6 MW methane gas-based power plant in FY27
items.quote: In parallel, we are building out the supporting infrastructure for this growth, with an additional 50,000 tons of storage across two new silos, a 50,000-square-feet Maize godown and a 1.6-megawatt Methane gas-based power plant.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capacity utilization 71.4% due to planned shutdowns for integration; expect progressive improvement from Q2 FY27
items.quote: The capacity utilization of 71.4% for the quarter should be viewed in the context of commissioning and integration of the doubled capacity. Integrating the expanded plant, required planned shutdown days during the quarter which temporarily lowered utili zation.

items.statement: Cash conversion cycle 130 days in Q1 FY27 driven by higher inventory for expanded capacity; expect normalization as utilization ramps
items.quote: The cash conversion cycle stood at 130 days, driven largely by higher inventory levels built to support the expanded 1650 metric ton per day capacity.

items.statement: Net debt Rs 735.32 crore at 30 June 2026; peak debt in H1 FY27, expected to decline in H2 as working capital normalizes
items.quote: On the balance sheet, the net debt stood at Rs . 735.32 crore s, reflecting the funding of our expansion program as well as seasonal procurement of raw material.

items.statement: All new capex debt qualifies for interest subvention under Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy; subvention cap amended from Rs 20 crore to Rs 40 crore in FY25 but not yet cleared for this project
items.quote: Importantly, all debt raised towards the new CAPEX qualifies for interest subvention under Bihar ’s Industrial Investment Promotion Policy, meaningfully containing our effective cost of borrowing and supporting the economics of the expansion.

items.statement: Export contribution more than doubled to 10.4% in Q1 FY27 from 4.9% in Q1 FY26; targeting further geographic diversification
items.quote: Contribution from exports more than doubled to 10.4% in quarter 1 ‘27 from 4.9% in quarter 1 ‘26, reflecting growing acceptance of our products across international markets.

items.statement: Plan to launch Dextrose Anhydrous, Dextrose Monohydrate, Hydrol and specialized modified starches (cationic, carboxy methyl, pre-gel, spray starch) in FY27
items.quote: During FY’27, we plan to enter high value derivatives including Dextrose Anhydrous, Dextrose Monohydrate and Hydrol , while expanding beyond our existing Dextrin and edible starch range into specialized modified starches such as cationic starch, carboxy methyl starch, pre-gel starch and spray starch.

items.statement: Procure ~80% maize inventory during Rabi season (Apr-Jul) at FOR doorstep prices; currently getting maize at Rs 22.5-23/kg delivered versus market Rs 24/kg
items.quote: I’m still getting maize at my doorstep delivered at 22.5 or 23 at the most, a very, very good quality of maize, sweet quality at 23, first of all.

items.statement: Maize crushing volume 69,689 MT in Q1 FY27 versus 64,770 MT in Q1 FY26; Q2 FY27 expected 100,000-110,000 MT
items.quote: Operationally, maize crushing rose to 69,689 metric tons from 64,770 metric tons in Q1 FY’26.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 value-added revenue grew 30.3% YoY to Rs 80.53 crore; trading share fell to 3.3% from 19.5%
items.quote: value-added growing 30.3% year-on- year to Rs. 80.53 crores and value-added margin expanding by 1,477 basis points to 39.8

items.statement: White-label business expanding with existing and new MNC customers; 70-80% of new value-added products sold through existing dealer/institutional channels
items.quote: Yes, sir. It is completely on. White labelling base has increased. Few more customers have come in. Again, the India White brand has come in and the customers which we were doing earlier, they have increased their products.

items.statement: No new capex planned for FY27; focus on stabilizing current expansion, reaching 90-95% utilization, deleveraging before evaluating next phase
items.quote: Sir, at the moment, we want to stabilize because this is a very, very big expansion, which we have done. So, we want to consolidate and stabilize this, come to our experience of 90 %-95% capacity utilization.

items.statement: Liquid glucose at ~70% capacity utilization; maltodextrin powder needs 2-3 more months to reach target; modified starch trials online by September
items.quote: Talking about the value -added products, liquid glucose, one product which we are doing pretty, we have started now doing it about 70% odd we have reached of the entire capacity. And this again, on the increase only, maltodextrin powder, it is yet to because maltodextrin powder, all the samples and everything has to go to a lot of places and the MNCs and all.

items.statement: Employee count 719; sales/marketing team breakup not disclosed on call but available through IR team
items.quote: Since your employee count is 719, can you help me with the break -up of the marketing or sales team? Anil Kishorepuria: Sir, that’s a really detailed thing which you are asking. We don’t have this at the moment ready with us, but it will be available with you with the IR team

items.statement: Management targets crossing INR500 crores consolidated revenue in FY27 and INR630-640 crores in FY28.
items.quote: We continue to work towards our stated objective of crossing INR500 crores in consolidated revenue during the FY 27, while maintaining appropriate discipline on margins and working capital.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to increase by 1-2% over the next 2 years.
items.quote: I would expect at least an increase of about 1% to 2% in the EBITDA area over the next 2 years or so.

items.statement: Received orders worth INR45.71 crores from Reliance Group, INR1.94 crores from Nesco, and INR36.71 lakhs from West Bengal Public Department in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: We received 5 work orders from Reliance Projects and Property Management Services worth INR30.77 crores for housekeeping, MEP electrical, and ancillary services. In addition, we secured facility management contracts across 7 Reliance Group entities valued at INR14.94 crores, taking the combined value of orders from the Reliance Group to INR45.71 crores.

items.statement: CCTV project pipeline includes Mumbai traffic tenders worth INR15-18 crores, HDFC Bank command center worth INR1.5-2 crores, NKDA AMC worth INR6 crores, and SAIL Burnpur worth INR4-5 crores.
items.quote: We are also expecting 2 big projects of around INR15 to INR18 crores from the Mumbai police and traffic. So these are also around 25% to 30%. Then one of the banks, larger banks where we work with, HDFC Bank, has kind of asked us to set up a command and control center which is more CCTV driven.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 121 bps to 7.99%; net profit margin improved 81 bps to 5.54%.
items.quote: increased by 36.24% year -on-year to INR9.22 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded by 121 basis points to 7.99%. Net profit stood at INR6.40 crores, growing 35% year -on-year with the net profit margin improving by 81 basis points to 5.54

items.statement: Healthy order inflows across private and government clients; opportunities in government tenders, private sector cross-selling, and industry formalization.
items.quote: We continue to see opportu nities across both the government and private sectors. In the government segment, our established credentials provide opportunities to participate in large tenders and expand geographically, while in the private sector, we see scope to deepen client relationships through a broader combination of security, housekeeping, facility management, and technical services

items.statement: Shifting contract mix toward technology (CCTV, access control, command centers) and mechanization (facade cleaning, AI-driven machines) to improve margins.
items.quote: we are already pretty well occupied with manpower deployment whether it is in the security guarding sector or in the housekeeping cleaning sector a nd such other labor intensive facility management sector. So that is one. Now what we have started doing is firstly, we have started adding more components to these 2 primary manpower elements

items.statement: Top clients: Reliance INR46-47 crores, HDFC Bank INR18 crores, Anjali Jewellers INR12 crores, Airports INR30 crores combined; client retention ~96-97%.
items.quote: Reliance is o ur top client. So that is we will be we are doing around INR46 crores to INR47 crores from Reliance itself. Like Reliance is our top client. And then we have HDFC bank which is at around INR18 crores and then Anjali Jewellers around INR12 crores. We have the airports which have a combined revenue of around INR30 crores annually speaking

items.statement: West Bengal contributes 72-73% of revenue; share not expected to decline significantly as West Bengal growth continues alongside diversification into Bihar and Odisha.
items.quote: Currently it's around 72% to 73% because see, right now what has in Gujarat and Maharashtra I think I had mentioned in either in some conference earlier or in some earnings call only, our Head of Marketing is based out of Bombay, right.

items.statement: Professional succession planning underway; management team ages 30-55; family members involved but not sole succession path.
items.quote: This company is looking towards a pretty professional succession instead of just a founder level, family level succession. But many in the family are involved and we are sir looking at a succession over the next few years and up to the decade with a pipeline where gradually at least four or five of the members will be able to take up the current senior positions.

items.statement: CCTV revenue target INR30 crores in FY27 vs INR13-14 crores in FY26; PAT target INR3.5-4 crores vs INR2.5 crores last year.
items.quote: By the end of this year ma'am we are expecting like I said around a INR30 crores revenue and with that we should be able to increase our PAT which was last year around INR2.5 crores to around INR3.5 crores to INR4 crores.

items.statement: Margin expansion dependent on project business growth; commoditized manpower business limits overall margin improvement.
items.quote: Fundamentally our margin growth that happens, happens from project businesses which is the CCTV project or the DDU-GKY projects et cetera. Whose revenue growth is not as at par with the kind of growth that we typically see in the security facility management sector because that is more commoditized and more manpower driven.

items.statement: No seasonality in business; regular maintenance and surveillance demand irrespective of seasons.
items.quote: Very little, very little. Ours is a regular maintenance and surveillance requirement. You see our work has in fact I think our experience in the COVID also, it showed that if a particular facility continues to function, if it doesn't stop down, then it continues to require both the security, facility management and the surveillance verticals almost irrespective of the terms the seasons or even the

items.statement: Africa revenue share rose to ~32% in Q1 FY27 from ~4.47% in Q1 FY26, driven by capital allocation and Middle East challenges
items.quote: Africa accounted for approximately 32% of our revenue in Q1 FY27 compared with around 4.47% in Q1 FY26, a significant shift in the geographical mix of our busin ess that reflects the relationships we have built and the stronger presence we have established in the region

items.statement: Long-term revenue target of INR600-700 crores over next 2-3 years remains in place
items.quote: I believe that INR600 crores to INR700 crores figure long-term revenue targets are still in place.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT fell to INR2.2 crores from INR6.51 crores YoY due to higher freight, logistics and employee costs
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, PBT stood at INR3.04 crores compared with INR7.26 crores, and PAT stood at INR2.2 crores compared with INR6.51 crores.

items.statement: Shipping and logistics costs rose sharply on standalone and consolidated basis due to geopolitical factors
items.quote: Shipping and logistics cost increased to INR3.86 crores from INR2.36 crores on a standalone basis, while consolidated shipping and transportation expenses increased to INR4.72 crores from INR2.76 crores last year.

items.statement: Consolidated employee benefit expenses increased to INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores YoY as company builds international teams
items.quote: Consolidated employee benefit expenses increased to approximately INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Consolidated inventory at INR96.8 crores with INR84.4 crores overseas; business cycle runs ~2 quarters for conversion
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our consolidated inventory stood at about INR96.8 crores, with around INR84.4 crores positioned at our overseas subsidiaries.

items.statement: Investments in inventory, manpower and marketing are transient and growing quarter-on-quarter, not fixed capex
items.quote: All the investments made are transient in nature. None of them are fixed investments or any plant machinery capex purchases, etcetera, which has a certain timeline of 3-year break even or whatever.

items.statement: HexL proprietary brand gaining momentum; long-term target is equal revenue split across new customized, used/refurbished and HexL segments
items.quote: In 2 years to 3 years, I think HexL should have larger share of the pie. And our used equipment business should also have the larger share of the pie. And I think if all the three verticals are equal in our revenue mix, I think we would be happy enough.

items.statement: Commodity inflation not fully passed through; partially absorbed and partially built into purchase/sales prices
items.quote: It is not expected to be fully passed through because the fluctuations in commodity prices are very, very wildly swinging right now. What we have tried to do is try to maintain a certain level of pricing and absorb certain costs in the interest of gaining long-term business.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments creating operational/logistical challenges, higher freight costs and longer shipping times
items.quote: The ongoing geopolitical developments across various regions have continued to create operational and logistical challenges, particularly for the businesses with significant international exposure, such as ours. These developments have contributed to an in crease in freight and shipping costs during the quarter

items.statement: International collections more sophisticated with documented timelines; challenges only during genuine geopolitical disruptions
items.quote: the challenges around customer collections are , I would say, internationally handled in a more sophisticated way than I would say domestically, because things are documented on record in writing, etc etera. So, I mean, the timelines which are there in the commercial negotiations, they are usually

items.statement: Inventory positioned overseas to improve availability and reduce delivery timelines for used/refurbished equipment business
items.quote: Availability is the key differentiator, and having machines positioned closer to our customers allows us to respond faster to requirements, improve product availability, and reduce delivery timelines.

items.statement: Standalone revenue grew 37.4% YoY to INR51.29 crores; consolidated revenue grew 15.9% YoY to INR56.57 crores
items.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue from operations stood at INR51.29 crores for Q1 FY27, up 37.4% year-on-year compared with INR37.32 crores in Q1 FY26. On a consolidated basis, revenue stood at INR56.57 crores compared with INR48.82 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, representing a growth of 15.9%.

items.statement: Stronger capital base post-IPO and enhanced banking facilities provide capacity for higher volumes and international expansion
items.quote: The stronger capital base following the IPO, together with enhanced banking facilities, provides us with the capacity to support higher business volumes and continued international expansion.

items.statement: International markets across Africa, Latin America, Middle East targeted; each region large with project opportunities over next 3 years
items.quote: I think in the next 3 years, as a whole, each of these regions are very large on their own. Each of them are developing regions. Africa and Latin America are very populous regions of the world as a whole, and Middle East has a very high per capita spending capacity with a lot of infrastructure projects always going on and expected after the geopolitical situation settles.

items.statement: Meaningful improvement in returns from strategic investments expected in 3-6 quarters
items.quote: I think as the team sets in, as the system, processes, organization overall, the inventory and overall, our marketing efforts sets in, for the next 3 quarters to 6 quarters, I think we'll start seeing visibility and, you know, the increase in the numbers.

items.statement: Long-term PAT margin target of 12-15% maintained; HexL expected to become EBITDA positive as volumes scale
items.quote: We definitely plan as in the previous questions, I think we addressed that 12% to 14% PAT levels are estimated. But, of course, we are in the nascent stages, initial stages. Will require obviously a lot of marketing expenses, discounting, promotions, exhibitions, etcetera, which will not be viable at a smaller volume. As soon as the volumes pick up, all the capital goods brands or anything else ha

items.statement: Working capital cycles elongated due to geopolitical situation; inventory levels expected at similar levels plus/minus few percentage points in lower double digits
items.quote: I believe we are going to see some elongated levels of working capital cycles that we are seeing right now because of the obvious facts that geopolitical situations are in a hazy situation right now. So, we still like to keep inventory when the customers need them and availability is there, and we are seeing a healthy turnaround given the fact that we are literally in turmoil globally.

items.statement: Operational manpower costs to rise further over next few quarters to build sales, purchase and operational teams for scale
items.quote: We definitely plan to increase our sales team and purchase team and everything. Basically, operational manpower cost is going to rise over the next few quarters. And yes, the reason behind it is to get future operating leverage, which will give obviously higher revenue profitability and everything in the quarters and years to come.

items.statement: Taking substantial hit on margins from higher shipping costs; partially passing to suppliers at purchase and customers at sale
items.quote: We are taking the hit, but we are still able to grow on revenue. We are taking partial hit and we are taking -- where we are partially trying to supply, like, pass it on to the suppliers also, like, at the time of purchase, and partially trying to pass it at the time of sales. But we are taking a substantial amount of hit as well.

items.statement: New customized equipment customization seeing stronger demand due to faster availability and lower breakdown needs
items.quote: I think new equipment customization is more in demand right now because of various reasons and input prices for the end users as well. So, they are looking at faster availability and lower breakdown times, etcetera. So, I think growth can come from new customized equipment.

items.statement: Shipping cost outlook uncertain due to unpredictable oil prices and route closures extending shipping times
items.quote: But I think, I mean, it's just like that, do you know the next quarter oil prices? No one does, right? So, it's hard to know what are the oil prices, which will directly impact the shipping cost, to be, over the next few quarters.

items.statement: Debtor increase is planned strategy for overseas market penetration; longer shipping times also extending working capital cycle
items.quote: Well, I mean, the increase of debtors is a planned strategy of penetration in overseas markets. And as we are deploying manpower and people in those areas, so it is for the purpose to sell locally in those regions, achieve higher growth in sales. And I bel ieve that is the part of the reason of increase in debtors

items.statement: HexL differentiates by filling gaps in legacy brands with technological, performance and productivity features like automotive disruption
items.quote: The answer to that is we have filled a lot of gaps that international legacy brands which are old and their philosophy of making the equipment and worked in a traditional conventional way were doing. And similarly, like the automotive industry was di srupted by a few new upcoming players, we intend to do similar things by incorporating a lot of technological features or performance features and pr

items.statement: Historically H2 stronger than H1 but too early to project Q1 FY27 given geopolitical uncertainty
items.quote: I mean, we are still on quarter one. So, it's too early to comment on that and giving any forward-looking questions. But historically that has been the case. I am not able to give any forward projections on the second half right away.

items.statement: Standalone PBT INR4.15 crores vs INR4.52 crores YoY; consolidated PBT INR3.04 crores vs INR7.26 crores YoY
items.quote: Standalone profit before tax stood at INR4.15 crores compared with INR4.52 crores in Q1 FY26, while profit after tax stood at INR3.31 crores compared with INR3.76 crores. On a consolidated basis, PBT stood at INR3.04 crores compared with INR7.26 crores, and PAT stood at INR2.2 crores compared with INR6.51 crores.

items.statement: China contract manufacturing for backhoe loaders unaffected by natural calamities as production locations not impacted
items.quote: China is a very large country. I mean, in area much larger than India. So, the locations that we are presenting are not affected by any such issues.

items.statement: Africa growth partly driven by November 2025 partnership with Africa's largest equipment dealer
items.quote: It is partly due to that we have increased our efforts in Africa. And it is definitely one of the founding reasons for that.

items.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance revised upward to 70% from previous 50%
items.quote: So, we would like to revise our guidance for the full year to 70% considering the robust demand which is there and the capacities that we are ready with in Ratlam.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at sustainable to improve from current 18.9% level
items.quote: So, we have reported a 18.9% margin, so we continue that guidance.

items.statement: Cumulative gross block including CWIP expected to reach Rs. 1,300 crores by end of FY27 from Rs. 800 crores at start
items.quote: When we start this year, we were close to 800 including CWIP and we are by the end of this year, it will be close to 1.300.

items.statement: FY27 incremental capex of Rs. 500 crores funded by Rs. 200 crores debt, Rs. 100 crores IPO proceeds, Rs. 200 crores internal accruals
items.quote: There would be no equity dilution as such in this year and so on the debt side out of this Rs. 500 crores, Rs. 200 crores will be from the debt side

items.statement: Commissioned 2 GW solar panel and 2 GW power electronics at Ratlam; total panel capacity 3.5 GW, power electronics 4 GW
items.quote: During the quarter, we commissioned 2-gigawatt solar panel manufacturing facility. With the addition, our total solar panel manufacturing capacity increased to 3.5 gigawatt. Additionally, we also commissioned 2-gigawatt power electronics manufacturing facility at Ratlam in August'26.

items.statement: 2 GW lithium-ion battery plant at Ratlam on track for commissioning by Q2 FY27
items.quote: Furthermore, the 2 gigawatt lithium-ion battery manufacturing capacity at Ratlam is also on track for commissioning by Q2 FY27.

items.statement: DCR solar cell plant operating at 80%+ utilization
items.quote: S, it is operating at 80% plus utilization right now.

items.statement: New 2 GW power electronics facility at Ratlam to start at 40-50% utilization (single shift)
items.quote: Initially, in terms of figure, you can take close to 40% to 50% utilization of the capacity of Ratlam.

items.statement: TOPCon facility building completed, machine orders placed, targeting commissioning in ~9 months (Q4 FY27/Q1 FY28)
items.quote: We have set a target of Q, sir. Coming year, I mean. After 9 months we can say. Now 7.5 months remaining basically.

items.statement: Distribution network expanded to 10,100+ channel partners (80+ distributors, 1,000+ dealers, 30+ exclusive Shoppes added in Q1)
items.quote: The distribution network recorded one of its largest quarterly expansions during the quarter. We added more than 80 distributors, over 1,000 dealers, and more than 30 exclusive Shoppes. This took a total channel partners network to over 10,100 as of June '26.

items.statement: Added coverage in Odisha and Uttarakhand (now have distributor in each district and service engineer)
items.quote: So, in this immediate quarter, we have added two new more states from growing category to covered, one is Odisha and the other one is Uttarakhand.

items.statement: Target 15,000+ network partners (distributors, dealers, Shoppes) by end of FY28
items.quote: At the end of 28, we believe more than 15,000 Network partaers including Shoppe?

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 18.9% from 17.7% in Q1 FY26 driven by scale, utilization, process improvements
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 18.9% from 17.7% in Q1 FY26. The improvement in operating profitability was supported by the significant increase in business scale during the quarter.

items.statement: Passed portion of efficiency gains to customers via competitive pricing but retained sufficient margin
items.quote: Importantly, we passed on a portion of these efficiency gains to customers through competitive pricing during the quarter. Despite sharing part of these benefits with the customers, we were able to retain sufficient efficiencies within the business.

items.statement: System realization Rs. 26-30 per watt including panel, inverter, battery (varies by DCR/non-DCR, battery type, on/off-grid)
items.quote: Generally, we sce it as a per-watt, how we measure it, we see it as a per-watt realization. So, for a system with battery, generally this cost comes to close to Rs. 26 to Rs.30 per watt.

items.statement: Increased stake in Zayo Energy and Zayo Cable from 19% to 50% each for backward integration of solar module components
items.quote: During the quarter, the company increased its stake in Zayo Energy Private Limited and Zayo Cable Private Limited from 19% to 50% in each company.

items.statement: Rooftop solar potential 630+ GW (Council of Energy); government target 90-100 GW rooftop by 2030 (of 300 GW total solar); ~30 GW installed so far
items.quote: overall potential level, sir, there was one report from Council of Energy where they gave a around more than 630 gigawatt of rooftop solar potential is there. That is the one number. items.quote: While the framework is still under discussion and has not been formally notified, the proposed reports include support for the battery storage, incentives linked to actual power generation and wider access through community solar and other models.

items.statement: Bawal facility fire: Rs. 1,436 million exceptional loss recognized; assets fully insured, claim survey completed, expect settlement by end of FY27
items.quote: The incident resulted in damage to building structures, plant and machinery, inventories, and other assets with a net carrying value of Rs. 1,436 million. Accordingly, the company has recognized a provisional exception loss of Rs. 1,436 million during the quarter.

items.statement: BIS non-compliance on 15 SKUs (~Rs. 2 crores stock, <1% of inventory); certifications obtained post inspection
items.quote: We have almost 500 SKUs out of which, let's assume for a rough understanding, 250 fall in the BIS category and 50% do not. So when the team came to us, they identified 15 SKUS out of 500, 15 which according to them fell in the BIS category and according to us they did not as per their definition.

items.statement: 90% revenue from B2C channel; focus on residential rooftop (on-grid growing faster, off-grid sustained in rural)
items.quote: Yes, the primary focus s on that side as you can se that our 90% of our revenue is from B2C channel network only, so the primary target is on that side only.

items.statement: On-grid growth driven by DCR cell availability; off-grid still growing but slower; hybrid also expanding
items.quote: So definitely growth is more in on-grid now. In off-grid too it's definitely more because there we are, I mean, number one somewhere. So there is growth there too.

items.statement: Zayo Energy and Zayo Cable to supply as OEM to Fujiyama and other solar panel companies; production start next FY, target Rs. 400-500 crores top-line
items.quote: Production will start next year, sir. They have just acquired the land and building construction will start in the next 2-3 months; meanwhile, they will order machines, so they have st a target for themselves to start production within one year. In the next financial year, I think we can't expect too much, but we can expect a top-line of Rs. 400 crores, Rs. 500 crores.

items.statement: Tubular battery fire impact on gross margin <0.5% (tubular battery ~10% of revenue); renting operational plant for interim supply
items.quote: See, sir, tubular battery s generally 10% of our revenue, and we believe that at company level the impact at the gross margin level will be below 0.5%.

items.statement: Estimated ~10% market share in on-grid rooftop solar inverter segment
items.quote: Officially it's very difficult to confirm on the market share side, but we believe that in terms of inverters that we are contributing in the roofiop solar market, and now we are also supply DCR panel. So, we believe that as you rightly mention, we are we are having around 10% of on-grid market share.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin of 5-6% reaffirmed
items.quote: We remain aligned with the FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin in the range of 5% to 6%.

items.statement: Executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for execution by Dec 31, 2026
items.quote: Together, these orders represent an executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for the execution by the December 31st, 2026.

items.statement: Total order book visibility stands at approximately INR3,400 crore across confirmed POs, signed MSAs, and advanced discussions
items.quote: On order book visibility, currently stands at approximately INR3,400 crore.

items.statement: Cell line capex revised to INR1,050 crore (INR700 crore debt, INR350 crore equity) for 2.2 GW first phase
items.quote: You can consider INR1,050 crore for the 2.2 gigawatt of cell line, that is the immediate expansion plan.

items.statement: 4 GW module capacity operating as planned; FY27 average utilization assumption of 55%
items.quote: For FY27, we are working with an average utilization assumption of around 55% across the year.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 16.4% YoY; PAT margin 3.1% due to softer volumes and full quarter depreciation/interest on expanded capacity
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR33.8 crore as against the INR42.7 crore in Q1 FY26, translating into an EBITDA margin of 12.7% for the quarter as compared to 16.4% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Indian TOPCon cell cost higher than imported Chinese cells; domestic cell prices will be same for all module manufacturers
items.quote: The Indian cell cost will be higher compared to the imported right now.

items.statement: ALMM-2 timeline clarified on May 25 with no extension; caused project delays and wait-and-watch mode; government later granted extension till December for commissioning
items.quote: On 25th May, it was clarified that there would be no extension. In the weeks that followed, a number of upcoming projects were placed on hold and the market as a whole moved into a wait-and-watch mode.

items.statement: Focus on G12R TOPCon modules; first Indian manufacturer to launch G12R TOPCon; facility fully automated with MES-driven traceability
items.quote: We were the first Indian manufacturer to launch G12R TOPCon module. Our facility is fully automated and MES-driven with complete unit-level traceability.

items.statement: Customer profile includes several largest IPPs; single largest order INR600+ crore; repeat business from quality-conscious buyers with pre-dispatch inspection
items.quote: Our customer profile, which includes several of the largest IPPs in the country, is a source of strength and not a concentration risk.

items.statement: Export focus on Middle East, Africa, Europe, and US; export revenue projection for FY27 very low; building European sales team
items.quote: Our focus is majorly as far as overseas market is concerned, it's a Middle East, Africa, Europe, and we are trying to establish on US market as well.

items.statement: Cell line debt component of ~INR700 crore at advanced discussion stage with lenders; working capital met more through fund-based limits increasing finance cost
items.quote: The debt component of approximately INR700 crore is at an advanced stage of discussion with our lender.

items.statement: Equity component of INR350 crore structured as NCDs and CCDs progressing through due diligence; shifted from QIP/pref to structured debt due to market conditions
items.quote: The equity component of INR350 crore structured as a combination of NCDs and CCDs is progressing through the due diligence stage.

items.statement: Onboarding experienced TOPCon cell manufacturer on KPI-linked basis for line design, commissioning, and operations to de-risk ramp-up
items.quote: We are also onboarding an experienced TOPCon cell manufacturer on a KPI-linked basis for line design, commissioning, operations, which significantly de-risks the ramp-up phase.

items.statement: 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line (first phase of 5 GW) on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027
items.quote: The 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line, which is the first phase of our planned 5 GW cell capacity, is on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027.

items.statement: Inventory buildup seasonal; finished goods pile-up due to H1 softness and monsoon; no obsolescence risk as manufacturing latest G12R technology
items.quote: is a seasonal impact and all the inventory, so last year also if you see, the same pattern was continued and similarly in the current quarter, the current half year, the same thing is going on

items.statement: Grid stability and connectivity challenges in Gujarat due to concentrated solar generation; expected to resolve with National Green Grid and BESS
items.quote: In Gujarat, yes, there is a situation majorly because the lot of generation which is happening in Gujarat and it is to be consumed in Gujarat. That's the reason there is some load curtailment issue is going on.

items.statement: Business inherently H2 weighted; Q1 softer due to ALMM uncertainty, monsoon, and seasonal patterns; H2 execution expected to cover shortfall
items.quote: Our business is closely linked to utility-scale solar project execution in India, and it is inherently H2 weighted. The first half of the fiscal year is seasonally softer, and the second half is when the bulk of module dispatches, EPC completion, and the revenue conversion happens.

items.statement: Chinese manufacturers aggressive on pricing overseas; Solex targets markets with preference for Indian modules; Indian modules at par or better on quality
items.quote: Chinese have their own business strategy and they are very aggressive in the overseas market. Solex is finding place where there is some preference for the Indian module manufacturer.

items.statement: No orders at risk from ALMM; timing shifts not cancellations; prepared for both ALMM compliant and non-compliant scenarios with domestic and imported cell supply
items.quote: These are the timing shifts and not cancellations. We do not currently see any orders at risk and whether ALMM is extended at any stage or not, there is no impact on our order book because we are prepared for both scenarios.

items.statement: BSE listing completed (existing shares, no fresh capital); now listed on both NSE and BSE with 11,000+ shareholders
items.quote: First, we have completed our listing on BSE Limited. Solex Energy is now listed on both the NSE and the BSE. Kindly note, this was a listing of existing shares on the BSE main board. No fresh capital was raised.

items.statement: Targeting VAS proportion of 50-60% over next 2-3 years
items.quote: Encouraged by the recent performance and positive outcomes of our strategic focus, we are targeting proportion of VAS products at about 50% to 60% over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Expecting revenue of INR2,000-2,200 crores in next 2-3 years
items.quote: Yes. I think we are steadily marching towards that, and we should definitely be hitting there in next 2 years to 3 years.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers targeting 20% CAGR over next 3-5 years
items.quote: We are targeting growth at a CAGR of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years in the Specialty Polymer segment.

items.statement: ELITe facility targeted to become operational in CY 2028
items.quote: The facility is targeted to become operational in CY 2028 and will use Loop's proprietary depolymerization technology to convert 100% textile waste streams into virgin-quality monomers.

items.statement: Debt repayment target of INR100 crores for FY27
items.quote: So, this year, the debt repayment target is around INR100 crores.

items.statement: No major capex planned for FY27 beyond sustenance and maintenance
items.quote: No. So, apart from our sustenance and maintenance capex, we are not planning any major capex.

items.statement: Strong structural tailwinds from circular economy and plastic waste management rules
items.quote: We continue to see strong structural tailwinds emerging from the circular economy. The implementation of plastic waste management rules and the increasing requirement for the PET and BOPET films, which stipulate post-consumer recycled content, are creating additional demand opportunities for rPET and recycled content BOPET films.

items.statement: Regained lost US market share in Q1 FY27 after Supreme Court rejection of tariffs
items.quote: India now enjoys a favourable import tariff scenario for imports into U.S. This has resulted in regaining of lost market share in U.S. between Q2 and Q4 of FY26 in this quarter.

items.statement: Expecting sustainable good earnings for next 6-8 quarters due to favorable supply-demand balance
items.quote: So, all this give us confidence that we should have sustainable good earnings going forward, not only for the next 3 quarters, but I would go on to say, for next 6 to 8 quarters.

items.quote: Consequently, EBIT margin improved to 9.8% from 2.4%.

items.quote: segment EBIT stood at INR14.8 crores with EBIT margin improving significantly to 45.3% from 31.7%.

items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA increased 103.4% to INR58.9 crores with the EBITDA margin expanding to 13.3% from 8.3% in the corresponding quarter.

items.value: INR25 to much, much higher levels

items.quote: Following Nike's earlier commitment as an anchor customer, our JV partner, Loop Industries has now secured a letter of intent from a leading global sports and athletic brand for the potential offtake of up to 15,000 metric tons per year of Loop PET fibre-grade resin annually under a multiyear commercial framework.

items.quote: Consolidated capacity utilization also improved to 84% compared with 82% in Q1 FY 26, supported by the better market scenario.

items.quote: See, we are seeing up to 35% contribution of VAS product out of our own -- up to the overall portfolio by the quarter end, I mean, in the exit quarter.

items.quote: So we have long-term contracts, and we are sourcing all our requirement of PTA and MEG locally. So, we have long-term contract with the suppliers of PTA and MEG, which ensures that we generally don't run short of the requirement that we have.

And in case there is a tighter scrutiny from the government and the compliance is enforced even more strictly, they can rapidly switch to rPET content-based films.

items.quote: As on 30th June 2026, the gross total debt of the company was INR722 crores and liquidity of INR236 crores. The company aims to gradually deleverage in the coming years by paring its debt on an overall basis.

items.quote: Consolidated film volumes increased 2.7% year -on-year to 22,120 metric tons, whi le film segment revenue grew by approximately 38% to INR399.5

items.quote: The volumes have grown by 5% and the pricing inflation that came in was almost about 12%.

items.quote: Revenue from nutraceuticals stood at INR18 crores with sports nutrition gaining significant momentum.

items.quote: Nutrela is a strong brand, we nearly have 40% market share . And so this quarter, for example, we did INR160 crores of business.

items.quote: On one hand, we carry long positions in edible oils, so the resulting commodity price inflation has actually been a net positive for the business. items.statement: Revenue guidance of around 300 crores for FY27 reaffirmed
